Location: Multiple Locations Across Assam(Guwahati,Dibrugarh,Jorhat,Nagaon,Silchar,Hojai)

Description:
Support the development and implementation of Monitoring & Evaluation (M&E) plans for Sub-Recipients (SRs) and Sub-Sub Recipients (SSRs).
Collect, compile, analyze, and review program data from SSRs to ensure data quality, accuracy, and timely feedback.
Coordinate with State AIDS Control Societies, DAPCU, and other stakeholders to facilitate data sharing and program monitoring.
Ensure timely submission of monthly, quarterly, and other periodic reports.
Develop and strengthen monitoring tools, reporting formats, and data management systems for SRs and state-level partners.
Maintain and manage MIS data and program indicators, conduct periodic data analysis, and generate reports to support evidence-based program planning and decision-making.
Support the implementation and effective utilization of the online SOCH application and other digital reporting platforms.
Assist SSRs in establishing and strengthening systems to ensure donor compliance and reporting requirements.
Conduct regular field monitoring visits to validate reported data, improve data quality, and provide on-site technical support to CSC staff.
Build the capacity of community staff on data collection tools, reporting procedures, and M&E methodologies through training and supportive supervision.
Develop and implement capacity-building plans for CSC 2.0 staff and Community Champions.
Plan, coordinate, monitor, and evaluate training programs using pre/post assessments, feedback mechanisms, and training evaluation tools.
Coordinate with internal teams and external stakeholders to organize and facilitate training programs and workshops.
Support cascade training initiatives by effectively utilizing the project resource pool and master trainers.
Maintain comprehensive training records, documentation, and reports, and share them with the Programme Manager.
Perform any other programmatic, M&E, or capacity-building responsibilities assigned by the Reporting Manager.
Degree in Social Science, Economics, Statistics, Population Studies (Demography), public health or development field (or equivalent).
At least 2 to 5 years of relevant monitoring and evaluation experience in the development sector.
Experience in the public health sector especially HIV/AIDS/ Tuberculosis will be an added advantage for selection besides qualification.

Strong knowledge of Monitoring, Evaluation, and Management Information Systems (MIS).
Proficiency in data collection, validation, analysis, and reporting.
Experience with SOCH Application
Good understanding of HIV/AIDS programs and National AIDS Control Programme (NACP).
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and data management tools.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Ability to conduct field monitoring, data quality assessments, and supportive supervision.
Experience in planning and delivering training and capacity-building programs.
Strong communication, coordination, and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities under deadlines.
Willingness to travel extensively to project locations.

Description:
About Us:
Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytms mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.

About the Role:
Paytm is looking for an experienced sales professional & people manager to be a part of the QR & Sound Box vertical.

Expectations/ Requirements:
1.Growth of distribution and market share in the assigned area of operations.
2.Visibility & accountability through extensive QR & Sound box deployment and sale of the product .
3.Identify and recruit the sales team to align and drive business in the market.
4.Plan the market size, span and geographies for ASMs .
5.Devise best methods for communication of plans/targets to the team so as to minimize the expectations vs delivery gap.
6.Monitor the quality parameters as suggested by the management.
7.Validate and conduct audits on the acquisitions and sales done by the team.
8. People manage a large team of 5-10 TSMs & 200+ indirect employees.

Must Have: Should have good networking capabilities and be willing to travel extensively throughout their specified area. Skilled in coaching and mentoring, a quick learner who grasps and puts into application the new learnt ideas and concepts.

Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role :
1. Self-starters, who can take ownership and are comfortable navigating ambiguity, will be an ideal fit. 8-12 years experience in sales - business development, B2C markets
2. Passionate about working in a fast growing firms and large team handling.
3. Articulate complex solutions to novice customers.
4. Good sales and negotiation skills. Experience in quota driven sales is a must.
5. Experience in payments and finance is a plus - though not mandatory

Why join us
A collaborative output driven program that brings cohesiveness across businesses through technology
Improve the average revenue per use by increasing the cross-sell opportunities
A solid 360 feedback from your peer teams on your support of their goals.
Respect, that is earned, not demanded from your peers and manager

Compensation:
If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you with enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 21 mn+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants and we are committed to it. Indias largest digital lending story is brewing here. It’s your opportunity to be a part of the story!

Description:
Support the development and implementation of Monitoring & Evaluation (M&E) plans for Sub-Recipients (SRs) and Sub-Sub Recipients (SSRs).
Collect, compile, analyze, and review program data from SSRs to ensure data quality, accuracy, and timely feedback.
Coordinate with State AIDS Control Societies, DAPCU, and other stakeholders to facilitate data sharing and program monitoring.
Ensure timely submission of monthly, quarterly, and other periodic reports.
Develop and strengthen monitoring tools, reporting formats, and data management systems for SRs and state-level partners.
Maintain and manage MIS data and program indicators, conduct periodic data analysis, and generate reports to support evidence-based program planning and decision-making.
Support the implementation and effective utilization of the online SOCH application and other digital reporting platforms.
Assist SSRs in establishing and strengthening systems to ensure donor compliance and reporting requirements.
Conduct regular field monitoring visits to validate reported data, improve data quality, and provide on-site technical support to CSC staff.
Build the capacity of community staff on data collection tools, reporting procedures, and M&E methodologies through training and supportive supervision.
Develop and implement capacity-building plans for CSC 2.0 staff and Community Champions.
Plan, coordinate, monitor, and evaluate training programs using pre/post assessments, feedback mechanisms, and training evaluation tools.
Coordinate with internal teams and external stakeholders to organize and facilitate training programs and workshops.
Support cascade training initiatives by effectively utilizing the project resource pool and master trainers.
Maintain comprehensive training records, documentation, and reports, and share them with the Programme Manager.
Perform any other programmatic, M&E, or capacity-building responsibilities assigned by the Reporting Manager.
Degree in Social Science, Economics, Statistics, Population Studies (Demography), public health or development field (or equivalent).
At least 2 to 5 years of relevant monitoring and evaluation experience in the development sector.
Experience in the public health sector especially HIV/AIDS/ Tuberculosis will be an added advantage for selection besides qualification.

Strong knowledge of Monitoring, Evaluation, and Management Information Systems (MIS).
Proficiency in data collection, validation, analysis, and reporting.
Experience with SOCH Application
Good understanding of HIV/AIDS programs and National AIDS Control Programme (NACP).
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and data management tools.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Ability to conduct field monitoring, data quality assessments, and supportive supervision.
Experience in planning and delivering training and capacity-building programs.
Strong communication, coordination, and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities under deadlines.
Willingness to travel extensively to project locations.

 Key Roles and Responsibilities

Report identified gaps, challenges, and action points to DAPCU, DISHA, and DTO to facilitate timely resolution and follow-up.

Support and Implement Prison Intervention and CSC Activities in the assigned district.

Visit ART centre, in rotation, to support ART counsellors by providing peer counselling to PLHIV newly initiated on ART to help them understand the benefits of treatment, address misconceptions and equip them with information & coping skills to manage possible side effects of ART.
Give information regarding the services of CSC at the ART centre and motivate the newly registered PLHIV to avail care and support services.
Support PLHIV in completing all baseline investigations and other tests from the hospital at the time of ART initiation. Support ART refill in case the CSC is engaged in community-based ART dispensing.
Facilitate support group meetings at CSC, ART centre or other convenient sites.
Provide peer counselling on treatment adherence, positive living and related topics during their visit to CSC
Ensure tracking for all priority indicators.
Organize community events with help of PC (e.g, health camps, fairs, festivals)
Organize and participate in advocacy activities, including rapport building with different stakeholders.
Facilitate linkage of PLHIV diagnosed HIV positive at the ICTC- to the nearest ART Centre for ensuring rapid initiation of ART.
Ensure systematic tracking of LFU cases and facilitate their link back to treatment.
Provide support to the ARTC to verify the address of the PLHIV newly initiated on ART.
Conduct proactive follow-up of PWLHIV to ensure treatment adherence, linkage to periodic ANC check-up, VL test during 32-36 weeks of pregnancy, institutional delivery, and post-natal care towards elimination of Vertical Transmission of HIV. After due consent from the PWLHIV, link them to ASHA / ANM and NHM facilities for ANC/PNC related care, ensuring confidentiality of the HIV status.
Follow-up of HIV exposed infants (HEI), ensuring life-saving ARV prophylaxis drugs, and adhering to the EID test schedule for up to 18 months of age or 3 months after cessation of breastfeeding, whichever is later.
Conduct follow-up of Sero-discordant couples and follow up of PLHIV who are overdue for VL testing.
Engage in follow-up with PLHIV to enhance treatment adherence and retention in HIV care.
Facilitate form filling for social entitlements, collect them from households, and hand them to the CSC Coordinator/Project Coordinator
Further, undertake any other project-related tasks assigned by the CSC Coordinator/Project Coordinator
8th pass with the basic understanding of CST programme for PLHIV. The candidate should preferably be from the community

Ability to conduct interpersonal communication (IPC), counseling, and group awareness sessions.
Effective communication skills with fluency in the local language.
Good interpersonal and relationship-building skills.

Knowledge of HIV/AIDS, TB, STI, and other public health issues (preferred).
Basic documentation, record-keeping, and reporting skills.
Ability to work independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team.
Proficiency in using smartphones and basic MS Office applications for data reporting.
Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned project area.
Problem-solving skills and ability to work with marginalized and vulnerable communities.
Commitment to confidentiality, ethics, and a non-discriminatory approach.

Shyam Sundar Co Jewellers is looking for a Social Media Live Anchor to host engaging Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube Live sessions. Title: Marketing Executive
Skills: Skills highlighted with ‘‘ are preferred keyskills, Community outreachPatient AquisitionReferral BusinessCorporate & Institutional Tie-upsDoctor network, Target AchievementStrategic ThinkingPersuasion and negotiationLead business development, About company, Desun Hospital: Trusted name in advanced healthcare and patient care excellence.
Description:
Role & responsibilities
Job Summary
The Hospital Marketing Executive will be responsible for promoting the hospital's healthcare services, boosting patient conversions, and strengthening the hospitals brand presence across Agartala. This role involves balancing community-level outreach with structured corporate B2B networking to establish a steady channel of patient referrals.

Key Responsibilities & Duties
Referral Network Management (B2B Outreach):Meet and build working relationships with local diagnostic centres, clinics, and independent physicians across Agartala and neighbouring districts to secure patient referrals.
Corporate & Institutional Tie-ups: Pitch, negotiate, and finalize healthcare service contracts with local corporate offices, banks, government departments, and NGOs for institutional health packages and employee wellness plans.
Community Health Initiatives: Plan, organize, and execute local health camps, free check-up drives, seminars and awareness programs in urban and rural community pockets.
Brand Visibility & Collateral: Coordinate the distribution of marketing materials (brochures, tariff flyers, banners) across the facility and target client zones. Work alongside the administrative team to market specific specialties (e.g.,Cardiology, Orthopedics).
Reporting & Market Intelligence: Conduct fieldwork to map competitor pricing, tracking patient footfall patterns, and compiling weekly or monthly ROI reports for upper management.
Patient: Directing and facilitating patient referrals to Desun Hospital, Kolkata for advanced medical care.

Preferred candidate profile
Education: Graduate degree; a Bachelors in Business Administration (BBA), MBA (Marketing), Mass Communication, or healthcare/ pharmacy background is preferred.
Experience: Generally, 1 to 4 years of experience in hospital sales, healthcare promotions, or medical representative (MR) field roles.
Skills: Functional proficiency in MS Office (for tracking targets), outstanding negotiation tactics, and a strong understanding of hospital workflows.
Language & Travel: Fluency in Bengali, English and Assamese is highly beneficial for local community camp execution. Candidates must own a two-wheeler for regular field visits.
AboutCompany:
Desun Hospital: Trusted name in advanced healthcare and patient care excellence.

Desun Hospital is the first in India to have a rooftop helipad, improving emergency healthcare services in Eastern India. This unique feature ensures quicker access to critical care, offering faster treatment for patients in urgent need.

DESUN Hospital enjoys the distinction of being the first Superspeciality hospital in the Kolkata region.

We at Desun, stand before you with unwavering commitment to our shared vision. Our mission is clear to deliver unparalleled healthcare services accessible to all. We believe in healing with compassion, combining cutting-edge technology with a human touch. Our pledge is to make quality healthcare affordable, ensuring no one is denied the right to well-being. Together, we embark on a journey where health knows no boundaries. Let this hospital be a sanctuary of hope, where the pursuit of wellness is not a privilege but a right.
CompanyAddress: 720,Anandapur, EM Bypass, Kasba Golpark, Kolkata, West Bengal, India

Description:
We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced Counselor to join our team in the education industry. The ideal candidate will have 2 to 5 years of experience, excellent communication skills, and a strong passion for helping students achieve their academic goals.
Roles and Responsibility
Provide individual and group counseling sessions to help students develop coping strategies and techniques.
Conduct workshops and seminars on topics such as time management, study skills, and career development.
Collaborate with teachers and other staff members to identify areas where students need additional support.
Develop and implement programs to promote student well-being and success.
Maintain accurate records of counseling sessions and student progress.
Participate in professional development opportunities to stay current with best practices in counseling.
Job Requirements
Minimum 2 years of experience in counseling or a related field.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work effectively with diverse groups of students.
Strong knowledge of counseling theories and practices.
Experience working in an educational setting is preferred.
Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information.
A graduate degree is required for this position.

Description:
Role & responsibilities
Weeks 12

Read the existing system. Written plan: multi-tenancy model, module order, what to keep and what to rewrite. Signed off before you build.
Weeks 36

Multi-tenant core — tenant isolation, SSO, RBAC, audit trail. Existing procurement and stores running on it, no loss of function.
Weeks 7–10

Projects Monitoring & Tracking Progress against plan (both material and labour) and cost control module. CI/CD, automated tests and monitoring in place — not retrofitted later.
Weeks 11–14

Finance interface (GST, Tally/ERP export) and reporting. Pilot rollout to two sites, users trained.
Weeks 15–60

Hardening, defect burn-down, documentation and handover pack. Company-wide rollout, supported by you.

Preferred candidate profile
Front end

React + TypeScript (primary), Angular useful. Component Design, Responsive layout, PWA and Offline-first behaviour.
Back end

Python (FastAPI/Django) and/or Node.js. REST and SOA APIs, microservices where they earn it, serverless where they do not.
Data

Supabase/PostgreSQL to a high standard — schema design, indexing, query plans, transactions. NoSQL and object storage where justified.
Middleware

Redis caching and invalidation, message queue or event bus, API gateway, CDN.
Test & debug

Unit, integration and end-to-end (Playwright/Cypress). Profiling, tracing, reading a live incident to root cause.
Creation and maintenance of test, staging, & production environment
Ship & run

Docker, cloud-native deployment, Jenkins and GitHub Actions, Jira, observability. You support what you ship.

Description:
We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced Program Manager to lead our district leadership and capacity building efforts. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in managing programs and leading teams, with excellent communication and leadership skills.

Roles and Responsibility


Develop and implement effective program management strategies to achieve organizational goals.

Lead and manage a team of professionals, providing guidance and support to ensure success.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify and prioritize project requirements.

Analyze data and metrics to measure program performance and make informed decisions.

Build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders, including partners and vendors.

Identify and mitigate risks associated with program implementation.


Job Requirements


Proven experience in program management, with a minimum of 5 years in a similar role.

Strong understanding of program management principles and practices.

Excellent leadership and communication skills, with the ability to motivate and inspire teams.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and accuracy.

Ability to work in a fast-paced environment, prioritizing multiple tasks and deadlines.

Strong knowledge of education industry trends and best practices.


About Company

Adhyayan Quality Education Foundation is a non-profit organization dedicated to improving educational outcomes for all students. We believe that quality education is a fundamental right, and we are committed to making a positive impact on the lives of thousands of students each year.

Description:
Job Purpose
1. Drive sales growth of solar products through distributor training and customer engagement.
2. Expand the dealer and distributor network by onboarding high-potential partners from the solar industry and competitors.
3. Build long-term trust with channel partners to ensure Loom Solar remains their first choice for solar solutions.
Primary Responsibilities
Meet retail shops, solar dealers, and distributors daily (minimum 10 visits) to promote Loom Solar products.
Conduct cold calling to prospective solar dealers/customers to generate new business opportunities.
Develop a strong dealer network by generating leads and converting them into active partners.
Negotiate with dealers to position Loom Solar as their preferred brand, ensuring competitive edge over other solar companies.
Prepare and share customized quotations for solar product orders.
Update all visits, leads, and sales data in the company sales application.
Respond to dealer queries promptly to build strong relationships.
Ensure 30 days stock availability with channel partners to support smooth order fulfillment.
Track distributor/dealer stock movement and secondary/tertiary sales of solar products.
Conduct dealer/distributor training sessions and meetings to enhance product knowledge and trust.



Requirements

Qualifications Skills
Any Graduate.
25 years of experience in solar product sales / channel sales / electrical product sales.
Strong knowledge of solar panels, inverters, batteries, and rooftop solar solutions.
Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
Willingness to travel extensively to meet dealers and distributors.
Self-driven, target-oriented, and passionate about renewable energy.



Benefits
Any Graduate.
15 years of experience in solar product sales / channel sales / electrical product sales.
Strong knowledge of solar panels, inverters, batteries, and rooftop solar solutions.
Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
Willingness to travel extensively to meet dealers and distributors.
Self-driven, target-oriented, and passionate about renewable energy.

Description:
As an Academic Publishing Consultant , you will be responsible for assisting our clients with identifying suitable journals for their manuscripts. You will consider manuscript scope, indexing requirements, and author preferences to help researchers navigate the publication process smoothly. This consultancy role will be highly flexible and project-based, offering the opportunity to work on diverse and impactful research projects across multiple disciplines.
Key Responsibilities
Journal Identification : Analyze manuscripts to recommend the most suitable journals based on their subject matter, scope, indexing needs, and author preferences.
Submission Guidance : Provide authors with expert advice on the submission process, including manuscript formatting, peer review, and editorial expectations.
Indexing Consultation : Advise authors on journal indexing requirements (e.g., Scopus, Web of Science, PubMed, etc.) and ensure the selected journals meet these criteria.
Collaboration : Work closely with researchers, authors, and internal teams to deliver high-quality, timely consultancy services.
Up-to-date Knowledge : Stay informed on the latest trends in academic publishing, journal impact factors, open access policies, and publishing ethics.
Qualifications & Skills
Educational Requirements
PhD in a relevant field (e.g., Science, Engineering, Medicine, Social Sciences, or Humanities).
Additional certification or training in academic publishing , research communication , or library/information science is highly desirable.
Professional Experience
Minimum of 2 3 years experience in academic publishing or editorial consultancy, particularly in journal selection and manuscript submission processes.
Familiarity with manuscript submission systems (e.g., ScholarOne, Editorial Manager, Open Journal System etc.) and the peer review process .
Demonstrated expertise in journal selection across various fields, including knowledge of impact factors, citation metrics , and open access options.
Technical & Analytical Skills
Proficient in using reference management tools (e.g., EndNote, Mendeley, Zotero).
In-depth knowledge of indexing databases (e.g., Scopus, Web of Science, PubMed, DOAJ).
Familiarity with journal ranking systems (e.g., Impact Factor, CiteScore, SNIP).
Ability to assess the scope and relevance of journals in line with manuscript requirements.
Soft Skills
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
Strong analytical abilities and attention to detail.
Ability to work independently in a remote, project-based environment.
Knowledge of current trends and challenges in academic publishing.
Compensation
This is a project-based consultancy role with compensation mutually agreed upon based on the project scope , complexity , and timeline . We offer competitive rates and ensure that our consultants are compensated according to the quality and scale of the work involved.
Mode of Selection:
Initial Interview : To assess your experience, background, and approach to secondary data collection and literature review.
Technical Assignment : A practical assignment to evaluate your research and data collection skills.
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an interview. Those who clear the interview stage will be given a technical assignment as the final step in the selection process.
Why Join DSCHOLAR RESEARCH CONSULTANCY AND ANALYTICS?
Flexible, Remote Work : Enjoy the freedom to work from anywhere in the world.
Impactful Work : Be part of a team that directly contributes to the success of academic researchers and the broader research community.
Competitive Compensation : Receive competitive compensation rates based on your expertise and the project s requirements.
Collaborative Environment : Work alongside a team of professionals passionate about academic research and publishing.
Equal Opportunity:
DSCHOLAR RESEARCH CONSULTANCY AND ANALYTICS is committed to promoting a culture of inclusion and diversity. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and identities. We strongly believe in providing equal opportunities for growth, advancement, and professional development.

Description:
Experience: 3+ years

Role Overview:
The Finance Admin Officer is responsible for strengthening and maintaining the organisations financial and administrative systems. This role supports effective budget management, accurate documentation, vendor coordination, and logistics administration while ensuring full compliance with statutory, regulatory, and donor requirements
Key Responsibilities:
1. Finance and Compliance
Policy Adherence: Ensure compliance with all financial and administrative policies and procedures.
Grant Management: Maintain donor-wise accounting, track grant conditions and utilization limits, and support donor financial reporting.
Reporting Audits: Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual reports for auditing and donor requirements. Provide support for both internal and external audits.
Budgeting: Plan, track, and report on budget utilization against monthly and quarterly milestones.
Statutory Compliance: Ensure adherence to all statutory requirements, including TDS, GST, PF, and Gratuity.
Payroll Procurement: Process payroll in coordination with HR. Review procurement proposals for financial compliance and validate vendor documentation.
System Management: Support the use and improvement of accounting/ERP systems and digital record management.
2. Effective and Efficient Administration
Procurement: Ensure all procurements comply with internal policies.
Vendor Management: Select and manage vendors for travel, office equipment, stationary, and maintenance to ensure cost-effective services.
Safety Security: Ensure proper safety measures are followed for employees during work hours and travel.
Consultant Support: Support consultants for programme implementation as per agreed terms of reference.
Qualification and Skills:
Education: Bachelors degree in Accounting or Finance.
Experience: Minimum of three years experience in accounting and administration within an NGO.
Technical Knowledge: Strong understanding of accounting principles, statutory compliances, and donor-funded project requirements.
Software: Proficiency in Accounting/reporting tools, ERPs, and Microsoft Office (Excel, Word).
Soft Skills:
Exceptional project management and data analysis skills.
Effective communication skills in English.
Ability to manage multiple deadlines and prioritize tasks independently.
Strong interpersonal and networking abilities.
AboutCompany:
Ground Zero is a nonprofit-focused organization that strengthens Indias social impact ecosystem by connecting talent with NGOs and development programs. It operates as a hiring and career platform, managing end-to-end recruitment for roles in education, healthcare, fundraising, operations, and program management across India and South Asia. With a mission to build capacity in the nonprofit sector, Ground Zero positions itself as a trusted partner for organizations seeking skilled professionals and for individuals pursuing impactful careers in social development.

Stay updated on product knowledge and sales techniques to enhance performance and productivity.

Job Description:
Central Medical Services Society (CMSS), (An autonomous body under Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Govt. of India), is seeking a skilled and dedicated Junior Pharmacist on the payroll of LRS Services Pvt. Ltd. The ideal candidate will have experience in pharmaceutical storage, distribution, and regulatory compliance.
Key Responsibilities:
Manage pharmaceutical store/warehouse/distribution functions efficiently.
Ensure adherence to Good Storage and Distribution Practices (GSDP) in line with GMP regulations.
Support regulatory audits related to store/warehouse and distribution operations.
Maintain and update inventory records in the ERP system.
Assist in maintaining compliance with all pharmaceutical storage and distribution guidelines.
Eligibility Criteria:
Age: Below 40 years as of the date of deployment (relaxation may be considered in exceptional cases).
Educational Qualification:
Diploma in Pharmacy (D. Pharma) or
Bachelor s Degree in Pharmacy (B. Pharma) from a recognized university/institute approved by the Pharmacy Council of India.
Experience:
Minimum 2 years of post-qualification experience for D. Pharma holders.
Minimum 1 year of post-qualification experience for B. Pharma holders.
Skills and Knowledge:
Familiarity with Good Storage & Distribution Practices (GSDP) as per GMP regulations.
Experience in handling regulatory audits.
Proficiency in ERP systems.
Strong command of English (both written and verbal).
Knowledge of the local language is desirable.
Additional Information:
Candidates with exceptional qualifications or experience may receive age and experience relaxation. This is a dynamic role requiring attention to detail, strong organizational skills, and a commitment to maintaining high pharmaceutical standards.

LRS services is an integrated and innovative technology firm providing managed IT services, maintenance services, staffing services and hardware support globally. Offering customized service solutions and hardware that help customers to reduce overall costs and minimize risk in all phases of their IT life cycle.

Description:
IC/PM
Individual Contributor Role
Company Profile
Jaquar Group is a prominent Indian conglomerate established in 1960 that operates in the bathroom and lighting industry headquartered in Gurugram and has a global presence with manufacturing facilities, subsidiaries, and distribution networks in various countries. Jaquar has grown to become one of the leading manufacturers of premium bathroom fittings, sanitary ware, faucets, showers, wellness products, and lighting solutions.
Our Values
At Jaquar Group, our values guide everything we do. As part of our team, you will be expected to uphold these principles:
Passion for technology – We innovate continuously
Highest quality standards – We strive for excellence
Building strong relationships – We value lasting partnerships
Excellent customer service – We prioritize customer satisfaction
Taking care of our people – We support and nurture our team
Integrity – We uphold the highest ethical standards
About the Role
As a Sales Generation Specialist (SGS), you will drive sales and revenue growth by converting leads into successful deals, educating channel partners about product offerings, and ensuring maximum product visibility in the market. You will play a key role in building strong relationships with dealers, builders, and end customers while implementing strategic promotional activities to enhance market penetration and brand loyalty.
Key Responsibilities
Convert the prospect pipeline generated by MDS into successful sales
Educate dealers and key decision-makers about product’s range, USPs, and benefits
Achieve product’s sales value and quantity targets across various categories
Generate demand for the products within specified channel partners or geographical areas
Ensure maximum display and visibility of products at dealer showrooms through effective EDS management
Maintain brand hygiene and ensure compliance with company pricing and promotional guidelines
Visit dealers as per MCP, encouraging them to sell products independently. Provide technical education to dealer sales staff and identify experts at counters for advanced training
Conduct training sessions at dealer sales counters, including role plays and practical demonstrations
Resolve dealer issues and escalate them timely if needed
Demonstrate the sales process to dealer staff and spend 2-3 hours daily at the dealer counter
Conduct site visits to end customers and promote the products & concepts
Convert retail builders of the branch into sales, add new builders, and share a universe of builders and architects monthly
Implement promotional activities and local events to increase product visibility and market penetration
Conduct architect activities at various outlets such as Orientation Centres (OC), Atelier, Jaquar World (JW), etc.
Collaborate with the branch CC team to conduct plumber training sessions
Gather and share information on competitors' activities, product development, benchmarking, etc.
Key Attributes
Excellent communication, interpersonal, and relationship-building skills
Strong product knowledge and ability to communicate value propositions effectively
Proven ability to drive revenue growth
Expertise in expanding and managing dealer networks
Ability to gather and analyze market and competitor data to inform strategies
Proficiency in MS Office Suite and CRM software (preferred) and Sales software
Proven ability to deliver engaging presentations and product training sessions
Competencies
Customer Focus
Negotiation Skills
Presentation Skills
Competitor Analysis and Market Development
Qualifications and Experience
Education: Graduation/Post Graduation preferred
Experience: Proven track record of 4-6 years’ experience in sales or related field
Skills:
Excellent verbal and written communication skills with pleasing personality, including ability to effectively communicate with internal and external customers
Time management and organizational skills
Analytical skills for tracking sales performance and network productivity
Initiative and drive to meet and exceed sales targets
Ability to travel within the assigned territory
Company Commitment to Equal Opportunity Employment
Jaquar Group is committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, gender, national orientation or disability.
Reach Us At
Jaquar and Company Private Limited
Plot No.3, Sector – 11, IMT Manesar
Gurgaon, Haryana – 122050
www.jaquar.com

To ensure all Security Associates are aware of and adhering to the company Policies and Procedures.
Conducts an effective shift hand over, including briefing all staff of relevant events and information, taking possession of departmental property and responsibility for their safekeeping
Initiates investigation of crimes committed against property and persons, writes incident and accident reports, monitors investigations to their timely conclusion and ensures appropriate follow-up with guests, visitors, employees, reports and documenting contacts.
Be correct, secure and courteous in handling any disciplinary or criminal case.
Observe and report all identified violations of company Policies and Procedures, suspicious activities and criminal acts to Company Management.
Responsible for the security of the Hotels assets including but not limited to guests, colleagues, contractors and visitors.
Observe and report to company management all identified security hazards.
Maintain a high level of discipline punctuality along with regular attendance as required by the standards.
Record all observed incidents on a daily log of incidents and submit same to Company Management.
Conduct locker checks in line with Human Resources when requested
Coordinate functions with other security staff or external agencies such as Police, Civil Defence and other government departments, promoting good will with them.
Be alert for any unusual packages, guests or vehicles, taking appropriate action if located.
Be thoroughly familiar of the property layout, design, entry and exit points.
Ensure that the Security Control Room and Fire Control Rooms are never left unattended.
To attend regular training within the department.
Make way by escorting VIPs and dignitaries when directed and direct traffic away from Lobby and other busy thoroughfares.
Attend to all guest inquiries and requests immediately, with respect and to a high standard of customer service.
To strictly adhere to the hotels policy on confidentiality and ethics.
Responsible for the safety of guests, colleagues, contractors and visitors.
Observe and report to Safety Security Management all property defects, safety hazards and fire life safety matters requiring attention.
Initiate action to improve a hazardous situation immediately.
In the event of fire or any emergent situation, respond in the first instance and take appropriate action as guided by the companys emergency plan immediately, efficiently and calmly.
Have a full and comprehensive working knowledge of locations of fire indication panels, public address system, fire alarms and fire fighting equipment.
Ensure visual checks are conducted on fire hose reel outlets, fire fighting equipment and all other safety equipment, ensuring that all are in good working order, immediately taking action of any item of equipment which is faulty.
Conduct briefings to events delegates and guests as required regarding the hotels fire safety and evacuation management plan

Minimum two years experience in similar role within a 5 Star Hotel/Hospitality sector and have a good knowledge of Local legislation and best practice.

Description:
At voco , we ve created a hotel brand that gives people a different choice. Hotels to count on but different enough to be fun. Unstuffy hotels, where people feel comfortable to relax, and just get on with relaxing. Our new family of hotels are connected by their own sense of style and individual character - and that s something we make the most of. Finding the perfect mix of reliability and new experiences. Because we believe that when you respect individuality life gets interesting.
Duties and responsibilities
Financial returns:
Sell the hotel products and services using up-selling and suggestive selling techniques
Prepare and execute action plans which increase reservation sales and associated business
Record special billing arrangements for groups and conventions
Liaise with Guest Service Leader or Finance Manager for all reservations requiring credit approval
Maintain knowledge of special rates/ offers/ promotions
Monitor reservation levels and inform Managers of current and future occupancy rates
Prepare reports as requested (eg to travel agents, business houses etc)
Prepare reservation sales reports
People:
Promote the one team approach and reliable service through daily communication and coordination with all team members.
Works with superior on manpower planning and management needs.
Works with superior in the preparation and management of the Department s budget
Guest experience:
Answer any guests enquires practically and simply in adherence to brand standards.
Handle guests complaints appropriately adhering to brand standards or direct them to GSL s.
Reliably handle all special needs and requests of guests and repeat visitors.
Process amendments to reservations such as extensions, early departures,
Manage no show reservations by investigation and recording of same
Record and process reservations made by phone/fax/email
Accept wait list reservations
Demonstrate Brand Hearted behaviours by maintaining compliance with all brand standards, behaviours, hallmarks and license agreement mandates.
Handle Telephone Enquires efficiently and effectively
Work closely across all hotel departments, seeking proactive opportunities to address specific business challenges, as required
Manage and promote the hotel on IHG brand website.
Produce monthly reports as required
Responsible business:
Demonstrate awareness of Occupational Health and Safety Responsibilities (OHS) policies and procedures and ensure all procedures are conducted safely and within OHS guidelines
Be familiar with property safety, first aid and fire and emergency procedures and operate equipment safely and sensibly
Support the hotel s corporate responsibility initiatives in the areas of community involvement, environment management, workplace health safety and food safety, drive action plans as required to achieve hotel corporate responsibility objectives.
Engage in the hotel CSR activities on timely manner.
Accountability
This is the top Marketing Communications/PR job in a full or limited service hotel and may include meeting space and/or catering facilities. May manage professional level and graphic designing colleagues
Qualifications and requirements
Master s/Bachelor s degree / higher education qualification / equivalent in Marketing specialisation or related field, and two to four years of experience in a hospitality or hotel marketing setting with direct supervisory experience, or an equivalent combination of education and work experience. Must speak local language. Other languages preferred.

Description:
Responsibilities
Repair or replace items around the hotel and refurbish items in guest rooms. By keeping on top of these tasks, you ll keep our hotels looking great and working well.
Organise supplies and make sure equipment is ready for the next day
Live up to high safety standards - follow guidelines and tell your supervisor about any incidents, dangerous conditions or unsafe equipment
Take responsibility for the safety and cleanliness of areas inside and outside the hotel, like the car park and pool
Always keep an eye out for improvements - follow the preventative maintenance calendar and keep everything working and efficient at all times
Be a friendly face and helping hand to our guests
Keep your supervisor or duty manager in the loop and tell them about any low running supplies
Look smart and approachable in your uniform
Be ready to take on extra duties as and when the team needs you
Requirements
Experience - you ll have at least one year of maintenance or repair work under your belt
A high school diploma or related vocational training
You ll be familiar with Microsoft Office, a building management programme and/or any other reporting tools like HotSos, Opera, Lutron, Bartech, or Inncom
On top of building equipment and hand tools, you ll have a working knowledge of basic plumbing, electrics and preventative maintenance procedures
CPO certification - if the hotel has a pool, a Certified Pool Operator license would be ideal
Fitness - you ll be on your feet most of the day, and will need to bend and kneel a lot
Compliance - as well as meeting local laws on food handling and serving alcohol, you ll be above the minimum age required and fluent in the local language
Great communication skills, you ll be warm, welcoming and easy to talk to

Description:
Role: Service Specialist (Travel Based Job)
Company : OYO
Location: Amritsar
What is this role about?
This role is all about making sure guests have a great stay at OYO hotels.
This is an internship role.
As a Service Specialist, you will regularly visit OYO hotels, work closely with hotel owners and staff, and ensure service quality is maintained. Your work directly impacts guest satisfaction, hotel ratings, and repeat bookings.
This is a field-based role, not a desk job.
Important to know upfront:
You will be required to travel daily and visit around 45 hotels per day within your assigned area.
What will you do in this role?
Guest Experience & Satisfaction:
Check guest feedback, ratings, and reviews regularly
Identify issues faced by guests and take steps to fix them
Work towards improving guest satisfaction and online ratings
Hotel Quality & Operations:
Physically visit hotels to check cleanliness, maintenance, and overall quality
Ensure OYO service and brand standards are followed
Support hotel owners in fixing operational gaps
Staff Training & Support:
Train hotel staff on OYO service standards and guest handling
Help staff understand OYO processes and expectations
Guide them to deliver better service consistently
Coordination & Issue Resolution:
Act as a link between hotel owners and OYO internal teams
Handle guest and hotel escalations calmly and professionally
Ensure faster resolution of issues on the ground
Performance Tracking & Improvement:
Track guest ratings, NPS, and service-related KPIs
Use data and on-ground observations to improve performance
Who can apply?
Graduates (Hospitality background is a plus, not mandatory)
Candidates comfortable with *field work and daily travel*
Strong communication and problem-solving skills
Ability to manage multiple hotels and priorities
Comfortable working on weekends or holidays if required
In simple words:
You will go to hotels every daysupport hotel staff, solve problems, improve service quality, and ensure guests leave happy.

We are looking for a technically skilled engineer responsible for the maintenance, troubleshooting, installation and support of IT hardware, software, networking systems and FM Radio broadcast equipment. The role will ensure smooth day-to-day technical operations and minimum downtime.

Move through narrow, confined, or elevated spaces.
Move over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces as well as up and down stairs and/or service ramps.
Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping.
Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.

Description:
Key Outputs: List the main results which the job must deliver in order to achieve its purpose Inventory Management: Maintain accurate inventory records of all technical materials, spare parts, tools and consumables. Conduct regular stock counts and reconciliation. Implement ABC classification and manage reorder levels to ensure optimal stock availability while minimizing carrying costs. Receipt & Issue Management: Ensure proper receipt, inspection, and documentation of incoming materials. Manage material issuance against authorized requisitions. Maintain FIFO/FEFO principles and ensure proper handling and storage conditions. Store Organization & Safety: Maintain clean, organized and safe store environment. Implement 5S principles and ensure proper labeling, bin locations, and material segregation. Ensure compliance with safety, environmental and quality standards. Obsolete & Slow-Moving Stock: Identify, report and manage obsolete, slow-moving and non-moving inventory. Coordinate with engineering and finance for disposal or write-off as per company policy. Minimize dead stock and optimize warehouse space utilization. Supplier & Stakeholder Coordination: Coordinate with procurement, maintenance, projects, and suppliers for material availability. Support vendor development and quality improvement initiatives. Ensure timely communication on stock status and delivery schedules.

What experiences are key to success in this job? • Stores/Warehouse Management: 3+ years experience in technical stores management, preferably in manufacturing/FMCG industry
• Inventory Management & Control: Experience with stock management, ABC analysis, reorder level management
• ERP Systems: Working knowledge of SAP MM module or equivalent ERP systems

• Technical Knowledge: Basic understanding of mechanical, electrical spare parts and engineering materials
• Team Leadership: Experience in supervising store staff and coordinating with multiple departments
• Compliance: Experience with internal audits, stock verification and documentation standards

Core knowledge of the 10 Nestl Corporate Business Principles and expert knowledge in our areas of responsibility. (mandatory)

Store Management: Inventory control techniques, ABC/XYZ analysis, FIFO/FEFO principles
SAP/ERP: Material Management module, inventory transactions, reporting
Nestl Standards: NGMP, SHE requirements, Quality standards
TPM: Understanding of Planned Maintenance pillar, spare parts management
Technical: Basic understanding of engineering materials, spare parts specifications
Safety: Warehouse safety, material handling, hazardous goods storage
Documentation: GRN, Issue notes, Stock registers, Audit compliance
Diploma/Degree in Materials Management, Supply Chain, Engineering or equivalent
MS Office proficiency (Excel, Word)

Description:
Job Summary
Job Title: Customer Service Assistant
As a Customer Service Associate at Marks and Spencer, your main role is to assist customers, maintain store standards, and learn the basics of store operations. Your key responsibilities include:
Responsibilities
Customer Service: Greet and Assist Customers: Welcome customers with a friendly attitude and help them find what they need.
Customer Service: Understand Customer Needs: Listen to customers, understand their preferences, and recommend suitable products.
Store Standards: Support Visual Merchandising: Help maintain the store's appearance by following guidelines for product displays.

Role & responsibilities
Key Outputs: List the main results which the job must deliver in order to achieve its purpose Before starting the project design phase:
Support the End to End Project Manager and Project Engineering Manager in developing the investment project charter and ensure that it is strictly followed throughout the project. During project design phase:
Execute the basic and detailed design of the project based on Nestl Corporate Business Principles, Nestl standards, local regulations, the defined User Requirements Specifications and the TPM characteristics of a unit operation (safety, quality, affordability, maintainability, operability and reliability). Ensure by design the workers, and operators, safety during both the construction and the ongoing operation of the plant. During the project implementation phase:
Ensure that the engineering side of the project is implemented (e.g. buildings, equipment erections, piping, utilities, etc.) in accordance with the defined timing, cost and quality, the URS and the characteristics of a unit operation. And that all of the elements of the project (including technical people training, as needed) in performed in such a way that safety is always guaranteed on the whole project site and that a vertical start-up is assured. Select and qualify contractors and coordinate their activities. Ensure that Nestl standards are applied. During the start-up phase of the project:
Support the start-up manager and their team to ensure a smooth transition to operations after the qualification and verification of the installation.
Contribute to and support the preparation and distributing the engineering project documentation, including the engineering part of the project final report and provide feedback to the Maintenance Prevention System.

Manufacturing projects management- 3 years experience in capital investment projects development and implementation in food industry.
Determination of methods to minimise the likelihood of injuries or damages to people and/or equipment (SH&E)
Factory operations (as required)
Core knowledge of the 10 Nestl Corporate Business Principles and expert knowledge in our areas of responsibility. (mandatory)

Project management accreditation: Technical Instructions & Guidelines Management System ; Sound understanding of contracts, construction law and permitting requirements; certification] • Engineering and Manufacturing: Nestl Engineering activities, including Toolkit (NEMT, NSAT, etc); Project Engineering; Plant Design and Construction, and CAPEX cycle (budget preparation and project justification in CIAT, AMM PS); Understanding of Electricity, Control and Automation. Including MES; Nestl proprietary technology; Maintenance and Projects Management and Planning, including TPM, AMM (decision support and reporting tools), MS Project; Innovation & Renovation process
Nestl Leadership Principles and Group organization: Nestl Management & Leadership Principles, Nestl on the Move, Nestl Leadership Framework and Nestle Corporate Business Principles
Degree/Diploma in an Engineering discipline (Mechanical, E&A, Process, Industrial engineering, or similar)
Nestl product and process technologies - with PTC & Factories experience
Financial and budget analysis and tracking: Knowledge of Costing Guidelines and Finance & Accounting principles
Food plant principles and hygienic engineering: Food processing plants and technologies (Maintenance and Utilities), food safety, hygienic engineering
Nestl SHE standards
Nestl quality, regulatory, IP and business standards (S): QM Policies (including among others NGHE, NEMS, NSAT, ISO 14001, OHSAS 18001)
TPM and Early Management at Nestl

Established in 1994, Birla Sunlife Asset Management Company, (BSLAMC) is a joint venture between Aditya Birla Group and Sunlife Financial Inc., a leading international financial services company in Canada.

BSLAMC has a customer base of approx. over 2.5 million customers as on Dec 2015 with total gross sales of approx. 8.8 lac Crores
BSLAMC offers investors a range of comprehensive investment options, which includes diversified and sector specific equity schemes, hybrid funds and a wide range of debt and treasury products. Its offerings also include Portfolio advisory services for High Net worth individuals as well as offshore funds for Non Resident Indians. There are approx. 176 schemes managed by the organisation as on Dec 2015. The Company follows a long – term, fundamental research based approach to investment and thrives to provide a transparent and ethical services to its investors.

Description:
Purpose/Objective


The Territory Sales Officer is responsible for driving sales growth, market penetration, fostering strong customer relationships, executing targeted sales strategies, and expanding the dealer network for both traditional cement products and specialized S&P offerings within the assigned territory.
The TSO will ensure a deep understanding of product benefits across different segments, effectively communicate with stakeholders, and maintain a focus on achieving sales targets.
Key Responsibilities of Role


Sales Facilitation, Execution, and Target Achievement: - Execute sales strategies to achieve targets across both traditional and S&P product lines.
- Facilitate the sales process at the sub-dealer and customer levels, promoting the product line to stimulate higher sales.
- Maintain a robust sales pipeline, ensuring effective promotion and advocacy for both premium cement products and allied S&P offerings.
Customer Relationship Management and Market Development: - Build and maintain strong relationships with a diverse customer base, including sub-dealers, stakeholders, and end-users.
- Identify new business opportunities and market trends, tailoring sales approaches to meet customer needs and expand market reach.
In-depth Product Knowledge and Promotion: - Educate sub-dealers, customers, and their staff on the benefits and unique selling propositions of all products.
- Support the launch and promotion of new products, ensuring comprehensive market coverage and customer awareness.
Micro-Market Analysis and Competitive Intelligence: - Conduct detailed analysis of micro-markets within the territory to identify expansion opportunities and competitive threats.
- Monitor competitors' actions and pricing strategies, providing insights to refine sales strategies and outperform the competition.
Operational Support and Coordination: - Work closely with logistics and supply chain teams to optimize distribution and delivery systems.
- Relay field feedback to improve inventory planning and address real-time sales dynamics.
Network Expansion and Re-engagement: - Execute initiatives to onboard new sub-dealers and reintegrate degrowing sub-dealers into the active network.
- Develop retention strategies based on insights gathered from degrowing sub-dealers and market analysis.
Reporting, Communication, and Transparency: - Accurately record sales orders and communicate essential details to ensure seamless information flow.
- Foster a culture of openness, sharing information transparently with team members and stakeholders.
- Document and communicate decision-making processes to ensure clarity and departmental understanding.
Organizational Skills and Accountability: - Prioritize tasks effectively, managing multiple projects with agility and implementing best practices in workflow management.
- Establish clear accountability mechanisms to track performance and decision-making within the sales team.
Key Stakeholders - Internal: - Area Sales Manager - Back Office - Trade - Secondary Logistics Officer Key Stakeholders - External: - Sub- dealers
Technical Competencies

Qualifications and Experience


Educational Qualification: - MBA from a premier institute with a focus on Sales or Marketing.
Work Experience (Range of years): - 3 - 5 years of experience in sales and marketing activities Industry Knowledge: - Demonstrate in-depth understanding and proficiency in sales, specifically tailored to the Cement, Construction and Building Materials industries.

Description:
We are looking for a versatile and creative individual who can bridge the gap between web development and visual design. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys building interactive web applications using ReactJS, while also having a flair for creating engaging visual content such as posters, banners, social media creatives, and short-form videos.
You will work closely with our product, marketing, and design teams to build user-facing web features and produce compelling visual assets that support our brand and marketing efforts.


Role & responsibilities
Web Development
Develop, test, and maintain responsive web applications using ReactJS (and related tools such as Redux, React Hooks, REST/GraphQL APIs).
Translate UI/UX designs and wireframes into clean, reusable, and efficient code.
Collaborate with backend developers to integrate APIs and ensure smooth data flow.
Debug, troubleshoot, and optimize application performance across browsers and devices.
Maintain code quality through best practices, version control (Git), and code reviews.

Creative & Design
Design eye-catching posters, banners, social media creatives, and marketing collaterals.
Create and edit short promotional videos and reels for social media and marketing campaigns.
Work with tools such as Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, Canva, Premiere Pro, or After Effects (or equivalent).
Ensure all creative output aligns with brand guidelines and marketing objectives.
Collaborate with the marketing team to conceptualize and execute campaign visuals.


Preferred candidate profile
Proven experience in ReactJS and modern JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3.
Familiarity with front-end tools like Webpack, npm/yarn, and version control (Git/GitHub).
Hands-on experience with graphic design tools (Photoshop, Illustrator, Canva) and basic video editing (Premiere Pro, CapCut, or similar).
A strong creative eye for layout, typography, and visual storytelling.
Ability to manage multiple tasks and switch between technical and creative work.
Good communication skills and ability to work collaboratively in an on-site team environment.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Design, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
AboutCompany: Vaayath Infotech is here to revolutionize the pharma-tech space in India. We are already live with our first product - Pharminho - which is the first and only regulatory intelligence platform in India. With many more products in pipeline, Vaayath Infotech aims to empower pharma professionals with the power of technology.

Overview
From an online bookstore to one of the world’s largest e-commerce platforms, Amazon has emerged as the top player in the industry since its inception in 1994. Amazon has built an extensive online marketplace across continents, empowering its customers with a catalog encompassing products from A-Z. Amazon strives to be the world’s most customer-centric company, a purpose that has powered multiple breakthroughs in our delivery, supply chain, and customer support services. In the pursuit of operational efficiency, tech innovations have become the cornerstone of the organization. This has led to the pioneering of new services, most notably within the entertainment, publishing, finance, IT, cloud computing, AI, and Machine Learning industries.

At the heart of our services and innovations lies our exceptional talent network, which works on behalf of our customers. Customer obsession, passion for innovation, enhancing operational efficiency, and long-term thinking are the values guiding our workforce. Employees have the space to experiment, even if it means encountering failures. This idea ties back to our “Day 1” mentality, where employees are encouraged to ideate like entrepreneurs and renew their efforts the next day with their learnings. Employees have routes to upskill and reinvent themselves through various educational and leadership programs offered by Amazon. These programs are designed to enable them with the know-how to engineer solutions with real-world impact.

From its global footprint to its local presence in India, Amazon's operations span continents. With key corporate offices in Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Mumbai, Chennai, Delhi, and Pune, Amazon’s offices are designed to foster collaboration and invention, with suitable amenities to keep employees recharged throughout the day.

Description:
Job Summary
Position: Security Officer
Business: Mall Operation
Responsibilities
You will be part of the Mall Operation team based at the site and will be responsible for ensuring that all aspects of Security and Fire Safety are supervised and taken care of during your shift in consultation with the Security/Operation Head. You would be managing the following:
Maintaining and updating Security Policies and Procedures at site, especially updating/ establishing specific security procedures and crime deterrent programs.
Supervising Security and Fire safety staff, assign /monitor work assignments and provide training for staff on security procedures and basic fire and first aid (weekly / monthly).
Ensuring complete documentation and Police verification of vendor security personnel and periodically auditing all contractors for ongoing compliances.
Conducting Security investigations and preparation of Incident report.
Tracking of Material movement and stock of Lost and Found.
Handling emergency situations with efficiency (i.e. fire, evacuations, customer complaints/ human crises etc.).
Ensuring an effective emergency preparedness /disaster management plan is in place, along with an ERT- Emergency Response Team.
Conducting Security Risk Assessment planning effective Guarding Strategies.
Conducting Mock Drills on medical emergencies, Bomb Threats/Search Handling, Riots etc.
Being proficient with security and safety devices like CCTV, access control, DFMD, fire detection and fighting system. Carrying out weekly meetings with vendor operations head and share M.O.M with PM and client.
Reporting
You will be accountable to Operation Head/Security Manager.
Requirements
Being Analytical and Meticulous
You must pay attention to detail and possess the ability to use logical thought processes to develop solutions for short term and long-term Security needs; Demonstrate integrity in the performance of assigned tasks.
Qualifications
You are a qualified degree holder with 3-5 years security experience.
Relevant experience in required property type (Mall / Hotel/ Commercial others) will be preferred.
Ability to communicate well with others, both verbal and in writing.
Ability to conduct Fire drills Mock drills on emergency scenarios.
Location
Ludhiana
Scheduled Weekly Hours
48

Description:
Job Description
Position: Security Manager
Business: Mall Operation
What this job involves
You will be in charge of the safety and security aspects of your designated site. Your role will be to prevent Security lapses and be the first responder to emergency and non-emergency situations. Security planning, risk assessment formulating effective guarding strategies are some of your key responsibilities areas. Your role will incorporate managing the following:
Supervising security staff, assigning/monitoring work assignments, and providing training in daily security procedures, customer service skills, basic life safety, and first aid, etc.
Maintaining and updating security policies, checklists, and procedure manuals.
Having a working knowledge of all current building s security panels, fire, and life safety code requirements.
Managing all manpower records for on-roll and contract staff (training, compliance documents, and scheduling details)
Ensuring fire drill is carried out every week for security and unit staff.
Physically patrolling the designated area (focusing on elevators, and all areas of ingress/egress); using surveillance equipment, access control points, and alarms. Control buildings access and monitor activities of visitors.
Conducting Security investigations and preparation of an Incident report.
Tracking of material movement and stock of lost and found.
Regular and ongoing communication with Property Manager/Team members/Clients regarding events, incidents, concerns of Security Team members, recommendations, staffing needs, etc.
Approving and interviewing the hiring of contract security staff personnel.
Ensuring customer-related briefing is provided to all site employees.
Carrying out weekly meetings with vendor operations head and share M.O.M with PM and client.
Reviewing security after hour s reports and monitor staff performance.
In case of emergency coordinate with the respective tenant /administration staff/client and ensure quick movement/transfer the injured person to the nearest hospital by coordinating with and handing-over to local doctors / local legal bodies etc.
Drafting a disaster management plan in coordination with site team members Property Manager.
Playing a key role emergency (i.e. fire, evacuations human crisis, etc).
Monitoring and being a part of performance/behavior related meetings regarding contract staff
Implements and provides budgets relating to security requirements and staffing.
Reporting
You will be accountable directly to the Mall Head / Operation Head.
Sound like you Here is what we re looking for
Being Analytical and Meticulous
You will be building, maintaining, supporting, and validating the performance of subordinate security staff. You must pay attention to detail and possess the ability to use logical thought processes to develop solutions for short term and long-term Security needs; Demonstrate integrity in the performance of assigned tasks.
Qualifications
You are a qualified degree holder with 8-10 years of security experience. experience required in Mall Operation/Hotel will be preferred. Ability to communicate well, both orally and in writing.
Location
On-site - Ludhiana, PB
Scheduled Weekly Hours
48

Description:
Job Description: Wealth Manager
Department
Wealth Management / Private Banking / Financial Advisory

Employment Type
Full-time
Job Summary
We are seeking a knowledgeable and client-focused Wealth Manager to help individuals and families achieve their financial goals. The ideal candidate will build long-term client relationships, assess financial needs, and provide customized investment, retirement, tax, insurance, and estate planning strategies. This role requires strong financial expertise, relationship management skills, and the ability to deliver exceptional client service.

Key Responsibilities
Build and maintain long-term relationships with high-net-worth and affluent clients.
Conduct detailed financial assessments to understand clients' financial goals, risk tolerance, and investment objectives.
Develop personalized wealth management and financial planning strategies.
Recommend suitable investment products, insurance solutions, retirement plans, and other financial services.
Monitor investment portfolios and provide regular performance reviews and recommendations.
Stay informed about market trends, economic developments, and regulatory changes.
Identify opportunities to expand client portfolios through cross-selling and upselling financial products.
Ensure compliance with internal policies, regulatory requirements, and ethical standards.
Prepare financial reports, investment proposals, and client presentations.
Collaborate with product specialists, investment advisors, tax consultants, and relationship managers to deliver comprehensive financial solutions.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Commerce, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field.
MBA, CFP, CFA, NISM, or other relevant financial certifications are preferred.
38 years of experience in wealth management, private banking, financial advisory, or investment consulting.
Strong understanding of financial markets, investment products, mutual funds, insurance, and portfolio management.
Excellent communication, presentation, and relationship management skills.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office and CRM platforms.
Preferred Skills
Financial planning and advisory
Portfolio management
Investment analysis
Client relationship management
Sales and business development
Risk profiling
Negotiation and influencing skills
Regulatory compliance
Time management
Attention to detail
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Assets Under Management (AUM) growth
Revenue and fee generation
Client acquisition and retention
Portfolio performance
Cross-selling ratio
Client satisfaction scores
Compliance adherence

Description:
Job Summary
JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way .
Assistant Technical Manager Mall


Key Responsibilities
Manage mall technical operations including utilities, machines, manpower allocation, and overall security monitoring
Prepare and implement planned preventive maintenance (PPM).
Prepare and maintain manpower reports, weekly reports, and other documentation
Coordinate with local vendors and technical service providers
Monitor daily activities, manage help desk operations, and liaise with client facilitators to ensure high-quality facility management
Negotiate pricing with vendors, certify bills for contractors, and execute projects with the in-house engineering team
Implement process enhancements and quality control techniques
Operate and manage Building Management Systems (BMS) and interface with HVAC, firefighting, electrical switchgear, and other utilities
Maintain HT and LT systems, diesel generator sets, power transformers, and electrical panels
Manage HVAC chiller plants, VRV systems, air handling units (AHU), fan and filter units (FAU), chiller pumps with variable frequency drives (VFD), and cold rooms of various capacities.
Review the work of subordinate staff and provide guidance when needed.
Formulating suitable budgeting controls and Monitoring SLA s KPI s for JLL and outsourced agencies towards effective service deliverance.
Monitor all mechanical installation work, including sewage treatment plants (STP) and water treatment plants (WTP)
Oversee industrial kitchen extraction systems, cold rooms, and refrigeration equipment
Maintain plumbing systems, treatment plants, ring main systems, booster pumps, transfer pumps, sump pumps, and WTP facilities
Maintain firefighting systems including sprinklers, hose reels, wet risers, and fire pumps (diesel, jockey, and electric) in compliance with government regulations and standards
Coordinate CCTV systems, public address systems, access control, and video door phone installations and maintenance
Conducting risk/root-cause analysis in case of system failures and breakdowns and creating corrective /preventive action plan.
Implementing and administering inventory control programs for purchase of parts and utilisation.


Required Qualifications
Degree in Electrical / Mechanical Engineering or related discipline
Minimum 5-8 years of professional experience
Prior experience in the facility management or mall operations industry is an added advantage
Strong communication skills
Reporting: You will be working with operation team and reporting to the Mall Head / Operation Head/ Technical Manager.
Sound like you To apply, you need to be:
Qualifications
Degree / Diploma in Electrical/Mechanical OR any equivalent, with min 5-8 years of work experience in or Mall operation / Hotel / Real Estate.
Location: Ludhiana, Punjab
Scheduled Weekly Hours: 48

Description:
Associate Inside Sales
Locations: Chandigarh & Bangalore

About the Role
We are looking for a sharp, energetic, and customer-focused Associate Inside Sales to join our Intracity Logistics business. The role will involve managing customer relationships, driving retention and growth, and identifying opportunities for upselling and cross-selling through effective inside sales.
The ideal candidate should have strong communication skills, a sales mindset, and the ability to build meaningful customer relationships while working in a fast-paced environment.

What Youll Do
Manage a portfolio of customers and build strong, long-term relationships.
Drive customer retention and engagement through regular follow-ups and proactive account management.
Handle inbound and outbound sales calls to generate business opportunities.
Identify customer needs and recommend relevant Delhivery solutions.
Drive upselling and cross-selling opportunities within existing accounts.
Work closely with customers to understand their requirements and ensure a positive customer experience.
Support customer success by resolving queries and coordinating with internal teams for timely closure.
Maintain accurate customer and sales information and track opportunities through the sales funnel.
Meet defined sales, retention, revenue, and customer engagement targets.
Continuously identify opportunities to improve customer experience and business growth.

What We’re Looking For
0–3 years of experience in inside sales, account management, customer success, relationship management, telesales, or a similar customer-facing role.
Freshers with excellent communication skills and a strong interest in sales may also be considered.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Confident in handling inbound and outbound calls and engaging with customers.
Strong relationship-building and customer-handling skills.
Good sales orientation with the ability to upsell and cross-sell.
Sharp, proactive, and target-oriented with strong problem-solving abilities.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
Basic proficiency in MS Office/Google Workspace and CRM tools
Prior experience in logistics, e-commerce, D2C, or B2B sales will be an added advantage.

Who Will Do Well in This Role?
Someone who is sharp, articulate, proactive, and comfortable speaking to customers every day—someone who enjoys sales and account management, takes ownership, learns quickly, and can turn customer conversations into meaningful business opportunities.
If you are looking to build a career in Inside Sales, Account Management & Customer Success with one of India’s leading logistics companies, we’d love to hear from you
AboutCompany:
Delhivery is India's leading supply chain services company.
The company provides a full suite of logistics services such as express parcel transportation, LTL and FTL freight, reverse logistics, cross-border, B2B & B2C warehousing and technology services.
Our vision is to become the operating system for commerce in India, through a combination of world-class infrastructure, logistics operations of the highest quality and cutting-edge engineering and technology capabilities

Job description,

Hiring for Selenium Automation tester with experience range 2 years & above

Responsibilities
A day in the life of an Infoscion
As part of the Infosys consulting team, your primary role would be to actively aid the consulting team in different phases of the project including problem definition, effort estimation, diagnosis, solution generation and design and deployment
You will explore the alternatives to the recommended solutions based on research that includes literature surveys, information available in public domains, vendor evaluation information, etc. and build POCs
You will create requirement specifications from the business needs, define the to-be-processes and detailed functional designs based on requirements.
You will support configuring solution requirements on the products; understand if any issues, diagnose the root-cause of such issues, seek clarifications, and then identify and shortlist solution alternatives
You will also contribute to unit-level and organizational initiatives with an objective of providing high quality value adding solutions to customers. If you think you fit right in to help our clients navigate their next in their digital transformation journey, this is the place for you!
