Description:
Design, develop, test, and maintain Teradata database solutions.
Write complex SQL queries, stored procedures, macros, and scripts.
Develop and support ETL processes for data integration and migration.
Perform data analysis, data profiling, and data validation activities.
Optimize query performance and troubleshoot database issues.
Create and maintain database objects such as tables, views, indexes, and joins.
Monitor and improve database performance, space utilization, and workload management.
Collaborate with business analysts, data architects, and application teams to understand requirements.
Ensure data quality, security, and compliance standards are maintained.
Prepare technical documentation and support production deployments.
Required Skills:
Strong experience with Teradata Database.
Expertise in Teradata SQL, Stored Procedures, Macros, and Utilities.
Experience with BTEQ, FastLoad, MultiLoad, TPump, FastExport, TPT.
Knowledge of Data Warehousing Concepts and Dimensional Modeling.
Experience in ETL Development.
Strong understanding of query optimization and performance tuning.
Experience with Unix/Linux scripting.
Knowledge of scheduling tools such as Control-M or Autosys.

Description:
About the role: This position will assist the marketing team in executing go-to-market campaigns.
Desired Profile:
Degree or equivalent in marketing or business
Excellent oral and written skills
Passion for food and alcoholic beverage sectors
Management experience is a plus
Energetic, driven, and highly organized
Must have a passion for marketing
Pro-active self-starter
Ability to prioritize effectively
Good team player able to work well with various stakeholders
Ability to travel across India for meetings and events
Location: Mohali, Sector 82,
Experience: 0-2 years
Responsibilities: The responsibilities will include but may not be restricted to the following:
Brand Management: Developing and maintaining the brand identity for key mandates of the organization, ensuring consistency across all marketing channels. Work with the team in building strategy, implementation of plans (both b2b and b2c), and evaluation.
Marketing Strategy: Creating comprehensive marketing plans with the team that outline objectives, target markets, positioning strategies, and tactics for reaching key target audiences effectively. This may include traditional advertising, digital marketing, social media campaigns, retail partnerships, and promotional events.
Market Research: Conducting market research to understand consumer trends, preferences, and behaviors related to food products. This includes analyzing competitors and identifying opportunities for differentiation.
Content Creation: Generating engaging content for marketing materials, including website copy, product descriptions, infographics, blog posts, social media posts, and email newsletters.
Campaign Management: Planning and executing marketing campaigns from start to finish, including budget allocation, timeline management, and performance
tracking. This involves coordinating with internal teams and external agencies to ensure successful implementation.
Analytics and Reporting: Monitoring and analyzing the performance of marketing campaigns using key performance indicators (KPIs). Generating reports to evaluate the effectiveness of marketing efforts and identify areas for improvement.
Relationship Management: Develop and maintain strong and continuous relationships with influencers and key opinion leaders
Design: Work with the design team to curate key visuals for the mandate
Events: Organize and manage influencer, trade, and healthcare events
Partnerships: Set up and execute media and brand partnerships
Stay abreast of the ever-changing industry landscape and best practices in the field
Identify trends and explore new collaborative opportunities
Vendor Management
Manage database of key activities and contacts
Support wider marketing team with various projects

PERFECT PLACER (www.perfectplacer.com), Promoted by a team of dedicated professionals with varied background, having comprehensive and extensive industry and consultancy exposure, is “One of the most preferred and referred consultants” today in Executive Search & Placement.

PERFECT PLACER in less than half a decade has grown to be a force to reckon with, having offices in Mumbai, Chennai, Bangalore, and New Delhi.

Perfect Placer along with its associate services has a long and prestigious list of leading Indian and Multinational Corporates in India and Outside across Managerial levels, functions, and Industries, covering both IT and Non-IT specialized in chief executive, board member and senior-level management search assignments.

Sales Manager - Post-Harvest
You will oversee crop sales pipelines, convert seasonal crop projections into buyer order sheets, and build robust B2B buyer relationships, pricing strategy, and logistical coordination to minimize post-harvest loss and maximize crop profitability.

Key Responsibilities
Sales & Account Management
F Create and update crop availability lists for wholesale channels.
F Secure long-term purchase agreements with supermarkets, restaurants, and food hubs.
F Establish agile pricing models based on market volatility and crop grading.
F Onboard new buyers to expand local, regional, or export sales channels.
F Manage invoices, payments, and client communication accounts.
Inventory & Operational Coordination
F Collaborate with the Harvest Operations Manager to forecast weekly crop yields.
F Translate active buyer orders into clear harvest directives for field crews.
F Monitor cold storage and packing environments to preserve produce shelf-life.
F Supervise quality control metrics, ensuring proper packaging and accurate labeling.
F Oversee delivery logistics to ensure time-sensitive shipments arrive safely.
Market Strategy & Analysis
F Track competitor pricing, consumer demands, and agricultural industry trends.
F Feed market data back to ownership to influence future crop planning cycles.
F Train retail and farmers' market staff on specific crop profiles and selling points.

Preferred candidate profile
1. Bachelor’s degree in Agribusiness, Marketing, Agriculture, or related business discipline with Minimum of 2–5 years of sales experience within food hubs, commercial farms, or agricultural distribution.
2. Proven track record of managing highly perishable supply chains and cold chain logistics.
3. Proficiency with CRM systems, inventory management software, and MS Excel.
4. Strong negotiation, public relations, and client-retention skills.
5. Ability to rapidly re-route orders and adapt under pressure during peak harvest windows.

Remuneration:
An outstanding remuneration package that rewards professionalism and diligence will be on offer for the successful applicant as well as a well-defined career path. An excellent package will be on offer for the right candidate, including an above-mentioned industry base salary for the right person as well as the most complete employee benefit scheme. Don't miss out on this opportunity to join the market leader.

Description:
IC/PM
Individual Contributor Role
Company Profile
Jaquar Group is a prominent Indian conglomerate established in 1960 that operates in the bathroom and lighting industry headquartered in Gurugram and has a global presence with manufacturing facilities, subsidiaries, and distribution networks in various countries. Jaquar has grown to become one of the leading manufacturers of premium bathroom fittings, sanitary ware, faucets, showers, wellness products, and lighting solutions.
Our Values
At Jaquar Group, our values guide everything we do. As part of our team, you will be expected to uphold these principles:
Passion for technology – We innovate continuously
Highest quality standards – We strive for excellence
Building strong relationships – We value lasting partnerships
Excellent customer service – We prioritize customer satisfaction
Taking care of our people – We support and nurture our team
Integrity – We uphold the highest ethical standards
About the Role
As a Sales Generation Specialist (SGS), you will drive sales and revenue growth by converting leads into successful deals, educating channel partners about product offerings, and ensuring maximum product visibility in the market. You will play a key role in building strong relationships with dealers, builders, and end customers while implementing strategic promotional activities to enhance market penetration and brand loyalty.
Key Responsibilities
Convert the prospect pipeline generated by MDS into successful sales
Educate dealers and key decision-makers about product’s range, USPs, and benefits
Achieve product’s sales value and quantity targets across various categories
Generate demand for the products within specified channel partners or geographical areas
Ensure maximum display and visibility of products at dealer showrooms through effective EDS management
Maintain brand hygiene and ensure compliance with company pricing and promotional guidelines
Visit dealers as per MCP, encouraging them to sell products independently. Provide technical education to dealer sales staff and identify experts at counters for advanced training
Conduct training sessions at dealer sales counters, including role plays and practical demonstrations
Resolve dealer issues and escalate them timely if needed
Demonstrate the sales process to dealer staff and spend 2-3 hours daily at the dealer counter
Conduct site visits to end customers and promote the products & concepts
Convert retail builders of the branch into sales, add new builders, and share a universe of builders and architects monthly
Implement promotional activities and local events to increase product visibility and market penetration
Conduct architect activities at various outlets such as Orientation Centres (OC), Atelier, Jaquar World (JW), etc.
Collaborate with the branch CC team to conduct plumber training sessions
Gather and share information on competitors' activities, product development, benchmarking, etc.
Key Attributes
Excellent communication, interpersonal, and relationship-building skills
Strong product knowledge and ability to communicate value propositions effectively
Proven ability to drive revenue growth
Expertise in expanding and managing dealer networks
Ability to gather and analyze market and competitor data to inform strategies
Proficiency in MS Office Suite and CRM software (preferred) and Sales software
Proven ability to deliver engaging presentations and product training sessions
Competencies
Customer Focus
Negotiation Skills
Presentation Skills
Competitor Analysis and Market Development
Qualifications and Experience
Education: Graduation/Post Graduation preferred
Experience: Proven track record of 4-6 years’ experience in sales or related field
Skills:
Excellent verbal and written communication skills with pleasing personality, including ability to effectively communicate with internal and external customers
Time management and organizational skills
Analytical skills for tracking sales performance and network productivity
Initiative and drive to meet and exceed sales targets
Ability to travel within the assigned territory
Company Commitment to Equal Opportunity Employment
Jaquar Group is committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, gender, national orientation or disability.
Reach Us At
Jaquar and Company Private Limited
Plot No.3, Sector – 11, IMT Manesar
Gurgaon, Haryana – 122050
www.jaquar.com

Stock levels at yard
Delivery commitment based on line availability
Complaint management through CCMS process
Recommend MoU customers / quantity / deviation

Should have prior experience in handling key customer accounts independently
Good communication and negotiation skills required

Product Knowledge

Result oriented

Find ways & means to increase customer base and sales volume
Need to have product wise plan
Continuously explore new business and application possibilities

Description:
Areas of responsibility include Restaurants/Bars and Room Service, if applicable.
Supervises daily restaurant operations and assists with menu planning, maintains sanitation standards and assists servers and hosts on the floor during peak meal periods.
Strives to continually improve guest and employee satisfaction and maximize the ficial performance in areas of responsibility.
Determines training needed to accomplish goals, then implements plan.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 4 years experience in the food and beverage, culinary, or related professional area. OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Food Service Management, Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; 2 years experience in the food and beverage, culinary, or related professional area. CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Managing Day-to-Day Operations
- Supervises and manages employees.
Manages all day-to-day operations.
Understands employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees absence.
- Maintains service and sanitation standards in restaurant, bar/lounge and room service areas.
- Reviews staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and ficial objectives are met.
Leading Food and Beverage Team
- Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound ficial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
- Encourages and builds mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.
- Serves as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.
- Identifies the developmental needs of others and coaches, mentors, or otherwise helps others to improve their knowledge or skills.
- Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish your work.
- Ensures and maintains the productivity level of employees.
- Provides the leadership, vision and direction to bring together and prioritize the departmental goals in a way that will be efficient and effective.
- Ensures compliance with all food beverage policies, standards and procedures by training, supervising, follow-up and hands on management.
- Ensures compliance with all applicable laws and regulations.
- Ensures compliance with food handling and sanitation standards.
- Ensures staff understands local, state and Federal liquor laws.
- Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees and ensures employees do the same within the team.
- Establishes guidelines so employees understand expectations and parameters.
- Monitors alcohol beverage service in compliance with local laws.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
- Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
- Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.
- Manages day-to-day operations, ensures the quality, standards and meets the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.
- Displays leadership in guest hospitality, exemplifies excellent customer service and creates a positive atmosphere for guest relations.
- Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.
- Acts as the guest service role model for the restaurants, sets a good example of excellent customer service and creates a positive atmosphere for guest relations.
- Handles guest problems and complaints.
- Meets with guests on an informal basis during meals or upon departure to obtain feedback on quality of food and beverage, service levels and overall satisfaction.
- Ensures corrective action is taken to continuously improve service results.
- Incorporates guest satisfaction as a component of departmental meetings with a focus on continuous improvement.
- Manages service delivery in outlets to ensure excellent service from point of entry to departure (eg, greeting from hostess, speed of order taking and food and beverage delivery, fulfillment of special requests, collection of payment invitation to return).
Managing and Conducting Human Resource Activities
- Provides guidance and direction to subordinates, including setting performance standards and monitoring performance.
- Identifies the educational needs of others, develops formal educational or training programs or classes, and teaches or instructs others.
- Ensures employees are treated fairly and equitably.
Strives to improve employee retention.
- Ensures employees receive on-going training to understand guest expectations.
- Solicits employee feedback, utilizes an "open door" policy and reviews employee satisfaction results to identify and address employee problems or concerns.
- Strives to improve service performance.
- Ensures recognition is taking place across areas of responsibility.
Additional Responsibilities
- Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
- Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
- Assists servers and hosts on the floor during meal periods and high demand times.
- Recognizes good quality products and presentations.
- Supervises daily shift operations in absence of Assistant Restaurant Manager.
- Oversees the ficial aspects of the department including purchasing and payment of invoices.

We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
About the Role
We are looking for a sharp, energetic, and customer-focused Associate Inside Sales to join our Intracity Logistics business. The role will involve managing customer relationships, driving retention and growth, and identifying opportunities for upselling and cross-selling through effective inside sales.

The ideal candidate should have strong communication skills, a sales mindset, and the ability to build meaningful customer relationships while working in a fast-paced environment.

What You’ll Do
Manage a portfolio of customers and build strong, long-term relationships.
Drive customer retention and engagement through regular follow-ups and proactive account management.
Handle inbound and outbound sales calls to generate business opportunities.
Identify customer needs and recommend relevant Delhivery solutions.
Drive upselling and cross-selling opportunities within existing accounts.
Work closely with customers to understand their requirements and ensure a positive customer experience.
Support customer success by resolving queries and coordinating with internal teams for timely closure.
Maintain accurate customer and sales information and track opportunities through the sales funnel.
Meet defined sales, retention, revenue, and customer engagement targets.
Continuously identify opportunities to improve customer experience and business growth.
What We’re Looking For
1–5 years of experience in inside sales, account management, customer success, relationship management, telesales, or a similar customer-facing role. Freshers with excellent communication skills and a strong interest in sales may also be considered.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Confident in handling inbound and outbound calls and engaging with customers.
Strong relationship-building and customer-handling skills.
Good sales orientation with the ability to upsell and cross-sell.
Sharp, proactive, and target-oriented with strong problem-solving abilities.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
Basic proficiency in MS Office/Google Workspace and CRM tools

Description:
Training Exp. in hotels is mandatory.

Overview:
Are you prepared to start an exciting adventure as an exceptional Hotel Trainer? Join us in
revolutionizing the hospitality industry by ensuring that every member of our hotel staff receives
top-notch training to elevate their skills and enhance our guests' experience.
As a Hotel Trainer, you'll be at the forefront of our mission, delivering dynamic training sessions
across various locations with content curated by our innovative central team. If you're a
hospitality enthusiast with a passion for training and a hunger to make a real impact, this is the
role for you!

Key Responsibilities:
Training Delivery:
Conduct training sessions for hotel staff on topics provided by the central team,
utilizing materials such as PowerPoint Presentations and Videos.
Utilize Train the Trainer (TTT) certification and prior experience in hotels to
deliver engaging and effective training sessions.
Utilize a range of training methods to accommodate different learning styles and
ensure maximum retention of information.
Collaboration:
Work closely with the central team and ensure alignment with training objectives.
Provide feedback to the central team on the effectiveness of training materials
and suggest improvements as needed.
Qualifications:
Minimum of 3 years of experience in the hotel industry.
Graduation from a Hotel Management school or College.
Train the Trainer (TTT) certified.
Passion for training and making a difference in the hotel industry.

Soft Skills:
Proactive Approach: Take charge with a proactive mindset, always ready to tackle
challenges and make a meaningful impact.
Enthusiasm for Training: Bring your infectious enthusiasm to every training session,
fostering an environment where hotel staff feel inspired and motivated to enhance their
skills and knowledge.

As a Hotel Trainer, you will have the opportunity to make a significant impact on the success
and satisfaction of hotel staff, ultimately contributing to the overall guest experience and
reputation of the Brand. If you are passionate about hospitality, possess the necessary
qualifications, and thrive in a dynamic training environment, we encourage you to apply for this
rewarding role

Hands-on experience with Generative AI concepts and implementation (prompt engineering, evaluation, and iterative improvement).

Working knowledge of AI/ML fundamentals (supervised/unsupervised learning, model validation, metrics).

Strong Python programming skills with clean coding practices, testing, and debugging.

Bachelors degree in engineering or computers or AI

Job Summary
We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Power BI +DAX with 7-9years of experience in designing, developing, and maintaining business intelligence solutions. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Power BI, data modeling, DAX, SQL, and data visualization to transform business data into actionable insights.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and deploy interactive Power BI dashboards and reports.
Gather and understand business requirements and translate them into analytical solutions.
Create and optimize data models, datasets, and report performance.
Develop complex calculations using DAX and Power Query (M Language).
Connect Power BI to multiple data sources including SQL Server, Excel, APIs, Azure, and other databases.
Implement data validation and ensure data accuracy and consistency.
Schedule report refreshes and manage Power BI Service environments.
Collaborate with business stakeholders, data engineers, and analysts to deliver reporting solutions.
Troubleshoot performance issues and optimize existing reports and dashboards.
Maintain documentation and follow BI development best practices.
Required Skills
Technical Skills
Strong experience with Microsoft Power BI
Expertise in DAX (Data Analysis Expressions)
Proficiency in Power Query and M Language
Strong SQL querying and database skills
Experience in Data Modeling (Star Schema, Snowflake Schema)
Knowledge of ETL processes and data transformation
Experience with Power BI Service, Gateway, Workspaces, and Row-Level Security (RLS)
Understanding of data warehousing concepts
Experience with Excel and advanced reporting techniques
Preferred Skills
Experience with Azure Data Factory (ADF)
Knowledge of Azure Synapse Analytics
Exposure to Databricks
Experience with SSIS, SSRS, and SSAS
Basic understanding of Python or R for analytics
Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies
Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field.
7-9 years of relevant experience in BI/Analytics development.
Microsoft Power BI Certification is an added advantage.

Description:
About the Role
We are looking for a sharp, energetic, and customer-focused Associate Inside Sales to join our Intracity Logistics business. The role will involve managing customer relationships, driving retention and growth, and identifying opportunities for upselling and cross-selling through effective inside sales.
The ideal candidate should have strong communication skills, a sales mindset, and the ability to build meaningful customer relationships while working in a fast-paced environment.
What You’ll Do
Manage a portfolio of customers and build strong, long-term relationships.
Drive customer retention and engagement through regular follow-ups and proactive account management.
Handle inbound and outbound sales calls to generate business opportunities.
Identify customer needs and recommend relevant Delhivery solutions.
Drive upselling and cross-selling opportunities within existing accounts.
Work closely with customers to understand their requirements and ensure a positive customer experience.
Support customer success by resolving queries and coordinating with internal teams for timely closure.
Maintain accurate customer and sales information and track opportunities through the sales funnel.
Meet defined sales, retention, revenue, and customer engagement targets.
Continuously identify opportunities to improve customer experience and business growth.
What We’re Looking For
0–3 years of experience in inside sales, account management, customer success, relationship management, telesales, or a similar customer-facing role.
Freshers with excellent communication skills and a strong interest in sales may also be considered.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Confident in handling inbound and outbound calls and engaging with customers.
Strong relationship-building and customer-handling skills.
Good sales orientation with the ability to upsell and cross-sell.
Sharp, proactive, and target-oriented with strong problem-solving abilities.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
Basic proficiency in MS Office/Google Workspace and CRM tools
Prior experience in logistics, e-commerce, D2C, or B2B sales will be an added advantage.
Who Will Do Well in This Role?
Someone who is sharp, articulate, proactive, and comfortable speaking to customers every day—someone who enjoys sales and account management, takes ownership, learns quickly, and can turn customer conversations into meaningful business opportunities.
If you are looking to build a career in Inside Sales, Account Management & Customer Success with one of India’s leading logistics companies, we’d love to hear from you.
AboutCompany:
Delhivery is India's leading supply chain services company.
The company provides a full suite of logistics services such as express parcel transportation, LTL and FTL freight, reverse logistics, cross-border, B2B & B2C warehousing and technology services.
Our vision is to become the operating system for commerce in India, through a combination of world-class infrastructure, logistics operations of the highest quality and cutting-edge engineering and technology capabilities

Description:
About the Role
We are looking for a sharp, energetic, and customer-focused Associate Inside Sales to join our Intracity Logistics business. The role will involve managing customer relationships, driving retention and growth, and identifying opportunities for upselling and cross-selling through effective inside sales.
The ideal candidate should have strong communication skills, a sales mindset, and the ability to build meaningful customer relationships while working in a fast-paced environment.
What You’ll Do
Manage a portfolio of customers and build strong, long-term relationships.
Drive customer retention and engagement through regular follow-ups and proactive account management.
Handle inbound and outbound sales calls to generate business opportunities.
Identify customer needs and recommend relevant Delhivery solutions.
Drive upselling and cross-selling opportunities within existing accounts.
Work closely with customers to understand their requirements and ensure a positive customer experience.
Support customer success by resolving queries and coordinating with internal teams for timely closure.
Maintain accurate customer and sales information and track opportunities through the sales funnel.
Meet defined sales, retention, revenue, and customer engagement targets.
Continuously identify opportunities to improve customer experience and business growth.
What We’re Looking For
0–3 years of experience in inside sales, account management, customer success, relationship management, telesales, or a similar customer-facing role.
Freshers with excellent communication skills and a strong interest in sales may also be considered.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Confident in handling inbound and outbound calls and engaging with customers.
Strong relationship-building and customer-handling skills.
Good sales orientation with the ability to upsell and cross-sell.
Sharp, proactive, and target-oriented with strong problem-solving abilities.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
Basic proficiency in MS Office/Google Workspace and CRM tools
Prior experience in logistics, e-commerce, D2C, or B2B sales will be an added advantage.

Description:
Role Overview

We are looking for a Inside Sales Associate who will be responsible for generating leads, connecting with prospective customers, understanding their requirements, and converting opportunities into business. The role requires strong communication, persuasion, and follow-up skills.

Key Responsibilities

Generate and qualify leads through calls, emails, and online channels.
Connect with prospective customers and understand their business requirements.
Conduct product/service pitches and handle customer queries.
Follow up with leads and maintain a healthy sales pipeline.
Convert qualified leads into customers and achieve monthly sales targets.
Maintain accurate customer and lead information in CRM/trackers.
Coordinate with internal teams for onboarding and smooth customer activation.
Build strong customer relationships and ensure a positive experience.
Track sales performance and share regular updates with the reporting manager.

Requirements

0-6 years of experience in Inside Sales, Telesales, Business Development, or Customer Acquisition.
Freshers with strong communication and sales aptitude can also be considered.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Comfortable making a high volume of outbound calls.
Strong persuasion, negotiation, and follow-up skills.
Target-oriented with a strong willingness to learn and grow.
Basic knowledge of MS Excel/Google Sheets and CRM tools.

Description:
Delhivery is Indias leading fulfillment platform for digital commerce. With its nationwide network extending beyond 18,000 pin codes and 2,500 cities, the company provides a full suite of logistics services such as express parcel transportation, LTL and FTL freight, reverse logistics, cross-border, B2B & B2C warehousing and technology services. Delhivery has successfully fulfilled over 550 million transactions since inception and today works with over 10,000 direct customers, which includes large & small e-commerce participants, SMEs, and over 350 leading enterprises & brands.

Vision- Since its inception in 2011, Delhivery has become India’s leading supply chain services company. Our vision is to become the operating system for commerce in India, through a combination of world-class infrastructure, high- quality logistics operations, cutting-edge engineering, and technology capabilities.

Team- Delhivery was founded in 2011 by Sahil Barua, Mohit Tandon, Bhavesh Manglani, Suraj Saharan, and Kapil Bharati and is now 40,000+ people strong.

Location: Chandigarh
Function: Control Tower - Escalation
Level: Associate
Working Days - 6
Role Objective : To manage in-transit fleet escalations and ensure on-time truck movement by coordinating with vendors and internal stakeholders, minimizing service impact and client escalations.
Key Responsibilities :
Handle real-time escalations related to FTL fleet operations during transit.
Coordinate with vendors / drivers / supply team to resolve issues such as delays, breakdowns, route deviations, detentions, disputes or security concerns.
Ensure on-time delivery commitment to clients by proactive follow-ups and corrective action.
Act as a single point of contact during critical movements and high-priority escalations.
Liaise with multiple internal stakeholders including: CS, BD, Security, Finance, Vendor Desk, Supply team.
Support resolution of vendor disputes related to delays, detention, route changes, or operational deviations.
Track and update escalation logs, actions taken, and closure status.
Escalate unresolved or high-risk issues to seniors with clear RCA and next steps.
Ensure adherence to Delhivery SOPs, SLAs, and compliance standards.
Skills & Competencies :
Strong coordination and communication skills
Ability to handle high-pressure situations and multiple escalations
Good understanding of fleet operations / FTL movement
Stakeholder management across functions
Problem-solving mindset with ownership approach
Basic data tracking and reporting skills (Excel / internal tools)
Preferred Experience :
1-3 years of experience in fleet operations, control tower, supply ops, Full truck load or escalation management
Exposure to logistics / transportation / FTL environment preferred
Experience in vendor coordination is an added advantage

Description:
Job Title: Data Science Instructor
Location: Chandigarh, Bhubaneshwar
Working Days: 6 (Monday to Saturday)

About the Role
As an Instructor at our Offline Learning Centres, you will deliver engaging sessions in Data Science,
Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and related fields to students and working professionals. You will play a vital role in ensuring high-quality learning outcomes through classroom teaching, mentorship, and academic support. This is a unique opportunity to combine your passion for technology and education, while shaping the careers of tomorrow.

6 Reasons to Join upGrad Offline Learning Centres
1. Career Growth & SME Pathway: Accelerate your career with opportunities to move into
leadership roles and grow as a Subject Matter Expert by contributing to content
development, curriculum design and new program launches.
2. Continuous Upskilling: Access 100% free upGrad programs for yourself and a 50% discount
for your family.
3. Comprehensive Health & Wellbeing: Benefit from INR 5L medical insurance for yourself
and your family, plus a 24x7 mental health helpline for all-round support.
4. Attractive Incentives: Earn additional incentives for successful student referrals from your
batches, giving you direct rewards for expanding the learner community.
5. Employee Referral Bonus: Receive INR 15,000 for every successful employee referral
bring great talent to upGrad and get rewarded.
6. Impact & Exposure: Opportunity to work with industry leaders, design cutting-edge content,
and directly impact learner success.

Key Responsibilities
* Deliver in-person lectures and training sessions in Data Science, Machine Learning, Deep Learning and related domains.
* Guide learners through concepts, case studies, and projects to ensure strong understanding and application.
* Collaborate with Centre Managers and academic teams to monitor learner progress and outcomes.
* Support students with doubt-solving, mentorship, and building career-ready skills.
* Continuously update knowledge and content to stay current with industry trends and tools.

Skills & Experience
* Minimum 2+ years of teaching/training experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, or related fields.
* Strong programming skills in Python and understanding of SQL, Excel.
* Solid grasp of ML/DL concepts such as Regression, Decision Trees, Random Forests,Ensemble methods, Neural Networks, NLP, Recommendation Systems, etc.
* Strong communication, presentation, and mentoring skills.
* Comfortable with both classroom delivery and online teaching (camera-facing).
* Education: BE/ B.Tech (minimum); Postgraduate preferred.

Equal Opportunity
We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate
on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual
orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.
AboutCompany:
Started in 2015, upGrad is one of Asia's largest integrated Learning, Skilling, and Workforce Development Majors. It offers a range of online & hybrid skilling, pathway and study abroad courses, Certifications, and Bootcamps under its B2C portfolio. It also facilitates top Indian and global universities to offer their Diploma, Masters and Executive Doctorates. Additionally, select programs are tailored for Enterprise clients under the corporate skilling division, along with other recruitment and staffing services.
Origin: Co-founded by Ronnie Screwvala, Mayank Kumar, and Phalgun Kompall, upGrad was born to bridge the gap between imparting skills and employability, and is committed to providing affordable, accessible and high-quality lifelong learning at scale to millions worldwide. It caters to the end-to-end learning requirements of freshers to seasoned professionals in the age group of 18-60+ years who would use constant learning to enhance their skill sets while also receiving career acceleration.

Impact: To bridge the gap between academia and the industry, upGrad has built an immersive and 360-degree integrated learning solution that rests upon strong pillars like Content, Technology and Deep Personalization, further accelerating stronger career outcomes for learners. It enjoys a wide brands credibility and recall within India Inc. and globally, and continues to command strong course completion rates as high as 80%+ and higher Repeat and Referral rates annually. The skilling major has achieved two consecutive years of remarkable growth, closing FY23 and FY24 with over 55,000 successful career transitions, further establishing the credibility and mettle of the online higher education segment in India and globally.

Description:
About the Role
We are looking for a sharp, energetic, and customer-focused Associate Inside Sales to join our Intracity Logistics business. The role will involve managing customer relationships, driving retention and growth, and identifying opportunities for upselling and cross-selling through effective inside sales.
The ideal candidate should have strong communication skills, a sales mindset, and the ability to build meaningful customer relationships while working in a fast-paced environment.
What You’ll Do
Manage a portfolio of customers and build strong, long-term relationships.
Drive customer retention and engagement through regular follow-ups and proactive account management.
Handle inbound and outbound sales calls to generate business opportunities.
Identify customer needs and recommend relevant Delhivery solutions.
Drive upselling and cross-selling opportunities within existing accounts.
Work closely with customers to understand their requirements and ensure a positive customer experience.
Support customer success by resolving queries and coordinating with internal teams for timely closure.
Maintain accurate customer and sales information and track opportunities through the sales funnel.
Meet defined sales, retention, revenue, and customer engagement targets.
Continuously identify opportunities to improve customer experience and business growth.
What We’re Looking For
1–5 years of experience in inside sales, account management, customer success, relationship management, telesales, or a similar customer-facing role. Freshers with excellent communication skills and a strong interest in sales may also be considered.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Confident in handling inbound and outbound calls and engaging with customers.
Strong relationship-building and customer-handling skills.
Good sales orientation with the ability to upsell and cross-sell.
Sharp, proactive, and target-oriented with strong problem-solving abilities.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
Basic proficiency in MS Office/Google Workspace and CRM tools

Description:
Job Purpose
 The role will be responsible to drive sales and customer acquisition for home loan and mortgage products, and contribute to the organizations revenue growth through direct sourcing and strategic networking. This role involves generating leads, managing customer relationships, conducting field visits, and ensuring end-to-end loan processing with a focus on delivering a seamless customer experience.

Key Responsibilities:

 Go on field visits to meet customers and explain loan products
 Work to achieve sales targets and help grow the companys business
 Build good relationships with customers by meeting them regularly and following up for more business
 Meet new customers and ask happy customers to refer others who may need a home loan
Coordinate with credit team for smooth processing and disbursal of loans
 Maintain credit quality
 Onboard new channel partners
 Find and add new housing projects (APFs) and agents to bring in more loan applications.

Required Qualifications and Skills

 1-5 years of experience in Home Loan or Mortgage Sales within the BFSI/NBFC sector
 Prior experience in direct customer acquisition and channel sales preferred; Freshers with strong sales aptitude may also be considered
 Strong local market knowledge and established network in the region
 Excellent interpersonal skills
 Customer handling and relationship-building abilities • Result-oriented and self-motivated
 Strong negotiation and influencing skills

Educational Qualifications:

 • Minimum: Graduate in any discipline (Bachelors degree required)
 • Having a two-wheeler will be an added advantage

Interested candidates can share their resume on mail id - Prabhjot.kaur@iiflhomeloans.com OR whatsapp on 8700239696
AboutCompany:
IIFL Home Finance Limited is a technology-driven, India's leading retail-focused housing finance company dedicated to supporting first-time homebuyers from the Economically Weaker Sections (EWS) and Low-Income Groups (LIG) in India. A subsidiary of IIFL Finance Ltd. (79.59% stake), Abu Dhabi Investment Authority holds the remaining (20.41% stake) as a shareholder since 2022.
The company has served over 4.89 lakh customers since inception, including 3.17 lakh first-time home buyers, 1.68 lakh customers from the informal sector, and 4.62 lakh women borrowers as of 31st March 2026, reflecting its strong commitment to financial inclusion and empowerment.
Operating through a wide network of 315 branches across 18 states and 2 Union Territories, IIFL Home Finance focuses on underserved and emerging geographies, including the suburbs of Tier 1 cities and Tier 2 to Tier 4 towns, with residential property serving as collateral.
CompanyAddress: Plot No. 98, Phase - IV, GURGAON, Haryana, India

Job Details


Profile: Technical Support Voice Process
Location: Chandigarh
Work Schedule: 5 days working + 2 rotational week-offs
Shift: Night shift only
Salary: Approximately 3 LPA
Cab Facility: Two-way cab facility available; 500/month will be deducted towards the cab facility.

Roles & Responsibilities


Handle inbound customer calls and provide technical support for networking, connectivity, and other technical issues.

Understand customer concerns, diagnose issues, and provide appropriate troubleshooting and resolution.

Guide customers step-by-step through troubleshooting procedures in a clear and professional manner.

Ensure timely resolution of customer queries while maintaining quality and customer satisfaction.

Work effectively in a 247 support environment, including the required night shifts.

Preferred Candidate Profile

Graduate in any discipline; candidates with a technical/IT background will be preferred.
Good understanding of basic networking, troubleshooting, and technical concepts.
Strong verbal and written communication skills.
Good problem-solving and analytical abilities.
Willingness to work in permanent night shifts.
Comfortable working 5 days a week with 2 rotational week-offs.
Candidates should be willing to work from the Chandigarh location.

Bachelors degree in engineering or computers or AI

Description:
Role & responsibilities
Overall, 5-7 years of IT experience with minimum 5+ years of relevant Appian Dev. Experience.
Must be Appian L2 (Senior Developer) certified.
Design, develop, and implement Appian components primarily Interfaces and Process Models based on signed off FRD adhering to best practices. Participated in the entire software development lifecycle, from requirements gathering to deployment and assisted testing in UAT and PROD.
Expertise in Integrations with External Systems using Web APIs, Integration Objects and Web Services.
Experience in Appian Integration with SharePoint, SAP, Salesforce and RPA desirable.
Should have in-depth knowledge of writing SQL queries and functions.
Should have written and maintained documentation for developed solutions, including technical specifications and user manuals.
Deployed the developed solutions via Bitbucket and GIT.
Should be an active participant in code reviews to maintain code quality and ensure compliance with coding standards.
Should have actively tracked and provided technical support to UAT/PROD users by fixing CRs/Defects logged through JIRA.
Led the Appian best practices and governance oversight alongside client sponsors.


Preferred candidate profile

Ability to develop value-creating strategies and models that enable clients to innovate, drive growth and increase their business profitability
Good knowledge on software configuration management systems
Awareness of latest technologies and Industry trends
Logical thinking and problem solving skills along with an ability to collaborate
Understanding of the financial processes for various types of projects and the various pricing models available
Ability to assess the current processes, identify improvement areas and suggest the technology solutions
One or two industry domain knowledge
Client Interfacing skills
Project and Team management

Description:
Solution Delivery & Consulting


Partner with client stakeholders to understand business goals, translate them into AI/ML and Generative AI use cases, and define success metrics.

Contribute to solution design, effort estimation, and delivery planning for AI initiatives in a consulting environment.

Communicate findings, trade-offs, and recommendations through clear documentation and presentations.

Generative AI Development


Build Python-based prototypes and production-ready components for Generative AI workflows (prompting, evaluation, and iteration).

Develop and refine prompts, templates, and guardrails to improve response quality, safety, and consistency.

Implement evaluation approaches to measure output quality (accuracy, relevance, hallucination checks) and drive continuous improvement.

AI/ML Engineering


Develop and maintain ML pipelines in Python for data preparation, training, inference, and monitoring.

Perform model experimentation, feature engineering, and performance tuning aligned to business requirements.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate AI services into applications and workflows.


Minimum Qualifications:


3-5years of professional experience delivering Python-based solutions, including AI/ML or Generative AI components.

Hands-on experience with Generative AI concepts and implementation (prompt engineering, evaluation, and iterative improvement).

Working knowledge of AI/ML fundamentals (supervised/unsupervised learning, model validation, metrics).

Strong Python programming skills with clean coding practices, testing, and debugging.

Bachelors degree in engineering or computers or AI

Description:
Job Summary
We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Power BI +DAX with 7-9years of experience in designing, developing, and maintaining business intelligence solutions. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Power BI, data modeling, DAX, SQL, and data visualization to transform business data into actionable insights.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and deploy interactive Power BI dashboards and reports.
Gather and understand business requirements and translate them into analytical solutions.
Create and optimize data models, datasets, and report performance.
Develop complex calculations using DAX and Power Query (M Language).
Connect Power BI to multiple data sources including SQL Server, Excel, APIs, Azure, and other databases.
Implement data validation and ensure data accuracy and consistency.
Schedule report refreshes and manage Power BI Service environments.
Collaborate with business stakeholders, data engineers, and analysts to deliver reporting solutions.
Troubleshoot performance issues and optimize existing reports and dashboards.
Maintain documentation and follow BI development best practices.
Required Skills
Technical Skills
Strong experience with Microsoft Power BI
Expertise in DAX (Data Analysis Expressions)
Proficiency in Power Query and M Language
Strong SQL querying and database skills
Experience in Data Modeling (Star Schema, Snowflake Schema)
Knowledge of ETL processes and data transformation
Experience with Power BI Service, Gateway, Workspaces, and Row-Level Security (RLS)
Understanding of data warehousing concepts
Experience with Excel and advanced reporting techniques
Preferred Skills
Experience with Azure Data Factory (ADF)
Knowledge of Azure Synapse Analytics
Exposure to Databricks
Experience with SSIS, SSRS, and SSAS
Basic understanding of Python or R for analytics
Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies
Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field.
7-9 years of relevant experience in BI/Analytics development.
Microsoft Power BI Certification is an added advantage.

Description:
About the Role
We are looking for a sharp, energetic, and customer-focused Associate Inside Sales to join our Intracity Logistics business. The role will involve managing customer relationships, driving retention and growth, and identifying opportunities for upselling and cross-selling through effective inside sales.
The ideal candidate should have strong communication skills, a sales mindset, and the ability to build meaningful customer relationships while working in a fast-paced environment.

What You’ll Do
Manage a portfolio of customers and build strong, long-term relationships.
Drive customer retention and engagement through regular follow-ups and proactive account management.
Handle inbound and outbound sales calls to generate business opportunities.
Identify customer needs and recommend relevant Delhivery solutions.
Drive upselling and cross-selling opportunities within existing accounts.
Work closely with customers to understand their requirements and ensure a positive customer experience.
Support customer success by resolving queries and coordinating with internal teams for timely closure.
Maintain accurate customer and sales information and track opportunities through the sales funnel.
Meet defined sales, retention, revenue, and customer engagement targets.
Continuously identify opportunities to improve customer experience and business growth.

What We’re Looking For
0–3 years of experience in inside sales, account management, customer success, relationship management, telesales, or a similar customer-facing role.
Freshers with excellent communication skills and a strong interest in sales may also be considered.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Confident in handling inbound and outbound calls and engaging with customers.
Strong relationship-building and customer-handling skills.
Good sales orientation with the ability to upsell and cross-sell.
Sharp, proactive, and target-oriented with strong problem-solving abilities.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
Basic proficiency in MS Office/Google Workspace and CRM tools
Prior experience in logistics, e-commerce, D2C, or B2B sales will be an added advantage.

Who Will Do Well in This Role?
Someone who is sharp, articulate, proactive, and comfortable speaking to customers every day—someone who enjoys sales and account management, takes ownership, learns quickly, and can turn customer conversations into meaningful business opportunities.
If you are looking to build a career in Inside Sales, Account Management & Customer Success with one of India’s leading logistics companies, we’d love to hear from you.
AboutCompany:
Delhivery is India's leading supply chain services company.
The company provides a full suite of logistics services such as express parcel transportation, LTL and FTL freight, reverse logistics, cross-border, B2B & B2C warehousing and technology services.
Our vision is to become the operating system for commerce in India, through a combination of world-class infrastructure, logistics operations of the highest quality and cutting-edge engineering and technology capabilities

Description:
Key Responsibilities

Development & Pre-Opening

- Supervise and coordinate hospitality-related aspects of the resort's construction and development.
- Work closely with architects, consultants, contractors, vendors and other project stakeholders.
- Assist in planning operational layouts, equipment, systems and staffing requirements.
- Develop and implement SOPs, service standards and operating systems ahead of opening.
- Plan and oversee recruitment, training and development of the pre-opening team.
- Coordinate pre-opening activities to ensure the property is operationally ready for launch.
Resort Operations
Following the opening of the resort, the General Manager will assume overall responsibility for its day-to-day operations and performance.
Responsibilities will include:
- Overall management of resort operations, including Food & Beverage, Front Office, Housekeeping, Guest Services and Administration.
- Maintaining high standards of hospitality, service quality and guest experience.
- Developing and implementing operational policies, procedures and service standards.
- Managing budgets, procurement, operating costs and overall P&L performance.
- Driving occupancy, revenue generation, profitability and operational efficiency.
- Recruiting, training, motivating and leading a high-performing hospitality team.
- Managing relationships with suppliers, contractors, business partners and other stakeholders.
- Ensuring compliance with applicable statutory, safety and operational requirements.
- Representing the resort professionally with guests and external stakeholders.

Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should have:
- A degree or diploma in Hotel Management / Hospitality Management from a recognised institution.
- Approximately 1520+ years of relevant hospitality experience, with preference for candidates with around 20 years or more.
- Strong and demonstrable Food & Beverage management experience.
- Proven experience in a senior hotel or resort management position.
- Experience in resort pre-opening, hotel pre-opening, hospitality project development or setting up new operations will be highly advantageous.
- Strong knowledge of hotel/resort operations and hospitality service standards.
- Demonstrated ability to manage budgets, costs, revenue and P&L.
- Excellent leadership, communication and people-management skills.
- A hands-on, commercially minded and entrepreneurial approach.
- The ability to work independently, take ownership and manage multiple responsibilities during both the development and operational phases.

Compensation

A competitive salary commensurate with experience and suitability will be offered, together with a generous performance-linked incentive.
Confidentiality
The name of the company and the resort will be disclosed to shortlisted candidates during the selection process.

Description:
The upcoming Crowne Plaza & Holiday Inn Zirakpur marks an exciting new chapter in hospitality for the region. Strategically located along the Chandigarh-Ambala Highway, the cluster hotel will bring together 335 well-appointed rooms across two renowned brands - 149 rooms at Crowne Plaza and 186 rooms at Holiday Inn, Zirakpur.
The cluster will offer a diverse range of F&B experiences, along with a swimming pool, fitness centre, spa, and extensive banqueting facilities, including approximately 1,00,000 sq. ft. of meeting and event space. With excellent connectivity to Chandigarh and key destinations across North India, it will be well-positioned to cater to business and leisure travellers, while offering versatile spaces for conferences, weddings, and social celebrations
Every day is different, but you ll mostly :
Direct and coordinate the activities of all security personnel, engage in the implementation of safety and security procedures for the department, and provide assistance and advice to other departments in relation to security
Effective control over valet parking to ensure minimal costs, Compile and distribute security reports to relevant departments.
Ensure all security personnel as well as hotel s staff are adhering to P&P and security procedures
Interact with guests and individuals outside the hotel, including, but not limited to, current and potential clients, owning company representatives, community leaders, government officials, travel industry representatives, suppliers, competitors and other members of the local community.
Ensure highest level of guest satisfaction by providing quality guest services.
Ensure a safe and secure environment for guests, team members and hotel assets in compliance with owners policies and procedures and regulatory requirements.


What We need from you:
Bachelor s degree with minimum 6 years of security and safety experience and/or military/law enforcement experience, including supervisory experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. Must speak local language(s). Other languages preferred.
Great communication skills
You ll be a team player, proactive, responsible, hardworking, and able to work under pressure

What you can expect from us:

We give our people everything they need to succeed. From a competitive salary that rewards all your hard work to a wide range of benefits designed to help you live your best work life - including a full uniform, impressive room discounts and some of the best training in the business.

Our mission is to welcome everyone and create inclusive teams where we celebrate difference and encourage colleagues to bring their whole selves to work. IHG Hotels & Resorts provides equal employment opportunities to applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or disability. We promote a culture of trust, support, and acceptance. Always welcoming different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.

IHG gives every member of the team the room they need to belong, grow and make a difference in a collaborative environment. We know that to work well, we need to feel well - both inside and outside of work - and through our myWellbeing framework, we are committed to supporting wellbeing in your health, lifestyle, and workplace.

So, join us and you ll become part of our ever-growing global family.

Description:
Position: Regulatory Senior Consultant/ Consultant - CMC
Location: Hybrid (80 % remote, 20 % In office)
OFFICE: CHANDIGARH
Reports To: Manager or above, Regulatory Affairs
Company Overview
Client is a contract research organization offering Pharmacovigilance, Regulatory,
Evidence Evaluation and Technology Solutions, which are phase dependent. These verticals cover planning, launch and lifecycle management of Pharmaceutical, Consumer products and
Medical devices.
Functional Responsibilities

Work with global clients on regulatory filing projects for USFDA, EMA, MHRA, APAC, Canada etc. The key delivery areas include Pre and Post approval CMC authoring, preparation, and submission

Scientific writing, review, and compilation of submission documents like quality overall summary (module 2), CMC quality drug product, drug substance and regional information (module 3)

Independently author and/or coordinate CMC activities for new registrations, post approval changes (minor, moderate and major), renewals, annual reports, and line extensions to meet filing requirements. Coordinating and contributing to responses to Agency queries and performing quality review of regulatory CMC submissions

• Deliver projects in either pharmaceutical / consumer products / Over the counter (OTC) drug products as per client portfolio/requirements

Ensure timely delivery of error-free, high-quality CMC documents that meet international standards of written English and relevant technical requirements following internal/client-specific style guides/templates

Demonstrate expertise at planning CMC submissions, including appropriate knowledge management tools Job Description Confidential

Participate in meetings with Client on a regular basis to understand the clients requirement and proactively support the team in meeting or exceeding the targets in terms of quality and quantity within the agreed timelines

Demonstrate in-depth understanding of content requirements, including awareness and understanding of CTD format and apply expertise to ensure global regulatory commitment tracking

Prioritize and complete assigned workload appropriately under minimum supervision

Proactively identify moderately complex issues and risks to project delivery in own work or work of the team and escalate appropriately with associated resolution proposals

Work cross-functionally and in collaboration with key stakeholders/customers both internal and external

Ensure that all training (internal training and client training) are successfully completed in a timely manner

Education
M.Pharm/PhD or equivalent higher degree in a relevant discipline (preferably Regulatory affairs, Pharmaceutics, QA, Industrial Pharmacy, Life Sciences)

Work Experience
Minimum 6-10 years of regulatory affairs/operations experience in the relevant area (e.g. Pharma, Consumer, Medical device)

Description:
The upcoming Crowne Plaza & Holiday Inn Zirakpur marks an exciting new chapter in hospitality for the region. Strategically located along the Chandigarh-Ambala Highway, the cluster hotel will bring together 335 well-appointed rooms across two renowned brands - 149 rooms at Crowne Plaza and 186 rooms at Holiday Inn, Zirakpur.

Reliable hardware and seamless software are at the heart of every day-to-day IHG experience. To deliver a truly first-class service, we need a Cluster IT Manager capable of installing new systems, boosting security, and setting exceptional standards. A little taste of your day-to-day:

Maintaining hardware and software performance, digital and physical security standards and evaluating vendor proposals
Passing on your expertise to the hotel team by running knowledge sharing and training sessions
Safeguarding our IT infrastructure against cyberthreats

What We need from you:
Diploma or Vocational Certificate in Computer Science or IT or related field
4 years related experience with computer set-up and troubleshooting
Working knowledge of networks, operating systems, and databases
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Knowledge in PCI DSS (Payment Card Industry Data Security Standards)
Great communication skills
You ll be a team player, proactive, responsible, hardworking, and able to work under pressure

Description:
The upcoming Crowne Plaza & Holiday Inn Zirakpur marks an exciting new chapter in hospitality for the region. Strategically located along the Chandigarh-Ambala Highway, the cluster hotel will bring together 335 well-appointed rooms across two renowned brands - 149 rooms at Crowne Plaza and 186 rooms at Holiday Inn, Zirakpur.
The cluster will offer a diverse range of F&B experiences, along with a swimming pool, fitness centre, spa, and extensive banqueting facilities, including approximately 1,00,000 sq. ft. of meeting and event space. With excellent connectivity to Chandigarh and key destinations across North India, it will be well-positioned to cater to business and leisure travelers, while offering versatile spaces for conferences, weddings, and social celebrations.
A little taste of your day-to-day:

Every day is different, but you ll mostly :
Develop and own promotional activities, marketing channels and the production of marketing materials for specific events
Implement PR campaigns to celebrate successes and awards and the promotion of product
Create, develop and market key events for the hotel, especially during key business periods
Communicate effectively, to target markets, the amenities and benefits of the hotel, including hotel refurbishments, food and beverage provisions, conference, banqueting and events
Identify operational problems that reduce the effectiveness of marketing activities and overall hotel sales performance and work with appropriate department on solutions.


What We need from you:
Master s/Bachelor s degree / higher education qualification / equivalent in Marketing specialization or related field, and two to four years of experience in a hospitality or hotel marketing setting with direct supervisory experience, or an equivalent combination of education and work experience. Must speak local language. Other languages preferred.
Great communication skills
You ll be a team player, proactive, responsible, hardworking, and able to work under pressure

What you can expect from us:
We give our people everything they need to succeed. From a competitive salary that rewards all your hard work to a wide range of benefits designed to help you live your best work life - including a full uniform, impressive room discounts and some of the best training in the business.

Our mission is to welcome everyone and create inclusive teams where we celebrate difference and encourage colleagues to bring their whole selves to work. IHG Hotels & Resorts provides equal employment opportunities to applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or disability. We promote a culture of trust, support, and acceptance. Always welcoming different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.

IHG gives every member of the team the room they need to belong, grow and make a difference in a collaborative environment. We know that to work well, we need to feel well - both inside and outside of work - and through our myWellbeing framework, we are committed to supporting wellbeing in your health, lifestyle, and workplace.

So, join us and you ll become part of our ever-growing global family.

Description:
The upcoming Crowne Plaza & Holiday Inn Zirakpur marks an exciting new chapter in hospitality for the region. Strategically located along the Chandigarh-Ambala Highway, the cluster hotel will bring together 335 well-appointed rooms across two renowned brands - 149 rooms at Crowne Plaza and 186 rooms at Holiday Inn, Zirakpur.
The cluster will offer a diverse range of F&B experiences, along with a swimming pool, fitness centre, spa, and extensive banqueting facilities, including approximately 1,00,000 sq. ft. of meeting and event space. With excellent connectivity to Chandigarh and key destinations across North India, it will be well-positioned to cater to business and leisure travelers, while offering versatile spaces for conferences, weddings, and social celebrations.
A little taste of your day-to-day:
Every day is different, but you ll mostly :
Translate operating forecasts into material requirements plans and thereby determine standard stock and re-order levels with Department Heads
Direct day-to-day purchasing activities, plan and assign work, and establish performance and development goals for team members. Provide mentoring, coaching, and regular feedback to help manage conflict and improve team member performance.
Ensure that the item conforms to the required standards of quality and quantity at the lowest possible time
Demonstrate understanding and awareness of all policies and procedures relating to Health, Hygiene and Fire Life Safety
What We need from you:
Bachelor s degree / higher education qualification / equivalent in Accounting or Finance and five to six years in hotel purchase experience with one year in a supervisory role, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Great communication skills
You ll be a team player, proactive, responsible, hardworking, and able to work under pressure

What you can expect from us:
We give our people everything they need to succeed. From a competitive salary that rewards all your hard work to a wide range of benefits designed to help you live your best work life - including a full uniform, impressive room discounts and some of the best training in the business.
Our mission is to welcome everyone and create inclusive teams where we celebrate difference and encourage colleagues to bring their whole selves to work. IHG Hotels & Resorts provides equal employment opportunities to applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or disability. We promote a culture of trust, support, and acceptance. Always welcoming different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.
IHG gives every member of the team the room they need to belong, grow and make a difference in a collaborative environment. We know that to work well, we need to feel well - both inside and outside of work - and through our myWellbeing framework, we are committed to supporting wellbeing in your health, lifestyle, and workplace.
So, join us and you ll become part of our ever-growing global family.

Role & responsibilities


Preferred candidate profile
Payroll company - Trigent Software
Working Hours:
* Shift will be in any of United States of America time zones
* Open to work in rotating work week (Mon-Fri, Tue-Sat, Wed-Sun)
Overall Purpose of Job

* Provide high quality Tier 2 Customer Support service to Customers with complete focus on 100% issue resolution and 100% customer satisfaction.
* Adhere to Client defined as well as internally defined processes and procedures while handling Inbound calls emails & chats
* Follow standard procedures for proper escalation of unresolved issues to the appropriate internal teams
* Strive and achieve SLA target and business outcome indicators defined by the client

Job Responsibilities / Authorities

* Receive inbound Calls/Emails/Chats and ensure that cases and interactions are logged correctly in the required tool
* Provide recruitment support to candidates (fresh applicants, rehire) as per defined processes
* Walk customers/ Provide navigational support on self service portal
* Ensure security verifications are carried out per company policies and procedures and is lines with the GDPR guidelines
* Place outbound calls to customers when required in line with Client / Company guidelines
* Work productively whilst maintaining exceptional call/data quality standards in line with targets
* Contribute to the team through open and regular communication with peers / supervisors
* Adhere to all company or departmental policies and procedures (personnel and operational)
* Keep the process repositories like DTPs, Knowledgebase, SharePoint updated with the current process
* Maintain regular and punctual attendance in line with company policies and procedures
* Minimise customer complaints and escalations by providing exceptional service and call control

Knowledge & Skill Requirement

* Ability to demonstrate an efficient use of customer service technologies to complete a customer transaction using Ticket Tracking System (Service Now preferred), ERP systems, Microsoft Office Suite, and Internet Explorer
* Good technical aptitude with an ability to learn quickly
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
Experience Profile

* Prior international BPO work experience preferred
* Freshers acceptable

Personal Attributes

* Able to work on a flexible basis as determined by the business needs
* Ability to work under pressure
* Team worker
* Positive Attitude
* Quick Learner
* Punctual and Disciplined
* Good Communication skills
* Customer Focussed
* Results driven
* High standards of Integrity
* Attention to detail

Working Hours:
* Shift will be in any of United States of America time zones
* Open to work in rotating work week (Mon-Fri, Tue-Sat, Wed-Sun

Thanks & Regards,
Nandini V

Description:
Role: Business Development Associate


NoBroker About the Company: NoBroker is the world's largest no-brokerage property platform, offering end-to-end services in real estate. As India's first Prop-Tech unicorn with a billion-dollar valuation, we provide a seamless experience to future homeowners. We operate in six major cities: Bangalore, Mumbai, Pune, Hyderabad, NCR, Delhi, Gurgaon and Chennai.

About the Role: As an Business Development Associate (BDA), you will play a crucial role in bridging demand and supply in the real estate market. You will guide, consult, and support potential homebuyers throughout their purchase journey, helping them find the right property while maximizing sales for NoBroker.

Key Responsibilities:
Engage potential customers via phone, virtual meetings, and on-site visits to explain available properties and convert them into buyers.
Attend qualified leads through virtual or in-person meetings, present tailored property options, and encourage on-site visits.
Negotiate deals between clients, ensuring a win-win agreement.
Build and maintain client relationships, ensuring satisfaction and generating referral business.
Cross-sell additional NoBroker services to offer a complete home-buying experience.
Nurture leads to build a strong sales pipeline and meet daily, weekly, and monthly targets.
Stay updated on market trends, property prices, inventory, and buyer demand.

Requirements:
Bachelors degree or equivalent qualification.
Proven track record in sales, preferably in real estate or a similar domain.
Strong communication, negotiation, and persuasion skills.
Ability to handle objections and close deals effectively.
Good local market knowledge.
Target-driven mindset with a customer-first approach.
Own a vehicle (two-wheeler/four-wheeler preferred).
Fluency in English, Hindi, and a local language.
Availability to work 6 days a week (including weekends).

Key Competencies:

Real Estate Knowledge
Communication, Questioning, and Listening Skills
Networking & Relationship Building
Problem-Solving & Negotiation
Rapport Building
Persuasion & Convincing Skills
Customer-Centric Approach

Description:
Role & responsibilities

Restaurant Partner Management: Manage a portfolio of restaurant partners and act as the primary point of contact.
Business Growth: Drive order growth, revenue, conversion, and overall business performance for assigned restaurants.
Partner Performance: Track key metrics such as orders, GMV, cancellations, ratings, customer complaints, and restaurant availability.
Restaurant Success: Identify performance gaps and recommend actions to improve visibility, orders, menu conversion, and customer experience.
Relationship Management: Build strong relationships with restaurant owners/management and understand their business challenges.
Promotions & Campaigns: Drive participation in relevant Swiggy campaigns, offers, discounts, and promotional programs.
Menu & Catalogue Management: Ensure menus, pricing, images, availability, and other restaurant information are accurate and optimized.
Issue Resolution: Coordinate with internal teams to resolve operational, payment, technology, or customer-related issues faced by restaurant partners.
Data Analysis: Use business data and dashboards to identify trends, opportunities, and underperforming restaurants.
Competition & Market Insights: Monitor competitor activity, pricing, offers, and market trends to provide actionable recommendations.
Retention: Reduce partner churn and improve engagement by proactively addressing partner concerns.
Cross-functional Coordination: Work with Operations, Sales, Marketing, Support, Finance, and Product/Tech teams to resolve issues and improve restaurant performance.
Target Achievement: Deliver assigned revenue, order, retention, and partner-engagement targets.


Preferred candidate profile

15 years of experience in account management, sales, business development, partner management, or customer success.
Experience managing B2B/B2C clients or merchant/restaurant partners.
Strong data analysis and Excel/Google Sheets skills.
Good understanding of revenue, sales, conversion, retention and growth metrics.
Strong communication and negotiation skills.
Ability to handle multiple restaurant partners and work in a target-driven environment.
Experience in food-tech, e-commerce, marketplace, SaaS, retail, or hospitality would be an advantage.

Job Title: Hospital Success Executive
Location: bangalore ,chennai and pune | Experience: 010 Years

Role Overview
As a Hospital Success Executive, your main goal is to drive daily bookings for our Pay 0 healthcare service at partner hospitals. You will work on the ground inside hospitals to train front-desk staff, run live operations, and ensure receptionists independently pitch and book services for patients.

What You Will Do
Train Front-Desk Staff: Teach hospital receptionists how to check patient eligibility and pitch Pay 0 services.
Drive Daily Bookings: Work alongside receptionists on-site to run live operations and hit daily booking targets.
Handover & Stabilize: Fix operational issues and train staff until the hospital can run the process independently.
Cross-Sell Services: Train staff to recommend extra services like lab tests to patients.
Monitor & Support: Track hospital performance after handover, stepping in to retrain staff whenever numbers drop.

Who We Are Looking For
Field-Ready: Ready to work inside hospitals daily and travel across the city.
People Pitcher & Trainer: Excellent at building rapport, training counter staff, and driving adoption.
Target-Oriented: High energy, independent problem solver who owns their numbers
