Description:
Role Name: Cross Border (Air Express Services - New Sales Development)
Location: Mumbai / Bangalore
About the Role:
We are seeking a high-impact Frontline Sales professional to spearhead the growth and lifecycle management of our Cross-Border Air Express vertical. In this capacity, you will be responsible for new client acquisition, account expansion, and revenue optimization for international air express solutions, catering to a diverse portfolio of e-commerce merchants, SMEs, and large-scale enterprise exporters and importers.

What You'll Do:
Identify, prospect, and onboard new customers for Cross Border Air Express services within an assigned territory.
Achieve monthly/quarterly volume and revenue targets for international air shipments.
Build and manage a strong sales pipeline through cold calling, field visits, referrals, and market mapping.
Understand customer shipping needs (destination countries, volumes, product categories) and pitch the right service solutions
Coordinate with operations, customer service, and pricing teams to ensure smooth onboarding and service delivery.
Negotiate rates and contracts within approved pricing guidelines
Track competitor activity, pricing, and market trends in the cross-border logistics space.
Maintain accurate records of leads, meetings, and conversions in CRM.
Ensure high customer satisfaction and retention through regular account reviews.
Resolve escalations related to billing, documentation, or service delays in coordination with internal teams.

Required Skills:
Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
Proven track record in B2B/B2C field sales, preferably in logistics, courier, freight forwarding, or export-import services.
Basic understanding of international shipping/customs documentation is a plus.
Target-driven mindset with strong negotiation skills.
Ability to work independently and manage a territory.
Proficiency in MS Office/CRM tools.
Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned area.

Eligibility:
Experience: 2-6 years in frontline/field sales (logistics, courier, freight, export-import, or related industries preferred).
Education: Any Graduate.
Other: Two-wheeler with valid driving license preferred (this is a field-intensive role).
AboutCompany:
Delhivery is India's largest fully integrated logistics services provider.
With its nationwide network covering over 18,400 pin codes, the company provides a full suite of logistics services such as express parcel transportation, PTL freight, TL freight, cross-border, supply chain, and technology services.
Delhivery has successfully fullled over 1.7 billion shipments since inception and today works with over 28,000 customers, including large & small e-commerce participants, SMEs, and other enterprises & brands.
For more information about Delhivery, please visit www.delhivery.com.
Vision - Our vision is to become the operating system for commerce in India, through a combination of world-class infrastructure, high-quality logistics operations, cutting-edge engineering, and technology capabilities.
Team- Delhivery was founded in 2011 by Sahil Barua, Mohit Tandon, Bhavesh Manglani, Suraj Saharan, and Kapil Bharati and is now 56,000+ people strong.

Description:
Position - HNI Fundraiser
Work Location - Mumbai, Bangalore
Job Description -

We are looking for an experienced HNI Fundraiser to lead the identification, engagement, cultivation, and stewardship of High Net Worth Individuals (HNIs), philanthropists, family offices, and other major individual donors.

The role will be responsible for building strong, long term relationships with HNI donors, understanding their philanthropic interests, developing compelling funding proposals, and mobilizing significant resources to support the organizations programmes and mission.

Build and maintain meaningful relationships with existing and prospective HNI donors.
Understand donors philanthropic interests and align them with the organizations programmes and impact areas.
Conduct regular donor meetings, presentations, programme visits, and engagement activities.
Ensure timely communication, reporting, acknowledgement, and recognition of donors.
Work closely with programme teams to communicate the organizations impact effectively to donors.
Prepare donor updates, impact reports, success stories Etc
Organize donor visits and opportunities for meaningful engagement with beneficiaries and programmes, wherever appropriate.
Ensure compliance with applicable NGO, FCRA, tax, and internal fundraising policies.

Education:
Bachelors or Masters degree in Social Work, Development Studies, Management, Marketing, Communications, or a related field is preferred.

Experience:
5+ years of experience in fundraising, major donor/HNI engagement, philanthropy, CSR, development sector, or relationship management.
Proven track record of raising funds from HNIs, philanthropists, family foundations, or major individual donors will be strongly preferred.
Experience working with senior business leaders, entrepreneurs, family offices, or philanthropic foundations is an advantage.
AboutCompany:
The Akshaya Patra Foundation :-

With a vision to serve 6 million meals per day by 2030, the organisation is committed to eliminating classroom hunger and enabling education through a scalable and sustainable model.

Description:
Job Description
You make sound judgments and promote candidates' focused environments. You
optimize execution and results. You inspire commitment through communication and
influence. You demonstrate adaptability while thinking and acting strategically. You
build and sustain internal and external relationships.
About Team
The Walmart Contact Center specializes in providing best-in-class service to
customers, stores, and associates via phone, chat, email. We are a metrics driven
center dedicated to driving results where our associates thrive in this high-volume
environment that handles over 10 million contacts per year.
We Invest in You! At Walmart, we focus on the growth and development of our
associates! We are a highly engaged team that prides itself on exceeding customer
expectations, building relationships, career progression and providing individual and
team recognition.
We are looking for career minded, customer centric individuals who are
experienced in providing best-in-class customer service.
What you'll do
As a Customer Care Senior Resolution Coordinator, you will take a high volume
of incoming calls, chats, and emails from customers, stores, and associates while
navigating multiple systems to aid in answering questions and resolving issues.
All Customer Care Coordinators must have the ability to communicate
professionally in a conversational manner while utilizing all available resources
to ensure customer satisfaction.
¢ To exceed our customers needs, our associates must be punctual, reliable,
problem solvers, act with integrity and be dedicated to making a difference.
What you'll bring
¢ 0-1 years of relevant Customer Service experience
¢ Excellent written and verbal communication skills



¢ Able to interact professionally with customers.
¢ Ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
¢ Customer focused mindset with a high level of urgency; role model for
delivering Extraordinary Customer Care
¢ In this role, you may be asked to switch between any support channel of
phone, chat, and Email based on the business requirements.
¢ Review, analyze, and process critical customer queries with accuracy to
provide customer satisfaction.
¢ Adhere to quality, compliance guidelines and SLAs
¢ Proficient with Microsoft Office programs (Outlook, Word)
¢ Successful completion of mandatory training
¢ Should be flexible work in a 24/7 work environment with rotating weekly time off.
¢ Should be able to work in permanent night shifts or any assigned shifts on
a rotational basis.
¢ Any graduation
About Walmart Global Tech
Imagine working in an environment where one line of code can make life easier for
hundreds of millions of people. Thats what we do at Walmart Global Tech. Were a team
of software engineers, data scientists, cybersecurity expert's and service professionals
within the worlds leading retailer who make an epic impact and are at the forefront of
the next retail disruption. People are why we innovate, and people power our
innovations. We are people-led and tech-empowered. We train our team in the skillsets
of the future and bring in experts like you to help us grow. We have roles for those
chasing their first opportunity as well as those looking for the opportunity that will define
their career. Here, you can kickstart a great career in tech, gain new skills and
experience for virtually every industry, or leverage your expertise to innovate at scale,
impact millions and reimagine the future of retail.



Walmarts culture sets us apart, and we know being together helps us innovate, learn
and grow great careers. This role is based in our [Bangalore] office for daily work, with
the flexibility for associates to manage their personal lives.
Benefits
Beyond our great compensation package, you can receive incentive awards for
your performance. Other great perks include a host of best-in-class benefits
maternity and parental leave, PTO, health benefits, and much more.
Belonging
We aim to create a culture where every associate feels valued for who they
are, rooted in respect for the individual. Our goal is to foster a sense of
belonging, to create opportunities for all our associates, customers and
suppliers, and to be a Walmart for everyone.
At Walmart, our vision is "everyone included." By fostering a workplace culture
where everyone isand feelsincluded, everyone wins. Our associates and
customers reflect the makeup of all 19 countries where we operate. By making
Walmart a welcoming place where all people feel like they belong, were able to
engage associates, strengthen our business, improve our ability to serve
customers, and support the communities where we operate.
Equal Opportunity Employer
Walmart, Inc., is an Equal Opportunities Employer By Choice. We believe we
are best equipped to help our associates, customers and the communities we
serve live better when we really know them. That means understanding,
respecting and valuing unique styles, experiences, identities, ideas and opinions
while being inclusive of all people.

Description:
About the job

Company Description

Simplilearn is a leading global digital skills platform that helps individuals build in-demand capabilities to succeed in the digital economy. The company delivers rigorous online training in fields such as Cyber Security, Cloud Computing, Project Management, Digital Marketing, and Data Science, where technology and best practices evolve quickly. Programs are designed and continuously updated by over 2,000 industry and academic experts and include individual courses, certification tracks, and collaborations with top universities. Simplilearn supports both individual professionals and organizations with practical, applied learning, resulting in a high percentage of learners earning promotions or new roles. With thousands of live classes, real-world projects, and hands-on learning experiences each month, Simplilearn offers a dynamic and career-focused learning environment.

Role Description

This is a full-time, on-site Student Advisor (Sales) role based in Bangalore Urban. The Student Advisor will engage with prospective learners via phone, email, and chat to understand their career goals and recommend suitable Simplilearn programs. The role includes counseling learners on course content, admission criteria, pricing, and financing options, while maintaining high standards of customer service and ethical sales practices. The Student Advisor will manage and nurture a pipeline of leads, follow up consistently, and work toward defined enrollment and revenue targets. Day-to-day tasks also include updating CRM systems, coordinating with internal teams on admissions and onboarding, and providing post-enrollment support to ensure a smooth learning experience.

Qualifications
Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build rapport with diverse learners and stakeholders.
Demonstrated student counseling or academic advisory experience, preferably in edtech or education services.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with clear and persuasive presentation abilities.
Customer service mindset with a focus on responsiveness, empathy, and problem-solving.
Understanding of the education and professional upskilling landscape, especially in digital skills domains.
Goal-oriented approach with experience working toward sales, enrollment, or revenue targets.
Comfort working in night shifts and in a fast-paced, target-driven environment.
Bachelors degree in any discipline; a background in education, business, or related fields is an advantage.
Proficiency with CRM tools and basic office software; ability to learn new systems quickly.
Previous experience in inside sales, admissions counseling, or telesales is preferred but not mandatory.


Regards
Mohit Kumar
Assistant Manager - Talent Acquisition
mohit.kumar@simplilearn.net / 8792517752

Description:
Job Title: Clearing and Settlement Analyst, NCT
Location: Bangalore, India


Role Description
The Assistant s role within Trade Services is responsible to acquire complete knowledge of Trade Services processes. Incumbent can be placed in any Trade Services Processes which are Settlement
Matching / Fails / Instructions / Registered Shares/Confirmation, Cancellations, Reconciliation, Transaction Reporting or Trade Investigation


Your key responsibilities
Successfully meeting process SLAs/productivity/quality as per the process standards.
Get certified on all training levels of the process.
Meet SLA s requirements as per the agreed Service Specifications
Meet training targets to learn process for securities transfers, matching, fails handling confirmation of trades and non-trades, cancellations corrections of trades, registration deregistration of shares, cash stock reconciliation, transaction reporting and trade investigation
100% completion of the assigned work with required quality and appropriate productivity
Contact counterparts through mails/calls as per the process requirement for any clarifications.
Performing quality checks as and when required.
Understand the linkages between various Trades Services Processes
Strive for process improvements.
Responsiveness to feedback provided by Trainers/ Team Leaders
Maintaining a professional approach to work at all times, providing prompt and appropriate responses at all levels.
Actively participate in the team meetings and other initiatives taken by the company.
Following company rules and standard operating procedures.
Adhering to all Security Policies and Procedures as per business requirements
Maintaining MIS reports, analyse data by using various reporting/presenting tools.
Active demonstration of the company values in behaviour and attitude
Continually up-grading domain knowledge.
Exhibiting discipline on a personal level as well as a professional level.


Qualifications
Graduate / Post-Graduate
German language (Level 3 above for specific processes) mentioned beforehand


Skills & Experience
0-2 years of work experience
Good communication skills
Computer literate


Key Performance Indicators
Meet and exceed timelines on productivity targets on a consistent basis.
Meet and exceed quality targets on a consistent basis
To ensure that the queries are raised within the stipulated TAT
Completeness and correctness of the MIS sheet should be strictly followed
Productivity - (must meet productivity targets set)
Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.

Description:
Candidate Manager / Senior Candidate Manager

Location -Bangalore
Experience -0 to 6 Years

About the Role

Are you passionate about connecting people with the right career opportunities? Do you thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment where relationship-building and problem-solving are key? TEKsystems is looking for a Candidate Manager / Senior Candidate Manager to join our high-performing recruitment team.
In this role, you will act as a trusted career partner to candidates while supporting clients in identifying and hiring top talent. You will manage the complete recruitment lifecycle, from sourcing and screening to offer management and onboarding, ensuring an exceptional candidate experience throughout the process.

Key Responsibilities

Understand client hiring requirements and identify suitable talent aligned with business needs.
Manage end-to-end recruitment activities including sourcing, screening, candidate engagement, interview coordination, offer negotiation, and onboarding.
Build and maintain strong candidate networks within the technology market.
Develop relationships with potential candidates through phone calls, virtual meetings, and face-to-face interactions.
Proactively market candidate profiles to clients and identify new opportunities.
Ensure a seamless and positive candidate experience throughout the hiring process.
Stay updated on industry trends, recruitment best practices, and technology skill demands.
Collaborate with internal teams to achieve hiring objectives and contribute to a supportive team culture.
Maintain regular follow-ups with candidates and stakeholders to drive successful hiring outcomes.
Identify opportunities to improve recruitment efficiency and overall team performance.

Required Skills & Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in any discipline.
0 to 6 years of experience in recruitment, preferably within the staffing or talent acquisition industry.
Strong experience in:
Sourcing and screening candidates
Candidate engagement and relationship management
Interview coordination
Offer management and salary negotiations
Post-offer follow-up and onboarding
Experience hiring for technology/IT roles is preferred.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Strong networking and relationship-building abilities.
Ability to work in a target-driven and fast-paced environment.
Proactive, self-motivated, and results-oriented mindset.

Preferred Attributes

Description:
HANA Cloud Developer (BDC Upskilling Program)
Role Summary
Seeking professionals to upskill on SAP HANA Cloud with a strong focus on data modeling, SQL scripting, and cloud-native development. The role involves designing performant data models, developing database artifacts, and supporting analytics and application workloads on SAP HANA Cloud.
Key Responsibilities
Develop and maintain SAP HANA Cloud data models including Calculation Views, Dimensions, and Analytical Models.
Create and optimize SQLScript procedures, functions, and database objects.
Design data transformation and integration logic using HANA Cloud capabilities.
Implement performance tuning, query optimization, and data quality best practices.
Work with business and technical teams to translate requirements into scalable data models.
Support deployment and lifecycle management using SAP Business Application Studio and Git-based workflows.
Adhere to cloud security, governance, and data management standards.
Required Skills
Understanding of SAP HANA Cloud architecture and database concepts.
Hands-on experience in Data Modeling (Calculation Views, Star Schema, Dimensional Modeling).
Proficiency in SQL and SQLScript development.
Knowledge of performance optimization, debugging, and troubleshooting techniques.
Familiarity with SAP BTP, HDI Containers, and cloud development concepts.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
Preferred Skills
SAP Business Data Cloud (BDC) certification and/or hands-on implementation experience preferred.
Exposure to SAP Datasphere, SAP BW/4HANA, or SAP Data Intelligence.
Experience with data integration, ETL processes, and reporting tools.
Understanding of DevOps, CI/CD, and version control practices.
Experience working with Hyperscalers (Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform) and knowledge of cloud integration patterns is desirable not mandatory.
Familiarity with integrating SAP solutions with hyperscaler-native services for data, analytics, security, and application development is an advantage.
Upskilling Outcome Participants will gain practical expertise in SAP HANA Cloud data modeling, advanced SQL Script development, performance optimization, cloud-native database application development, and integration with SAP Business Data Cloud and Hyperscalers ecosystems.
SAP HANA Cloud exp is must- 4 to 7 yrs exp

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced SAP BusinessObjects Developer with 5 years of expertise in designing, developing, and maintaining Business Intelligence solutions using SAP BusinessObjects. - Develop and maintain data models, joins, contexts, aliases, and derived tables.
- Perform report scheduling, publication, and distribution using BO Central Management Console (CMC).
- Work with database teams to develop SQL queries, stored procedures, and performance tuning activities.
- Support BO platform administration activities, including user access management and security setup.
- Collaborate with business users, data analysts, and ETL teams to ensure data accuracy and reporting consistency.
- Participate in testing, deployment, and production support activities.
- Prepare technical documentation and provide end-user support/training.

SAP BusinessObjects Tools
- Web Intelligence (WebI)
- Information Design Tool (IDT)
- Central Management Console (CMC)
- BI Launch Pad
Database Skills
- SQL
- Oracle
- SQL Server
Data Warehousing
- ETL Concepts
- Data Modeling
- Star Schema and Snowflake Schema
Reporting & Analytics
- Report Development
- Dashboard Design
- Query Optimization
- Data Validation
### Preferred Skills
- Experience with SAP BW/HANA reporting.
- Knowledge of SAP BusinessObjects 4.2/4.3 versions.
- Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
- Familiarity with version control and deployment processes.

Description:
Territory Sales Manager (TSM)
About NoBroker Technologies Private Limited
NoBrokerHood, a part of NoBroker Technologies Pvt.Ltd. Our founders understood the need to have a tech-enabled
visitor and community management system, that aims to make life convenient, hassle-free, and secure for the
residents of a gated community. Thus, NoBrokerHood was launched. NoBrokerHood is a smart visitor, society and
accounting management system. From our start in late 2018, NoBrokerHood is currently securing 20,000+ societies
under its hood. From catering to all the society needs like complaint management, gate entry, maintenance bill
payments, digital notice board, it also has features like Marketplace, home services and more. NoBrokerHood goes
beyond visitor and gate management delivering an end-to-end community experience that empowers residents
and management committees with digital convenience, revenue growth, and future-ready innovation.
To know more about NoBrokerHood, visit our website - https://www.nobrokerhood.com/
About the role:
We are currently looking to hire an energetic, highly motivated, can-do attitude individual who is willing to join our
team as a Territory Sales Manager. In this role, you will be responsible for acquiring leads and generating revenue
by onboarding new apartment complexes and societies into NoBrokerHood by meeting with prospective clients in
person and explaining the product.
Job Description:-



Minimum 1-5 years of proven sales track record and ability to meet targets.
Lead generation through prospecting referral and web researches
Should have an interest in Business Development (B2C/ B2B) for Software Application Products
/solutions.

Meet prospective clients, execute effective product demonstrations, and emphasize product features and
benefits with a focus on the value of the solution.


Capabilities of selling Hardware IOT devices
Meet with Committee Members of Apartments and Societies,accounting services partners and builders to
understand the scope of business and their expectations.




Prospect, educate, qualify, and generate interest for Sales Opportunities and lead conversions.
Ability to do product demonstrations to higher level authorities
Onboarding new apartments on the NoBrokerHood platform will be a major KRA.
Researching potential leads from the open market, web searches, or digital resources.
Mandatory requirements for this position





Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Should be proficient in English and Regional language (knowing the regional language of the job location
will be a plus).






Should be comfortable working on weekends(Sat & Sun compulsory working), with a week off on Monday.
Effective presentation and negotiation skills.
Hands-on MS Office Excel, Word & PPT, etc.
Ability to handle CRM softwares
A valid drivers license(DL) with a two-wheeler/four-wheeler as this role requires you to be on the field.
Geographical knowledge of the job location is an added advantage.
What we have to offer!

Working directly with the leadership team; having a high level of work independence, autonomy, and
empowerment to lead company-wide changes


Flexible working hours
Being part of a start-up from an early stage, lead your area of expertise and be a part of this exciting growth
journey of changing the real estate world


Excellent platform for learning how to build teams, achieve goals and handle high-growth situations. Ideal
for people with entrepreneurial ambitions.
Uncapped variables based on performance
Benefits





Performance Bonus
Corporate Health Insurance
Travel Allowance
Monthly R&R awards
Early promotions for the outstanding performers

SAP Project Manager S/4HANA Public Cloud
Location - Mumbai , Pune , Bangalore , Gandhinagar

Flexible / Hybrid / Remote

Experience
8-15 years in SAP Project Management with at least 2 end-to-end SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud implementations.
Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced SAP Project Manager to lead SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud implementation projects. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing project delivery, stakeholder engagement, budget oversight, risk management, and ensuring successful deployment of SAP best practices using the SAP Activate methodology.
The Project Manager will collaborate with business stakeholders, SAP consultants, system integrators, and technical teams to drive projects from initiation through go-live and hypercare support.
Key Responsibilities
Lead end-to-end SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud implementation projects.
Manage project scope, timelines, budgets, risks, and resources.
Drive project governance and ensure compliance with SAP Activate methodology.
Facilitate requirement gathering, fit-to-standard workshops, and solution design discussions.
Coordinate cross-functional teams including Functional, Technical, Integration, Data Migration, and Change Management workstreams.
Monitor project progress and provide regular status reporting to leadership and steering committees.
Manage stakeholder expectations and ensure alignment with business objectives.
Identify and mitigate project risks, issues, and dependencies.
Oversee testing cycles including SIT, UAT, and Go-Live readiness activities.
Support cutover planning, deployment, hypercare, and project closure activities.
Ensure delivery quality, adherence to best practices, and customer satisfaction.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field.
8+ years of SAP project management experience.
Minimum 2 full lifecycle SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud implementation projects.
Strong understanding of SAP Activate methodology and Cloud ERP deployment models.
Experience managing global or multi-country SAP programs.
Proven expertise in project planning, budgeting, risk management, and vendor management.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
Experience with Agile, Hybrid Agile, and Waterfall delivery methodologies.
Preferred Qualifications
SAP Activate Project Manager Certification.
PMP, PRINCE2, Scrum Master, or Agile certifications.
Experience with SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP), SAP Integration Suite, and SAP Signavio.
Knowledge of finance, procurement, supply chain, manufacturing, or HR business processes.

Description:
We have an opportunity to have SAP BTP Administrator - Integration & AI Transformation Manager
Position: SAP BTP Administrator - Integration
Experience Required: 10-16 Years
Notice Period: Immediate to 30 Days
Locations: Bangalore, Hyderabad & Chennai
Work Timing: Rotational Shifts (2 To 11)
Required Skills:
1. Design and implement real-time integration strategies connecting SAP S/4HANA, SuccessFactors, and Ariba to ensure seamless data flow across systems.
2. Deploy and manage SAP AI Core and Generative AI technologies to automate and optimize core business processes.
3. Govern and oversee API management and event-driven architectures using SAP Event Mesh to enable scalable and secure integrations.
4. Architect and maintain robust data orchestration pipelines between cloud platforms and hyperscaler environments.
5. Administer SAP Integration Suite and Cloud Platform Integration (CPI) to build, monitor, and troubleshoot integration scenarios.
6. Develop, deploy, and maintain machine learning models using SAP AI Launchpad and related AI tools to support business needs.
7. Ensure compliance and efficient usage of communication protocols such as REST, SOAP, OData, EDI, and GraphQL in all integration workflows.
8. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify automation opportunities leveraging AI and integration technologies.
9. Monitor system performance and provide continuous improvements for integration flows and AI deployments within the SAP BTP environment.
10. Maintain documentation, provide training and support to stakeholders on SAP BTP administration, API governance, and AI-enabled automation solutions.Experience in SAP Technical Pre-Sales including creation of technical proposals and constructing estimates for SAP Technical work.
11. Knowledge on SAP cloud offerings like BTP, SAC, Cloud connector, etc.
12. Full cycle experience in SAP Migration and S/4 Conversion activities.
13. Strong knowledge and exposure to HANA Database and MS SQL Database.
14. Strong knowledge in BOBI, Data services etc.
15. Proficient in the use of methodologies supported by SAP best practices.
16. Strong knowledge in troubleshooting performance issues and providing solutions to fine tune the system.
17. Must be proactive and self-motivated.
18. Must be easily understood and possess excellent English communication skills, both verbal and writing skills.
19. Must Have customer facing experience and possess good negotiation skills.
20. Exposure to ITIL framework.
21. Provide SME advice to the team and Mentor team members to achieve the desired result by conducting Boot camps, learning sessions, etc.
22. Should have a good understanding of the organization structure and requirements.
23. Develop and maintain process and technical documentation.
24. Prepare and present project status reports to Clients and Senior Management.
25. Must have experience in working with cross functional and cross cultural teams across the globe.
26. Should provide escalation support and ensure all the tasks and issues are resolved within the deadline.

Description:
Role: Workday Extend Consultant
Exp: 4 to 10 years
Locations: Bang/Hyd/Chennai/Pune/Gurugram
Mode of work: Hybrid
Certifications: Workday Certified (Mandatory)

Certification(s) Preferred:
Active Workday Extend certification
Required Skills:
Active Workday Extend Certification.
Hands-on experience building, testing, and deploying Extend solutions for Workday Customers.
Workday Extend support experience and ability to work on multiple projects.
Proficiency in Workday Extend configuration, including data modeling, business process customization, and integration development
Well versed with Business Processes, Security Group configurations, Calculated Fields.
Ability to translate functional / nonfunctional requirements to systems requirements.
Good project & time management skills - ability to handle multiple priorities, organize work and meet deadlines.
Preferred Skills:
Good to have experience on advance reports and other Workday certifications.
Knowledge of Workday Studio, BIRT, Payroll (PECI/PICOF) and various middleware Integrations, Connectors, Matrix, Composite reports, etc.
Knowledge of Workday security framework, custom fields and custom reports.
Integration experience in either of Human Resources, Payroll or Financials Management.
Analyze Workday release updates to understand impacts of feature changes, in relation to clients existing configuration.

Description:
Role: Workday Benefits Consultant
Exp: 4 to 10 years
Locations: Bang/Hyd/Chennai/Pune/Gurugram
Mode of work: Hybrid
Certifications: Workday Certified (Mandatory)

Certification(s) Preferred:
Active Workday certification (HCM/Benefits)

Responsibilities & Key skills:
As a Workday Benefits Consultant, you will be responsible for ensuring the successful support of Workdays Benefits Solution.
Certification in Workday Benefits is a must, along with that compensation certification will be an added advantage.
Having experience in any other module in addition to benefits would be considered an additional advantage
You will provide Workday product, subject matter, and solution expertise; and work with partners to understand their business requirements and help develop ,configure and test the derived solutions.
In-depth knowledge of how benefits plan such as retirement plans 403b are setup in benefits payroll functional areas.
You will work effectively individually and with team members toward customer satisfaction and success.
Design and support requirements in the Workday Benefits solution including company benefits program, which can include health and welfare plans, retirement plans, wellbeing plans, PTO and other leave programs, and other voluntary benefits.
Demonstrate the configurations through the development of a POC, perform Testing .
You will assist in creating solutions for clients and or internal review.
Conduct working sessions with clients to gather, understand, and analyze business requirements; ensure client takes advantage of Workday standard methodologies.
Analyze Workday release updates to understand impacts of feature changes, in relation to clients existing configuration.
Resolve functional issues and understand and implement complex business scenarios.
Ability to manage multiple projects of differing scale and duration.

Description:
Role & responsibilities
Role & responsibilities
Location: Hyderabad/Bangalore/Pune/PAN india
Work mode : Hybrid Exp : 7 to 10 Yrs only
Primary Skills : MS Intune admin, Windows Autopilot& Zero-Touch Deployment, Endpoint Security & Device Configuration
Notice Period : Immediate/30 Days only
Shift : 24/7 , 5 PM - 5 AM (Rotational shift - Night shift)

Mandatory Skills:
Windows Autopilot & Zero-Touch Deployment
Application Packaging & Deployment          
Patch Management & Update Rings
Endpoint Security & Device Configuration Automation, Scripting & Intune Administration
Key Responsibilities Intune Administration & Endpoint Management Manage and administer Microsoft Intune (MEM) platform. Configure and maintain device enrollment policies. Manage Configuration Profiles, Compliance Policies, and Security Baselines. Support Windows, iOS Android, macOS, and BYOD devices. Implement and manage Mobile Device Management (MDM) and Mobile Application Management (MAM). Autopilot & Device Provisioning Design and manage Windows Autopilot deployments. Support Zero-Touch provisioning and device lifecycle management. Configure Hybrid Azure AD Join and Entra ID Join scenarios. Application Management Package and deploy Win32, MSI, Microsoft Store, and Line-of-Business applications. Manage Company Portal applications. Troubleshoot application deployment failures. Create detection methods, requirement rules, and supersedence relationships. Security & Compliance Implement Conditional Access policies. Manage Defender for Endpoint integration. Configure BitLocker Windows Hello for Business, and Endpoint Security policies. Maintain compliance with organizational security standards. SCCM Co-Management Manage SCCM and Intune co-management workloads. Support workload migration from SCCM to Intune. Configure Software Updates, Compliance Policies, and Device Configuration workloads. Automation & Reporting Develop PowerShell scripts for automation and reporting. Utilize Microsoft Graph APIs for endpoint management tasks. Generate compliance and device health reports. Troubleshooting & Support Provide L3 support for complex endpoint incidents. Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for recurring issues. Handle escalations from L1/L2 teams. Create technical documentation, SOPs, and Knowledge Articles. Job Description: Data Scientist Manager (PwC US AC)
PwC US Acceleration Center is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Data Scientist to join our team at the Manager level. As a Data Scientist, you will play a critical role in designing, developing, and deploying predictive models, statistical analyses, and AI-driven solutions that transform complex data into actionable business insights.
The ideal candidate should have a strong background in data science and machine learning, hands-on experience in model development and deployment, and the ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable analytics solutions across industries.
Responsibilities:
Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand problem statements and translate them into analytical solutions.
Design, develop, and deploy predictive models including classification, regression, clustering, and time-series forecasting models.
Perform exploratory data analysis (EDA), data cleaning, preprocessing, and feature engineering on structured and unstructured datasets.
Apply statistical techniques including hypothesis testing and experimental design to validate insights and model performance.
Work closely with data engineers to build and maintain scalable data pipelines and ensure efficient data processing.
Deploy machine learning models into production environments using APIs and containerization technologies.
Implement MLOps best practices including model versioning, monitoring, CI/CD integration, and model registries.
Utilize cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP for model training, deployment, and scaling.
Develop interactive dashboards and visualizations using tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Matplotlib
Communicate findings and insights to technical and non-technical stakeholders through reports, presentations, and data storytelling.
Stay updated with the latest advancements in machine learning, AI, and data science methodologies to drive innovation.
Requirements:
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related field.
7+ years of relevant experience in data science, machine learning, or applied statistics.
Strong programming proficiency in Python (pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, statsmodels) and/or R.
Experience building and validating predictive models (classification, regression, clustering, time-series).
Strong understanding of statistics, hypothesis testing, and experimental design.
Proficiency in SQL and experience working with structured and unstructured datasets.
Hands-on experience with machine learning frameworks such as scikit-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM, TensorFlow, or PyTorch.
Experience deploying ML models into production using FastAPI or similar frameworks.
Familiarity with containerization and orchestration tools such as Docker and Kubernetes.
Experience working with cloud platforms such as Azure ML, AWS SageMaker, or GCP Vertex AI.
Experience with Spark (PySpark), Databricks, or large-scale data processing frameworks.
Knowledge of MLOps tools such as MLflow, model registries, and CI/CD pipelines.
Experience working with SQL/NoSQL databases, Data Lakes, and Blob Storage.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
Ability to work in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.
Nice to Have Skills:
Experience working on AI/LLM-enabled analytics solutions.
Exposure to Generative AI or advanced AI frameworks.
Experience in building data products or end-to-end ML platforms.(pandas,Keras, Tensorflow)
Relevant certifications in Data Science, Cloud, or Machine Learning technologies.
Strong background in the Healthcare domain, with deep understanding of Payer operations and working knowledge of Provider ecosystems.
Experience in consulting engagements, including direct interaction with client stakeholders and managing client relationships.
Demonstrated leadership experience managing and mentoring teams of 5–10 members.
Preferred Qualifications:
BE / B.Tech / MCA / M.Sc / M.E / M.Tech / Master’s Degree / MBA from a reputed institute

Description:
Job Title: Automation Test Engineer
Job Summary
We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Automation Test Engineer to design, develop, and maintain automated test solutions that ensure the quality and reliability of software applications. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in test automation frameworks, functional testing, API testing, and continuous integration practices.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and execute automated test scripts for web, mobile, and API applications.
Create and maintain automation frameworks using industry-standard tools.
Collaborate with developers, business analysts, and QA teams to understand requirements and testing needs.
Identify, document, and track software defects.
Perform functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end testing.
Execute API testing using tools such as Postman, Rest Assured, or similar.
Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.
Analyze test results and prepare detailed test reports.
Improve test coverage, efficiency, and overall product quality.
Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies and contribute to quality assurance best practices.
Required Skills & Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
2-3 years of experience in software testing and automation.
Hands-on experience with automation tools such as:
Selenium WebDriver
Cypress
Playwright
Appium (for mobile testing)
Strong programming skills in Java, Python, JavaScript, or C#.
Experience with TestNG, JUnit, NUnit, or similar frameworks.
Knowledge of API testing tools such as Postman and Rest Assured.
Experience with version control tools like Git.
Familiarity with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or GitHub Actions.
Strong understanding of SDLC, STLC, and Agile methodologies.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
Preferred Skills
Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
Knowledge of performance testing tools like JMeter or LoadRunner.
Experience with BDD frameworks such as Cucumber.
Familiarity with containerization tools such as Docker and Kubernetes.
Key Competencies
Attention to detail
Strong communication skills
Team collaboration
Critical thinking
Quality-focused mindset
Location: Bangalore / Hybrid / Remote
Experience: 2 -3 Years
Employment Type: Full-Time

Description:
Job Title: Area Sales Manager
Experience: 2-6 Years
Location: Bangalore | Pune | Chennai
Employment Type: Full-Time Industry: Real Estate / PropTech
Working Days: 6 Days a Week (Including Weekends)
Role Category: Retail & B2C Sales

About NoBroker

NoBroker is India's first PropTech unicorn and the world's largest no-brokerage property platform. We provide end-to-end real estate solutions and help customers buy, sell, rent, and finance properties seamlessly.Job SummaryWe are looking for a highly motivated Area Sales Manager to drive property sales by consulting prospective homebuyers, managing qualified leads, and closing deals. The ideal candidate should possess excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills with a passion for achieving sales targets.

Key Responsibilities
Handle qualified leads through calls, virtual meetings, and site visits.
Understand customer requirements and recommend suitable property options.
Conduct property presentations and schedule site visits.
Negotiate and close property deals with customers.
Build strong customer relationships and generate referrals.
Cross-sell NoBroker's additional services to enhance the customer experience.
Maintain a healthy sales pipeline and achieve daily, weekly, and monthly sales targets.
Stay updated on market trends, inventory, and property pricing.

Candidate Profile
Bachelor's degree in any discipline.
26 years of experience in Sales, Real Estate, BFSI, Investment Advisory, or similar customer-facing roles.
Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
Strong customer handling and relationship management abilities.
Target-driven with a consultative sales approach.
Good knowledge of the local real estate market is preferred.
Own vehicle (preferred).
Proficiency in English, Hindi, and the local language.

Key Skills- Direct Sales, Investment Advisory, Real Estate Sales, Property Sales, Customer Relationship Management (CRM), Lead Generation, Lead Conversion, Negotiation, Closing Sales, Business Development, Cross Selling, Consultative Selling, Communication Skills.

Why Join NoBroker?
Work with India's leading PropTech Unicorn.
Attractive salary and performance-based incentives.
High-quality qualified leads.
Excellent learning and career growth opportunities.

Description:
We are looking for an experienced Full Stack Ecommerce Developer (Magento 2) to join our platinum team of entrepreneurial, enthusiastic, and caring people.
You will be responsible in developing, maintaining, securing, and optimizing our eCommerce platform based on Magento 2 on hyper scaler cloud environment including underlying components.
You will identify new and exciting functionalities and develop new modules.
If you are the person who can design and develop web / mobile platforms securely at an unbelievable pace, we would like to meet you.
To succeed in this role, you must have a growth mindset and be a self-starter, top-notch communicator and passionate hands-on programmer.
Responsibilities
Optimize existing Magento 2 installation
Provide regular and emergency support for break-fixes
Troubleshoot integration and performance issues
Design interfaces, themes, templates while following best practices and maintain world-class coding styles and standard
Anticipate the performance requirements and communicate with management on remediation plans to CTO/CIO
Develop new Magento modules and functionalities
Manage and upgrade Magento add-ons and conduct code reviews/scans
Establish DevOps pipelines, Release/Change management procedures, etc.
Develop testing scenarios including unit testing, integration testing and automate those
Work with UI/UX and graphic designers to implement front-end changes
Work with content writer to implement new contents
Implement additional components such as Elastic Search, Varnish, Redis, CDN, RabbitMQ, etc.
Manage SSL certificates, software accounts, keys, etc.
Rearchitect environment and provide vertical and horizontal scaling as demand grows
Fine-tune batch jobs (Crons) or Consumers
Migrate databases and data
Develop integrations for files, images, etc.
Manage stack components and upgrade them (Ubuntu, PHP, Percona, Nginx, Composer, Firewall, Redis, etc.)
Create plans for developing mobile experience, mobile apps or PWA front end environment
Maintain confidentiality about IP, methods, processes and data
Participate in conferences, webinars and provide presentations while socializing and partnering with startups
Install security patches and monitor web traffic
brand and perform soft-sell while managing and improving brand reputation
Collaborate with other stakeholders such as content developer (copywriter), graphics and media designer, and management for consistent brand messaging and best customer experience
Qualifications
Strong experience with Magento 2 development and debugging
Strong experience with high-performance technologies such as Nginx, Varnish, Redis, ElasticSearch
JavaScript and AJAX experience for Front-end
Extensive HTML5, LESS and CSS knowledge
Understanding of modern UI/UX trends
Experience or knowledge of React.js, Vue.js and Node.js
Experience with AWS components such as VPC, IAM, EC2, ECS, Lambda, S3, CloudFront, WAF Cloud Formation
Linux or Ubuntu server operations working and know-hows
Experience in working with MySQL databases like MariaDB and Percona
Basic understanding of networking and ports
Experience with Google Tag Manager, SEO, Google Analytics, PPC, Facebook Pixels. A/B Testing
Strong attention to details about design styles to improve look and feel
Very good PHP knowledge and understating of various frameworks
Ability to work in a professional capacity and team environment is must
Ability to manage projects and work in strict deadlines
Education Certifications
Bachelors/Masters in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field
Magento 2 Certification is required
Cloud Computing Certification (AWS/GCP/Azure) is a plus
AboutCompany:
Prayag Healths idea dates back to 2017 when one of the founders experienced an acute episode of back pain and could not get the product guidance to obtain temporary relief. Prayag Health was born out of his life- long passion for healthcare and commitment in Allen, Texas. Prayag Health began its operations in late 2019 to help people live healthy and happy. We achieve that by providing innovative solutions that can influence their lives and the lives of their loved ones.

Job Title: API Automation Test Engineer
Experience: 5 to 9 Years
Location: Bangalore / Pune / Chennai
Employment Type: Full-Time

Required Skills
5-9 years of experience in software testing with strong expertise in API Automation Testing.
Hands-on experience in API testing and automation using Rest Assured, Postman, and Swagger/OpenAPI.
Strong programming skills in Java with experience in developing and maintaining API automation frameworks.

Good understanding of TestNG, JUnit, Maven, Gradle, and Git.
Experience working with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or GitLab CI.
Strong knowledge of Agile methodologies and SDLC/STLC processes.
Experience in backend testing, database validation, and SQL queries.
Knowledge of defect tracking tools such as JIRA, Azure Boards, etc.
Experience in automation of API test cases, regression suites, and integration testing.
Understanding of authentication mechanisms such as OAuth, JWT, Basic Authentication, and API security testing concepts.
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills.

Description:
Role: Workday Compensation Consultant
Exp: 4 to 10 years
Locations: Bang/Hyd/Chennai/Pune/Gurugram
Mode of work: Hybrid
Certifications: Workday Certified (Mandatory)

Certification(s) Preferred:
Active Workday certification (HCM/Compensation)

Required Skills:
Active Workday Core HCM and Advanced Compensation certification.
At least 4 years of relevant Workday HCM experience and ability to work on multiple projects.
Hand on experience on setting up compensation elements like grades, grade profiles, sticks plans, bonus plans, merit plans etc.
Subject Matter Expertise in configuring compensation grid, managing new and existing plans while identifying opportunities for automation and process improvements.
Expertise on stock grants and updates, Processing Bonus Events, One-time payments, Future payments, consolidated Merits.
Functional experience in multiple HR processes like Payroll, Time Tracking, Benefits, Absence, Recruiting, Talent.
Perform HRIS operational duties for Workday HCM and Compensation modules.
Ability to work with the client and drive design sessions for various HCM/Compensation areas and hands-on experience in business process configuration and building validation/condition rules.
Understanding of HR programs and policies along with a commitment to HR principles of confidentiality required data analysis and report building skills is essential.
Hands-on experience creating and troubleshooting EIBs (Enterprise Interface Builder).
Ability to help customers resolve functional issues requiring in depth expertise in the Workday solutions.
In-depth knowledge of Workday security framework, calculated fields, custom reports like Advanced/Matrix/Composite and setting up notifications.
In-depth knowledge of various data sources available and how to use them.
Analyze Workday release updates to understand impacts of feature changes, in relation to clients existing configuration.
Ability to maintain the highest regulatory and compliance standards in handling employee records.
Ensure effective engagement and collaboration with cross functional teams (HRIS & Digital, P&C, People Analytics).
Preferred Skills:
Good to have additional certifications like: Payroll, Time Tracking, Benefits, Absence, Talent, Recruiting, Reporting.
Knowledge on using object transporter, Customer Central for configuration and migration.

Description:
Hiring for Legal Entity Controller for Bangalore & Pune location!!
Client: Fortune 500 MNC, World's largest pure-play American consumer health MNC by revenue
Location: Bangalore & Pune
Bangalore-Manyata Tech park
Exp: 5 Plus Years of relevant Experience
Tenure : 6 Months contract through Randstad Payroll (Extendible & Convertible based on Performance & Projects)
Timing : 12PM to 9PM (EMEA Shift)
Mode: Hybrid 2 Days Office
Interview Rounds: 2 Rounds Virtual

Contact Details
Email :- ganeshm.reddy@randstadsourceright.com
Phone :- 7760406375
Job Description:
The Legal Entity Controller role primarily oversees the legal entity (LE) financial reporting process, ensuring the integrity and precision of the LE financial statements, tax filings, reporting packages, and other relevant reports. Responsibilities will include streamlining month, quarter, and year-end closings within established timelines, handling high importance/complex items during entity closings, and managing local audits. The position requires interaction with Business Unit (BU) Finance, providing crucial financial data and analysis. Additionally, it includes the recruitment and development of a high-performing accounting team.

Experience and Skills
Required:
Bachelors degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field (Master's degree or CPA preferred).
5-8 years of proven experience as a controller or similar roles, preferably in a multinational company.
Deep understanding of accounting principles, financial legislation, and regulatory standards.
Strong leadership skills with the ability to manage and develop a team.
Strong analytical, strategic planning, and decision-making skills.
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and manage well through ambiguity and complexity.
Proficient in accounting software and Microsoft Office Suite.

Key Responsibilities:
Gain a thorough understanding of each legal entitys jurisdiction to grasp the financial accounting and reporting procedures, bearing in mind the complexities and effect of local laws on the overall companys financial protocols.
Spearhead the timely assembly, submission, and sign off of financial statements, which includes the Balance Sheet, Profit & Loss, Cash Flow, alongside local tax requirements, internal reporting packages, and other mandatory reports in alignment with established accounting standards.
Review and approve complex journal entries prepared by accounting teams.
Lead the close process, which includes month-end, quarter-end, and year-end accounts for each legal entity within their jurisdiction.
Oversee internal controls and introduce enhancements as necessary to safeguard the integrity of financial information.
Liaise with BU Finance teams to understand trends that may influence LE reporting and tax compliance due to local regulations.
Collaborate with Regional Controller, Consolidations, and Technical Accounting teams to address intricate accounting issues.
Coordinate with external auditors for Legal Entity audits.
Monitor the progress of local audits, supplying necessary aid as required.
Demonstrate the capability to manage and supervise a team of Legal Entity Accountants.

Stakeholder Interaction:
Local Finance Director and/or General Manager
The LE Controller will closely support the local FD and/or GM related to all matters pertaining to entity results, financial statements, local filings, and compliance.
Consolidations and Technical Accounting
The LE Controller will actively connect with the Consolidations and the Technical Accounting team for guidance on complex accounting matters.
BU Finance
LE Controller will support BU Finance teams with regards to providing data for month-end performance analysis.
Regional Controllers
The LE Controller will connect with the regional controllers on complex matters pertaining to entity financial reporting documents and other local filings, audit requests, etc.

Education:
A minimum of a bachelors degree is required in Finance / Accounting / Business Management. CPA or related professional certification preferred.

Description:
We are looking for a skilled Electrician with 2 to 7 years of experience to join our team at Ambuja Cements Ltd, located in the steel plant. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in electrical systems and troubleshooting.

Roles and Responsibility


Troubleshoot and repair electrical issues in the steel plant.

Install, maintain, and test electrical equipment and systems.

Collaborate with other teams to ensure smooth operation of electrical systems.

Develop and implement preventative maintenance schedules for electrical equipment.

Ensure compliance with safety protocols and regulations.

Provide technical support and training to junior staff members.


Job Requirements


Minimum 2 years of experience as an electrician, preferably in a steel plant setting.

Strong knowledge of electrical systems, including wiring, circuits, and testing.

Ability to read and interpret electrical diagrams and schematics.

Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.

Good communication and teamwork skills.

Familiarity with safety protocols and regulations related to electrical work.

Description:
Microsoft Dynamics 365 Project Operations Technical Consultant / Senior Developer
Experience: 57 Years
Location: Bangalore (First Preference) / Chennai / Hyderabad (Hybrid / Onsite)
Mandatory: Project Operations experience.
Role Summary
We are seeking a hands-on Microsoft Dynamics 365 Project Operations Technical Consultant who will be responsible for designing, developing, and supporting enterprise-scale Project Operations solutions. The candidate should have strong technical expertise in D365 CE, Project Operations, Power Platform, custom development, and integrations.
Key Responsibilities
D365 Project Operations – Technical Ownership
- Implement and customize Microsoft Dynamics 365 Project Operations (Lite and Integrated models).
- Develop and customize model-driven apps, entities, forms, views, dashboards, business rules, and process flows.
- Support technical enablement of project planning, resource management, time & expense, costing, and billing.
Custom Development
- Develop plugins using C# (.NET).
- Build custom workflows, actions, and extensions.
- Develop JavaScript and TypeScript customizations.
- Follow Microsoft best practices and ALM standards.
Power Platform
- Develop Power Automate cloud flows for approvals, time & expense, and billing workflows.
- Configure solution layering, security, and environment management.
Integration & Data Migration
- Design and support integrations with Finance & Operations, ERP systems, and third-party systems.
- Perform data migration using KingswaySoft SSIS and Dataverse tools.
- Support cut-over, reconciliation, and validation activities.
DevOps & Delivery
- Use Azure DevOps for source control, CI/CD pipelines, and work item tracking.
- Prepare Technical Design Documents (TDDs).
- Participate in Agile ceremonies.
Mandatory Skills & Qualifications
- Strong hands-on experience with Dynamics 365 Project Operations.
- Proficiency in C#, .NET, JavaScript, TypeScript.
- Strong experience with Power Automate and Dataverse.
- Experience with Azure DevOps and Git.
Good to Have
- Experience integrating with Finance & Operations.
- Exposure to Azure Functions or Logic Apps.
- Microsoft Dynamics 365 or Power Platform certifications.
- Experience in global enterprise implementations.
Soft Skills
- Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
- Excellent communication skills.
- Ability to work independently and in distributed teams.
- Strong documentation and knowledge transfer skills.

Description:
Personal Assistant Office Manager (1 Post)
Qualifications
Graduate above
Requirements
Excellent organisation and attention to detail.
Excellent written and spoken English with strong drafting skills.
Strong communication, coordination, and follow-up skills.
Ability to handle confidential information with complete discretion.
Calm under pressure with strong problem-solving abilities.
Initiative, adaptability, and independent judgment.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office and Google Workspace.
Familiarity with ChatGPT/AI productivity tools, Notion, Trello, or Asana.

Maintain digital files, cloud storage, task trackers, calendars, and contact databases.
Ideal Candidate
Highly organised, trustworthy, discreet, and proactive.
Comfortable working with senior political leaders, academics, diplomats, and civil society representatives.
Able to manage multiple priorities independently and anticipate requirements.
Functional Area
Nagaland / as required

Full Time

Description:
At Saturday Art Class (SArC), we believe that every child deserves the tools to imagine, express, and grow. As a non-profit educational initiative, we embed visual arts and social-emotional learning (SEL) into the classrooms of India s government and low-income schools-helping children discover their voices and build the skills they need to thrive in life.
Since 2016, SArC has co-created safe and creative spaces with over 90 partners across 13 states , enabling students to engage in art-based learning that nurtures empathy, resilience, and self-awareness. Our digital resources have empowered 1.12 million+ users across 7 countries , reinforcing our commitment to equitable access to creativity and emotional wellbeing.
SArC s journey has been powered by educators, artists, learners, and changemakers who believe in the transformative power of art. Join us as we continue to make creativity a right, not a privilege- for every child, everywhere.

As the Manager, Program Operations (Nagaland) , you will lead Saturday Art Classs government partnerships and program implementation across Nagaland. You will be responsible for driving the successful execution, growth, and sustainability of state-level programs while strengthening relationships with government departments, schools, implementation partners, and local ecosystem organizations.
Beyond managing day-to-day implementation, you will develop long-term operational strategies, anticipate future opportunities and challenges, and build systems that enable sustainable scale. You will lead the Nagaland team, ensure high-quality implementation across districts, and contribute to organizational strategy through contextual insights, continuous learning, and strong cross-functional collaboration.
This role requires a strategic and execution-oriented leader who can navigate complex government systems, build trust with senior stakeholders, manage teams, and create sustainable pathways for institutional adoption of arts-based education.

Roles and responsibilities:
Government Partnerships & State Leadership
Lead strategic engagement with SCERT, Samagra Shiksha, the Directorate of School Education, District Education Offices, school leaders, and other government stakeholders.
Build, strengthen, and sustain long-term partnerships with government departments, implementation partners, civil society organizations, and ecosystem stakeholders.
Represent Saturday Art Class in government reviews, consultations, planning meetings, workshops, and official forums.
Develop trusted relationships with senior government officials while ensuring timely follow-up on commitments, approvals, and action points.
Monitor shifts in government priorities, policies, leadership transitions, and education initiatives, adapting implementation strategies to sustain long-term partnerships and program continuity.
Identify opportunities for program expansion, institutionalization, and deeper government ownership across Nagaland.
Lead the preparation of government presentations, review documents, partnership reports, and official communication.
Program Strategy, Planning & Operational Leadership
Own the end-to-end planning, implementation, and monitoring of all programs across Nagaland.
Develop annual implementation plans, district rollout strategies, educator training calendars, operational roadmaps, and state-level implementation timelines.
Work backwards from organizational and government priorities to translate strategic goals into actionable implementation plans.
Develop and maintain a 1-3-year state implementation and partnership roadmap, identifying opportunities for scale, institutionalization, capacity building, and sustainable government ownership.
Develop contingency plans and risk mitigation strategies to address operational, logistical, stakeholder, political, environmental, or contextual challenges that may impact implementation and to ensure continuity, quality, and timely delivery.
Establish systems, trackers, review mechanisms, and operational processes that improve accountability and implementation efficiency.
Drive operational excellence by identifying process improvements and strengthening systems based on implementation learnings.
Program Implementation & Quality Assurance
Oversee educator training, school implementation, exhibitions, district events, and state-level engagements.
Ensure operational readiness by coordinating logistics, training materials, stakeholder communication, budgeting, procurement, and resource planning.
Serve as the primary operational liaison between the Nagaland team, government stakeholders, implementation partners, schools, and the central office.
Conduct regular field visits to monitor implementation quality, strengthen stakeholder relationships, provide on-ground support, and identify opportunities for improvement.
Ensure consistency and quality across districts while adapting implementation approaches to local contexts.
Lead operational decision-making during implementation and ensure timely resolution of challenges.
Monitoring, Evaluation, Reporting & Learning
Oversee implementation monitoring systems and ensure timely collection of qualitative and quantitative data.
Work closely with the Monitoring & Evaluation team to review implementation trends, measure program quality, and identify areas for improvement.
Lead the preparation of donor reports, government reports, presentations, case studies, budgets, and learning documentation.
Use implementation data, field insights, and stakeholder feedback to inform long-term planning, improve implementation strategies, and strengthen program sustainability.
Document implementation learnings, best practices, and partnership progress to support organizational knowledge and future expansion.
Team Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration
Lead, mentor, and develop the Nagaland Program team, fostering a culture of ownership, collaboration, accountability, and continuous learning.
Set team priorities, provide regular coaching and feedback, and support recruitment and onboarding of new team members as required.
Collaborate closely with the Curriculum, Training, Partnerships, Monitoring & Evaluation, Finance, Operations, and Communications teams to ensure seamless program delivery and alignment with organizational priorities.
Coordinate cross-functional planning, track shared deliverables, and ensure timely follow-up on key action points.
Share implementation insights and stakeholder feedback to strengthen program design, operational systems, and government engagement strategies.
Contribute to organizational planning, proposal development, budgeting, and strategic initiatives related to Nagaland.

Qualifications & Experience:
Graduate or postgraduate degree in Education, Public Policy, Development Studies, Social Sciences, Management, or a related field.
5-7 years of experience in program management, government partnerships, education programs, or development sector implementation.
Demonstrated experience managing government partnerships and working with state and district education departments.
Experience leading teams and managing large-scale or multi-district education programs.
Strong understanding of Nagalands education ecosystem and government systems is highly desirable.
Proven ability to independently manage multiple projects, stakeholders, and competing priorities.
Skills and Mindset:
Strong leadership and people management skills with the ability to develop high-performing teams.
Excellent relationship-building and stakeholder management skills with confidence in engaging senior government officials and institutional leaders.
Strategic thinking with the ability to translate vision into implementation.
Strong project management, planning, prioritization, and operational execution skills.
Excellent communication, facilitation, and documentation abilities.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities.
Ability to anticipate risks, navigate ambiguity, and respond effectively in dynamic environments.
High ownership, adaptability, attention to detail, and commitment to continuous improvement.
Willingness to travel extensively across Nagaland.

Other Details:
Location: Kohima, Nagaland (Non-negotiable)
Compensation: 6 - 7 LPA
Reporting Manager: Krutika Khare, Chief Operations Officer.

Description:
Summary
The Area Sales Manager is a key strategic leader within the solar energy industry, responsible for driving revenue growth and expanding market presence across a defined geographic region. This role focuses on building and managing a high-performing B2B sales team, cultivating relationships with commercial and industrial clients, and executing targeted sales strategies to achieve aggressive quarterly and annual targets. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in B2B sales within the renewable energy sector, with a proven ability to navigate complex procurement processes, negotiate long-term contracts, and deliver scalable solar solutions. As a critical link between the organization and its enterprise clients, the Area Sales Manager plays a pivotal role in advancing sustainable energy adoption, contributing to corporate sustainability goals, and strengthening the company position as a leader in the solar industry.

Responsibilities
Develop and execute regional sales strategies aligned with company growth objectives and market opportunities in the solar energy sector.
Lead, mentor, and manage a team of B2B sales representatives, ensuring performance excellence through coaching, goal setting, and regular feedback.
Identify, qualify, and pursue new commercial and industrial B2B prospects, focusing on solar PV system installations for businesses, manufacturing facilities, and institutional clients.
Build and maintain strategic relationships with key decision-makers at enterprise accounts, including facility managers, sustainability officers, and procurement teams.
Collaborate with technical and project development teams to deliver customized solar solutions that meet client energy needs and financial objectives.
Analyze market trends, competitor activity, and customer behavior to refine sales approaches and improve win rates.
Prepare and present detailed proposals, financial models, and ROI analyses to support client decision-making.
Track and report on sales pipeline, forecast accuracy, and KPIs using CRM platforms to ensure transparency and data-driven planning.
Ensure compliance with industry regulations, safety standards, and company policies throughout the sales and project handoff process.

Requirements
Requirements:
Bachelor degree in Business, Engineering, Renewable Energy, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
Proven experience (5+ years) in B2B sales, with a strong track record of exceeding sales targets in the renewable energy, clean tech, or construction industry.
In-depth knowledge of solar energy systems, including photovoltaic (PV) technology, financing models (PPA, lease, cash purchase), and incentive programs (e.g., ITC, state rebates).
Demonstrated ability to manage complex sales cycles involving multi-stakeholder decision-making and long-term contracts.
Proficiency in CRM software (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot) and Microsoft Office Suite for reporting, forecasting, and client presentations.
Strong negotiation, presentation, and interpersonal skills with the ability to influence at the executive level.
Valid driver license and willingness to travel extensively within the assigned region.
Experience in team leadership and performance management, including hiring, training, and performance evaluation.
Familiarity with sustainability metrics and ESG reporting is a plus.
Compensation Benefits
Competitive base salary: ${salary}
Performance-based commission and bonus structure
Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
401(k) plan with company match
Paid time off, holidays, and professional development opportunities
Company-sponsored training in solar technology and sales strategy

Description:
Role & responsibilities

Job Summary:
We are seeking a skilled Application Support Analyst to provide technical support and maintenance for applications built on Microsoft technologies. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with BizTalk, .NET Framework, ASP.NET (4.7.x including MVC), Web Development, SSRS Reporting, and Microsoft SQL Server. This role involves troubleshooting, performance optimization, and collaborating with development teams to ensure seamless application functionality.
Key Responsibilities:
Application Support & Maintenance:
Provide Level 2/3 support for business-critical applications, ensuring minimal downtime.
Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve application issues promptly.
Monitor application performance and implement fixes or enhancements as needed.
Integration & Development Support:
Support BizTalk integrations and manage message flows, orchestrations, and pipelines.
Assist in maintaining and enhancing .NET and ASP.NET MVC applications.
Collaborate with developers to deploy patches, updates, and new features.
Database & Reporting:
Manage and optimize SQL Server databases, including stored procedures and triggers.
Design and maintain SSRS reports for business intelligence and operational needs.
Documentation & Compliance:
Maintain accurate documentation for application configurations, troubleshooting steps, and standard operating procedures.
Ensure compliance with security and governance standards.
Continuous Improvement:
Identify opportunities for AI, automation and process optimization.
Stay updated with emerging technologies and recommend improvements.
Required Skills & Qualifications:
Strong experience in BizTalk Server administration and development.
Proficiency in .NET Framework, ASP.NET MVC, and C#.
Solid understanding of Web Development technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript).
Expertise in Microsoft SQL Server and SSRS Reporting.
Experience with AI coding and automation tools.
Familiarity with integration patterns, web services (SOAP/REST), and API management.
Excellent problem-solving and communication skills.
Preferred Qualifications:
Experience with DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud deployments.
Knowledge of ITIL processes and service management best practices.
Exposure to performance tuning and security hardening for applications.
Education:
Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field
