Description:
Position: Regional Head Northeast: Manipur, Nagaland and Assam (Programmes, Partnerships & Business)

About Dharmalife
Dharmalife (www.dharmalife.in) is a social impact organization advancing inclusive progress across India through two core pillars — People and Planet. Working in over 40,000 villages across 15 states, it has built a rural network of 20,000+ women entrepreneurs, known as Dharmalife Entrepreneurs (DLEs), who drive sustainable community development.

The organization works alongside women by enhancing their economic power, agency, and leadership, while addressing key social and environmental challenges. Through this network of DLEs, Dharmalife promotes sustainable livelihoods, behaviour change, and solutions across key domains — Health, Well-being, Livelihood, Education, Care, Clean Energy, Sustainability, and Circular Economy.

By 2030, Dharmalife aims to advance 1 million rural women through sustainable livelihoods and care support. Its group entities — Dharmalife Foundation, Gajam India Pvt. Ltd., Dharmalife Labs, and Dharmalife Society — work together to create lasting systemic change at scale.

Position Summary
The Regional Head – Northeast-Manipur, Nagaland and Assam is the senior leadership position in the region responsible for driving Dharmalife’s growth, programme delivery, partnerships, and operational excellence across the region.

The role combines four critical dimensions:
Business and Sales Growth through the Dharmalife Entrepreneur (DLE) network
DLE Group Development and Entrepreneur Ecosystem Strengthening
High-Quality Execution of Donor and CSR-Funded Programmes
Strategic Government and Institutional Partnership Development

The Regional Head serves as the primary representative of Dharmalife within the Northeast region, along with central office functions, and is responsible for achieving commercial, social impact, operational, and stakeholder engagement objectives across all assigned districts

Key Responsibilities

1. Business Growth & Revenue Generation
Drive state-level sales and revenue targets across region, across Dharmalife products, services, and programme-linked business opportunities.
Strengthen entrepreneur productivity, customer outreach, and market penetration.
Develop district-wise growth plans and sales strategies.
Monitor sales conversion, order fulfilment, collections, inventory movement, and business performance.
Identify new business opportunities and market expansion areas.
Improve DLE earnings and income-generating opportunities.
Drive sustainable business growth through community-based distribution models.

2. DLE (Dharmalife Entrepreneur) Network Development & Community Engagement
Lead recruitment, onboarding, activation, and retention of DLEs and DLTs.
Build and strengthen village-level DLE groups and entrepreneur collectives.
Increase active participation and engagement of women entrepreneurs.
Develop leadership capabilities among high-potential DLEs.
Ensure regular field engagement, group meetings, and entrepreneur support.
Improve entrepreneur retention and productivity.

3. Programme & Project Execution
Lead implementation of donor-funded and CSR-supported programmes across the Northeast.
Ensure achievement of programme deliverables, timelines, budgets, and impact indicators.
Monitor beneficiary outreach, training completion, adoption metrics, and community engagement.
Ensure high-quality implementation across Health, Livelihood, Education, Care, Clean Energy, Sustainability, Circular Economy, and future programmes.
Maintain programme documentation, field evidence, case studies, and reporting standards.
Support surveys, assessments, research activities, audits, and donor visits.
Ensure safeguarding, compliance, and quality standards are maintained.

4. Government & Strategic Partnerships
Develop strategic relationships with: State Rural Livelihood Missions (SRLMs); Women & Child Development Department; Labour Department; Education Department; Tribal Development Department; Skill Development Missions; Renewable Energy Agencies; District Administration; and Panchayati Raj Institutions
Build partnerships with CSR foundations, corporate partners, financial institutions, NGOs, development organizations, Academic and research institutions
Identify opportunities for programme convergence, co-funding, and scale-up.
Represent Dharmalife at state-level/ region level forums, consultations, and stakeholder meetings.
Facilitate approvals, coordination, and institutional support for programme implementation.

5. Team Leadership, Governance & Operations
Lead and mentor Territory Channel Managers, Cluster Heads, Enterprise Leaders, and other teams.
Drive performance management, coaching, and capability development.
Conduct regular reviews and field visits.
Ensure compliance with organizational policies and operating procedures.
Monitor budgets, resource utilization, and operational efficiency.
Ensure data quality, reporting discipline, and governance standards.

Candidate Profile

Education
Graduate or Postgraduate in: Rural Management; Business Administration; Social Work; Development Studies and Related disciplines

Experience Required
8–12 years of relevant experience.
Experience in rural markets, social enterprises, development sector, livelihood promotion, microfinance, channel management, CSR, or large-scale field operations.
Proven experience managing multi-district or state-level teams across the region.
Demonstrated success in both programme delivery and business development.
Experience working with government stakeholders and donor-funded programmes will be preferred.

Competencies Required

Leadership Competencies: Strategic Thinking; Execution Excellence; Team Leadership; Ownership & Accountability

Functional Competencies: Rural Market Development; Programme Management; Sales & Business Development; Stakeholder Engagement; Partnership Development; Community Mobilisation; Data-Driven Decision Making;

Behavioural Competencies: Integrity; Collaboration; Resilience; Learning Agility; Entrepreneurial Mindset; Relationship Building

Travel Requirement
This position requires extensive travel across the Northeast, including regular visits to the Head office (Delhi), villages, DLE groups, programme sites, government offices, partner organizations, and district headquarters. Field immersion and direct stakeholder engagement are critical success factors for this role.

Why Join Dharmalife
This role is a chance to lead one of India's largest women-led rural entrepreneurship and impact ecosystems and to directly contribute to livelihoods, sustainability, community development, and social transformation at scale.
AboutCompany: Dharmalife is a grassroot level social impact organization committed to fostering inclusive progress for both people and the planet. Its initiatives are driven by women change agents, known as Dharmalife Entrepreneurs (DLEs), and are supported by data-driven insights, innovative approaches, and technology. Operating through a network of over 20,000 rural women entrepreneurs across 40,000 villages in 15 states, Dharmalife has positively impacted more than 17.5 million individuals, including 500,000 children. We aim to enhance womens economic autonomy and leadership while promoting sustainable practices, thereby contributing to the creation of resilient communities. By 2030, Dharmalife aims to empower 1 million rural women through sustainable employment, livelihood growth, and care support.

Description:
Trainee, Program Implementation
Location: Nagaland, Haryana
About Program Operations and Logistics Sub-vertical
Antarang Foundation runs 2 programs: 1) Career Aware with students of municipal schools and low-income private schools studying in 9th and 10th standard across Mumbai, Pune, Udaipur and Goa. 2) Career Ready with students of low-income private junior colleges studying in 11th and 12th standard across our five geographies. The role of Program Operations and Logistics Sub-vertical is to provide end to end support to the facilitators and partner schools/colleges to be able to deliver the program with the required quality. From orienting the schools/colleges at the start of the year, distributing the books/materials to them, allocation of facilitators, to ensure data comes back on a timely basis and gets scanned and uploaded on to our systems, we do it all.
Position Overview
If you have a knack for management, multi-tasking, problem solving coupled with the traits like consistency, spontaneity and dependability, this is the place you may want to be in.
This position is an opportunity for you to impact the career journeys of more than 60,000 young adults and you will need to do everything to make their experience with us, a smooth and memorable one. You will specifically have a very important role in working with our High-tech OMR scanner to ensure student information gets uploaded on our systems timely and accurately. This is a Full-time position and requires an dependable and committed candidate who has an eye for detail.
Responsibilities
Data Management and Upload (PRIMARY): Ensuring filled OMR sheets come back on a timely basis from facilitators
Checking if the sheets are filled as expected, else getting it rectified with facilitators
Scanning approx 2000 sheets per hour on our high tech scanner and and doing minor troubleshooting if required
Operations and Administration: Sorting and Packaging of student books and getting it couriered to schools
Operations and Administration: Managing the storage of books and scanned OMRs and optimum utilization of office space.
Operations and Administration: Packaging of gifts/momentos if required and couriering it to all the Headmasters
Operations and Administration: Maintaining the inventory of medium wise books and other program Related materials
Vendor Management: Coordinating with the vendors (Courier, Books printing and Scanner) to get the tasks done
Vendor Management: Maintaining the bills/invoices and submitting it to the Finance department
Communication: Coordinating with Headmasters to share the progress and solve for the issues Escalate it on a timely basis to ensure speedy resolution of the same
Communication: Keeping the internal teams looped in to seek their support and inputs
Communication: Writing emails to the stakeholders in reference to the task in hand
Student Support and Tracking: Making student support calls to collect information and tracking their journeys post of our programs
Student Support and Tracking: Maintaining, updating the database with the same and preparing reports
Student Support and Tracking: Interpreting data from dashboards and reporting trends to the team.
Profile Requisites
Minimum 1-year commitment required with 8.5 hrs per day
Ability to multitask and prioritize tasks
Clear verbal and written communication, knowledge of local language
Tech Savvy (comfortable using Microsoft Office; confident of learning to operate scanners, dashboards)
Ability to do a certain task multiple times with focus without getting bored
Readiness to give hand and feet support even at odd hours (if and when required).

Description:
Field Enumerators (15 Posts): Position Summary:
We are seeking dedicated and enthusiastic Field Enumerators to conduct baseline assessments for students in primary schools. The successful candidates will visit schools, interact with children to make them feel comfortable, ask assessment questions, and accurately record their responses using a provided tool. This role requires excellent communication skills, proficiency in English, and the ability to use technology effectively. Prior experience working with primary-grade children is highly desirable.
Key Responsibilities:
Visit assigned schools to conduct baseline assessments with students.
Create a welcoming and comfortable environment for children to ensure accurate and honest responses.
Ask assessment questions as per the guidelines and record responses using the designated tool.
Ensure accuracy and completeness of recorded data.
Report any issues or inconsistencies encountered during the assessments to the project supervisor.
Maintain the confidentiality and integrity of the data collected.
Adhere to the schedule and complete the assessments within the stipulated timeframe.
Utilize technology tools efficiently to record and manage data.
Communicate effectively with school staff and maintain a professional demeanor at all times.
Qualifications/Requirements:
Must have a two-wheeler to travel to conduct the assessments
Proficiency in English (both written and spoken) is a mandatory requirement.
Proficiency in the local language is required.
Basic knowledge and experience in using tech tools and software.
Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to make children feel at
ease.
Attention to detail and accuracy in data recording.
Ability to work independently and manage time effectively.
Flexibility to travel to various school locations as required.
High school diploma or equivalent; higher education in education, psychology, or a
related field is a plus point.
Functional area:
Chozuba Block, Dist. Phek
Employment type:
Temporary/Contract
Salary:
450 INR per day + 250 INR Travel allowance

Description:
Role Overview
The Infrastructure Finance Expert will provide financial and economic expertise to support the planning and appraisal of infrastructure and risk reduction interventions, with a focus on long-term resilience and efficiency.
Roles and Responsibilities:
Overall Evaluate the financial and economic benefits of infrastructure and disaster risk reduction interventions, including assessment of avoided losses and long-term impacts.
Undertake cost-benefit analysis and economic analyses to support investment decisions for resilient infrastructure and risk mitigation measures.
Support preparation and review of financial and economic appraisal documents, models, and justification notes for government review and approval.
Provide technical inputs to prioritisation and decision-making processes based on economic viability, sustainability, and value for money.
Educational Qualifications:
CA/CMA or MBA (Finance)/Master of Finance and Control /M.Com /PGDBM (with specification in Finance).
Skills and Experience:
Minimum 10 years of relevant professional experience in the field.
Experience of working on at least one externally funded project (such as ADB, AFD, WBG, etc.)
Prior work experience across Himalayan regions with exposure to multiple hazards in India, Nepal, Bhutan, etc.

Description:
Job Details
Department: Creative / Marketing / Production
Reports To: Lead Video Editor / Creative Director / PMO
Location: Northeast India (Travel Required)
Contract Duration: 6 8 Months
Employment Type: Project-Based Contract
Job Summary
We are looking for a creative and digitally savvy Video Editor to join the Creative Team of Hillywood Fiesta. The Video Editor will be responsible for creating engaging video content for Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, and other digital platforms, with a strong focus on Reels, short-form videos, promotional content, campaign assets and social-first storytelling. The role requires someone who understands what makes digital content engaging, has a strong sense of visual storytelling and pacing, and can transform raw footage, photographs, interviews, campaign ideas and creative concepts into compelling video content. This is not a production/post-production editing role. The position will primarily support the Creative and Marketing teams in developing digital and social media content.
Organisational Unit Function
The Video Editor will:
A. Social Media Short-Form Video Content Edit engaging Reels, Shorts and other short-form videos for social media.
A. Social Media Short-Form Video Content Create content optimised for Instagram, Facebook, YouTube and other relevant platforms.
A. Social Media Short-Form Video Content Convert raw footage and existing content into multiple social media assets.
A. Social Media Short-Form Video Content Identify strong moments, visuals, sound bites and stories that can be turned into engaging digital content.
A. Social Media Short-Form Video Content Create videos with strong hooks, pacing and storytelling designed to capture audience attention.
A. Social Media Short-Form Video Content Adapt videos into different formats, durations and aspect ratios as required by different platforms.
B. Creative Content Development Work with the Creative Team to translate content ideas and concepts into videos.
B. Creative Content Development Participate in brainstorming sessions for social media campaigns, promotional campaigns and digital content.
B. Creative Content Development Suggest video concepts, formats, trends and creative approaches.
B. Creative Content Development Develop creative treatments for Reels and other short-form content.
B. Creative Content Development Experiment with different editing styles, transitions, music, text treatments and visual storytelling techniques.
B. Creative Content Development Stay updated on current social media trends, formats, editing styles and audience behaviour.
C. Promotional Campaign Content Support the development of video assets for Campaign launches.
C. Promotional Campaign Content Support the development of video assets for Event promotions.
C. Promotional Campaign Content Support the development of video assets for Contestant/participant introductions.
C. Promotional Campaign Content Support the development of video assets for Artist and celebrity content.
C. Promotional Campaign Content Support the development of video assets for Behind-the-scenes content.
C. Promotional Campaign Content Support the development of video assets for Teasers and announcements.
C. Promotional Campaign Content Support the development of video assets for Promotional Reels.
C. Promotional Campaign Content Support the development of video assets for Countdown campaigns.
C. Promotional Campaign Content Support the development of video assets for Sponsor-related content.
C. Promotional Campaign Content Support the development of video assets for Interviews and bite-sized content.
C. Promotional Campaign Content Support the development of video assets for Highlights and recap videos.
C. Promotional Campaign Content Support the development of video assets for Festival/event coverage.
C. Promotional Campaign Content Support the development of video assets for Website and digital content.
D. Content Repurposing Repurpose existing videos, interviews, photographs and other creative assets into multiple pieces of content.
D. Content Repurposing Create different versions of content for different platforms.
D. Content Repurposing Identify opportunities to extend the life of existing content through creative editing.
D. Content Repurposing Create short clips from longer interviews or videos.
D. Content Repurposing Turn key campaign messages into visually engaging social content.
E. Creative Collaboration Work closely with the Creative Team to maintain consistency in the visual identity of Hillywood Fiesta.
E. Creative Collaboration Coordinate with the Marketing and Social Media teams to understand the content calendar and campaign requirements.
E. Creative Collaboration Work with Graphic Designers to incorporate visual assets, typography, illustrations and animations into videos.
E. Creative Collaboration Take direction from the Creative Lead while also contributing independent creative ideas.
E. Creative Collaboration Participate in content planning and creative review meetings.
Selection Criteria
We are looking for a creative and proactive Video Editor with strong editing and visual storytelling skills. The candidate should understand short-form social content, current trends, and audience engagement, while being able to work under tight deadlines and collaborate effectively with the Creative and Marketing teams.
Key Deliverables
Instagram Reels
YouTube Shorts
Facebook short-form videos
Promotional videos
Campaign videos
Teasers and announcements
Behind-the-scenes videos
Interview clips
Event and activity highlights
Participant/artist introduction videos
Social media promotional assets
Sponsor-related video content
Other creative video assets required by the Creative and Marketing teams
Required Skills Competencies
Proficiency in video editing software such as Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro or equivalent.
Strong understanding of Reels, Shorts and other social media video formats.
Good sense of visual storytelling, pacing, music and composition.
Ability to create strong hooks and engaging short-form content.
Basic knowledge of motion graphics, text animation and visual effects.
Good understanding of social media trends and digital audience behaviour.
Strong creative thinking and ability to develop content ideas.
Attention to detail and ability to maintain brand consistency.
Ability to work under tight deadlines and manage multiple content requirements.
Experience Qualifications
Essential:
A degree/diploma in Film, Mass Communication, Media, Visual Communication, Graphic Design or a related field is preferred. However, a strong portfolio and practical experience will be given greater importance than formal qualifications.
2 3+ years of experience in video editing and digital content creation.
Proven experience creating Reels, Shorts or other social-first video content.
Strong portfolio/showreel demonstrating creative editing.
Experience working with social media or digital content teams.
Experience Qualifications
Preferred:
Experience in entertainment, media, music, events, lifestyle, advertising or digital content.
Experience creating content for entertainment brands or public personalities.
Experience with motion graphics and basic animation.
Familiarity with Northeast Indian culture, entertainment and digital audiences is an advantage.
Ideal Candidate
The ideal candidate is not just an editor but a content creator with strong editing skills. They should understand why people stop scrolling, what makes a Reel engaging, how to build a story within a short duration and how to turn ordinary footage into content that people want to watch and share. They should be creative, fast, trend-aware and proactive, while also being able to work within the brand guidelines and creative direction of Hillywood Fiesta.

Document challenges, learnings, innovations, and success stories from livelihood interventions.

Monitoring, Documentation Reporting: Maintain accurate records of beneficiaries, enterprises, training activities, production, employment, placements, and livelihood outcomes.

Track project indicators, milestones, outputs, and outcomes against approved targets.

Description:
Project: Hillywood Fiesta
Reports To: Program Manager/Festival Operations Manager
Location: Northeast India (Travel Required)
Contract Duration: 6-8 Months
Employment Type: Project-Based Contract
Salary Range: Upto 3.6 LPA
Purpose of the Position
The Logistics Coordinator is responsible for planning, coordinating, and overseeing all logistical and on-ground operational requirements for Hillywood Fiesta. This includes the online and offline auditions, Bootcamp, production activities, and the Grand Finale. The role ensures that people, equipment, materials, transportation, accommodation, venues, and operational resources are in the right place at the right time, enabling every phase of the project to run efficiently and without disruption. This is a highly operational role that requires exceptional planning, coordination, and problem-solving abilities.
Organisational Unit Function
The Logistics Coordinator will:
Plan and coordinate all logistical requirements across the project lifecycle.
Manage travel, accommodation, transportation, and local movement for contestants, judges, mentors, crew, vendors, and guests.
Coordinate venue readiness and ensure all operational requirements are in place before each event.
Oversee movement and delivery of equipment, materials, production assets, and event supplies.
Coordinate with vendors, suppliers, transport providers, hotels, and local service providers.
Develop logistics schedules, movement plans, and operational checklists.
Monitor inventory and ensure all required resources are available on time.
Support site setup, dismantling, and operational readiness during auditions, Bootcamp, and the Grand Finale.
Work closely with Production, Finance, Procurement, and Festival Operations to ensure seamless execution.
Identify logistical risks and prepare contingency plans to minimise disruptions.
Ensure compliance with health, safety, and operational requirements during all project activities.
Reporting Relationships
This role reports directly to the Festival Operations Manager and works closely with the PMO Director, Program Manager, Creative Production Lead, Production Team, and all Mentors and Trainers engaged on the project.
Communications (Internal/External)
PMO Director - Share progress updates and escalate key issues.
Head of Operations - Coordinate logistics and operational planning
Project Coordinator - Align schedules and daily project activities.
Finance Procurement Manager - Process procurement and budget-related requests.
Creative Production Lead - Plan and execute event logistics
Event Coordinator - Plan and execute event logistics
Vendors, Contractors, Hotels, Transport Providers, Venue Partners - Coordinate bookings, deliveries, and operational support.
Selection Criteria
We are looking for someone who thrives behind the scenes and understands that flawless logistics are the backbone of a successful event. The ideal candidate is highly organised, proactive, and capable of anticipating operational challenges before they arise. They should be comfortable managing multiple moving parts simultaneously, coordinating diverse stakeholders, and ensuring that every logistical detail from transport and accommodation to equipment and venue readiness is executed seamlessly. Above all, they should take ownership, communicate effectively, and remain composed under pressure to keep Hillywood Fiesta running smoothly from start to finish.
Qualifications
Bachelor s degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Hospitality, Tourism, Event Management, Business Administration, or a related field.
3 5+ years of relevant logistics or operations experience.
Experience in coordinating transportation, accommodation, and venue operations for large-scale events is highly desirable.
Familiarity with project management and logistics tracking tools is an advantage.
Essential
Relevant Logistics or Event Operations Experience Candidates must have prior experience in logistics, operations, hospitality, large-scale events, festivals, productions, conferences, or similar operational environments. Experience managing complex logistical operations involving multiple vendors and stakeholders is essential.
Excellent Planning Coordination Skills Must be capable of managing multiple logistical workstreams simultaneously while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.
Strong Communication Skills Professional communication is essential and must communicate effectively with:
Vendors
Hotels
Transport providers
Production teams
Internal departments
Government authorities
Venue management
Contractors
Strong Problem-Solving Ability Must be able to respond quickly to unexpected operational issues such as transportation delays, accommodation changes, weather disruptions, equipment failures, or schedule adjustments.
Ability to Work Under Pressure The candidate must remain calm, organised, and solution-oriented during live operations and changing project conditions.
Willingness to Travel Must be willing to travel extensively across the Northeast throughout the auditions, Bootcamp, and Grand Finale.
Flexible Working Hours Must be available to work evenings, weekends, holidays, and extended hours during critical phases of the project.
Professionalism Accountability Must consistently demonstrate:
Reliability
Ownership
Integrity
Accountability
Punctuality
Teamwork
Strong work ethic

Experience (and interest) in different coding languages and frameworks

Description:
Marketing Strategist
Project: Hillywood Fiesta
Reports To: PMO Director / Ecosystem Lead
Location: Northeast India (Travel Required)
Contract Duration: 6-8 months
Employment Type: Project-Based Contract
Purpose of the Position
The Marketing Strategist will be responsible for marketing strategy, influencer coordination onboarding, driving awareness, audience growth, engagement, and conversion across the entire Hillywood Fiesta ecosystem. This role serves as the primary bridge between BluPrint, Hillywood, marketing agencies, media partners, influencers, PR partners, and audience-facing channels. While external agencies may execute campaigns, this role is responsible for ensuring all marketing activities align with project objectives, strategy, and audience growth targets. This is not a social media management role it is a strategic audience growth and campaign management role.
Organisational Unit Function
The Marketing Strategist will:
Marketing Strategy Campaign Management (Primary Function)
Assist in developing and executing the overall marketing strategy across all phases of Hillywood Fiesta from auditions through to the Grand Finale.
Coordinate campaign execution across all project phases, ensuring consistency in messaging, branding, and communication.
Monitor campaign performance and audience engagement, providing regular insights and optimisation recommendations.
Develop and support audience acquisition and retention initiatives across all touchpoints.
Ensure all marketing activities are tracked against agreed targets and delivered within a timeline.
Agency Vendor Management
Serve as the primary point of contact between BluPrint and all external marketing agencies and media partners.
Brief agencies and external partners clearly on project objectives, campaign requirements, and audience targets.
Review deliverables and campaign outputs against agreed briefs, and provide structured feedback to ensure quality.
Track campaign timelines and agency performance, escalating delays or quality issues to the PMO Director when required.
Maintain strong working relationships with all external marketing partners throughout the project lifecycle.
Audience Growth Engagement
Drive awareness campaigns across Northeast India targeting potential participants, audiences, and OTT subscribers.
Build audience engagement strategies for each project phase before, during, and after the bootcamp and events.
Develop initiatives that encourage audience participation, community building, and ongoing engagement.
Monitor audience sentiment and engagement trends and adjust strategies accordingly.
OTT Subscription Growth Support
Support HillyPix subscription growth campaigns coordinating audience conversion initiatives around key project milestones.
Assist with campaign planning tied to episode releases and OTT content rollout schedules.
Monitor audience engagement and retention performance across OTT channels.
Support the development and execution of growth strategies linked to HillyPix subscription objectives.
Influencer PR Coordination
Coordinate influencer partnerships managing communications, deliverables, and performance against agreed terms.
Support media and PR initiatives, including interview coordination, press features, and promotional opportunities.
Maintain and grow relationships with regional creators, media personalities, and media partners.
Ensure influencer and PR activity remains aligned with overall brand messaging and project narrative.
Content Communication Coordination
Coordinate campaign content requirements working with creative teams to ensure all marketing needs are met on time.
Support social media planning and campaign scheduling in collaboration with content teams and agencies.
Ensure all content is aligned with audience objectives and campaign goals before publication.
Maintain a content and campaign asset repository for all phases of the project.
Reporting Performance Tracking
Track key campaign metrics across all channels and phases, and maintain a live performance dashboard.
Prepare weekly marketing reports for PMO leadership with insights, highlights, and recommended actions.
Monitor audience growth, engagement, and OTT conversion performance throughout the project.
Reporting Relationships
This role reports directly to the PMO Director / Ecosystem Lead and collaborates closely with the Creative Director, Program Manager, Production Supervisor, Sponsorship Lead, PMO Coordinator, and all external marketing and media partners.
Communications (Internal/External)
PMO Director / Ecosystem Lead: Direct reporting line marketing strategy alignment, approvals, and escalations
Creative Director: Campaign creative direction, brand alignment, and content production
Program Manager: Campaign timeline coordination and operational alignment
Production Supervisor: Content production requirements and event-day marketing support
Sponsorship Lead: Sponsor visibility integration within campaigns and activations
Selection Criteria
This role is suited to a strategic marketing professional who thinks from an audience perspective, takes ownership of campaign outcomes, and is equally comfortable managing agency relationships and analysing performance data.
Essential
Bachelor s degree in Marketing, Communications, Media, or Business, or a related field. Relevant experience may be considered in lieu of formal qualifications.
2 7 years of experience in marketing, communications, media, audience growth, PR, or campaign management.
Experience managing agencies or external partners and holding them accountable to deliverables.
Strong understanding of digital marketing, audience growth strategies, and campaign performance metrics.
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple campaigns and workstreams simultaneously with strong organisational skills.
Excellent communication skills both written and verbal for engaging agencies, stakeholders, and media partners.
Comfort working in a fast-paced, high-energy project environment.
Desirable
Prior experience in entertainment, events, media, startups, agencies, or consumer brands.

Bachelor s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Network Engineering, Electronics & Telecommunications, BCA, or a related field.
Equivalent qualifications and relevant networking experience may also apply.

Experience with routing and switching technologies, including OSPF and BGP.
Hands-on experience with MikroTik RouterOS and enterprise networking equipment.
Knowledge of network security, firewalls, access control management.
Ability to troubleshoot and resolve network, connectivity, and hardware-related issues.
Experience in network design, implementation, optimization, capacity planning, and performance tuning.

Description:
We are looking for a Python Team Lead who can combine strong technical expertise with leadership skills. The ideal candidate will guide a team of Python developers, drive best practices, and deliver scalable, high-performance solutions. You will be responsible for project architecture, mentoring team members, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to meet business objectives.
Key Responsibilities
Lead a team of Python developers, providing technical guidance, mentoring, and performance feedback.
Design and develop scalable, maintainable, and secure applications using Python frameworks (Django, Flask, FastAPI).
Drive system design, architecture decisions, and code reviews.
Collaborate with product managers, business analysts, and QA teams to deliver high-quality software.
Ensure best practices in coding standards, version control, CI/CD, testing, and documentation.
Optimize application performance, scalability, and reliability.
Manage project timelines, allocate tasks, and ensure timely delivery.
Stay updated with new technologies, tools, and industry trends to improve processes and efficiency.
Required Skills
5+ years of hands-on Python development experience.
Strong expertise in Python frameworks such as Django, Flask, or FastAPI.
Solid understanding of REST APIs, microservices architecture, and asynchronous programming.
Experience with databases (SQL & NoSQL), ORMs, and query optimization.
Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP).
Strong knowledge of unit testing, integration testing, and test automation.
Excellent problem-solving skills, debugging, and optimization experience.
Familiarity with agile methodologies (Scrum/Kanban).
Strong communication and leadership skills, with experience mentoring junior developers.
Good to Have
Experience with big data, machine learning, or AI integration in Python.
Knowledge of messaging systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ, Celery).
Exposure to DevOps practices and monitoring tools (ELK, Prometheus, Grafana).

Description:
5+ years of total IT experience, including 2-3 years in AI/ML or Generative AI development. Must have hands-on experience building, testing, and deploying LLM-based or agentic AI applications in production or pilot settings.

Role & responsibilities
The Senior Associate Generative AI Developer will design, develop, and rigorously test end-to-end Generative AI and agentic AI applications. This role requires hands-on expertise with LLM APIs, RAG pipelines, prompt engineering, and multi-agent frameworks, combined with a disciplined approach to testing, performance monitoring, and optimization.

LLM & GenAI Development:
Design, develop, and maintain LLM-powered applications using APIs such as OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, or Cohere. Implement core GenAI workflows including summarization, classification, Q&A, and content generation.
Agentic AI Implementation:
Build and orchestrate multi-agent systems using frameworks like CrewAI, LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK, or Azure AI Agent Framework. Implement inter-agent communication, task routing, and tool orchestration for complex workflows.
RAG & Embedding Pipelines:
Implement retrieval-augmented generation pipelines involving embedding creation, chunking, and vector indexing using FAISS, Pinecone, Chroma, or Milvus. Ensure efficient retrieval for context-aware outputs.

Strong proficiency in Python, LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, and LangGraph
Deep understanding of LLM architectures, tokenization, embedding models, and vector databases
Experience with prompt testing and evaluation frameworks (TruLens, LangSmith, PromptLayer, DeepEval)
Familiarity with bias mitigation, safety testing, and Responsible AI principles
Knowledge of MLOps/LLMOps practices for deploying and monitoring AI models
Strong analytical mindset, documentation discipline, and collaborative approach
Exposure to at least one major cloud AI platform (Azure, AWS, GCP, or OCI)
Preferred Background:
Prior experience in building chatbots, intelligent assistants, summarizers, or document automation solutions using LLMs

Role & responsibilities


Responsibilities
Client Service
Maintain and build internal and external client relationships by providing exceptional client service
Commit to  proactively connecting and building rapport with both internal and external clients 
Assist with resolving complex client issues and suggest favourable solutions
Invoicing
Maintain client codes in the firms proprietary accounting software based on information provided by the partner and/ormanager .
 Validate the job record billing details and add projects to the job, if required
Confirm invoicing arrangements with the client representative prior to issuing the first invoice to ensure high accuracy
Monitor WIPs, review engagement letters to determine fees to be charged, and liaise with practice managers to capture out of pocket expenses

Respond to client queries regarding invoices, including preparation of analyses and preparation of amended invoices when required (as directed by the partner/manager)
Prepare, finalize and issue credit notes

Update and manage billing schedules

Update and maintain billing schedules

Accounts Receivables

Respond to requests from National Finance with respect to cash allocations
Initiate reminders to clients and diligently follow up to ensure timely resolution, as directed by manager/partner

Description:
Key Responsibilities
Define and drive cloud architecture strategy across the organization.
Lead end-to-end cloud architecture design for complex, enterprise-scale solutions on AWS.
Design cloud architecture solutions leveraging the full breadth of AWS services including compute (EC2, Lambda, ECS/EKS, Fargate), storage (S3, EBS, EFS), databases (RDS, Aurora, DynamoDB, ElastiCache, Neptune, Redshift), and networking (VPC, Transit Gateway, CloudFront, Global Accelerator, Route 53, PrivateLink).
Lead and institutionalize Well-Architected Framework reviews using the AWS WA Tool, driving continuous improvement across all six pillars (Operational Excellence, Security, Reliability, Performance Efficiency, Cost Optimization, Sustainability).
Design enterprise-scale cross-service integrations using API Gateway, Lambda, Step Functions, EventBridge, SQS/SNS, AppSync, and Kinesis.
Drive strategic FinOps initiatives using Cost Explorer, Savings Plans, Reserved Instances, Compute Optimizer, and AWS Budgets; establish cost governance frameworks.
Architect multi-account Landing Zone strategies using AWS Control Tower, Organizations, and Service Control Policies (SCPs).
Establish architecture governance frameworks, review boards, and design authority processes.
Drive strategic initiatives around performance engineering using CloudWatch, X-Ray, Trusted Advisor, and Compute Optimizer.
Lead and mentor architecture teams, building organizational capability.
Engage with executive stakeholders to align technology strategy with business objectives.
Collaborate with DevOps, Security, QA, and business teams for delivery excellence.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
15+ years of experience in IT architecture or software engineering.
6+ years of hands-on AWS experience in architecture design and implementation.
Mastery of AWS architecture design spanning all six Well-Architected Framework pillars.
Proven track record leading enterprise-scale cloud architecture programs.
Extensive experience with complex cross-service integrations (API Gateway, Lambda, Step Functions, EventBridge, AppSync, SQS/SNS, Kinesis).
Expert-level proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, CDK).
Strategic experience in FinOps, cost governance, and performance engineering using Cost Explorer, Compute Optimizer, and AWS Budgets.
Experience architecting multi-account Landing Zones with Control Tower, Organizations, and Service Control Policies.
Strong understanding of application security, identity management (IAM, Cognito, SSO), and cloud governance (AWS Config, Service Catalog, GuardDuty, Security Hub).
Strong communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
Proven ability to drive architectural decisions at the executive level.
Knowledge of Agile Methodology and Practices.
Deep experience with microservices architecture, serverless patterns, and event-driven design.
Nice to Have
AWS Solutions Architect Professional or Specialty certifications.
Experience with AI tools in development lifecycles (GitHub CoPilot, Cursor) and brought in efficiencies.
DevOps experience (CI/CD pipelines using CodePipeline, GitHub Actions, Jenkins).
Experience with AWS migration tools (DMS, SCT, Migration Hub, AWS Transform).
Multi-cloud architecture experience (Azure, GCP).
Experience building and scaling architecture practices within consulting organizations.
Experience with AWS Well-Architected Partner program and conducting formal reviews.

Description:
The Opportunity
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Youll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
As a UX / Design Engineer - Senior Associate, you will focus on designing and developing intuitive and engaging user interfaces for digital products and services. You will create seamless user experiences through the use of advanced technologies and design principles. As a Senior Associate, you will build meaningful client connections and learn how to manage and inspire others. You will navigate increasingly complex situations, growing your personal brand and deepening your technical skills. You are expected to anticipate the needs of your teams and clients, and to deliver quality work. Embracing increased ambiguity, you will be comfortable when the path forward isn’t clear, asking questions and using these moments as opportunities to grow.
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will be part of our Software and Product Innovation team, focusing on developing cutting-edge software solutions and driving product innovation to meet the evolving needs of clients. Within our Technology Consulting practice, you will combine technical experience with creative thinking to deliver innovative software products and solutions. This position offers a unique opportunity to work within our Data, Analytics & AI competency network, where you will use a broad range of tools and methodologies to generate new ideas and solve problems.
Responsibilities
- Designing and developing intuitive user interfaces for digital products and services
- Creating seamless user experiences using advanced design principles and technologies
- Conducting usability testing and user research to inform design decisions
- Collaborating with cross-functional teams to align design solutions with business objectives
- Utilizing tools like Figma and AngularJS to create interactive prototypes and mock-ups
- Implementing digital accessibility standards to enhance user inclusivity
- Analyzing industry trends to inform user interaction strategies and innovations
- Developing user personas and conducting workflow analysis to optimize user journeys
- Customizing and developing product features to meet client needs and enhance user satisfaction
- Applying human-centered design principles to improve customer experience and engagement
What You Must Have
- At least a Bachelor's degree
- At least 2 years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required
What Sets You Apart
- Utilizing AngularJS and Vue.js for dynamic UI development
- Creating mock-ups and prototypes using Figma and HTML5
- Conducting usability testing and user research design
- Developing human-centered design solutions for client projects
- Analyzing industry trends to inform UX strategies
- Embracing change and learning agility in complex environments

Description:
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
16+ years of experience in IT architecture or software engineering.
8+ years of hands-on GCP experience in architecture design and implementation.
Mastery of GCP architecture design spanning all core Google Cloud Architecture Framework pillars.
Proven track record leading enterprise-scale cloud architecture programs.
Extensive experience with complex cross-service integrations (REST, gRPC, OpenAPI, API Gateway/Apigee, Pub/Sub, Managed Service for Apache Kafka, Cloud Tasks, Workflows, Eventarc).
Expert-level proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Config Connector, Deployment Manager).
Strategic experience in FinOps, cost governance, and performance engineering using Cloud Billing reports, the Recommender, and Budgets & Alerts.
Experience architecting multi-project Landing Zones with Resource Manager, Organization Policy Service, and the Cloud Foundation Toolkit.
Strong understanding of application security, identity management (Cloud IAM, Cloud Identity, Identity Platform), and cloud governance (Security Command Center, Assured Workloads, Policy Intelligence).
Hands-on experience designing GenAI/agentic architectures using Vertex AI, Gemini, RAG pipelines, and Vector Search.
Strong communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
Proven ability to drive architectural decisions at the executive level.
Knowledge of Agile Methodology and Practices.
Deep experience with microservices architecture, serverless patterns, distributed system design, and event-driven design.
Technical Skills
Languages: Python, ReactJS/Angular, TypeScript, Bash.
Compute & Serverless: Cloud Run, GKE Standard/Autopilot, Cloud Run functions, App Engine, Compute Engine fundamentals, Eventarc, Workflows.
Architecture & Design: Domain-Driven Design (DDD), Microservices, Modular Monolith, Event-Driven Architecture, Hexagonal/Clean Architecture, Twelve-Factor Apps, distributed systems.
API Integration & Architecture: REST, gRPC, OpenAPI, API Gateway, Apigee, Pub/Sub, Managed Service for Apache Kafka, Cloud Tasks.
Distributed System Patterns: Saga, Transactional Outbox, Idempotency, Retry/Backoff, Circuit Breaker, CQRS, Event Sourcing (where justified), caching, eventual consistency.
Data Architecture: Cloud SQL/PostgreSQL, Spanner, Firestore, Bigtable, Memorystore/Redis, Cloud Storage; BigQuery awareness.
Container Architecture: Docker, Kubernetes, GKE, Helm, autoscaling, Ingress/Gateway API, Cloud Service Mesh.
DevSecOps: Terraform, Cloud Build, Cloud Deploy, Artifact Registry, GitHub Actions, Helm, Argo CD.
Reliability & Observability: Cloud Logging, Cloud Monitoring, Cloud Trace, OpenTelemetry, SLI/SLO, error budgets, HA/DR, RTO/RPO.
GenAI Architecture: Vertex AI, Gemini APIs, RAG Engine, Vector Search, embeddings, grounding, Agent Development Kit (ADK), agentic workflows, evaluation, guardrails.
AI Development Tools: Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot.
Must-Have Skills
GCP application architecture
GKE
Cloud Run
Microservices
Apigee
Cloud Spanner
Gemini
Nice to Have
Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect or specialty certifications.
DevOps experience (CI/CD pipelines using Cloud Build, GitHub Actions, Jenkins).
Experience with GCP migration tools (Migrate for Compute Engine, Database Migration Service, Storage Transfer Service, BigQuery Data Transfer Service).
Experience building and scaling architecture practices within consulting organizations.
Experience with the Google Cloud Well-Architected Partner ecosystem and conducting formal Architecture Framework reviews.

Description:
Job Summary
As a Manager, you will work with the client and project teams to support global engagements to capture value and enable organizational transformation. This includes activities such as conducting analyses and developing insights, preparing excel models, analyzing large sets of data, capturing as-is processes, preparing work plans, and designing to-be processes.
In addition, you will also support the project lead, facilitate meetings to enable decision making, organize and prepare recommendations on client issues, and participate actively in new business development, thought leadership and firm building activities.
PwCs global leadership development framework provides a structured path for career progression and skill development.
PwC Professional skills and responsibilities for this management level include, but are not limited to:
Encourage collaboration and proactively contribute to team discussions
Apply critical thinking to complex procurement challenges and strategic decision-making
Leverage data and industry trends to extract insights for S2P strategy
Provide clear and structured communication to stakeholders and suppliers
Maintain adaptability in working across various business environments and supply chain models
Uphold PwCs commitment to ethics and business conduct
Additional Responsibilities
Team and Client Management
Lead procurement project delivery and ensure execution against KPIs
Act as a key liaison between stakeholders, suppliers, and procurement teams
Provide insights and recommendations for process efficiencies and procurement modernization
Lead client discussions and drive influence through actionable insights
S2P Transformation
Experience with Coupa - Procure-to-Pay (P2P) platform, as an implementer and administrator; ERP knowledge – SAP / PeopleSoft / ORACLE or others is preferred
Understanding of fundamental principles of Coupa including spend and commodity taxonomies, requisitioning, PO generation, receiving and invoice processing
Experience with AP automation including eInvoicing, scanning and workflow, online tracking, reporting capabilities, electronic invoice user interfaces, supplier networks, etc.
Ability to design the approval work flows in Coupa transactional documents like PO’s, Service Confirmations and Invoices
Ability to configure, develop, and troubleshoot RESTful APIs and flat file-based integrations for all master and transactional data between P2P platforms and backend systems
Ability to work with middleware tools Like Dell Boomi, Mulesoft, Snaplogic etc. to implement middleware logic as part of the integrations between Coupa & ERP system
Ability to develop solutions for clients using service-oriented architecture patterns to ensure master and transactional data are traveling successfully between systems
Ability to gather technical requirements and conduct sessions to design the integrations between P2P platforms and backend systems

Maximo JD:
Responsibilities
PwC Professional skills and responsibilities for this management level include but are not limited to
As a Senior Associate, youll work as part / lead a team of problem solvers, helping to solve complex business issues from strategy to execution.
Lead by example for the team and provide evidence-based feedback in a timely and constructive manner.
Share knowledge and collaborate effectively within the team and among other project teams.
Work with existing processes/systems whilst making constructive suggestions for improvements.
Follow risk management and compliance procedures.
Keep up to date with technical developments for business area.
Communicate confidently in a clear, concise, and articulate manner - verbally and in written form.
Seek opportunities to learn about other cultures and other parts of the business across the Network of PwC firms.
Uphold the firm’s code of ethics and business conduct.
Maximo Job Description:
Analyzes customer business requirements and application objectives, develops configuration design, functional, and technical specifications to meet customer needs.
Knowledge on Maximo Architecture and at least one business add-on.
Customize/Configure, test, and deploy IBM Maximo through all phases of the implementation life cycle
Serve as the Maximo Application Administrator, providing technical advice to the team along with guidance to the client on complex system implementation.
Monitor and manage the quality of development within the team for deliverables.
Develop interfaces using Maximo Integration Framework (MIF)
Deploy solutions using various technologies, including XML, XLST, SQL, Java Message Service (JMS), Web Logic, WebSphere, SQL Server and/or Oracle databases
Program in Java and jython/python scripting languages to tailor IBM Maximo (including Maximo Integration Framework) for client requirements
Collaborate with consultants and other subject matter experts across the internal and external landscape
Provides technical advice on product implementation, integration, enhancement, or other projects as applicable.
Translate business and technical requirements into a project and architectural blueprint that achieves the desired business outcomes, including identifying solutions
Work with Product Owner/Business Analysts to understand functional requirements and interact with other cross-functional teams to architect, design, develop, test, and release features.
Design, develop and/or re-engineer application components, and integrate software packages, programs, and reusable objects residing on multiple platforms
Identify areas in the business process and convert them into Automation Ideas.

Open Job Locations - Pune/Kolkata/Hyderabad/Bangalore
Mandatory to have-Experience in RACM, SOX 404, control testing, and remediation

At EY, youll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture, and technology to become the best version of you. And were counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

The opportunity
Financial Accounting Advisory Services (FAAS) professionals provide advisory services including Accounting and regulatory support for accounting change and special matters; accounting processes and controls support.

As an SOX professional, the individual should be a qualified CA/CPA/ACCA/MBA with experience in IFC and strong knowledge of SOX audit processes. The role involves handling large projects covering SOX implementation, documentation, control testing, internal control evaluation, financial reporting reliability, compliance, and operational efficiency.

Your key responsibilities

Technical Delivery and Subject Matter Expertise -
Execute SOX and IFC design, walkthrough, and implementation
Perform business process reviews and create flowcharts and RCMs
Conduct risk assessments and identify key accounts and transactions
Prepare SOX documentation (narratives, flowcharts, RACM)
Test design and operating effectiveness of controls and suggest improvements
Lead SOX compliance phases including walkthroughs, testing, and reporting
Support audit planning, execution, and reporting
Ensure clear communication of control deficiencies and remediation
Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.

Business Development & Solution Development -
Lead pursuit teams to understand client problem statements & formulate that in solutions
Lead developing client specific solutions for the engagement team
Lead proposal development or lead proposal teams
Lead collaboration with market teams to develop relationship and drive business growth for EY
Collaborate cross service lines to ensure smooth execution of the project.
Lead development of internal capability development and lead training sessions to coach internal teams to develop capability
Lead operational initiatives within the practice areas.

Skills and attributes for success

Business Skills and Knowledge
Strong business development skills
Very strong solution conceptualization/ideation skill
Strong solution/product build skills
Strong project management skills
Human Skills –
Excellent written & oral communication & articulation
Flexible work attitude
Proven ability to lead diverse team over multiple geographies
Strong collaboration skills
Ability to comprehend complexity quickly & apply solutions
Comfort in dealing with ambiguity
Strong entrepreneurial skills in terms of ownership of problem & solutions
Strong problem-solving skills
Ability to perform effectively under pressure and deliver results
Willingness to travel for short or long duration at short notice

To qualify for the role, you must have
CA/CPA/ACCA with 3+ years of relevant experience
2–7 years of experience in SOX/IFC implementation
Experience in RACM, control testing, and remediation
Strong understanding of COSO framework and PCAOB requirements
Knowledge of financial statements (Indian/US GAAP)
Strong analytical, communication, and teamwork skills
Proficiency in Excel, Word, Visio, and MS Office tool
Experience of working with international clients preferred
Experience with previous multinational consulting firms or Big4 firms

Description:
Join our Team
About this opportunity

Data Governance Manager are responsible for Responsible and drive formulation of policies, directives, guidelines for data Governance and control. Owner of Data-Governance strategy framework. Drive and responsible for operationalization of Data-governance framework across units in MSN(CU/SLOP/SDAP). Reporting and communicate regularly to management on Data Governance. Innovative in the offensive application & defensive controls in the use of data! Standardization and constant evolution of data governance framework data in a data domain and ensure that data is managed according to policies and standards. They have the appropriate capabilities and skills to access the data together with the tools required to manage and audit access. Enforces data governance policies and procedures, ensures reliable data quality as well as supports education for employees in data governance
The job is published across India, Hungary and Romania, final location will be decided after selection.

What you will do

- Sets the strategic direction for the data governance.
- Leads data standardization, drives domain data standardization and system alignment and improvements for the relevant data domain
- Acts as a data Leader to set the strategic direction.
- Support business processes (use cases) and resolves customer concern of data issues
- Develops data expertise within a data-domain to ensure data is accurately defined and used across organization
- Plans and design future data availability within data domain expertise
- Proposes and leads any change in existing data or acquire new data to meet business requirements.
- Provides information to internal stakeholders on data lifecycle within their domain expertise (from collection till decommission) and how this data can support business objectives, including the use-of technology to facilitate this.
- Trains business stakeholders on the content and definition of domain data fields and the impact on their operational processes
- Creates and maintains the documentation of the domain data definitions and domain data use
Tools & Resources
Data Catalog
Data Governance (Risk)
Data Lineage
Data Quality
Data ETL (Extract, Transform, Load)

Behavioral Competences:

Adapting & responding to change
Applying expertise & technologyAnalyzing (data, business and process)
Persuading & Influencing
Deciding & initiating action ||Leading & Supervising .
You will bring

Experience in Information Technology
Management experience
Experience in (data) domain subject matter
Data Steward Qualification Exam
Knowledge of data sources, transformation rules and users
Data analysis
Understand how a data operating model can be applied within an organisation
Knowledge of TOGAF (The open group architecture framework)
DAMA (Data Management Association)
All academic credentials must be from recognized and accredited institutions and are further subject to verification.
Why join EricssonAt Ericsson, you ll have an outstanding opportunity. The chance to use your skills and imagination to push the boundaries of what s possible. To build solutions never seen before to some of the world s toughest problems. You ll be challenged, but you won t be alone. You ll be joining a team of diverse innovators, all driven to go beyond the status quo to craft what comes next.

What happens once you apply Click Here to find all you need to know about what our typical hiring process looks like.Encouraging a diverse and inclusive organization is core to our values at Ericsson, thats why we champion it in everything we do. We truly believe that by collaborating with people with different experiences we drive innovation, which is essential for our future growth. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply and realize their full potential as part of our Ericsson team. Ericsson is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. learn more.

Description:
Role & responsibilities
Visit customers with overdue home loan accounts to recover payments and manage assigned cases based on risk severity.
Negotiate repayment plans or settlements within policy guidelines and ensure adherence to collection targets and timelines.
Educate customers on loan terms, payment obligations, and consequences of default while addressing grievances professionally.
Conduct field visits to borrower premises, guarantors, or property sites; trace skip cases and update records.
Maintain accurate reports of visits, commitments, and collections, and submit timely updates to the reporting manager.
Coordinate with legal teams for notices, SARFAESI actions, possession, or repossession activities as required.
Ensure compliance with company policies, RBI Fair Practices Code, and ethical collection practices.
Preferred candidate profile
Strong negotiation and persuasion skills.
Good interpersonal and communication skills (local language proficiency preferred).
Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
Problem-solving attitude and resilience under pressure.
AboutCompany:
IIFL Finance Limited (hitherto referred to as IIFL) (NSE: IIFL, BSE: 532636) is one of the leading players in the financial services space in India. Together with its subsidiaries IIFL Home Finance Limited, IIFL Samasta Finance Limited (Formerly known as Samasta Microfinance Limited) and IIFL Open Fintech Private Limited, it provides a diverse range of loans and mortgages.
These include home loans, gold loans, business loans including loans against property and medium & small enterprise financing, micro finance, developer & construction finance and capital market finance; catering to both retail and corporate clients.
The company has a nationwide presence with a thriving network of 2600+ branches across 500+ cities.

Description:
Role Purpose
The Assistant Manager - PR & Digital Communication will be responsible for driving integrated public relations and earned media strategies across ITC PCPB's portfolio of brands. The role will focus on building brand visibility, strengthening media and influencer relationships, managing reputation, and amplifying brand narratives across traditional, digital and emerging communication platforms.
The incumbent will play a critical role in shaping the earned media agenda for PCPB by leveraging data, digital intelligence and AI-enabled communication tools to deliver impactful and measurable outcomes. The role will also partner closely with agencies to drive content seeding, discoverability, and brand visibility across search engines, social platforms, AI assistants, and emerging answer engines, ensuring brands remain relevant in an evolving communications landscape.
Key Responsibilities
Public Relations & Media Management
Develop and execute integrated PR strategies aligned with PCPB's business, brand and innovation priorities.
Build and nurture strong relationships with key journalists, editors, media houses, industry experts, and relevant stakeholders across beauty, lifestyle, wellness and consumer sectors.
Identify and leverage opportunities for high-impact earned media coverage across print, digital, broadcast, trade and lifestyle media.
Develop compelling communication assets including press releases, media kits, thought leadership articles, feature stories, leadership profiling content and crisis communication materials.
Manage media interactions, product launches, brand campaigns and corporate announcements.
Track and evaluate media coverage, sentiment, share of voice and quality of coverage to assess PR effectiveness.
Build and maintain a strong network of beauty, lifestyle, grooming and wellness influencers and content creators to support earned and advocacy-led campaigns.
Digital, AI & Emerging Communications
Leverage AI-powered tools and platforms to enhance PR planning, content creation, media intelligence, reputation management and performance reporting.
Drive visibility of PCPB brands across emerging discovery platforms, including AI-powered search and answer engines, through effective content amplification and seeding strategies.
Monitor digital conversations, social sentiment and reputation signals to generate actionable insights and identify potential risks or opportunities.
Evaluate and adopt emerging communication technologies, trends and digital-first storytelling formats to enhance stakeholder engagement.
Drive digitization and automation of PR processes, dashboards, reporting frameworks and analytics systems.
Collaborate with agencies and partners to improve the discoverability and relevance of brand content across digital ecosystems.
Advocacy Programs
Support the development and execution of influencer engagement strategies aligned to brand objectives.
Identify and cultivate relationships with credible creators, experts and community voices relevant to PCPB brands.
Stakeholder Management & Cross-functional Collaboration
Partner closely with brand marketing teams to identify communication opportunities and amplify key business initiatives.
Work collaboratively with agencies and external partners to ensure seamless execution of PR and influencer programs.
Coordinate with internal stakeholders across marketing, digital, legal and leadership teams to ensure alignment and consistency in communication.
Measure and report campaign performance, deriving insights and recommendations for future initiatives.
Key Requirements
Education
MBA or Postgraduate Degree in Marketing, Communications, Public Relations, Mass Communication, Journalism or a related discipline.
Experience
6/7+ years of experience in Public Relations, Brand Communications, Corporate Communications, Digital Communications or Integrated Communications.
Experience in Beauty, Personal Care, FMCG, Lifestyle, Fashion or Consumer Brands will be preferred.
Demonstrated experience in managing high-intensity, fast-paced communication environments involving multiple brands and stakeholders.
Proven track record of securing impactful earned media coverage and managing agency relationships.
Exposure to digital analytics, social listening platforms and AI-enabled communication tools will be an advantage.
Key Competencies
Strong media relations and storytelling capabilities.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Understanding of the evolving media, creator and digital ecosystem.
Analytical mindset with the ability to translate data into actionable insights.
Strong project management and stakeholder management skills.
Agility, ownership and ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
Curiosity and enthusiasm for emerging technologies, AI applications and the future of communications.

Description:
Job Title- Data engineer Senior associate
Years of experience -4-9yrs
Location - Bangalore/Hyderabad/Kolkata
Shoft timings-2-11PM
Skills requirement - Database-Sql, Mango DB, AI , Gen AI , AI engineer
Role Overview
We are looking for a Senior Associate Data Engineering & AI to design, develop, and manage scalable data platforms supporting analytics, reporting, and AI-driven applications. The ideal candidate will have strong experience with Oracle, SQL databases, MongoDB, Databricks, and database administration, along with an understanding of vectorization, embeddings, vector search, and Generative AI data patterns.
This role combines hands-on data engineering, database management, performance optimization, and the preparation of enterprise data for AI and machine-learning use cases.
Key Responsibilities
Design and develop reliable ETL/ELT pipelines using SQL, Python, PySpark, and Databricks.
Build and maintain data models across Oracle, relational databases, MongoDB, and lakehouse platforms.
Develop and optimize complex SQL queries, stored procedures, views, indexes, and database objects.
Administer databases, including user access, security, backup and recovery, monitoring, patching, and performance tuning.
Build Databricks workflows using Spark SQL, Delta Lake, and medallion data layers.
Prepare structured and unstructured data for analytics, machine learning, and Generative AI applications.
Support AI use cases involving embeddings, vectorization, semantic search, vector databases, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
Implement data-quality checks, metadata management, security controls, and data-governance standards.
Troubleshoot production database and data-pipeline issues and perform root-cause analysis.
Collaborate with data architects, application teams, analysts, data scientists, and AI engineers.
Mentor junior team members and contribute to data engineering and database best practices.
Required Skills
Strong hands-on experience with Oracle Database, SQL, and PL/SQL.
Experience with relational database design, query optimization, indexing, partitioning, and performance tuning.
Working knowledge of MongoDB, including document modeling, aggregation, indexing, and administration.
Experience with Databricks, Apache Spark, Spark SQL, PySpark, and Delta Lake concepts.
Experience building batch or near-real-time data pipelines.
Knowledge of database administration, including backup, recovery, security, monitoring, migration, and high availability.
Understanding of AI-ready data pipelines, embeddings, vector search, similarity matching, and vector databases.
Proficiency in Python or another data-engineering scripting language.
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and documentation skills.
Preferred Skills
Exposure to Generative AI, large language models, RAG, prompt-based applications, or AI/ML platforms.
Experience with Databricks Vector Search, MongoDB Atlas Vector Search
Familiarity with Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
Experience with orchestration and streaming tools such as Airflow, Azure Data Factory, Kafka, or Databricks Workflows.
Knowledge of Git, CI/CD, automated testing, and DevOps practices.

Job Description
Senior associate -7-12 years of experience required delivering EPM solutions, with hands-on experience on Oracle EPM Cloud and/or OneStream Oracle EPM/ OneStream tool certifications are an asset
As a Senior associate in finance Transformation EPM, you will play a key role in technology-enabled finance transformations, with a focus on Enterprise Performance Management, advanced analytics, and AI-enabled finance capabilities. You will support clients in translating strategic ambition into measurable outcomes by contributing to transformation efforts from finance vision and operating model definition through execution and value realization. You will support the design and delivery of scalable EPM solutionson Oracle EPM Cloud or OneStreamthat connect business strategy, data, and technology, while providing guidance to client stakeholders and contributing to PwC's Finance Transformation offerings.

Role & responsibilities
Work on challenging and rewarding Finance Transformation EPM engagements with multidisciplinary teams
Perform hands-on design and configuration of EPM components, including workflows, data sources, transformation/business rules and calculations, metadata, cubes, process flows, controls, and system security (e.g., Oracle FCCS, ARCS, Profitability & Cost Allocations, Oracle EPM planning modules such as Workforce, Capital, Project, and Finance Planning, or Onstream)
Advise clients on optimizing financial consolidation, planning, budgeting, forecasting, reporting, and dashboards
Conduct current-state assessments and organizational diagnostics on finance and performance management processes, and assist in identifying improvement opportunities
Assist in defining business and functional requirements for EPM solutions, including planning models, assumptions, forecasting logic, and application configuration
Support the design, build, migration, and testing of multi-dimensional data models, including dimensions, hierarchies, and attributes
Develop input templates, reports, and analytical dashboards
Support data integration and import processes, including source systems, data mappings, validations, and reconciliations
Implement calculations leveraging business rules and formulas (allocations, top-down spreading, currency logic, etc.)
Contribute to process optimization for EPM-enabled finance improvements across Consolidation, FP&A, allocations and core finance processes
Support vendor and EPM software selection activities, including business requirements gathering
Support project delivery activities including timeline tracking, milestone management, and cross-functional coordination
Identify, monitor, and help resolve project issues and risks
Support system testing, deployment, and post-go-live stabilization and support


Experience & Capabilities
Experience working in a professional services environment (a combination of industry, management consulting, and/or software implementation)
Hands-on implementation experience with one or more EPM platforms, with emphasis on Oracle EPM Cloud or OneStream
Experience managing and executing large finance, enterprise, and/or data architecture transformation programs
Leading or contributing to the design, build, migration, and testing of EPM solutions, including multi-dimensional data models (dimensions, hierarchies, attributes); input template and report build; data integration and Extract, Transform, and Load (ETL) concepts; understanding of calculations; and workflow, data permissions, and security
Leading the configuration of EPM components, including but not limited to workflows, data sources, transformation rules, business rules and calculations, dashboards, data management sequences, cube/metadata and master data, and system security (e.g., Oracle EPM modules / OneStream)

Operate and maintain welding equipment for optimal performance.
