Description:
Job Description

The Opportunity
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Youll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
As a Guidewire Senior Business Analyst - PolicyCenter - Consult, you will engage with clients to understand their business needs and translate them into functional requirements for Guidewire PolicyCenter implementations. Within our Technology Consulting practice, you will leverage your skills to analyze complex problems and develop solutions that align with client objectives. This role involves collaborating with multidisciplinary teams to deliver high-quality solutions that meet client expectations.
As a Senior Associate, you will focus on building meaningful client connections and guiding junior team members. You will navigate complex situations, using your problem-solving skills to anticipate client needs and deliver value. Your role will involve mentoring others and maintaining professional standards, contributing to the growth of both your personal brand and technical skills.
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will have the opportunity to work on diverse projects, enhancing your understanding of business contexts and developing your ability to manage and inspire others. This position offers a platform to deepen your technical knowledge and grow within a dynamic and supportive environment.
Responsibilities
Demonstrates expert abilities managing ITIL Processes; Tracking SLA’s, and contracting; 
Demonstrates advanced abilities providing solution strategy and Application Evolution Services (AES, formerly AMS) delivery as a Guidewire Functional Lead. Employees in the Functional Lead position should think of themselves and be regarded by the client as a trusted advisor and think strategically about how to create value using the Guidewire Suite of products; 
Demonstrates expert abilities with ITIL Incident and Problem management for the  Guidewire Suite of applications as it will be critical that Senior Business Analyst in this position are capable of navigating both business processes as well as enterprise solution perspectives at high level and holistic view;   
Demonstrates expert abilities and/or a proven record of success in leading proposal development efforts; Senior Business Analyst in these positions should be capable of delivering Advisory-level work and be able to discuss future enhancements in Guidewire roadmap discussions with the client; 
- Analyzing complex business requirements to develop and implement Guidewire PolicyCenter solutions
- Collaborating with clients to gather and document functional and technical requirements
- Configuring Guidewire BillingCenter and ClaimCenter to meet client specifications
- Leading system development and integration efforts to enhance software functionality
- Utilizing analytical thinking to identify and resolve system issues efficiently
- Embracing change and adapting to evolving client needs and project scopes
- Applying software development methodologies to optimize project delivery
- Engaging in active listening and accepting feedback to improve client interactions
- Demonstrating intellectual curiosity and learning agility to stay updated with industry trends
- Supporting teamwork and inclusion to foster a collaborative work environment
What You Must Have
Guidewire PolicyCenter, BillingCenter, ClaimCenter and ContactManager - leading requirement gathering sessions, conduct analysis, develop functional specifications and perform business walkthroughs; 
User story creation/updation, developing process flows, UI mock ups, and devloping data mapping in the standard Guidewire recommended user stories;  
Familiarity with Use case, SWOT analysis, Mindmapping, PESTLE analysis; Product Designer 
Usage of Tools JIRA, Confluence, ServiceNow, Splunk and familiarity with SQL  
- At least a Bachelor's degree
- At least 5-9 years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required
What Sets You Apart
Demonstrates expert abilities identifying and addressing client needs by: Developing and sustaining impactful client relationships using networking, negotiation and persuasion skills to identify and sell potential new service opportunities; Preparing and presenting complex written and verbal materials; and, Defining resource requirements, project workflow, budgets, billing and collection; 
Demonstrates expert abilities guiding team and motivating, creating a community of high performing professional consultants, creating an atmosphere of trust, leveraging diverse views, coaching staff, and encouraging improvement and innovation;  
Senior Business Analyst will be responsible for utilization and learning perspective of the team. Mentoring and helping to upskill junior resources will be critical in this role;     
Demonstrates intimate abilities and/or a proven record of success developing strategy as well as writing, communicating, facilitating, and presenting cogently; to and/or for all levels of industry audiences, clients and internal staff and management, such as presentation slides, practice marketing materials, change management plans and/or project plans, workshops and whitepapers, practice, methodologies and tools, policies and procedures, and/or other standard business communications; 
- Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Actuarial Science, Business Administration/Management, Business Analytics, Commerce, Computer and Information Science, Computer Applications, Computer Engineering, Computer Engineering & Accounting, Data Processing/Analytics/Science, Economics, Electrical Engineering, Engineering, Engineering and Business, Finance, Information Technology, Management Information Systems, Mathematics, Mechanical Engineering, Operations Management/Research, Risk Management, Software App, Statistics
- At least one of the following: Guidewire and Scrum Master Certification
- Demonstrating proficiency in Guidewire BillingCenter and ClaimCenter
- Utilizing analytical thinking to solve complex client issues
- Embracing change and adapting to evolving project requirements
- Excelling in communication to build meaningful client relationships
- Leveraging software development methodologies for efficient project delivery

I worked at Wockhardt Hospital from September 2014 to April 2025, dedicating myself to my role with precision and commitment. Over the years, I gained valuable experience in medical calculations, laboratory procedures, and structured professional communication. However, despite my dedication, several challenges made my experience frustrating. What I liked about working at Wockhardt Hospital: - I had the opportunity to refine my technical skills and expertise in laboratory processes. - The work allowed me to build strong analytical skills and attention to detail. What I disliked about working at Wockhardt Hospital: - There was no fair system for promotions—despite company policy stating promotions should occur every three years, I never received one in my ten-year tenure. - My salary increments were minimal Rs. 100, Rs. 200, and Rs. 200 over three years. For two of those years, I was given a “needs improvement” rating, not based on my actual performance but because the company said someone had to get it. - My designation was changed unfairly. I was originally a Senior Laboratory Technician but was demoted to Lab Technician after 2.5 years. Later, in 2023-2024, my senior post was reinstated, but they framed it as a promotion when it was simply a reversal of the earlier demotion. - Salary discrepancies colleagues who initially earned Rs. 1,000 less than me eventually earned Rs. 4,000 to Rs. 5,000 more, leaving me behind financially despite my experience and tenure. - Limited opportunities for skill development, which affected long-term career growth. Ultimately, while I value the technical experience I gained, these factors made me feel undervalued and unrecognized for my contributions. That’s why I decided to move on.

Title: Store Operations Professional
Skills: Store operations, About the company, Starbucks, 4.1, 912 employee reviews, Hotels & RestaurantsFood ProcessingJV, Follow, 99.6k followers, Overview, Every day, we go to work hoping to do two things: share great coffee with our friends and help make the world a little better. Description:
Star Bucks is looking for Store Operations to join our dynamic team and embark on a rewarding career journey.

The Store Operations Specialist is responsible for overseeing and optimizing the daily operations of our retail stores. They play a vital role in ensuring a seamless customer experience, managing inventory, and implementing operational processes to enhance store efficiency. This role requires a detail-oriented individual with strong organizational and communication skills. Key Responsibilities : Customer Service : Provide exceptional customer service by addressing inquiries, resolving issues, and ensuring a positive shopping experience. Train and mentor store staff on customer service best practices. Inventory Management : Monitor and manage store inventory levels to prevent stockouts and overstock situations. Coordinate with suppliers for timely replenishment of inventory. Conduct regular stock audits and maintain accurate inventory records. Store Layout and Merchandising : Collaborate with the visual merchandising team to ensure attractive and effective product displays. Optimize store layout for a smooth flow of customers and improved product visibility. Operational Efficiency : Develop and implement operational procedures to streamline store processes and reduce operational costs. Monitor and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) related to store operations. Loss Prevention : Implement loss prevention strategies to minimize theft and ensure the security of store assets. Job Title: Playwright Automation Test Engineer
Job Summary
We are seeking a skilled Playwright Automation Test Engineer to design, develop, and maintain robust automated test frameworks for web applications. The ideal candidate should have strong experience in Playwright, TypeScript/JavaScript, API testing, CI/CD integration, and modern quality engineering practices to ensure high-quality software delivery.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain automation frameworks using Playwright.
Create and execute automated test scripts for web applications.
Perform functional, regression, integration, smoke, and end-to-end testing.
Develop reusable Page Object Model (POM) frameworks and test utilities.
Execute cross-browser testing across Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit.
Automate API testing using Playwright and other API testing tools.
Identify, document, and track defects using defect management tools.
Collaborate with developers, product owners, and business analysts to understand requirements and acceptance criteria.
Analyze test execution results and prepare detailed test reports.
Integrate automation test suites with CI/CD pipelines.
Ensure test coverage, scalability, maintainability, and reliability of automation frameworks.
Participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives.
Required Skills & Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field.
2-83years of experience in Software Testing and Test Automation.
Minimum 2+ years of hands-on experience with Playwright Automation.
Strong expertise in:
Playwright Test Framework
TypeScript (Preferred) or JavaScript
Node.js
Page Object Model (POM)
Test Design Patterns
Experience with:
UI Automation Testing
End-to-End Testing
Cross-Browser Testing
Regression Testing
API Testing
Strong understanding of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and web technologies.
Experience with version control systems such as Git.
Knowledge of SQL and database validation.
Experience with Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar test management tools.
Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies.
Preferred Skills
Experience with Playwright API Testing capabilities.
Integration with CI/CD tools:
Jenkins
Azure DevOps
GitHub Actions
GitLab CI/CD
Experience with cloud testing platforms:
BrowserStack
LambdaTest
Sauce Labs
Knowledge of Docker and containerized testing environments.
Experience with BDD frameworks such as Cucumber.
Exposure to Accessibility Testing and Visual Testing tools.
Experience working with Azure, AWS, or GCP environments.

Description:
Infrastructure Automation Engineer (DevSecOps) Azure, Kubernetes & Terraform
Experience: 48 years
Role Overview
We are seeking experienced and hands-on Senior Infrastructure Automation Engineers (DevSecOps) with strong proficiency in Azure and Kubernetes to design, provision, automate, secure, and support scalable multicloud infrastructure for enterprise workloads.
The role requires deep expertise in Infrastructure as Code with Terraform, container orchestration on Kubernetes, automated CI/CD pipeline engineering, Python-based infrastructure automation, and embedding security controls across the build, deploy, and run lifecycle, with a strong focus on reliability, compliance, cost-awareness, and delivery quality.
Key Responsibilities
Design, provision, and manage scalable multicloud infrastructure with Azure as the primary platform and AWS as the secondary platform.
Architect and operate production-grade Kubernetes clusters (AKS / EKS / self-managed) covering deployments, scaling, networking, ingress, secrets, RBAC, upgrades, and operational troubleshooting.
Implement and govern Infrastructure as Code using Terraform module design, remote state, workspaces, policy-as-code, and reusable platform components for repeatable, secure, and auditable deployments.
Build, maintain, and optimize end-to-end CI/CD pipelines for application and infrastructure delivery, including build, test, scan, approval, and progressive deployment workflows.
Develop Python-based automation, tooling, and operators to streamline provisioning, configuration, remediation, and day-2 operations across cloud platforms.
Embed DevSecOps practices across the SDLC — SAST, DAST, SCA, container image scanning, IaC scanning, secrets management, and policy-as-code (OPA / Sentinel / Kyverno).
Integrate cloud infrastructure with enterprise networking, IAM, security, monitoring, logging, and DevOps toolchains in line with enterprise standards.
Monitor platform health, lead incident response, perform root cause analysis, and drive continuous service and reliability improvements.
Ensure infrastructure is resilient, secure, compliant, cost-aware, and aligned with enterprise architecture, security baselines, and operational standards.
Mentor junior engineers, lead technical reviews, and contribute to platform engineering standards, runbooks, and reference architectures.
Required Skills and Experience
Strong hands-on experience with Azure services (AKS, VNet, Azure AD / Entra ID, Key Vault, Storage, Monitor, Policy, Azure DevOps);
Strong expertise in Terraform — module development, state management, multi-environment patterns, and integration with policy-as-code frameworks.
Proven experience designing and operating CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or equivalent, including pipeline security and supply-chain controls.
Strong proficiency in Python for infrastructure automation, tooling, and integration; working knowledge of Bash / Shell scripting.
Solid grounding in cloud security — IAM, network segmentation, encryption, secrets management, vulnerability management, and DevSecOps tooling (e.g., Trivy, Checkov, tfsec, SonarQube, Snyk, Aqua / Prisma Cloud).
Qualification and Certifications
B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
One or more relevant certifications strongly preferred — Microsoft Azure (AZ-104 / AZ-305 / AZ-400), CKA / CKAD / CKS, HashiCorp Terraform Associate, AWS Solutions Architect / DevOps Engineer, or recognized security certifications (CCSK, CompTIA Security+).
Strong commitment to continuous learning and staying current with cloud, DevSecOps, Kubernetes, and platform engineering practices.

Locations- Hyderabad, Bangalore, Chennai, Kolkata, Noida, Kochi, Coimbatore

Description:
Make an impact with NTT DATA
Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion its a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
Your day at NTT DATA
As a Security Managed Services Engineer (L2) at NTT DATA, your role will be to ensure that our clients'' security infrastructures and systems remain operational. With a proactive approach, you''ll monitor, identify, investigate, and resolve technical incidents and problems, restoring service efficiently. Your primary objective will be to handle client requests or tickets with technical expertise, ensuring they are resolved within the agreed service level agreement (SLA).

You''ll actively manage work queues, perform operational tasks, and update tickets with resolution actions. By identifying issues and errors early on, you''ll log incidents promptly and provide second-level support, communicating effectively with other teams and clients to extend support when needed. Your role includes executing changes responsibly, flagging risks and mitigation plans, and ensuring all changes have proper approvals.
Collaborative efforts are at the heart of this role. You''ll work closely with automation teams to optimize efforts and automate routine tasks, ensuring seamless handovers during shift changes. Your analytical skills will be key in auditing incident and request tickets for quality, recommending improvements, and contributing to trend analysis reports to identify automation opportunities.

As a go-to for initial client escalations, you''ll assist L1 Security Engineers with triage and troubleshooting, and support project work when required. Your contributions to the change management process will ensure thorough documentation, effective planning and execution of maintenance activities, and compliance with standard procedures.

To thrive in this role, you need to have:
Experience with managed services handling security infrastructure and working knowledge of ticketing tools, preferably ServiceNow.
Proficiency in active listening, with techniques like paraphrasing and probing for further information.
Excellent planning skills, able to anticipate and adjust to changing circumstances.
Strong ability to communicate and engage across different cultures and social groups.
Adaptability to changing conditions and flexibility in approach.
Client-focused mindset, always putting their needs and positive experience first.
A positive outlook and the ability to work well under pressure.
Willingness to put in longer hours when necessary.
Bachelor''s degree or equivalent qualification in IT/Computing, or relevant work experience.

Description:
Big Data Technical Senior Associate Engineer
We are looking for a suitable candidate for the opening of the Senior/Associate Engineer role with good to have experience in the Banking and Financial Services domain with 4-6 years of relevant experience in Data Engineering / Big Data platforms. The candidate will work closely with Business, Risk, and Technology stakeholders to deliver scalable data products on Cloudera (CDH/CDP).
Key Roles & Responsibilities:
Must have / Primary Skills / Mandatory
Hands-on experience building data pipelines on Hadoop/Spark ecosystem
Strong Spark (Scala and/or PySpark), Hive/Impala SQL, and performance tuning
Working knowledge of Kafka for streaming ingestion and NiFi (or StreamSets) for batch/near-real-time flows
Experience with Cloudera Manager, YARN/Tez, HDFS, and job orchestration using Oozie/Airflow
Good understanding of data warehousing concepts (dimensional modelling, partitioning, bucketing)
Proficiency in Linux/Unix, Shell scripting, Git, and CI/CD (Jenkins/GitLab CI)
Strong SQL and data modelling for BFSI use cases (lending, liabilities, risk, regulatory reporting)
Experience in writing technical design documents (HLD/LLD) and unit/integration testing
Exposure to SDLC/Agile and working in onsiteoffshore model
Location - Mumbai
Develop robust Spark jobs (batch and streaming) with unit tests and observability
Implement ingestion patterns (Kafka/NiFi), data quality checks, and job scheduling
Analyze and tune SQL/Spark for large-scale datasets
Good to have / Secondary Skills / Desired
Experience with Cloudera Data Platform (CDP) Private Cloud Base/Public Cloud
Security and governance: Apache Ranger, Atlas; Kerberos; Sentry (legacy)
Cloud data services – AWS (EMR, Glue, S3), Azure (HDInsight, Synapse, ADLS), or GCP (Dataproc, BigQuery)
Databricks experience (Spark, Delta Lake) for select workloads
Containerization and orchestration (Docker/Kubernetes) for micro-batch/ML workloads
Python for data processing and utilities; familiarity with Scala build tools (sbt/maven)
Monitoring/observability – Cloudera Manager metrics, Grafana/Prometheus, log aggregation
Experience with BI consumption patterns and semantic layers for risk/regulatory dashboards
Educational Qualifications
B.E./B.Tech or equivalent
Experience Range
4-6 years
Certifications (Preferred)
Cloudera Certified Associate/Professional (CCA/CCP) or CDP certifications
AWS/Azure/GCP data certifications (nice to have)
Databricks Lakehouse Fundamentals or Associate (nice to have)

Description:
Himalayan Institute of Alternatives, Ladakh (HIAL) is an upcoming Alternative Institute for Mountain Development which follows Contextual Learning and Experiential Pedagogy where students learn by doing and earn while they learn. It aims to develop Ladakh into a benchmark of sustainable living for the mountain world, where all children receive a meaningful education that prepares them for a life of dignity in harmony with nature. It believes in collaborative exercise between learners and facilitators. Instead of solving problems with the conventional 3Rs (Reading, writing, and arithmetic), the learners are encouraged to solve problems using the 3Hs: Bright Head, Kind Heart, and Skilled Hands. The institute is promoted by the renowned leaders in entrepreneurial education in India and attracts talent and grants from leading corporates and Government bodies in India.
For more details about us, please check:
Visit : HIAL Website or watch: About HIAl Job Description:
Looking for an experienced content creator who has proven ability to develop content and experience of writing good quality engaging articles. Has an ability to conduct extensive research on the assigned topic. A team player who has good coordination skills to collate the data at hand from different stake holders. The right candidate will be the one who is able to work from remote ethically and maintain timelines for deliverables and take ownership of the expected output without supervision.
About The Role:
As a content writer / you shall get to create content that shares HIAL's story, vision and brand to the world and make an impact across many different digital / social / media platforms.
Responsibilities:
1.Write, edit, publish content for websites, blogs, vlogs, videos, social media campaign (LinkedIn, Facebook, Twitter, Instagram etc).
2.Creating compelling headlines and body content that will capture the attention of the target audience.
3.Write content for Annual Report, Newsletter and other internal communication initiatives.
4.Design content marketing strategy.
5.Optimise content considering SEO.
6.Should have the ability to work independently and with cross functional teams.
7.Should be able to come up with fresh ideas and take ownership of projects.
8.Ensure that the content adheres to required branding and style guidelines and is relevant for our target audience.
9.Scripting for audio-visual, written and other media content.
10.Plan and Execute Events and Conferences that are integral to HIAL.
11.Monitor HIAL's Social Media and online presence and timely preparing high quality content for promoting HIAL brand value.
12.Prepare HIAL Annual Report (Annually), Newsletters (Quarterly), Monthly Updates (Monthly) collating data as required from all stakeholders.
13.While ensuring that they adhere to standards and goals of the HIAL, write and produce high-quality materials for effectively communicating to the key audience at appropriate platforms.
14.Create creative content for social media platforms including LinkedIn, Facebook and Instagram to maintain an active online presence for HIAL.
15.Content for press releases, media briefings etc for HIAL's media relations across radio, print, digital, and television.
16.Assure uniformity in all content by serving as key brand guardian of HIAL.
17.Maintain the content of HIALs website by making sure it is correct, up to date, and persuasive.
18.Have an eye for detail and make sure all output is of a high quality.
19.Able to work from remote ethically and maintain timelines for deliverables.

KRA:
1.Written content for communication with HIAL's stakeholders.
2.Preparation and circulation of Annual Report (Annually), Newsletters (Quarterly), Monthly Updates (Monthly), brochures/ manuals, etc.
3.Branding and marketing related content.
4.Support in promoting the events organised time to time with valuable content for marketing and branding.
5.Social Media: Preparation of high quality and engaging content for all the social media handles as per tentative schedule mentioned below with SEO.
1. Instagram: Ensure daily effective posts.
2.Any Event: Instant Posting.
3.Facebook: Ensure daily effective posts.
4.Twitter
5.LinkedIn
6.Website
6.Content for the Events:
1.Annual Conferences & Festivals, promotion activities (Sun & Earth, Education, Entrepreneurship, Energy Studies).
2.Workshops.

7.I Live Simply (ILS).
1.Manage content related activities for ILS.


Preferred Educational Background:
1.Graduate or Master's in Mass Communication/ English literature or equivalent.
2.Good command over English.
3.Proven experience working under strict deadlines and the ability to work quickly.
4.Creative skills and usage of photographs, drawings, diagrams, animation, etc
The above is relaxed for the right candidate who can prove excellence in lines with the requirement with proven track record.
Preferred Work Experience:
1.Minimum of 2-5 years in similar roles.
2.Ability to work independently and reliably with minimal supervision.
3.Experience in SEO will be preferred.
4.Creative writing.
Compensation:
As per industry and region standards.

Description:
Job Description:
We are seeking a talented and creative Media Executive to join our team . The ideal candidate will have proven photography and videography skills, with a keen eye for capturing compelling visuals that tell a story. As a Media Executive, you will play a key role in documenting our projects, events, and initiatives through various forms of media, including photography, videography, and multimedia content creation. Responsibilities:
Capture high-quality photographs and videos that showcase the work and impact of HIAL's projects and initiatives.
Edit and enhance photos and videos using Adobe Creative Suite or similar software to ensure a polished and professional final product.
Collaborate with team members to develop creative concepts and visual storytelling strategies for various media projects.
Manage and maintain a library of multimedia assets, including photos, videos, and graphics.
Support social media and marketing efforts by providing engaging visual content for digital platforms.
Assist in the production of promotional materials, including brochures, presentations, and videos.
Travel with project teams to remote locations in Ladakh and other regions as needed to document fieldwork and events.

Qualifications:
Bachelor's degree in photography, videography, media production, or related field preferred.
Proven experience in photography and videography, with a strong portfolio demonstrating technical proficiency and creative vision.
Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, including Photoshop, Lightroom, Premiere Pro, and/or After Effects.
Strong attention to detail and ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
Excellent communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with colleagues from diverse backgrounds.
Willingness to travel and work in challenging environments, including remote Himalayan regions, and be flexible with assignments and schedules.
Benefits:
Opportunity to work with a dynamic team dedicated to making a positive impact in the Himalayan region.
Experience the rich cultural heritage and breathtaking landscapes of Ladakh.
Professional development opportunities and training in media production and storytelling techniques.
If you are passionate about using your media skills to make a difference and are excited about the opportunity to work in the beautiful Himalayan region of Ladakh, we encourage you to apply for the Media Executive position at HIAL. Join us in our mission to create a more sustainable and resilient future for Himalayan communities.

Description:
Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced Accounts Payable and Vendor Management professional with strong knowledge of Invoice Processing, General Accounting, and SAP. The candidate will be responsible for managing the end-to-end accounts payable process, vendor relationships, invoice validation and processing, reconciliations, and accounting activities while ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timely payments.

Key Responsibilities
Accounts Payable
Manage the end-to-end Accounts Payable (AP) process, from invoice receipt through payment.
Process vendor invoices accurately and within agreed turnaround times.
Perform invoice verification, including PO/non-PO validation, three-way matching, tax checks, and approval verification.
Resolve invoice discrepancies and coordinate with Procurement, Business, and Vendors.
Monitor AP aging and ensure timely resolution of outstanding invoices.
Support month-end and year-end closing activities.
Vendor Management
Create and maintain vendor master data in SAP in accordance with company policies.
Coordinate with vendors regarding invoices, payments, statements, and account discrepancies.
Perform regular vendor statement reconciliation.
Resolve vendor queries and ensure timely communication.
Identify duplicate invoices, incorrect payments, and other potential AP risks.
Invoice Processing
Receive, review, validate, and post invoices in SAP.
Ensure invoices contain appropriate supporting documentation and approvals.
Validate GST/VAT, withholding tax, cost center, GL code, PO, and payment terms as applicable.
Maintain accurate records of invoices and supporting documents.
Monitor invoice processing queues and ensure timely processing.
General Accounting
Perform GL postings, journal entries, accruals, provisions, and account reconciliations.
Assist with month-end closing and reporting activities.
Perform bank, vendor, and GL reconciliations.
Support preparation of financial reports and schedules.
Ensure transactions are recorded accurately in accordance with accounting policies.
Assist internal and external audits by providing required documentation and reconciliations.

Required Skills & Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Commerce, or a related field.
15years of experience in Accounts Payable, Invoice Processing, Vendor Management, and General Accounting.
SAP experience is mandatory; hands-on experience with SAP FI/AP is highly preferred.
Strong understanding of the Procure-to-Pay (P2P) process.
Good knowledge of accounting principles and AP controls.
Experience with vendor reconciliation and invoice discrepancy resolution.
Good knowledge of Excel, including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, and basic data analysis.
Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to work with multiple stakeholders and meet strict deadlines.
Preferred Qualifications

Description:
We are looking for a dynamic, strategic, and results-driven General Manager Projects & Operations to lead and oversee the organization's project portfolio. This role requires an experienced professional who can successfully manage both short-term, high-priority projects with immediate deliverables and long-term strategic initiatives that support the company's growth and operational excellence.

The ideal candidate will possess strong leadership, project management, stakeholder management, and operational planning skills, with the ability to adapt quickly in a fast-paced environment while driving sustainable business outcomes.

Key Responsibilities
Short-Term Project Management (Immediate Deliverables)
Lead, execute, and deliver high-priority projects within defined timelines (typically up to 36 months).
Develop project schedules, allocate resources, and ensure timely completion of deliverables.
Coordinate cross-functional teams to meet urgent project objectives efficiently.
Monitor project progress, identify roadblocks, and implement timely solutions.
Communicate project status, milestones, and risks to stakeholders on a regular basis.
Long-Term Strategic Project Management
Plan and manage long-term projects aligned with the organization's strategic vision and business goals.
Develop comprehensive project roadmaps, timelines, budgets, and resource plans.
Track project performance through KPIs, manage risks, and implement corrective actions when required.
Collaborate with senior leadership to prioritize projects and optimize resource allocation.
Drive continuous improvement, process optimization, and scalability across projects and operations.
General Management & Operations
Define project scope, objectives, deliverables, and success metrics in collaboration with stakeholders.
Lead and mentor cross-functional teams, ensuring alignment with organizational priorities.
Oversee project budgets, timelines, quality standards, and compliance throughout the project lifecycle.
Prepare and present project reports, dashboards, and performance updates to senior management.
Establish and promote best practices in project governance, planning, and execution.
Build a collaborative, high-performance work culture focused on accountability and results.

Required Qualifications
Master's Degree in any discipline from a recognized university.
Additional certifications in Project Management, Operations Management, Business Management, or related fields will be an added advantage.
Double Master's Degree is preferred.

Experience & Skills
Proven experience in Project Management and Operations Leadership.
Strong understanding of project planning, budgeting, risk management, and resource allocation.
Experience managing multiple projects simultaneously with varying timelines and priorities.
Excellent leadership, decision-making, and stakeholder management abilities.
Strong communication, presentation, and organizational skills.
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and adapt to changing business priorities.

Preferred Candidate Profile
Strategic thinker with strong execution capabilities.
Ability to balance immediate operational needs with long-term business objectives.
Proactive, solution-oriented, and capable of leading teams through complex projects.
Experience working with cross-functional teams and senior leadership.

F&B Production 2-4 Years Full-time Leh, Ladakh
Job Summary:
Job Summary

The Commis I Indian Kitchen is responsible for assisting in the preparation, cooking, and presentation of Indian cuisine while maintaining the highest standards of food quality, hygiene, and kitchen operations. The role requires sound knowledge of Indian cooking techniques, ingredients, and kitchen procedures, along with the ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities

Prepare and cook Indian dishes according to established recipes and standards.
Assist senior chefs in mise en place and daily kitchen operations.
Ensure consistency in taste, presentation, and portion control.
Monitor the quality and freshness of ingredients before use.
Maintain cleanliness and organization of the assigned work station.
Follow all food safety, hygiene, and sanitation standards.
Ensure proper storage, labeling, and rotation of food items (FIFO).
Support in receiving and storing kitchen supplies and ingredients.
Minimize food wastage and contribute to cost-control initiatives.
Assist during buffet service, la carte operations, banquets, and special events.
Report equipment malfunctions, stock shortages, and quality concerns to supervisors.
Work collaboratively with other kitchen team members to ensure smooth operations.

Qualifications & Experience

Diploma or Degree in Hotel Management, Culinary Arts, or a related field preferred.
Minimum 2 4 years of experience in an Indian kitchen, preferably in a luxury hotel or fine-dining restaurant.
Knowledge of North Indian, Mughlai, Tandoor, and regional Indian cuisines is desirable.
Familiarity with food safety and hygiene standards.

Skills & Competencies

Strong understanding of Indian cooking methods, spices, and ingredients.
Ability to work under pressure and meet service timelines.
Attention to detail and commitment to quality.
Good organizational and time-management skills.
Team-oriented attitude with a willingness to learn.
Ability to maintain a clean and disciplined work environment.

What We Offer

Opportunity to work in a luxury hospitality environment.
Professional growth and learning opportunities.
Competitive compensation and benefits.
A collaborative and supportive workplace culture.

style="margin-bottom: 0px;"> Sous Chef-Indian Cuisine
F&B Production 7-8 Years Full-time Leh, Ladakh
Job Summary:
Job Summary

The Sous Chef - Indian Kitchen is responsible for assisting the Executive Chef in managing the preparation, cooking, and presentation of Indian cuisine while maintaining the highest standards of food quality, hygiene, and kitchen operations. The role requires strong knowledge of Indian cooking techniques, ingredients, menu execution, and kitchen procedures, along with proven leadership skills and the ability to manage a team effectively in a fast-paced hospitality environment.

Key Responsibilities

Assist the Executive Chef in managing the day-to-day operations of the Indian kitchen.
Supervise and coordinate the work of Chefs de Partie, Commis Chefs, and other kitchen team members.
Prepare and oversee the preparation and cooking of Indian dishes according to established recipes and standards.
Ensure consistency in taste, presentation, portion control, and overall food quality.
Conduct regular quality checks and ensure all dishes meet the required standards before service.
Plan and supervise mise en place and ensure adequate preparation for daily operations and service.
Assist in menu planning, development of new dishes, and implementation of seasonal and special menus.
Ensure proper handling, storage, labeling, and rotation of food items in accordance with FIFO practices.
Monitor ingredient quality, freshness, and availability and coordinate with the relevant departments for timely replenishment.
Control food wastage and assist in maintaining food-cost targets through effective production and portion control.
Ensure strict compliance with food safety, hygiene, sanitation, and HACCP standards.
Maintain cleanliness, organization, and discipline across the Indian kitchen and assigned work areas.
Assist in managing buffet service, la carte operations, banquets, special events, and other culinary requirements.
Train, guide, and develop junior kitchen team members in Indian cooking techniques, hygiene, and standard operating procedures.
Allocate daily duties and ensure efficient deployment of kitchen personnel during service.
Monitor kitchen equipment and report maintenance requirements, malfunctions, stock shortages, and quality concerns to the Executive Chef.
Take responsibility for the Indian kitchen in the absence of the Executive Chef, ensuring uninterrupted and efficient operations.
Work closely with other kitchen sections and service teams to ensure smooth coordination and timely food delivery.

Qualifications & Experience

Diploma or Degree in Hotel Management, Culinary Arts, or a related field preferred.
Minimum 7-8 years of experience in a professional Indian kitchen, preferably in a luxury hotel or fine-dining restaurant.
Previous experience in a Sous Chef, Junior Sous Chef, or senior Chef de Partie position is preferred.
Strong knowledge of North Indian, Mughlai, Tandoor, and regional Indian cuisines.
Proven experience in supervising and leading a kitchen team.
Good knowledge of food safety, hygiene, sanitation, and HACCP standards.

Skills & Competencies

Strong understanding of Indian cooking methods, spices, ingredients, and regional cuisines.
Strong leadership and team-management skills.
Ability to maintain consistency and quality during high-volume service.
Ability to work effectively under pressure and meet service timelines.
Excellent organizational and time-management skills.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.
Good understanding of food cost, portion control, and wastage management.
Ability to train, motivate, and develop junior kitchen team members.
Strong communication and coordination skills.
Ability to maintain a clean, disciplined, and professional kitchen environment.

What We Offer

Opportunity to work in a luxury hospitality environment.
Professional growth and learning opportunities.
Competitive compensation and benefits.
A collaborative and supportive workplace culture.

Description:
" >
As a Technical Officer at BSM, you will be responsible for supporting the Technical Superintendent in ensuring the smooth operation and maintenance of vessels. This role plays a critical part in bridging ship and shore activities by coordinating services and maintaining compliance with technical and safety standards.
Key Responsibilities
Monitor monthly vessel reports and follow up on analysis reports for lubricating oil, bunker, boiler, and cooling water, highlighting deviations for corrective action.
Maintain vessel certification records and collate data for owners reports.
Arrange services and repairs, including annual surveys and routine servicing of vessel equipment, and liaise with classification societies as required.
Ensure service arrangements are carried out by approved vendors, issue purchase orders, and follow up on service delivery to avoid cost overruns.
Coordinate port service planning and logistics for each vessel call.
Utilize relevant systems to manage purchasing, certification, and voyage planning, providing feedback for system improvements.
Qualifications Experience
Bachelor s degree in Business or Accounting, or equivalent qualification, or Second Mate/Third Engineer license.
Minimum 6 years of experience in purchasing or supply chain management, preferably in the shipping industry.
Skills Competencies
Strong knowledge of vessel technical requirements and voyage regulations.
Advanced understanding of the local and regional market for technical subcontractors.
Excellent negotiation and communication skills.
Strong organizational and project management abilities.
Fluency in English and proficiency in PC applications.
Why You Should Join Us!
We offer a supportive environment, competitive compensation, and meaningful opportunities. By joining us, you will enjoy:
On-the-job training.
First-hand exposure to the growing maritime technological industry.
Diverse workforce.
Technology-driven company.
Be a part of the ever-growing Schulte group family!

Job Title: SAP FICO Manager
Location:-Pune, kochi, hyderabad, bangalore, DELHI/NCR
EXP-11+ Years
We are seeking an experienced SAP FICO Manager to lead our Application Management Services (AMS) delivery for global clients. In this role, you will manage cross-functional support teams, lead L2/L3 incident resolution, and drive business process improvements. The ideal candidate brings a blend of deep SAP FICO technical knowledge, strong ITIL/ITSM operational expertise, and proven global stakeholder management skills.

Key Responsibilities
AMS Delivery Leadership: Drive day-to-day L2/L3 application support operations, managing incidents, service requests, defect resolution, change requests, and system enhancements.
Incident & Outage Management: Lead the resolution of complex system outages and technical issues; conduct root-cause analysis to ensure high system availability and minimal business disruption.
Team Guidance & Mentorship: Direct and inspire cross-functional functional and technical consultants (onsite/offshore model), fostering continuous learning and best practice adoption.
Stakeholder & Client Management: Work directly with global business stakeholders to gather requirements, assess operational needs, and deliver efficient SAP FICO solutions.
Documentation & Governance: Maintain solution blueprints, configuration guides, functional specifications, and test scripts in line with ITIL/ITSM and ALM frameworks.
Process Automation: Identify operational bottlenecks and implement SAP best practices, automation, and continuous process improvements.

Key Requirements (Must-Haves)

Education: Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience.
Experience: 1014 years of hands-on experience in SAP FICO, with a focus on global client delivery.
ITSM / ITIL Expertise: Strong understanding of ITIL methodologies, incident lifecycle management, and defect resolution.
Global Team & Client Management: Demonstrated success managing cross-functional teams and regional stakeholders across multiple geographies in an onshore/offshore setup.
Operational Flexibility: Willingness to work flexible hours/shifts to align with global business coverage (Australia, Asia, Europe, Americas) and participate in critical on-call rotations.
Preferred Qualifications
SME-Level Module Knowledge: Deep expertise across Core FI (G/L, AP, AR, Bank, Asset Accounting) and CO (CCA, PCA, Product Costing, CO-PA, PS, Month-End/Year-End Close).
Cross-Module Integrations: Solid knowledge of FICO integration touchpoints with MM, SD, HR, PP, and PM.
Certification: Official SAP FICO Certification is highly desirable.

Description:
Our jobs aren t just about putting food on the table that our guests will enjoy until they ask for their bill.
Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique - with food and drinks on the side.
Our Guest Service Experts take the initiative and deliver a wide range of services to make sure that guests enjoy their meal.
Whether setting tables, communicating with the kitchen, interacting and serving guests, or cleaning work areas and supplies, the Guest Service Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - creating a safe workplace, following company policies and procedures, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Service Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time; moving over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces), managing the menu (read and visually verify information), and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance and 50 pounds with assistance; reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Service Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: Less than 1 year related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Company: PRISM
Location: Bangalore & Thrissur

About the Role
PRISM is looking for an experienced and results-driven Operations Manager to oversee hotel and hospitality operations in Bangalore. The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience managing hotel operations, leading teams, maintaining service standards, and driving operational efficiency.

Key Responsibilities
Manage day-to-day hotel and hospitality operations, ensuring smooth and efficient functioning.
Oversee operations across a minimum portfolio/key of 50 rooms (keys).
Lead and manage operational teams across departments to achieve business and service objectives.
Ensure high standards of guest experience, service quality, hygiene, and operational excellence.
Monitor occupancy, revenue, costs, guest satisfaction, and other key operational metrics.
Coordinate with housekeeping, front office, maintenance, F&B, and other operational functions.
Develop and implement SOPs and ensure compliance with company and hospitality standards.
Handle guest escalations and ensure timely resolution of operational issues.
Drive team productivity, training, performance management, and employee engagement.
Identify opportunities to improve processes, reduce operational costs, and enhance profitability.
Ensure compliance with safety, statutory, and company policies.
Candidate Profile

Minimum 5 years of experience in hotel/hospitality operations.
Strong hands-on experience in hotel and hospitality operations.
Experience managing a property/portfolio of 50+ keys is preferred/required.
Strong team-management and leadership skills.
Excellent communication, interpersonal, and problem-solving abilities.
Strong understanding of hotel operations, guest experience, and operational KPIs.
Candidates with experience managing multi-department hotel operations will be preferred.
Must be willing to work from/operate in Bangalore.

How to Apply

Description:
Service line - Position Title: Experience Management Supervising Associate
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
About Global Delivery Services:
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
The Opportunity:
As a part of a team, you will act as a Resource Management Hub Deputy Manager who provides consistent, high quality services to key individual stakeholders.
Your Key Responsibilities:
Service Delivery Leadership:
Manage end-to-end resource fulfilment, ensuring alignment with delivery timelines and business priorities.
Oversee billing and finance operations related to resource deployment, ensuring accuracy and compliance.
Own headcount planning to support growth and efficiency.
Champion and lead Strategic Experience Management initiatives, aligning resource strategy with long-term business objectives.
Monitor and improve service levels, turnaround times, and stakeholder satisfaction.
Planning & Optimization:
Forecast demand and plan capacity across skill sets.
Maximize bench utilization and redeployment efficiency.
Collaborate with Talent Acquisition and HR to align hiring plans with pipeline and delivery needs.
Performance Management:
Establish and track KPIs for resource performance, utilization, and productivity.
Conduct regular reviews with delivery leads to assess individual and team performance.
Stakeholder Management:
Act as a strategic partner to delivery, business leaders.
Facilitate governance forums to review resource allocation, pipeline, and performance metrics.
Resolve escalations related to staffing conflicts, skill mismatches, or delivery risks.
Data & Analytics:
Maintain accurate dashboards and reports on resource availability, utilization, and forecasting.
Use data-driven insights to inform decision-making and identify improvement opportunities.
Skills and attributes for success:
Hands on knowledge on End to End Resource management
Be proficient in MS Project/Word/PowerPoint/Excel - working knowledge of MS office
Knowledge in Data Visualisation tools would be an added advantage
Exceptional communication skills - both written and oral
Demonstrate strong organizational skills and structured thinking abilities
Demonstrate strong interpersonal and analytical skills
Demonstrate an eye for detail
Be flexible and willing to adjust responsibilities to align with developing business needs
Flexibility to adjust to multiple demands, shifting priorities, ambiguity and rapid change
To qualify for the role, you must have:
Graduate / MBA (HR) with 12-14 years of overall experience with 8+ years of relevant experience in E2E resource management, deployment, forecasting and scheduling concepts.
Exposure of short term and long-term resource planning would be an added advantage.
What we look for:
A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
An opportunity to be part of a market-leading, multi-disciplinary team in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide.
Opportunity to work with EY GDS practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries
AboutCompany:
EY | Building a better working world
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Description:
Position Title: Resource Management Senior Resource Analyst
About Global Delivery Services:
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
The Opportunity:
As a Senior Resource Analyst (L2), you will play a key role in driving data analysis, reporting, and process optimization within the resourcing team. Your primary responsibility will be to develop and maintain real-time dashboards, automate reporting processes, and provide actionable insights into resource utilization, capacity planning, and workforce performance metrics. You will also take ownership of driving operational efficiency or reporting and analytics suites across the SL you are aligned.
Your Key Responsibilities:
Data Analysis & Reporting:
Develop, maintain, and enhance real-time dashboards and reports on resource utilization, capacity planning, and performance metrics to support resourcing teams.
Use Power BI and advanced Excel functions to automate reporting and provide insightful data analysis to leadership.
Analyse trends, identify patterns, and provide actionable recommendations for improvements in resource allocation and planning.
Ensure that all reports and data are delivered in the right format and are aligned with business needs.
Process Optimization & Automation:
Identify inefficiencies within the current reporting and resource management processes and propose solutions for automation using VBA, Power Query, and macros.
Drive automation initiatives to reduce manual effort and increase reporting accuracy and efficiency.
Continuously improve resource management workflows to enhance scalability, reduce turnaround time, and ensure effectiveness.
Leadership & Ownership:
Take ownership of key deliverables, including streamlining non-audit assurance reports and developing advanced dashboards (e.g., RVA trends dashboard).
Proactively manage deliverables and prioritize tasks to meet deadlines while balancing current workload and additional responsibilities.
Provide insights and suggest enhancements to existing processes, tools, and reporting methods.
Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.
Collaboration & Innovation:
Collaborate with resourcing and operational teams to ensure reporting and data needs are met in alignment with organizational goals.
Contribute to the development of innovative tools and solutions to enhance workforce planning, resource allocation, and operational efficiency.
Skills and attributes for success:
Technical Proficiency:
Strong expertise in Power BI for developing dashboards, reports, and analytics.
Advanced proficiency in Excel, including formulas, pivot tables, and advanced functions.
Experience with VBA, Power Query, and macros for process automation.

Project Role: Automation Testing
Work Experience: 2-8 Years
Employment Type: Full-Time
Work location: Bangalore/Kochi
Work Mode: Hybrid
Must Have Skills: Automation Testing, Selenium Webdriver, Selenium Xpaths, Specflow ,BDD Framework, C#

Job Description:
Authors and executes automation test cases for larger computer systems within the scope of a broader defined testing strategy.
Ensures creation of test data to support test case execution and supports creation and maintenance of libraries of reusable test data sets.
Work as part of sprint test team to gain necessary input and execute appropriate revisions to ensure accurate and complete software testing activities.
Leverages quality engineering tools for test planning and management, test case authoring, test case execution and issue/defect tracking
Performs review of deliverables produced by other members of the IT department throughout the Systems Development Life Cycle, for completeness and detail ensuring the specifications are of a high quality and can be used to write test scripts. May participate in technical meetings with Business Analysts and Developers
Reviews requirements specifications for testability and verifying/ensuring traceability of testing to requirements and vice versa
Possess a detailed understanding of the requirements elicitation, analysis, and specification process including user requirement specifications and functional specifications for larger, complex applications.
Reports status, progress and concerns in a proactive, consistent and accurate manner to the QA Lead.
Perform different types of testing like unit, functional, non-functional, security and data validations.

Required Skills:
2+ years of experience in Automation Testing Technologies like Selenium Webdriver testing including Selenium Xpaths, Specflow ,BDD Framework
Programming Language: Java, C#, Scripting Languages
Good to have skills : CI/CD pipeline, Github, Selenium Grid, Performance testing & API testing
Experience with Product based testing and different testing methodology
Ability to deconstruct problems/systems into smaller components; organize components as part of larger system
Demonstrate and articulate the application of logical, analytical thought to a testing issues
Excellent oral/written interpersonal skills; user focused; work well with team members.
Very strong knowledge/skills around test case creation and test execution; ability to create and execute test cases as part of broader testing strategy. Test case creation and execution would be for discreet portions or multiple portions of larger sized systems that are complex and may interface with other products
Ability to author and execute test cases as well as to assist in authoring test plans and strategies and coordinate testing and testing assignments. Requires minimal technical instructions and guidance with complex tasks
Involved in the Designing, Preparing, Execution and Maintenance of the test cases.

Educational Qualification:
BTech/BCA/BSc/MTech/MCA/MSc

Description:
Security Data Engineer

Your key responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain robust data pipelines to process and analyze large datasets.
Utilize SQL for data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) processes.
Work with Data Bricks and Data Lake technologies to manage and optimize data storage and processing.
Collaborate with security teams to understand data requirements and integrate data from various security tools.
Create and maintain documentation for data pipelines, processes, and workflows.
Monitor and troubleshoot data pipeline performance and data quality issues.
Develop data models and visualizations to present security insights to stakeholders.
Stay updated with industry trends and best practices in data engineering and security analytics.
Skills and attributes for success
Conceptual knowledge of security applications and technologies, as well as operating system platforms including Cloud technologies
Proven experience as a Data Engineer or in a similar role.
Strong proficiency in SQL and experience with data manipulation and querying.
Hands-on experience with Data Bricks and Data Lake technologies.
Familiarity with security tools and frameworks for data extraction.
Knowledge of data modelling, ETL processes, and data warehousing concepts.
Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Proficiency in Azure Cloud services, with a strong understanding of Azure security tools such as Azure Security Center, Azure Monitor, and Azure Sentinel
Build and maintain strong relationships across all levels of a matrixed, geographically and culturally dispersed organization
Strong communication and collaboration skills.
Possess knowledge of the Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) to drive compliance in Incident, Problem, and Change processes and drive as necessary
To qualify for the role you must have
Degree in Computer Science or related discipline, or equivalent work experience
7-10 years working within Information Technology in a global firm
Knowledge of Azure Data Lake, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, Notebooks, PySpark, Spark SQL
Working knowledge of data analysis programming or scripting languages, such as Python (with libraries like pandas, NumPy) or PowerShell
Experience with Azure SQL and database management systems for data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) processes.
Certifications in data visualization or analytics platforms.
Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud).
Knowledge of programming languages such as Python or Scala.
Familiarity with data visualization tools (e.g. Power BI, Tableau).
What we look for
Critical thinking skills demonstrating analytical and systematic approach to problem solving
Experience working in a global virtual environment
Excellent interpersonal, communication and presentation skills
Good judgment, tact, and decision-making ability
Ability to understand and integrate cultural differences and motives and to work with cross cultural teams.
Ability to deal with ambiguity and change, and exercise appropriate time management to meet deadlines
Ability to work autonomously but also within a team environment where necessary

Description:
Job Summary
We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Power BI +DAX with 7-9years of experience in designing, developing, and maintaining business intelligence solutions. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Power BI, data modeling, DAX, SQL, and data visualization to transform business data into actionable insights.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and deploy interactive Power BI dashboards and reports.
Gather and understand business requirements and translate them into analytical solutions.
Create and optimize data models, datasets, and report performance.
Develop complex calculations using DAX and Power Query (M Language).
Connect Power BI to multiple data sources including SQL Server, Excel, APIs, Azure, and other databases.
Implement data validation and ensure data accuracy and consistency.
Schedule report refreshes and manage Power BI Service environments.
Collaborate with business stakeholders, data engineers, and analysts to deliver reporting solutions.
Troubleshoot performance issues and optimize existing reports and dashboards.
Maintain documentation and follow BI development best practices.
Required Skills

Strong experience with Microsoft Power BI
Expertise in DAX (Data Analysis Expressions)
Proficiency in Power Query and M Language

Experience in Data Modeling (Star Schema, Snowflake Schema)
Knowledge of ETL processes and data transformation
Experience with Power BI Service, Gateway, Workspaces, and Row-Level Security (RLS)
Understanding of data warehousing concepts
Experience with Excel and advanced reporting techniques
Preferred Skills
Experience with Azure Data Factory (ADF)
Knowledge of Azure Synapse Analytics
Exposure to Databricks
Experience with SSIS, SSRS, and SSAS
Basic understanding of Python or R for analytics
Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies
Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field.
7-9 years of relevant experience in BI/Analytics development.
Microsoft Power BI Certification is an added advantage.

Process all guest check-ins, check-outs, room assignments, and room change/late check-out requests.

Advise guest of messages.
Clear departures in computer system.

File guest paperwork or documentation.
Operate telephone switchboard station.
Run and check daily reports, contingency lists, and credit card authorization reports.
Supply guests with directions and information.

Arrange transportation for guests/visitors.
Count and secure bank at beginning and end of shift.
Cash-guests checks, process all payment types, vouchers, paid-outs, charges, and provide change.
Notify Loss Prevention/Security of any reports of theft.
Follow company policies and procedures; report accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets.
Welcome and acknowledge guests according to company standards; anticipate and address guests service needs; assist individuals with disabilities; thank guests with genuine appreciation.
Speak using clear and professional language; answer telephones using appropriate etiquette.
Develop and maintain positive working relationships; support team to reach common goals; listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of employees.
Comply with quality assurance standards.
Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time.
Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 10 pounds without assistance.
Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.

Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.

Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None

Job Title: Python Developer (Django)
Job Summary
We are looking for a skilled Python Developer with strong experience in Django to build, deploy, and maintain scalable web applications. The ideal candidate should have solid backend development skills, experience designing RESTful APIs, and hands-on expertise in cloud-based architectures using AWS.
Key Responsibilities
Develop and maintain web applications using Python and Django framework
Design and build RESTful APIs for integration with frontend and third-party services
Deploy, manage, and scale applications on AWS cloud infrastructure
Work with AWS services such as EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, API Gateway, CloudWatch
Develop secure, scalable, and high-performance applications
Optimize database queries and ensure efficient data management
Collaborate with front-end developers, DevOps teams, and stakeholders
Implement authentication, authorization, and data protection mechanisms
Write clean, reusable, and testable code
Troubleshoot and resolve application issues
Participate in code reviews and improve development standards

Operations Manager Hotel & Hospitality Operations
Company: PRISM
Location: Bangalore & Thrissur
Experience: Minimum 5 years
Industry: Hotel & Hospitality Operations

About the Role
PRISM is looking for an experienced and results-driven Operations Manager to oversee hotel and hospitality operations in Bangalore. The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience managing hotel operations, leading teams, maintaining service standards, and driving operational efficiency.

Key Responsibilities
Manage day-to-day hotel and hospitality operations, ensuring smooth and efficient functioning.
Oversee operations across a minimum portfolio/key of 50 rooms (keys).
Lead and manage operational teams across departments to achieve business and service objectives.
Ensure high standards of guest experience, service quality, hygiene, and operational excellence.
Monitor occupancy, revenue, costs, guest satisfaction, and other key operational metrics.
Coordinate with housekeeping, front office, maintenance, F&B, and other operational functions.
Develop and implement SOPs and ensure compliance with company and hospitality standards.
Handle guest escalations and ensure timely resolution of operational issues.
Drive team productivity, training, performance management, and employee engagement.
Identify opportunities to improve processes, reduce operational costs, and enhance profitability.
Ensure compliance with safety, statutory, and company policies.
Candidate Profile

Minimum 5 years of experience in hotel/hospitality operations.
Strong hands-on experience in hotel and hospitality operations.
Experience managing a property/portfolio of 50+ keys is preferred/required.
Strong team-management and leadership skills.
Excellent communication, interpersonal, and problem-solving abilities.
Strong understanding of hotel operations, guest experience, and operational KPIs.
Candidates with experience managing multi-department hotel operations will be preferred.
Must be willing to work from/operate in Bangalore.

INNOV8 | Area Sales Manager Job
Description
About INNOV8
INNOV8 is one of Indias leading coworking and managed office space brands, creating
beautifully designed, premium workspaces that enable people and companies to work,
collaborate, and grow together. With a growing presence across major Indian cities, INNOV8
serves a diverse ecosystem of entrepreneurs, freelancers, startups, and enterprises by offering
flexible workspace solutions tailored to different stages of growth.
Position: Area Sales Manager INNOV8
Reports To: City Head
Employment Type: Full-time
Role Overview
The Area Sales Manager will be responsible for driving revenue growth, occupancy, and
market penetration for INNOV8 centers in the assigned region. The role combines new
business acquisition, account management, and channel development, with a strong focus on
building long-term client and broker relationships.
You will work closely with center teams, marketing, and leadership to ensure sustained seat
sales, timely collections, and best-in-class client experience.
Key Responsibilities
1. Business Development & Growth
• Develop and implement a growth strategy for the region focused on financial gain,
occupancy improvement, and customer satisfaction.
• Identify, build, and expand new markets across relevant customer segments (startups,
SMEs, enterprises, freelancers).



• Generate a strong pipeline of prospects through cold outreach, referrals, ecosystem
connects, and channel partners.
2. Sales, Revenue & Collections
• Achieve monthly and quarterly seat sales and revenue targets for assigned centers.
• Prepare and present formal proposals, quotes, and commercial offers to prospects.
• Negotiate and close deals with key decision-makers, ensuring mutually beneficial
terms.
• Drive monthly collections based on invoices raised; ensure minimal delays and
revenue leakage.
3. Client Relationship Management & Retention
• Build long-term relationships with new and existing customers to drive repeat and
expansion business.
• Regularly engage with clients to understand their evolving needs and identify
upsell/cross-sell opportunities.
• Focus on renewal, expansion, and churn control for key accounts in the region.
• Ensure timely resolution of client complaints within defined TAT and proactively
address service gaps.
4. Channel & Lead Generation Strategy
• Devise and execute strategies for lead generation through:
o Brokers, channel partners, and IPCs
o Online and direct channels
o Startup and ecosystem collaborations
o Partnerships and alliances in the region
• Build and nurture a strong broker and partner network to ensure steady inflow of
qualified leads.
5. Reporting, Tracking & Governance
• Keep accurate records of sales, revenue, pipeline, collections, and key account
activity.
• Maintain updated data and reports on CRM/trackers as per organizational standards.
• Share regular updates and insights on market trends, competition, and customer
feedback with leadership.
Qualifications & Experience
• Proven experience in sales, preferably in coworking, commercial real estate, flex
spaces, or related sectors.



• Strong communication, negotiation, and deal-closing skills with comfort in handling
CXO/decision-maker conversations.
• Good connections and working relationships with brokers, IPCs, property consultants,
or relevant ecosystem partners.
• Experience in community building, events, or client engagement will be an added
advantage.
•
Bachelors degree in any field is preferred; MBA or equivalent in Sales/Marketing is
a plus.
Key Skills & Competencies
• Strong sales ownership and target orientation
• Relationship-building and stakeholder management
• Market understanding of coworking / office space / real estate ecosystem
• Analytical approach to revenue, pricing, and occupancy
• High level of responsiveness, follow-through, and execution discipline
• Ability to work in a fast-paced, growth-focused environment

Role & responsibilities
Location: Vizhinjam Port, Kerala
Department: Corporate Affairs
Role Purpose
To manage corporate affairs activities, maintain effective relationships with government authorities and regulatory bodies, and ensure timely approvals, compliance, and smooth external stakeholder coordination for operations at Vizhinjam Port.
Key Responsibilities
Government & Regulatory Liaison
Build and maintain strong relationships with central, state, and local government authorities
Coordinate with port authorities, ministries, and regulatory bodies for approvals, licenses, and clearances
Compliance & Approvals
Ensure compliance with all statutory, regulatory, and corporate governance requirements
Track and facilitate timely renewal of permits, licenses, and approvals
Stakeholder Management
Act as a single point of contact for external stakeholders including government officials and local authorities
Support in resolving issues related to land, operations, and regulatory matters
Policy & Advocacy
Monitor changes in policies, regulations, and government notifications impacting port operations
Provide inputs and recommendations to management on regulatory matters
Documentation & Reporting
Maintain records of approvals, licenses, and correspondence with authorities
Prepare MIS reports and status updates for leadership
Crisis & Issue Management
Support in handling regulatory issues, audits, and government inspections
Ensure smooth coordination during sensitive or critical situations

Malayalam Speaker - Expert

Undertakes installation of advertising and publicity materials for brand visibility

Thanks & Regards,
