Description:
Job Description
Overview
We are seeking an experienced Senior Offshore Structural Wind Engineer to join our Offshore Engineering Team based in the Bangalore Global Technical Centre (GTCI). This individual will play a key role in the technical delivery of complex offshore engineering work packages, especially related to offshore Substation (OSS) & offshore Wind turbine generators (WTGs). The Individual shall have hands on experience in Concept & Feasibility, FEED & Detail engineering Phase. Fabrication Construction and Installation engineering experience will be an added advantage.
The successful candidate will bring a strong structural/marine background, particularly in the design and analysis of floating and fixed marine/offshore structures. You will contribute directly to structural integrity assessments, hydrodynamic modelling, marine operations planning, and system integration - ensuring that designs meet international standards while remaining cost-effective and constructable.
This position offers the opportunity to work at the intersection of structural engineering, and offshore renewable energy, providing leadership in multi-disciplinary teams and contributing to AtkinsR alis continued growth in the offshore sector.
Your Role
Roles & Responsibilities
Lead and manage technical aspects of offshore engineering projects, with a strong focus on wind turbine generator, offshore substation platforms with substructure, superstructure and miscellaneous offshore structures design.
Having knowledge of foundation, soil parameter interpretation, casing pile design, mud-mat design, suction pile design.
Develop efficient and innovative design methodologies for WTG foundation design considering Monopile, Tripod, 4-legged foundation configurations.
Perform detail structural analysis and design report for offshore substation jacket and topsides includes (ULS, SLS, FLS, ALS) and structural analyses of floating platforms, monopiles, jackets, FPSOs, a using advanced tools such as SESAM Genie, DNV Bladed, SACS and ANSYS.
Shall have experience in Preservice analysis like lift, loadout, offshore transportation, on bottom stability, ship/boat impact, Crane fatigue design, helideck design. Individual shall have experience in miscellaneous design calculations like pad eye design, trunnion design, drop object analysis along with calculations
Ensure compliance with relevant international codes and standards (DNV, API, ISO, AISC, NORSOK, EURO) from a structural perspective.
Develop efficient and innovative design methodologies for offshore substation considering Monopile and jacket structures.
Prepare detailed technical reports, calculations, drawings, and specifications, with a strong emphasis on engineering rigor and verification.
Coordinate with cross-functional teams including mechanical, electrical, piping and geotechnical engineers to ensure integrated system performance.
Mentor junior structural engineers and support knowledge transfer within the team.
Engage directly with international clients and stakeholders through clear and confident communication.
Travel to site locations or partner offices for short-term assignments as required.
About You
Qualifications & Skills
Bachelor s degree in Structural engineering, marine Engineering, or Offshore Structural Engineering - must.
Master s Degree or PhD in Ocean Engineering, Offshore Structures, or a related discipline with significant professional experience in marine or offshore structural design within a consultancy or EPCI contractor environment.
Experience:
Minimum 10-20 years of relevant offshore engineering design experience with a strong offshore substation component.
Strong background in oil & gas structures, including fixed platforms, jackets, and FPSOs, with demonstrated application.
Proven track record in offshore projects, experience in WTGs foundation, offshore substation foundation & topside support structure design for fixed applications.
Demonstrated ability to lead medium to large-scale projects independently.
Experience across multiple phases of projects - FEED, Detailed Design, Procurement, and Construction Support.
Technical Skills:
Proficiency in structural and finite element analysis software:
Mandatory: SESAM Genie, SACS, Mathcad, MS Excel
Desirable: USFOS, Ansys
Strong understanding of offshore wave and wind calculation, dynamic analysis using relevant tools.
Knowledge of programming/scripting languages (e.g., Python, VBA) is advantageous for automation and data processing.
In-depth understanding of structural and ocean engineering fundamentals, including fatigue, stability, buckling, and dynamic loading.
Expertise in international standards and codes such as API, DNV, ISO, AISC, EURO and NORSOK.
Soft Skills:
Excellent interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills.
Confident communicator with the ability to liaise effectively with international clients and multi-disciplinary teams.
Strong project management and commercial acumen, including negotiation, budgeting, and planning.
Proven leadership and mentoring abilities with a collaborative mindset.
Ability to work in a fast-paced, multicultural environment.
Willingness to travel overseas when required.
Rewards & Benefits
Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive - at every stage of your life and your career.
This includes:
Comprehensive life insurance coverage.
Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.
Generous annual leave balance.
Flexible and hybrid work solutions.
Remote work opportunities outside of country.
Company gratuity scheme.
Discretionary bonus program.
Relocation assistance.
Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.
Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.

Description:
The Relationship Manager - CAT - Elite at Axis Max Life Insurance will be responsible for managing and enhancing relationships with high net worth clients. The role involves understanding clients financial goals and needs, providing tailored insurance solutions, and ensuring exceptional service delivery. The Relationship Manager will be expected to conduct regular client meetings, prepare financial plans, and present suitable insurance products. Additionally, the manager will work closely with the sales team to drive revenue growth and achieve business targets.

Key Responsibilities:
- Build and maintain strong relationships with high-value clients.
- Provide expert advice on insurance products and services based on clients financial objectives.
- Conduct market research to identify potential clients and business opportunities.
- Develop personalized financial plans and presentations for clients.
- Collaborate with internal teams to ensure the seamless processing of client requests and claims.
- Monitor client satisfaction and address any concerns promptly.
- Achieve sales targets and contribute to the overall growth of the business.

Skills Required:
- Strong interpersonal and communication skills.
- Proven ability to build and maintain client relationships.
- Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities.
- Knowledge of financial products, insurance, and investment options.
- Ability to work independently as well as part of a team.
- Strong sales and negotiation skills.
- Professional demeanor with a client-centric approach.

Tools Required:
- Customer Relationship Management (CRM) software.
- Financial planning tools and software.
- Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
- Data analytics tools for market research.
- Presentation software for client meetings.

Description:
Job description
Role & responsibilities
Operations Management: Manage day-to-day operations pertaining to loading, sorting, scanning, inbound shipments, and outbound or last-mile delivery procedures.
Team Supervision: Oversee, guide, and mentor delivery workers, field agents, or employees.
SLA & Target Adherence: Make sure that shipments follow strict service level agreements (SLAs) and turnaround times (TAT).
Manage shift scheduling, keep an eye on attendance, and assign duties as part of manpower planning.
Performance tracking: Use internal tools to monitor daily productivity, delivery success rates, and reporting metrics.
Escalation Handling: Deal with customer delivery issues, operational impediments, and local stakeholders.
Compliance & Safety: Put standard operating procedures (SOPs) and company safety policies into practice.

Preferred candidate profile
Graduate in any discipline.
1-3 years of experience in logistics, courier, or e-commerce operations.
Experience in handling executives or warehouse teams is preferred.
Strong leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills.
Proficient in MS Excel and basic operational reporting.
Willing to work in rotational shifts.
AboutCompany:
Delhivery is India's largest fully integrated logistics services provider.
With its nationwide network covering over 18,400 pin codes, the company provides a full suite of logistics services such as express parcel transportation, PTL freight, TL freight, cross-border, supply chain, and technology services.
Delhivery has successfully fullled over 1.7 billion shipments since inception and today works with over 28,000 customers, including large & small e-commerce participants, SMEs, and other enterprises & brands.
For more information about Delhivery, please visit www.delhivery.com.
Vision - Our vision is to become the operating system for commerce in India, through a combination of world-class infrastructure, high-quality logistics operations, cutting-edge engineering, and technology capabilities.
Team- Delhivery was founded in 2011 by Sahil Barua, Mohit Tandon, Bhavesh Manglani, Suraj Saharan, and Kapil Bharati and is now 56,000+ people strong.
CompanyAddress: PLOT NO. 5 SECTOR 44 GURGAON , GURGAON, Haryana, India

Description:
Purpose/Objective


The Financial Controller will be responsible for overseeing all finance and accounting functions for the Ports Business, including budgeting, financial planning & analysis, management information systems (MIS), accounting, treasury management, working capital management, receivables management, statutory compliance, audits, and financial reporting.
The role is critical in driving business growth through strong financial governance, effective controls, compliance management, and strategic decision support.
Key Responsibilities of Role


- Lead the preparation, consolidation, review, and finalization of annual OPEX and CAPEX budgets and ensure timely approvals.
- Monitor and analyze monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue, cost, and profitability performance and recommend corrective actions.
- Provide financial evaluation and decision support for capital expenditure proposals and investment decisions.
- Ensure timely preparation and circulation of monthly MIS reports and coordinate performance reviews.
- Oversee the preparation, analysis, and review of financial statements in accordance with applicable accounting standards.
- Analyze expenses, receivables, and working capital trends and drive operational efficiency.
- Manage cash flows, liquidity positions, and short-term investment decisions.
- Strengthen internal financial controls and ensure closure of audit observations.
- Ensure completion of statutory audits within defined timelines.
- Ensure compliance with GST, EPCG obligations, and all applicable statutory requirements.
- Lead, coach, and develop the finance team.
- Drive adoption of modern finance systems, technologies, and best practices.
Technical Competencies


Accounting,Budgeting/MIS,Fund / Treasury Management,IFRS/GAAP,Taxation/Audits
Qualifications and Experience


- Chartered Accountant (CA) - Minimum 10+ years of experience in Finance & Accounts.
- Experience handling end-to-end finance operations in a large organization or infrastructure / port setup.
- Strong exposure to balance sheet finalization, statutory audits, and regulatory compliances.

Description:
What you ll do:
Manage the research, design, and development of critical components for Medium Voltage (MV) Switchgear. Drive innovation, compliance, and industrialization to strengthen the competitiveness of MV Switchgear portfolio.
"-Supervise VCB, RMU, AIS and GIS design activities for MV Switchgear
-Define and approve type and prototype test plans covering MV Switchgear components
-Coordinate type testing with accredited labs (KEMA, CESI, GCC Lab) and oversee in-house prototype validation.
-Lead root cause analysis of failures and ensure effective corrective measures across both product families.
-Guarantee compliance with IEC / 100 / 102 / 103 / 200 standards as well as customer-specific and utility requirements.
-Maintain technical documentation supporting certifications, approvals, and type testing for both MV Switchgear projects.
-Utilize DFMEA and reliability engineering methods to strengthen robustness and long-term quality of Switchgear components.
-Coordinate with manufacturing, supply chain, electrical, and quality teams to ensure industrialization of components for both MV Switchgear.
-Collaborate with suppliers and RD institutions to localize and qualify components, reducing costs and lead times across both product lines.
-Able to anticipate problems and make the necessary proactive steps to prevent them
-Ability to take necessary and proper timely decisions.
-Deliver the required results in timely manner with required quality and cost.
-Must make a tangible difference to his area of operation. and exceed business expectations."

Description:
Job DESCRIPTION
Job Title
Assistant-PIU (Academic Support Fellow)
Grade
I
Department
Programme Operations
Reporting to
Assistant Manager/Manager-PIU
Location
Kakrala, Noida (PIU North)
Contract duration
Till 31 st March 2027

About Bal Raksha Bharat
Bal Raksha Bharat (also known as Save the Children) is Indias leading independent child rights organisation. It is a member of Save the Children movement that operates globally with the mission to inspire breakthroughs in the way the world treats children and achieve immediate and lasting changes in their lives. We are working towards three breakthroughs in how the world treats children by 2030:
No child dies from preventable causes before their fifth birthday
All children learn from a quality basic education and
Violence against children is no longer tolerated
We run programmes in the remotest corners of India and urban areas in the areas of Health & Nutrition, Education, Child Protection and Livelihood & Economic Wellbeing in order to facilitate quality education, healthcare and protection from harm and abuse and life-saving aid during emergencies to children.
ROLE PURPOSE
The Academic Support Fellow will look after the operations of the Multi Activity Centre (MAC) including supporting children in the academic classes conducted at MAC to improve their learning level, devise teaching learning materials for interacting teaching at MAC, help in the proper usage of resource material given at MAC. S/he will also be responsible to maintain cordial relationship with other stakeholders such as School principal, teachers, Ward Counsellor. Also acts as Bal Raksha Bharat s representative in the area to a broad range of external stakeholders including relevant government departments on issues related to strengthening child protection mechanism in the community. Work under strong thematic supervision of the Assistant Manager/Manager in order to maintain a consistent and coherent education strategy. S/he would be responsible for leading the project and its deliverable in the project geography and ensure that the envisioned outcomes and milestones of the project are accomplished with quality programming.
SCOPE OF ROLE
Scope: The person will be responsible for conducting academic classes with children and overall operation of the Multi Activity Centre (MAC)
Reports to: Assistant Manager/Manager-PIU
Staff reporting to this post: No
Budget Responsibilities: No
Role Dimensions:
Context: Development
KEY AREAS OF ACCOUNTABILITY
The key area of accountability required will be as follows:
- Based on the objectives set forth under the project, be accountable to plan and supervise the implementation of the deliverables of the project in lines to the larger vision, mission, commitments and strategy of the organization
- Identification of children to be enrolled at MAC (6-14 years)
- Identification of space for setting up MAC in the intervention area
- Prepare child profile and child tracking sheet for children enrolled at MAC and to develop time table and devise new teaching learning materials them
- Conduct academic classes with MAC enrolled children
- Maintain all the relevant MAC related documents
- Conduct monthly parent teacher meeting (parent-ASF meeting) and discuss the progress of the child with the parents/caregivers, Monitor retention of children in school after enrolment in schools
- Facilitate in creating a better learning environment promoting inclusion and learning of children in government school
- Identify local level partners, support and facilitate the partnership in the implementation of planned activities.
- Support the collection and documentation of impact and success stories on monthly, quarterly and annually.
- Build the capacity of children, families and community to collectively engage local leaders on identified issues.
- S/he would document periodic progress, case studies of best practices etc of her assigned area and share with the Manager/Assistant Manager.
- Develop and diligently track the project key documents such as milestones, detailed implementation plan, MIS, procurement plan, stakeholder engagement plan, project budget etc. & undertake periodic reviews of the same as well as continuously strive to achieve the project outcomes as set forth in the project
- Submit work plan on a weekly/monthly basis to the line manager.
- Ensure timely, accurate, and effective donor reporting (viz. donor reports, information requests, activity status updates, queries, field visits, donor engagement calendar etc.) and attend donor interface meetings if required.
- Oversee donor/s visits and manage interns, other visits as and when required
- Any other task assigned by line manager.
BEHAVIOURS (Values in Practice)
Accountability S/he should be accountable towards evaluating his/her performance or behavior related to work/community/children/society for which s/he is responsible. The term is related to responsibility but is regarded more from the perspective of oversight
Ambition S/he should be desire to achieve a particular goal as well aspiration in respect of project
Collaboration S/he should work in collaborative method with respective stakeholders (direct or indirect) and will make something together. To collaborate is to commit to the possibility of producing an outcome greater than one that would be developed in a silo.
Creativity: She should have the urge in solving problems and communicating with others,
Integrity is the quality of being honest and having strong moral principles. S/he must be truthful and honest with him/herself and others, should align own personal behavior and his/her action will be aligned with own values, principles and ethics. S/he would have self-awareness and have really explore value system.
QUALIFICATIONS
Graduate/Post Graduate in Social Science /Teaching//any discipline from a recognized university or college. Weightage will be given to female candidates with B.Ed./B. El. Ed./JBT qualification with teaching experience.
EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS
Minimum 1-3 years experience in working with NGO/School/Communities and children and community people. Freshers with good academic records can also apply.
KEY COMPETENCIES
Technical competencies
Proficiency with communication skills
Networking and influencing skills
Organizational skills and time management skills
Efficient to deliver project activities with quality
Generic Competencies
Being the Voice of Children: Utilizes being part of a global movement to promote change in the policy and public sphere on child related issues
Advancing Equality & Inclusion: Drives an enabling environment for gender equality and inclusion, and prioritizing the most deprived and marginalized children
Builds & Strengthens Partnerships: Inspires others to embrace the values and principles that underpin partnerships and the localization agenda
Child Rights: Promotes the rights of children in own work and in work with colleagues and peers
Additional job responsibilities
The duties and responsibilities as set out above are not exhaustive and the role holder may be required to carry out additional duties within reasonableness of their level of skills and experience.
CHILD SAFEGUARDING (Strike out whichever is not applicable)
Level 1: The role holder will not have contact with children and/or young people, or access to personal data about children or young people, as part of their work; therefore a police check will not be mandatory unless the content or location of the role changes, in which case the Child Safeguarding level will be reviewed.
Level 2: Either the role holder will have access to personal data about children and/or young people as part of their work; or they will be working in a regulated position (Finance, Monitoring & Evaluation, Legal etc.); therefore a police check will be required.
Level 3: The role holder will have contact with children and/or young people either frequently (e.g. once a week or more) or intensively (e.g. four days in one month or more or overnight) because they work in programs; or are visiting programs; therefore a police check will be required.
Child Safeguarding
We need to keep children safe so our selection process, which includes rigorous background checks, reflects our commitment to the protection of children from abuse.
Safeguarding our Staff
The post holder is required to carry out the duties in accordance with the BRB s anti-harassment policy.
Equal Opportunities
Bal Raksha Bharat aims to be an equal opportunity employer. We welcome all applications irrespective of age, race, colour, gender, disability, sexual orientation, religion, belief or creed. Women candidates are encouraged to apply.

Description:
JOB DESCRIPTION & CANDIDATE PROFILE --- PROJECT ARCHITECT/ JUNIOR ARCHITECT Positions --- 1 to 3 Years Experience

Location: Pondicherry / Puducherry | Engagement: Full-time

Hiring intent: Experienced candidates only. Fresh graduates / zero-experience candidates are not the target profile for this requirement. About company:

About RADICAL ARHITECTURE:

Radical Architecture is a small, couple-led (Architect. Manivel Rajan CA/2209/45519 & Architect. Janani Manivel - CA/2010/50503) architecture and interior design studio based in Pondicherry , operating from a home-based studio. We work across residential, villa, commercial and institutional projects, with direct involvement from design through execution.

We are currently looking for Junior Architects with 1 to 3 years of professional experience to join our couple studio and work closely with our projects. If you are looking for hands-on exposure, direct project involvement and a small studio environment with 20+ years experienced Principal-Architects' mentorship, Radical Architecture could be a good fit.

JOB LOCATION: AT PONDICHERRY (NOT BANGALORE/ NOT CHENNAI/ NOT HYDERABAD). JOB IS AT RADICAL ARCHITECTURE, PONDICHERRY STUDIO

JOB DESCRIPTION & CANDIDATE PROFILE - Architecture Positions 1 to 3 Years Experience

1. POSITIONS & EXPERIENCE BAND:

Education Degree Requirement - B. Arch [Bachelors of Architecture]

Junior Architect - 1 to 2 years - Strong production ability; accurate drawings with limited supervision. SALARY - 20000 to 24000/ Month

Project Architect - 2 to 3 years - Ownership of project packages, coordination and delivery. Interior working drawings, detailing, materials, joinery and site coordination. SALARY - 24000 to 28000/ Month

2. PREVIOUS FIRM EXPERIENCE
Preferred: 1 to 3 years of professional experience in an architecture, architecture-interiors or design-build studio.
Experience should demonstrate actual project production, not only academic work, rendering or presentation work.
Residential architecture, villas, bungalows, interiors, institutional projects and small-to-medium scale work are particularly relevant.
Candidate should be able to identify drawings or project packages personally produced or substantially developed.
Small/medium practice experience is an advantage because the role requires versatility and direct responsibility.

3. CORE TECHNICAL & SOFTWARE REQUIREMENTS
AutoCAD mandatory: plans, sections, elevations, working drawings, annotation, dimensions, layers and sheet organisation.
SketchUp mandatory: competent architectural modelling and model development.
Enscape / D5 / Lumion mandatory: usable architectural visualisation and presentation views.
Photoshop mandatory: presentation boards, image editing and post-production.
Illustrator / InDesign advantageous.
Revit / Rhino / 3ds Max advantageous only where genuinely demonstrable.
Software knowledge claims must be validated through appropriate portfolios.
4. ARCHITECTURAL HAND SKILLS
Read and understand plans, sections, elevations and details.
Identify missing information, dimensional conflicts, inconsistencies and drawing errors before submission.
Develop a drawing from a brief rather than mechanically reproduce a reference.
Basic freehand sketching / diagramming for design and site communication.
Convert verbal instructions into a clear drawing workflow.
Understand materials, construction logic, basic building components and practical detailing.
Maintain drawing standards, file naming, revisions and issue discipline.
5. PROJECT ARCHITECT / HIGHER-END RESPONSIBILITIES
Independent ownership of assigned projects or packages from brief through drawing development.
Plan work against deadlines and communicate risks before deadlines are missed.
Coordinate structural, MEP and specialist consultant inputs.
Attend and understand site coordination and basic buildability.
Review own work before submitting it to the Principal Architect.
Handle multiple projects/workstreams without losing priorities.
Make reasonable decisions independently and escalate matters genuinely requiring Principal-level direction.
6. SOFT SKILLS & PROFESSIONAL ATTITUDE
Ownership: responsibility for the result, not merely the task.
Deadline discipline: prioritise and communicate early when a deadline is at risk.
Comprehension: understand the purpose behind instructions.
Problem-solving: attempt a reasoned solution before asking for the answer.
Feedback maturity: accept corrections and convert feedback into improved future output.
Learning attitude: actively develop technical and architectural competence.
Communication: clear and professional with principals, consultants, vendors and site teams.
Reliability: consistent attendance, punctuality and predictable delivery.
7. SITE READINESS & PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS
Attend sites when project requirements demand it.
Work safely in unfinished buildings and normal site conditions using appropriate precautions.
Travel locally or interstate for meetings, measurements and site coordination when required.
Maintain professional conduct and safety awareness at construction sites.
8. PONDICHERRY-BASED CANDIDATES
Reliable daily commuting and punctual attendance.
Ability to remain available for site visits and project coordination within Pondicherry and nearby locations.
Understand that the role is a professional studio position, not simply a convenient hometown employment option.
Willingness to work in a small, direct-reporting practice where responsibility is visible and individual output matters.
Ready to work across drawing production, coordination, site-related tasks and project support.
9. CANDIDATES FROM OTHER CITIES / STATES
Must demonstrate genuine and practical willingness to relocate to Pondicherry / Puducherry for an office-based role.
Relocation, accommodation and commuting arrangements should be independently planned before joining.
Should not treat Pondicherry merely as a temporary stop while waiting for a preferred-city opportunity.
Must maintain reliable attendance and participate in site work and project coordination.
Candidates from Chennai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Coimbatore, Madurai, Trichy and other cities will be considered where their skill profile is materially stronger.

10. IDEAL RADICAL ARCHITECTURE CANDIDATE

We are looking for an architect who can think, draw, coordinate and take ownership. The ideal candidate is not expected to know everything at 1 to 3 years of experience, but should demonstrate a strong learning curve, technical discipline, architectural curiosity, accountability and the ability to convert instructions into accurate deliverables. For a small studio, individual contribution is highly visible; reliability and ownership are as important as software proficiency.

From its humble beginnings as a small toy balloon unit, the company has grown into a global leader in the tyre industry, with products exported to over 90 countries worldwide. Over the decades, MRF has built a strong presence across India with multiple manufacturing facilities and an extensive dealer network, while steadily expanding its footprint in international markets. The company’s registered office is located at 114, Greams Road, Chennai – 600006, and it operates under the name MRF Limited. Innovation is central to MRF’s success, with a dedicated Research and Design division that serves as a pioneering technology hub, focusing on safety, performance, and advanced tyre design. This emphasis on R&D has enabled the company to consistently deliver high-quality products that meet the diverse demands of passenger vehicles, two-wheelers, commercial trucks, farm machinery, and off-the-road applications. With a strong reputation for reliability, global reach, and technological leadership, MRF continues to stand as a symbol of Indian manufacturing excellence in the international tyre market.

MRF Tyres (Madras Rubber Factory) is India’s largest tyre manufacturer, established in 1946 and headquartered in Chennai. From its humble beginnings as a small toy balloon unit, the company has grown into a global leader in the tyre industry, with products exported to over 90 countries worldwide. Over the decades, MRF has built a strong presence across India with multiple manufacturing facilities and an extensive dealer network, while steadily expanding its footprint in international markets. Innovation is central to MRF’s success, with a dedicated Research and Design division that serves as a pioneering technology hub, focusing on safety, performance, and advanced tyre design. This emphasis on R&D has enabled the company to consistently deliver high-quality products that meet the diverse demands of passenger vehicles, two-wheelers, commercial trucks, farm machinery, and off-the-road applications. With a strong reputation for reliability, global reach, and technological leadership, MRF continues to stand as a symbol of Indian manufacturing excellence in the international tyre market.

Description:
Collections Manager
Job Summary
The Collections Manager is responsible for overseeing the organization's debt collection process, ensuring timely recovery of outstanding payments while maintaining positive customer relationships. This role involves managing the collections team, developing collection strategies, monitoring performance, reducing delinquency rates, and ensuring compliance with company policies and applicable regulations.
Key Responsibilities
Manage and lead the collections team to achieve monthly and annual recovery targets.
Develop and implement effective collection strategies and policies.
Monitor overdue accounts and prioritize collection activities.
Review aging reports and analyze collection performance.
Negotiate payment plans and settlements with customers when appropriate.
Ensure compliance with legal, regulatory, and company collection policies.
Handle escalated customer disputes related to outstanding payments.
Prepare and present collection reports and key performance metrics to management.
Coordinate with Finance, Sales, and Customer Service teams to resolve billing issues.
Train, mentor, and evaluate collection staff to improve productivity and customer service.
Identify opportunities to improve collection processes and reduce bad debt.
Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
37 years of experience in collections, credit management, or accounts receivable, including supervisory experience.
Strong knowledge of collection practices, financial regulations, and credit policies.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and ERP/CRM systems.
Excellent negotiation, communication, and leadership skills.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Preferred Skills
Team leadership and people management.
Financial analysis and reporting.
Negotiation and conflict resolution.
Time management and organizational skills.
Attention to detail and accuracy.
Decision-making under pressure.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Collection rate and recovery percentage.
Days Sales Outstanding (DSO).
Delinquency and bad debt reduction.
Team productivity and target achievement.
Customer dispute resolution time.
Compliance with collection policies and regulations.

The Group serves over 2.5 lakh customers every single day through its network of branches. Till date, the Group has served over 70 crore customers, including repeat customers. WE ARE HIRING
CIVIL SITE ENGINEER PWD / GOVERNMENT PROJECTS
K. Arunagiri & Sons Construction | Puducherry
K. Arunagiri & Sons Construction is a Puducherry-based civil contracting firm undertaking PWD and Government construction projects. We are looking for a responsible and technically capable Civil Site Engineer to manage site execution, measurements, billing and project documentation.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Supervise and execute day-to-day civil construction works at site.
Read and understand structural/architectural drawings, BOQ and specifications.
Coordinate with PWD officials, consultants, subcontractors, supervisors and labour.
Take accurate site measurements and maintain Measurement Book (MB) / measurement records.
Prepare RA Bills, final bills, quantity statements and abstracts.
Calculate quantities from drawings and actual site measurements.
Check BOQ quantities and identify deviations, excess quantities and extra items.
Prepare and verify subcontractor bills based on actual measurements.
Maintain DPR, site records, photographs, material records and work progress reports.
Monitor quality, materials, manpower and progress of works.
Assist in rate analysis, estimation and quantity surveying.
Coordinate material testing, concrete cube tests and other quality documentation.
Ensure works are executed as per PWD specifications, approved drawings and required quality standards.
REQUIRED SKILLS
Must have practical knowledge of:
Civil Site Execution
Measurement & Quantity Calculation
RA Bill Preparation
Measurement Book (MB)
BOQ & Quantity Surveying
PWD/Government Contract Procedures
AutoCAD
MS Excel
Basic Estimation & Rate Analysis
Reading Civil/Structural Drawings
QUALIFICATION & EXPERIENCE
Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech Civil Engineering
Experience: 2–5 years preferred.
Experience in Government projects or civil contracting companies will be an added advantage.
IDEAL CANDIDATE
We are looking for an engineer who can independently handle:
DRAWING EXECUTION MEASUREMENT QUANTITY MB RA BILL BILLING DOCUMENTATION
The candidate should be responsible, detail-oriented, good at measurements and comfortable coordinating with site teams and Government/PWD officials.
SALARY

Based on experience and technical capability.

Email / WhatsApp: senthilkaconstruction@gmail.com

Background:
Bal Raksha Bharat (also known as Save the Children) is India s leading independent child rights organisation, which works in 16 states of the country. Beginning its journey in 2008 in India, and registered as Bal Raksha Bharat , we have changed the lives of more than 12.4 million (1.2 crore) children till March 2022. We firmly believe that every child deserves the best chance for a bright future, which is why, we are fiercely committed to ensuring that children not only survive but thrive. With a bold ambition and a powerful vigilance, we do whatever it takes to save the children. In India and across the world, Save the Children works on-ground every day and especially, in times of crisis. Our pioneering programs address children s unique needs; giving them a healthy start, an opportunity to learn as well as protection from harm. When crisis strikes, we are always among the first to respond and the last to leave. We are the outspoken champions for children, ensuring that their voices are heard and their issues are given top
priority. Drawing on a century of leading expertise, we take on the toughest challenges, facing the hardest-to-reach children especially those unfairly excluded from the world s progress.
Function:
Programme & Policy covers Programme Implementation (with partners or direct implementation), Thematic Expertise (technical knowledge in areas of specialization), and Policy & Programme Impact (advocacy, research, monitoring & evaluation, and quality). The function links grass-roots work with policy changes at the highest level, and manages an ecosystem of partnerships including, but not limited to, community organizations, donors, peer organizations, academic institutions, media, and the state.
Role Purpose:
S/he will implement various interventions mentioned in the project. The key responsibility of the role would be to implement project activities in the target families, slums, AWC and schools.
Also, this role required 6 days working in the field (only second and forth Saturday will be off)
Role & responsibilities (

Description:
Change the world. Love your job.
Texas Instruments (TI) is out front and ready for the next big challenge. Our innovations are at the core of nearly every electronics product in use today. And it doesnt stop there. Were developing breakthrough technology to power the worlds future innovations as well. TI is committed to building a better future from the responsible manufacturing of our semiconductors, to caring for our employees, to giving back inside our communities. Put your talent to work with us.

Application specific MCU industrial (ASM-IND) product line offers a broad range of high performance, innovative and cost-effective specialized MCUs for a wide range of applications across Motor control and Digital power. We enable powering next generation AI datacenters, provide motor control solutions for Humanoids, robotics, etc., build AI solutions for predictive diagnostics, improve performance, control and optimize energy efficiency.
We are looking for an application engineer who has the passion and excitement to continuously learn, innovate, take an active role in solving real time control. It is a fast paced, results driven environment requiring Microcontroller knowledge, system level understanding, software development, Motor control algorithms and system hardware skillsets. You will collaborate with worldwide accounts to solve their system challenges, enable them to go to market faster, work with marketing and business leadership to develop strategic technical solutions to enable TI business growth and impact the next generation of products.
Key responsibilities include:
Develop sensored and sensor less motor control algorithms to enable faster response, Smoother speed, less acoustic noise
Own specific IP s write technical reference manual, resolve customer issues through E2E platform and field engagement
Participate in customer calls to understand system requirements and help select the right devices and reference designs
Support customer design-in activities by:
Adapting our system reference solutions to their custom hardware design.
Meet customer across the globe to promote our technical benefits and resolve technical issues / Debug
Schematic and layout review of customer solutions for our device
Help with software porting, optimize software to improve performance.
Resolve production stop issues for customers
Design EVM and internal evaluation boards to support evaluation activities of new products.
Train Field Applications Engineers and customers on ASM Microcontrollers and reference designs
Write application notes and training collateral that explain features, implementation of motor control on ASM Microcontrollers.
Qualifications
Minimum requirements:
Master s degree in Electrical Engineering or related degree
3 years of application/system engineering experience
Motor control algorithm development
Strong knowledge of Microcontrollers
Experience in embedded C software development
Solid hardware and software debugging skills

Preferred qualifications:
PHD in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics, Electrical Drive Systems
Hands-on experience working in motor control algorithm development
Knowledge on Matlab, Simulink and Plexim for simulation and model-based code generation
Digital control system design
Familiarity with field bus communication
Power electronic system design
Knowledge on functional safety, security and artificial intelligence
Ability to review schematics and PCB layout using CAD tools
Demonstrated strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Strong verbal and written communication skills
Ability to work in teams and collaborate effectively with people in different functions
Demonstrated ability to build strong, influential relationships
Strong time management skills that enable on-time project delivery
Self-driven and ability to take initiative and drive for results
Continuous learning mindset
Ability to produce high quality technical documentation
Good communication skillset to interface with customers and Field Applications Engineers

Description:
About the Role:

The Branch Head (BH) is responsible for coordinating and overseeing all branch operations and implementing strategies to increase productivity and performance levels in order to achieve the branchs financial targets. They are responsible for ensuring the smooth functioning of the branch and its compliance with the rules and regulations. They should maintain good relations with the key account holders of the Bank to ensure deepening of accounts and thus generating revenue.

Key Responsibilities

Ensure efficient daily operation of a branch, including lending, product sales and customer service in accordance with the banks objectives
Prepare the plan for the growth of branch business in consultation with the Cluster Head
Implement the plan through the Branch team so as to achieve the top line goals
Establish and strengthen relations with key customers (e.g. top 10%) to generate sustained business.
Review daily/ periodic reports (e.g. overdrawn accounts, temporary overdrafts, cash retention limit, office accounts, etc.) and take proactive action to ensure profitable and ethical business.
Ensure audit related deliverables, both internal and external are met as per the prescribed norms
Ensure compliance with due processes and guidelines
Create a performance oriented environment leading to high employee motivation and productivity
Ensure that all staff are adequately trained on the products of the bank, sales processes and various policies of the bank
Resolve, report any disruptions (e.g. strike or local disturbance) and take appropriate action to ensure that the branch operations are run smoothly.
Liaison with the cluster office and other branch offices to ensure the smooth management of operations and the achievement of overall business goals.
Ensure proper upkeep of branch premises and assets including safety and security
AboutCompany:
At Axis Bank, we go much beyond addressing the financial needs of our customers. We give them reasons to strengthen their trust in us, at every step. This belief has paid us rich dividends, bringing with it steady growth, rapid expansion and an opportunity for you to propel your career further.
Axis Bank is expanding and with expansion comes the opportunity to grow and chart your own career path. So, if you are a self-motivated banking professional, looking for opportunities to redefine your career, you might just be the person we require.

Description:
To know and develop proficiency in handling internal company software platforms, ie. iCABS, SCP and any other systems that may be introduced.
Must have a good knowledge of the branch territory.
To ensure that the Service Companion usage is maximised for all the service deliveries & should be always above 95%
Organisation of schedule and planning of all service (including contracts, jobbing, call outs, etc.) requirements on a daily, weekly and monthly basis for all technicians within the branch
To ensure that all the service companion devices are active and in use. All the devices should be active 100% at any given point of time
Priority-wise planning of all due for Renewals visits, enquiries, call outs and complaints. Pending visits should be negligible (Service backlogs). Emphasis on "On Time planning
Liaise with the Sales and Service team to best accommodate urgent service visit appointments and communicate changes to affected customers timely.
Ensure customer service-related complaints or termination notifications/STOP Services are attended to effectively and promptly.
Manage service documentation and ensure all customer/technician s feedback are followed up with actions
Enter correct (error free) consumption data and TOS in the SCP to ensure command centre account profitability reflects correct data customer wise.
Ensure all service data from dockets, log cards, service orders and other sources is updated accurately into business systems in timely manner
Coordinate with the IT team for new users, device issues etc.
Supports business transition from paper-based to system and digital-based planning, visit documents, whilst upholding documentation integrity. Follow callout process so as to ensure that the complaints are delivered only after raising the ticket
Review service reports with OM, OE and BM and highlight areas of concern critical backlog and weekly trend to manager.
Reviews and provides service compliance updates daily.
Assist & help AOM / OM / Assistant Branch Manager / Branch Manager in monitoring Technician service productivity and efficiency related KPIs
Maintain positive working relationship and effective communication with Sales & Service Colleagues, Supervisor, Technician, Operations staff for any service related issues. Coordinate with Sales for any available slots, time adjustment for new sales scheduling
Work with branch management to correct service areas distributed across the business based on annual revenue from areas, time on site, travel time & routine requirements
Utilise the Route technicians for jobbing only after the route technicians routine services are delivered
Expected to be knowledgeable about company safety policies and safety (SRA) requirements on the job, be able to read and understand company policies
Any unresolved issues should be quickly elevated to the next level of management for prompt resolution
Any other similar duties as and when specified by the manager
  REPORTING
Daily, weekly & monthly (SOS) State of Service for Branch. Residential GSS SOS should also be the priority
Weekly reporting of pending jobs, ageing profiles to ABM/BM
Monthly reporting of technician wise trends.
Maintain State of Service and productivity data per technician
Maintain visibility on complaints received and report on all call outs / critical incidents received from branch.
Annual Leave planning of technicians
Ensure that each technician service productivity is achieved as per set targets
Key Result Areas:
On time service planning with ZERO pending services every month
Monitoring SCP active devices & Usage on weekly basis
Minimum expectancy on SCP active device(100%) & usage >95%
Achieving progressive improvement in State of Service (SOS) and meet SOS targets assigned by the branch
Minimizing service backlog (meet our contractual obligations)
  Competencies (Skills essential to the role):
Be decisive
Attention to details and accuracy
Planning & organizing
Analytical skills
Customer oriented
Negotiation skills
Ability to work patiently in a dynamic service environment
  Educational Qualification / Other Requirement:
Minimum graduation with 1 to 3 years of relevant experience of managing team
Basic computer skills - for reporting/work management (Advanced computer skills would be an added advantage)
Communication - speaking on phone to external customers & internally with technicians, other Operations colleagues.
Knowledge of territory which is handled for planning
Occasional Travel required within the Division
Liaise with the Operations Manager, Operations Executive, Service Supervisors to establish service requirements and provide information, assurance and advice as required
Communicate all service issues in a timely manner to the ABM/BM, Operations Manager

Description:
Job Description
A Stock Helper assists in the organization and management of inventory within a warehouse or retail setting. They support stock control procedures by receiving, storing, and distributing goods efficiently. Responsibilities may include receiving shipments, checking for accuracy, and documenting inventory levels. Stock Helpers also help maintain a clean and organized stockroom, ensuring that items are properly labeled and stored according to established guidelines. They may assist with inventory counts, replenishing stock on shelves, and fulfilling orders as needed.
Skills
Machine Operating:
Proficiency in operating machinery relevant to stock handling tasks, such as forklifts, pallet jacks, or conveyor belts.
Ability to safely and efficiently operate machinery to move, lift, or transport stock within the warehouse or storage facility.
Packet Collection:
Experience in collecting and organizing packets, boxes, or containers of stock from incoming shipments or designated storage areas.
Attention to detail to ensure accurate collection and verification of packets according to delivery notes or inventory lists.
Stock Counting:
Strong numerical skills and accuracy in conducting stock counts, inventory audits, and cycle counts to maintain accurate stock records.
Familiarity with stock counting procedures, including manual counting, barcode scanning, or use of inventory management software.
Inventory Maintenance:
Ability to assist in maintaining organized and efficient inventory systems, including labeling, shelving, and arranging stock items.
Understanding of inventory management principles to ensure proper storage, rotation, and handling of stock to minimize damage or loss.
Machine Maintenance:
Basic knowledge of machinery maintenance tasks, such as cleaning, lubricating, and performing minor repairs or adjustments.
Capability to identify and report any issues or malfunctions with machinery to prevent operational disruptions and ensure workplace safety.

Description:
Job description

Location - Puducherry

Company Wellesta Services India Pvt. Ltd. is a 100% subsidiary of Wellesta Holdings, Singapore, specializing in Contract Sales Operations (CSO) and Contract Sales & Marketing Operations (CSMO). The company is hiring Business Executives (BE) to promote Sanofi (Opella) Consumer Healthcare brands across assigned territories. Position Business Executive (BE) Reporting To Area Business Manager (ABM) Brands to Promote
Allegra
Combiflam
DePura
Dulcolax
Buscogast
Festal

Key Responsibilities
Promote Sanofi (Opella) Consumer Healthcare brands to doctors, pharmacists, hospitals, and other healthcare professionals.
Conduct scientific product detailing and effectively communicate product features, benefits, and clinical advantages.
Achieve monthly and quarterly sales targets in the assigned territory.
Plan and execute daily doctor calls as per the call plan.
Generate prescriptions and increase product recommendation through regular customer engagement.
Conduct Retail Chemist Prescription Audit (RCPA) to monitor prescription trends and competitor activities.
Generate Primary Order Booking (POB) and coordinate with distributors and stockists to ensure timely product availability.
Build and maintain strong professional relationships with doctors, pharmacists, distributors, stockists, and key opinion leaders.
Organize CMEs, product awareness activities, and other promotional initiatives as guided by the company.
Maintain accurate records of daily field activities, doctor calls, expenses, and sales reports using the company's reporting system.
Gather market intelligence, monitor competitor activities, and share actionable insights with the reporting manager.
Ensure compliance with company policies, ethical promotion practices, and applicable industry regulations.

Eligibility Criteria
B.Sc., B.Pharm, or other Life Sciences graduates preferred.
Freshers as well as candidates with pharmaceutical sales experience are encouraged to apply.
Strong communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
Fluency in English and the local language.
Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned territory.
Two-wheeler with a valid driving license is preferred.
Desired Skills
Excellent relationship-building and negotiation skills.
Self-motivated with a result-oriented approach.
Strong planning and territory management skills.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Basic knowledge of pharmaceutical sales and healthcare products.
Compensation & Benefits
CTC: 3.0 to 3.5 LPA
Attractive performance-based incentives
Travel and communication allowance
Medical insurance
Structured induction and product training
Career growth opportunities within Wellesta Services India Pvt. Ltd.
Work Location Assigned territory across India (as per business requirements). Why Join Wellesta?
Opportunity to work with globally recognized Sanofi (Opella) Consumer Healthcare brands.
Comprehensive product and sales training.
Performance-driven career progression.
Exposure to a professional and growing healthcare organization backed by Wellesta Holdings, Singapore.

Description:
To create network of high performing agencies and promulgate initiatives within each agency
to achieve sales & productivity targets through sustainable partnership with Licensed Agents and partners.Recruit ,Coach,Mentor,Support and Retain qualified agents and partners and Drive them to achieve New business productivity & Renewal Targets.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES :
Organize and run recruitment events (BOP) for Partner and Agents.
Identify the prospective Partners and Licensed Agents.
Selection to on boarding of the Partners/Agents and responsible for Partners/Agents income
Own the operational aspects of coding of a new Partner/Agent and other day to day interactions with support functions whenever required.
Plan goals & performance needs for Partners and Agents in a periodic manner
Set weekly production target for team of agents and partners
Identify partner/ agents development needs and work with team to schedule appropriate technical, product and skills training and coaching. Develop agents in line with career development / training requirements of the Company.
Accompany agents on customer visits to support and improve sales skill. Help whenever needed in prospecting activity in the field by joint field work activity with Partners/Agents.
Responsible for the activation and productivity of the agents and partners on business month on month.
Motivate by providing support, recognizing good performers and arranging appropriate team-building activities.
Operate as a product Subject Matter Expert and run Train-Audit-Retrain cycle on skills of Partners and Agents.
Conduct weekly / monthly meeting to review performance, disseminate Company information, address common problems and concerns and rally the team to achieve goals.
Ensure Partners and agents work in accordance with Company standards, the regulation and ethics and maintain licensed status.
Make necessary decisions based on agent performance. Contact Partners and Agents who are falling short of Contract Maintenance criteria to re- activate them or arrange training.
Host events for customers to develop new and long-term relationship and promoting the brand.
Ensure submitting DSR through companys sales report management tool.
Maintain up to date knowledge of all insurance products and company regulations.
Stay informed about industry trends, competitors offerings and regulatory updates
MINIMUM/SPECIFIC EXPERIENCE :
Graduate/ Post Graduate in any discipline
Good communication skills English & regional language (mandatory)
Age group: 25-38 years
Minimum 2 years of Sales experience
Preferably has own conveyance
Previous experience of BFSI industry is preferred
Competencies and Skills -
Competency- Result Orientation
Definition-
Encourages the team to set challenging yet achievable sales, recruitment and persistency goals (13th and 25th month)
Regularly reviews self and team performance on KPI, incentive targets and provides feedback to help them improve
Recognizes and rewards team members who consistently exceed their sales, recruitment and persistency targets (KPI)

Skillset required-
Goal Setting, Time Management, Target Focus, Performance Review, Feedback Use
Competency - Sales Orientation
Definition-
Proactively researches and stays updated on new life insurance products and services
Identifies customer needs and recommends appropriate solutions
Develops strong relationships with existing distributors to drive repeat business
Meets or exceeds monthly/quarterly sales targets

Skillset required-
Product Knowledge, Prospecting, Communication, Customer Understanding, Closing Skills
Competency- Customer Delight
Definition-
Proactively identifies and addresses customer needs and concerns
Knows customer segments in the locality and develops strong relationships with customers to foster loyalty and trust
Provides product knowledge training to sales team to enhance customer experience
Analyzes customer feedback and implements improvements to processes and services

Skillset required-
Customer Service, Relationship Building, Active Listening, Problem Solving, Feedback Handling
Competency- Work Ethics
Definition-
Promotes a culture of integrity and ethical behavior within the team
Ensures sales practices comply with relevant laws, regulations, and industry standards
Provides guidance to sales representatives on ethical dilemmas and decision-making
Takes prompt action to address any unethical conduct or misconduct towards brand values

Skillset required-
Integrity, Compliance, Fairness, Responsibility, Ethical Behavior

Competency - People and Team Leadership
Definition-
Communicates a clear vision and strategy for the team to achieve organizational objectives
Motivates and inspires the team to perform at a high level
Delegates tasks and responsibilities effectively to leverage team members' capabilities
Provides constructive feedback and coaching to help team members develop their skills
Skillset required-
Motivation, Teamwork, Delegation, Coaching, Support

Competency - Recruitment/Distribution Skills
Definition-
Proactively identifies and maintains a diverse pipeline of potential advisors and partners using established criteria, competitor mapping, and professional networking.
Develops and delivers a compelling value proposition that clearly articulates the career opportunity, compensation, and support structure, effectively influencing and convincing high-potential advisors and partners to join the team.
Skillfully anticipates and manages advisor objections through clear communication, factual evidence, and motivational techniques.
Effectively leverages existing networks, professional referrals, and natural market opportunities to consistently generate quality leads for distribution expansion.
Demonstrates the ability to attract established and high-performing distributors or teams from competitor organizations by highlighting the unique advantages and growth opportunities the company offers.
Ensures a good selection process is followed, and successful recruits are smoothly integrated by providing initial training and necessary resources to facilitate a fast start in the role.
Skillset required-
Lead Generation, Networking, Prospecting, Communication, Interviewing

Job Title: Relationship Officer

Job Description Summary- Buyer

The Buyer role focuses on developing and managing the relationship with suppliers regarding assigned commodities (parts, components). The purpose of this role is to develop mutually beneficial, on-going relationships with suppliers.

Position Summary
The Buyer role focuses on developing and managing the relationship with suppliers regarding assigned commodities (parts, components). The purpose of this role is to develop mutually beneficial, on-going relationships with suppliers through below tasks:

Place purchase orders, manage exception messages, line stops & expedites.
Buy new parts and determines source with Commodity Team, arrange necessary system setups, place sample PO-s
Responsible for maintenance of Procurement Parameters
Analyses alerts from MRP and take necessary actions.
Manage phase in and phase out of parts, paying particular attention to E&O risk.
Inventory & E&O review/management for team
Review & Maintain Constraints in conjunction with Buyers & Material Planning
Support Supplier Management Engineer in Management of all Rework / RTV / DMC activity
On site supplier management and audits capacity & stock audits
Enforce compliance to agreed pricing policy with supplier as provided by Global Procurement escalate any deviation to Management Team. Ensure accurate standard cost maintenance.
Drive Improvements in specific measurement nr-s: OTD, missing promised date, past due promised dates, Overdue-invoices, Excess Exposure (Cancel + Push out), PPV, SMI hub level.


Key Areas of Responsibility

Reviewing Purchase Requirements & Issuing Purchase Orders
Monitoring deliveries in support of assigned commodities.
Supporting inventory control
Supplier Identification and Selection & Contract Development
Supplier Performance and Review

Additional Requirement-

Candidate to have 5 Years of Experience in Core Purchasing Area and Expected to Lead, Guide, train small group of 3 to 4 Purchase Administrators.

Role & responsibilities

Assistant Manager - Metallurgy 

1. Responsible for planning and managing the Metallurgy lab and monitoring all activities therein to ensure adherence to the defined SOPs and standards.

2. Plan, support and contribute to new product development by way of analysis and testing of new product / material.

3. Review quality issues and non conformances and ensure resolution activities like Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and Corrective Action Preventive Action (CAPA) .

4. Provide support in preparation of the budget, plan and systems for the metallurgy lab

5. Ensure preparation of and review documentation and reports pertaining to metallurgy lab

6. Carry out activities for implementation and delivery of quality improvement projects

7. Supervise and guide the Metallurgy team

Key Purpose

The Metallurgy Incharge is responsible for planning for and managing the processes, equipment and instruments at the Metallurgy Lab to ensure material property testing for raw material / new product. Implementing the quality standards and procedures, managing the metallurgy inspection process and overseeing the team is vital to the role.

Educational Qualification 

B.E/B.Tech/Diploma in Metallurgical Engineering

They are in charge of creating effective business plans to generate more revenue, increase brand loyalty and improve customer satisfaction
Key Accountabilities:
Lead Generation
Generates lead for deals through interactions with DSE or through channel partners/open market
Customer Relationship Management
End to end customer relationship management including explaining product offerings and resolving sales queries
Cross-selling product offerings to customers
Educates customer with information to build their understanding of issues and capabilities
Goes beyond their day to day work to assist customers in a positive manner
Dealer Relationship Management
Maintaining relationship with assigned dealer
Deal Processing
Collecting all pre-sanction and post sanction documents and performing accurate data entries (RSPM, SAGE etc)
Internal Stakeholder Management
Interact with operations and credit team in order to ensure smooth processing of loan applications
KPIs:
Units Disbursed
st EMI Resolution
RC Collection
Qualification: Any Graduate Experience :
years work experience only in Vehicle Sales
Skills & Competencies
Functional Competencies
Communication Skill
Negotiation Skill
Market/Industry Knowledge
Analytical Skill
Product Knowledge
Behavioural Competencies
Execution Excellence
Customer Centricity
Hiring Parameters:
Should be comfortable to move in the market
Should have learning attitude
Should have bike and license
Should have good knowledge of RTO
Should have product knowledge

Description:
Chartered Accountant (CA)
Minimum 10+ years of experience in Finance & Accounts.
Experience handling end-to-end finance operations in a large organization or infrastructure / port setup.
Strong exposure to balance sheet finalization, statutory audits, and regulatory compliances.
Lead the preparation, consolidation, review, and finalization of annual OPEX and CAPEX budgets and ensure timely approvals.
Monitor and analyze monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue, cost, and profitability performance and recommend corrective actions.
Provide financial evaluation and decision support for capital expenditure proposals and investment decisions.
Ensure timely preparation and circulation of monthly MIS reports and coordinate performance reviews.
Oversee the preparation, analysis, and review of financial statements in accordance with applicable accounting standards.
Analyze expenses, receivables, and working capital trends and drive operational efficiency.
Manage cash flows, liquidity positions, and short-term investment decisions.
Strengthen internal financial controls and ensure closure of audit observations.
Ensure completion of statutory audits within defined timelines.
Ensure compliance with GST, EPCG obligations, and all applicable statutory requirements.
Lead, coach, and develop the finance team.
Drive adoption of modern finance systems, technologies, and best practices.

Job Summary
We are looking for a highly motivated Digital Publishing Automation Engineer to support and enhance our digital content production and publishing workflows. The ideal candidate will combine strong technical skills with excellent problem-solving abilities and effective communication to help automate processes, improve efficiency, and ensure the timely delivery of high-quality digital content.

Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain automation solutions for digital content production and publishing workflows.
Create and manage scripts to automate repetitive tasks and streamline operational processes.
Work with structured content and data formats to support content transformation and delivery.
Troubleshoot workflow issues, identify root causes, and implement effective solutions.
Collaborate with editorial, production, and technology teams to ensure smooth project execution.
Monitor publishing workflows and proactively communicate risks, dependencies, and potential bottlenecks.
Ensure quality standards are maintained throughout the content lifecycle.
Contribute to process improvement initiatives and recommend automation opportunities.

Required Skills
Problem Solving & Critical Thinking
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
Ability to independently identify issues and develop practical solutions.
Self-driven with the ability to work with minimal supervision.

Communication & Collaboration
Strong verbal and written communication skills.
Ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams.
Awareness of project dependencies and the ability to communicate status, risks, and blockers proactively.

Technical Skills
Experience with scripting languages such as JavaScript, Python, Node JS, Extend script
Proficiency in working with structured data formats such as DITA XML, JSON, and CSV.
Solid understanding of HTML and CSS.
Experience with digital content creation, transformation, and publishing workflows.
Familiarity with content management systems and publishing pipelines.

Preferred Qualifications
Experience with digital publishing, educational publishing, or content production environments.
Familiarity with workflow automation tools and content transformation processes.
Knowledge of Adobe InDesign and scripting is a plus.
Experience working with XML-based publishing systems is an advantage.

Experience
5+ years of relevant experience in automation, digital publishing, content operations, or a related field.

What We Are Looking For
A proactive problem solver who takes ownership and drives results.
A strong communicator who understands the importance of collaboration and workflow dependencies.
A technically skilled professional with a passion for process improvement and automation.
Someone who thrives in a fast-paced, quality-focused production environment.
AboutCompany: Kryon Knowledge Works is a leading software development company based in Chennai, with 25+ years of expertise in IT and ITES. We specialize in web applications, mobile solutions, AI-driven automation, data intelligence, cloud solutions, and enterprise software development.

Description:
Job Description
A Delivery Executive is responsible for transporting goods or services from one location to another efficiently and safely. They ensure timely deliveries while adhering to company protocols and customer requirements. Delivery Executives may work in various industries, including logistics, e-commerce, food delivery, or courier services. Responsibilities typically include loading and unloading vehicles, planning delivery routes, verifying orders, and providing exceptional customer service during the delivery process. Additionally, they may be responsible for documenting deliveries, collecting payments, and resolving any delivery-related issues that may arise.
Skills
Door Delivery:
Experience and proficiency in executing door-to-door deliveries efficiently and accurately.
Familiarity with delivering packages directly to customers homes or specified locations, ensuring timely and safe arrival.
Vendor Coordination:
Strong coordination skills to liaise with vendors, suppliers, or warehouses to ensure timely pickup and delivery of goods.
Ability to track shipments, manage inventory, and communicate effectively with vendors to resolve any delivery-related issues.
English/Tamil Communication:
Fluency in both English and Tamil languages for effective communication with customers, vendors, and team members.
Capacity to comprehend instructions, convey delivery details accurately, and address customer inquiries or concerns in either language.

Description:
Position Overview:
The Quality Controller in the publishing industry is responsible for ensuring the highest standards of quality for printed and digital materials. This position involves overseeing the production process, reviewing content for accuracy and consistency, and ensuring that all products meet company and industry standards before they are published or distributed. The role requires a keen eye for detail, strong analytical skills, and a deep understanding of the publishing process.
Key Responsibilities:
Content Review & Proofreading:
Conduct thorough proofreading and copy editing of manuscripts, books, articles, or digital content to ensure accuracy, grammar, punctuation, spelling, and consistency.
Verify the formatting of text, tables, figures, and images to ensure they align with company standards and guidelines.
Ensure that all content is appropriate and meets the target audience's expectations.
Quality Assurance in Production:
Review and monitor the printing process for quality control, ensuring the final product is free of defects, errors, and inconsistencies.
Check color accuracy, alignment, and consistency during print production.
Inspect paper quality, bindings, and finishes to ensure they meet production standards.
Compliance and Industry Standards:
Ensure that all content adheres to relevant publishing and copyright laws, such as proper citations, permissions, and licenses for third-party content.
Stay updated with industry best practices and quality standards, applying them to the production process.
Document Review and Verification:
Cross-check proofs, layouts, and final versions of content against original manuscripts and edits to ensure no discrepancies exist.
Validate metadata, including titles, author names, ISBNs, and other identifiers.
AboutCompany: Founded in 1994, Integra Software Services Private Limited is among the largest e-publishing houses across the globe servicing prestigious customers who are among the biggest names in the publishing arena in US & Europe. With team strength of 600 professionals, we have been growing rapidly and aggressively setting benchmarks in the industry & spread over 4 locations, with 2 offices in India & 2 abroad & all set to grow soon to a team of 1000. We are an ISO 9001 certified company & winner of prestigious export awards such as MAIT Award for Business Excellence.

Description:
Job Description
A Marketing Executive plays a pivotal role in devising and executing marketing strategies to promote products or services. They collaborate with various teams to develop campaigns, conduct market research, and analyze consumer behavior to identify trends and opportunities. Marketing Executives also manage digital and traditional marketing channels, such as social media, email, advertising, and events, to enhance brand visibility and drive sales. Additionally, they monitor and evaluate campaign performance, prepare reports, and adjust strategies as needed to achieve marketing objectives.
Skills
Groceries Marketing:
Proficiency in developing and implementing marketing strategies specifically tailored for grocery products.
Understanding of consumer behavior and preferences in the grocery sector.
Knowledge of effective promotional tactics such as in-store displays, discounts, and loyalty programs.
FMCG Marketing:
Experience in marketing fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG) with a focus on creating demand and driving sales.
Familiarity with FMCG product lifecycle management, including product launches, branding, and packaging strategies.
Distributors Contacts:
Strong network of contacts with distributors and wholesalers within the grocery/FMCG industry.
Ability to negotiate and maintain favorable relationships with distributors to ensure product availability and visibility.
Customer Communication:
Excellent communication skills to engage with customers effectively through various channels such as social media, email, and in-store promotions.
Capacity to understand customer needs and preferences and tailor marketing messages accordingly.
Website Updates:
Proficiency in website management tools and content management systems for updating product information, promotions, and other relevant content on the company website.
Understanding of search engine optimization (SEO) techniques to enhance the visibility and ranking of the website.
Vendor Communication:
Strong interpersonal skills for effective communication with vendors, suppliers, and manufacturers.
Ability to negotiate contracts, manage vendor relationships, and coordinate product sourcing and procurement activities.

Description:
Job Overview:
The InDesign Composer will be responsible for laying out, designing, and preparing publications using Adobe InDesign. This role requires an eye for design, an understanding of typography, and an ability to execute complex layouts while maintaining editorial standards and ensuring high-quality production for print and digital formats.
Key Responsibilities:
Use Adobe InDesign to design, layout, and prepare files for print and digital publications (including books, journals, magazines, brochures, etc.).
Collaborate closely with editorial and design teams to create visually appealing and cohesive layouts, incorporating text, images, and graphics.
Prepare files for publication, ensuring they are print-ready and conform to industry standards.
Maintain and implement templates, styles, and design systems to ensure consistency across publications.
Work with other creative software tools (e.g., Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, Acrobat) to edit or manipulate graphics and images when needed.
Perform preflight checks to ensure all images, fonts, and files are correctly linked and formatted.
Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to file formats, color profiles, fonts, and other design-related technical aspects.
Ensure accurate typesetting, formatting, and alignment of text while adhering to the editorial style guide.
Prepare digital versions of publications (e-books, PDFs, etc.) for distribution, ensuring compatibility with various platforms and devices.
Work under tight deadlines while maintaining high-quality output.
Assist in the preparation of marketing and promotional materials when required.
Stay updated with the latest design trends, software developments, and publishing industry best practices.
Preferred Qualifications:
Experience working with InDesign scripting or automation tools to streamline workflows.
Knowledge of interactive design and multimedia content for digital publications.
Familiarity with other Adobe Creative Cloud tools like Adobe XD or Animate.
Prior experience in academic, scientific, or technical publishing .
AboutCompany: Founded in 1994, Integra Software Services Private Limited is among the largest e-publishing houses across the globe servicing prestigious customers who are among the biggest names in the publishing arena in US & Europe. With team strength of 600 professionals, we have been growing rapidly and aggressively setting benchmarks in the industry & spread over 4 locations, with 2 offices in India & 2 abroad & all set to grow soon to a team of 1000. We are an ISO 9001 certified company & winner of prestigious export awards such as MAIT Award for Business Excellence.
