Description:
Job Description - Agency Frontline Sales Role
Band- 1
CTC- Up to 3.5 lakh rupees
JOB SUMMARY: To create network of high performing agencies and promulgate initiatives within each agency to achieve sales productivity targets through sustainable partnership with Licensed Agents and partners. Recruit, Coach, Mentor, Support and Retain qualified agents and partners and Drive them to achieve New business productivity Renewal Targets.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Organize and run recruitment events (BOP) for Partner and Agents.
Identify the prospective Partners and Licensed Agents.
Selection to onboarding of the Partners/Agents and responsible for Partners/Agents income
Own the operational aspects of coding of a new Partner/Agent and other day to day interactions with support functions whenever required.
Plan goals performance needs for Partners and Agents in a periodic manner
Set weekly production target for team of agents and partners
Identify partner/ agents development needs and work with team to schedule appropriate technical, product and skills training and coaching. Develop agents in line with career development / training requirements of the Company.
Accompany agents on customer visits to support and improve sales skill. Help whenever needed in prospecting activity in the field by joint field work activity with Partners/Agents.
Responsible for the activation and productivity of the agents and partners on business month on month.
Motivate by providing support, recognizing good performers and arranging appropriate team-building activities.
Operate as a product Subject Matter Expert and run Train-Audit-Retrain cycle on skills of Partners and Agents.
Conduct weekly / monthly meeting to review performance, disseminate Company information, address common problems and concerns and rally the team to achieve goals.
Ensure Partners and agents work in accordance with Company standards, the regulation and ethics and maintain licensed status.
Make necessary decisions based on agent performance. Contact Partners and Agents who are falling short of Contract Maintenance criteria to re-activate them or arrange training.
Host events for customers to develop new and long-term relationship and promoting the brand.
Ensure submitting DSR through company's sales report management tool.
Maintain up to date knowledge of all insurance products and company regulations.
Stay informed about industry trends, competitors' offerings and regulatory updates
MINIMUM/SPECIFIC EXPERIENCE:
Graduate/ Post Graduate in any discipline
Good communication skills English regional language (mandatory)
Age group: 25-38 years
Minimum 2 years of Sales experience
Preferably has own conveyance
Previous experience of BFSI industry is preferred
Competencies and Skills
Competency- Result Orientation Definition- Encourages the team to set challenging yet achievable sales, recruitment and persistency goals (13th and 25th month)
Regularly reviews self and team performance on KPI, incentive targets and provides feedback to help them improve
Recognizes and rewards team members who consistently exceed their sales, recruitment and persistency targets (KPI)
Skillset required- Goal Setting, Time Management, Target Focus, Performance Review, Feedback Use
Competency - Sales Orientation Definition- Proactively researches and stays updated on new life insurance products and services
Identifies customer needs and recommends appropriate solutions
Develops strong relationships with existing distributors to drive repeat business
Meets or exceeds monthly/quarterly sales targets
Skillset required- Product Knowledge, Prospecting, Communication, Customer Understanding, Closing Skills
Competency- Customer Delight
Proactively identifies and addresses customer needs and concerns
Knows customer segments in the locality and develops strong relationships with customers to foster loyalty and trust
Provides product knowledge training to sales team to enhance customer experience
Analyzes customer feedback and implements improvements to processes and services
Skillset required- Customer Service, Relationship Building, Active Listening, Problem Solving, Feedback Handling
Competency- Work Ethics
Promotes a culture of integrity and ethical behavior within the team
Ensures sales practices comply with relevant laws, regulations, and industry standards
Provides guidance to sales representatives on ethical dilemmas and decision-making
Takes prompt action to address any unethical conduct or misconduct towards brand values
Skillset required- Integrity, Compliance, Fairness, Responsibility, Ethical Behavior
Competency - People and Team Leadership
Motivates and inspires the team to perform at a high level
Delegates tasks and responsibilities effectively to leverage team members' capabilities
Provides constructive feedback and coaching to help team members develop their skills
Skillset required- Motivation, Teamwork, Delegation, Coaching, Support
Competency - Recruitment/Distribution Skills
Definition- Proactively identifies and maintains a diverse pipeline of potential advisors and partners using established criteria, competitor mapping, and professional networking.

Role Overview
The Infrastructure Finance Expert will provide financial and economic expertise to support the planning and appraisal of infrastructure and risk reduction interventions, with a focus on long-term resilience and efficiency.

Overall Evaluate the financial and economic benefits of infrastructure and disaster risk reduction interventions, including assessment of avoided losses and long-term impacts.

CA/CMA or MBA (Finance)/Master of Finance and Control /M.Com /PGDBM (with specification in Finance).
Skills and Experience:
Minimum 10 years of relevant professional experience in the field.
Experience of working on at least one externally funded project (such as ADB, AFD, WBG, etc.)
Prior work experience across Himalayan regions with exposure to multiple hazards in India, Nepal, Bhutan, etc.

Description:
Key Responsibilities;-
1. Sales & Market Development
- Achieve monthly and annual sales targets for AAC Blocks in Mizoram.
- Identify and develop new customers (contractors, builders, government departments, and private projects).
- Generate demand by promoting AAC blocks to engineers, architects, and consultants.
- Drive product penetration into government and institutional projects.

Key Skills Required;-
1. Strong communication, presentation & negotiation skills.
2. Experience in sales of building materials (Cement, Steel, Bricks, Tiles, Blocks preferred).
3. Ability to establish dealer networks and institutional business.
4. Willingness to travel extensively across Mizoram.
5. Market knowledge of Mizoram (local language will be an advantage).
Experience 4 - 7 Years

Job Summary:
The Relationship Manager Agency Channel is responsible for driving life insurance sales through the recruitment, development, and management of insurance advisors. The role involves identifying potential advisors, providing product and sales training, motivating them to achieve business targets, and ensuring high levels of customer service. The incumbent will work closely with advisors to generate quality business, expand market reach, and contribute to the overall growth of the Agency Channel.

Generate business through advisor-led sales while ensuring achievement of monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets.
Conduct regular field visits with advisors to support customer acquisition, lead generation, and policy closures.
Identify new business opportunities through personal networking, referrals, local market activities, and customer interactions.
Build and maintain strong relationships with advisors to improve productivity, retention, and business performance.
Support advisors during customer meetings, presentations, and financial planning discussions to improve conversion rates.
Monitor advisor performance using MIS reports and provide continuous feedback to improve productivity.
Prepare and execute business development plans to increase market penetration and achieve branch objectives.
Ensure quality business by maintaining high policy persistency, minimizing cancellations, and reducing claim-related issues.
Coordinate with Branch Managers and internal support teams for smooth business processing and policy issuance.
Ensure timely documentation, KYC compliance, proposal submissions, premium collections, and policy servicing.
Drive customer awareness regarding life insurance solutions and financial protection through local campaigns and promotional activities.
Participate in branch sales meetings, review discussions, and performance planning sessions.

CTC Upto 4 LPA

Location : Tinsukia, Guwahati, Aizawl


Key Skill:

Excellent communication, interpersonal and selling skill • Strong problem solving skills and decision making ability

MINIMUM/SPECIFIC EXPERIENCE:

Graduate/ Post Graduate in any discipline

Description:
Job Summary
Technical Expert, Organisation YR Gaitonde Medical Educational & Research Foundation (YRGMERF) - Project Disha. Experience required: 5 years.
Responsibilities
The Technical Experts will provide mentoring and supportive supervision to DISHA cluster units, ensuring the effective implementation of the National AIDS Control Program (NACP) V.
Mentoring and Supervision: Based at the cluster level, provide mentoring support to 4 to 5 DISHA cluster units or DISHA single units.
Conduct monthly visits to all assigned DISHA units to provide on-site mentoring and supportive supervision.
Provide evidence-based technical guidance on all components of NACP V to the DISHA units.
Coordination and Collaboration: Strengthen coordination with allied health departments at the district level (NHM, NTEP, NVHCP) for enhanced referral linkages.
Make field visits to NACP facilities along with DISHA staff for supportive supervision and capacity building.
Reporting and Data Quality: Ensure the timely and quality submission of monthly reports for DISHA.
Verify data reported by at least 3 facilities per district each month and provide inputs to ensure data quality.
Guidance and Capacity Building: Guide the DISHA team on advocacy, stakeholder coordination, and coordination with other departments in the district.
Assist DISHA in developing district profiles, integrated action plans, and DISHA-specific IEC materials.
Orient and ensure optimal implementation of all component activities as per NACP V in the district/DISHA cluster.
Implementation of Strategies: Guide DISHA units on implementing new strategies of NACP V, such as CSS, SSS, SOA, use of virtual media, APN, index case, etc.

Description:
Process all guest check-ins, verifying guest identity, form of payment, assigning room, and activating/issuing room key.
Set up accurate accounts for each guest according to their requirements.
Enter Marriott Rewards information.
Ensure rates match market codes, document exceptions.
Secure payment prior to issuing room key, verify/adjust billing.
Compile and review daily reports/logs/contingency lists.
Complete cashier and closing reports.
Supply guests with directions and property information.
Accommodate guest requests, contacting appropriate staff if necessary.
Follow up to ensure requests have been met.
Process all payment types, vouchers, paid-outs, and charges.
Balance and drop receipts.
Count and secure bank at beginning and end of shift.
Obtain manual authorizations and follow all Accounting procedures.
Notify Loss Prevention/Security of any guest reports of theft.

Speak using clear and professional language; prepare and review written documents accurately and completely; answer telephones using appropriate etiquette.
Ensure adherence to quality standards.
Enter and locate information using computers/POS systems.
Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time.

Description:
Patrol all areas of the property; secure rooms; assist guests with room access.
Conduct emergency response drills, daily physical hazard/safety inspections, investigations, interviews, and key control audit.
Monitor Closed Circuit Televisions and alarm systems.
Authorize, monitor, and document access to secured areas.
Assist guests/employees during emergency situations.
Respond to accidents, contact EMS or administer first aid/CPR as required.
Gather information and complete reports.
Maintain confidentiality of reports/documents, release information to authorized individuals.
Defuse disturbances in accordance with company policies and procedures.
Resolve safety hazard situations.
Handle all interruptions and complaints.
Escort unwelcome persons from the property.
Ensure compliance with alcoholic beverage control laws.
Call for assistance using proper code responses.
Provide proper paperwork to employees.
Assist management in training, motivating and coaching employees; serve as a role model and first point of contact of the Guarantee of Fair Treatment/Open Door Policy process.
Follow all company policies and procedures; report accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; complete safety training and certifications; ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets.
Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards; anticipate and address guests service needs; thank guests with genuine appreciation.
Speak with others using clear and professional language; prepare and review written documents accurately and completely; answer telephones using appropriate etiquette.
Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others; support team to reach common goals; listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees.
Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards.
In addition, some states may have additional licensing/registration requirements to be considered for this position.
Read and visually verify information in a variety of formats (eg, small print).
Visually inspect tools, equipment, or machines (eg, to identify defects).
Enter and locate work-related information using computers and/or point of sale systems.
Move at a speed required to respond to work situations (eg, run, walk, jog).
Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time or for an entire work shift.
Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance and objects weighing in excess of 75 pounds with assistance.
Grasp, turn, and manipulate objects of varying size and weight, requiring fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination.
Move through narrow, confined, or elevated spaces.
Move over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces as well as up and down stairs and/or service ramps.
Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping.
Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: At least 2 years of related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: At least 1 year of supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None

We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
Responsible for the daily shift operations of Housekeeping, Recreation/Health Club and, if applicable, Laundry.
Directs and works with employees to verify property guestrooms, public space and employee areas are clean and well maintained.
Completes inspections and holds people accountable for corrective action.
Position assists in ensuring guest and employee satisfaction while maintaining the operating budget.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
High school diploma or GED; 2 years experience in the housekeeping or related professional area. OR
2-year degree from an accredited university in Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; no work experience required.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Managing Housekeeping Operations and Budgets
Verifies guest room status is communicated to the Front Desk in a timely and efficient manner.
Inspects guestrooms on a daily basis.
Obtains list of rooms to be cleaned immediately and list of prospective check-outs or discharges to prepare work assignments.
Inventories stock to verify adequate supplies.
Supports and supervises an effective inspection program for all guestrooms and public space.
Understands the impact of department s operations on the overall property ficial goals and objectives and manages to achieve or exceed budgeted goals.
Verifies all employees have proper supplies, equipment and uniforms.
Communicates areas that need attention to staff and follows up to verify understanding.
Supervises daily Housekeeping shift operations and verifies compliance with all housekeeping policies, standards and procedures.
Participates in departmental meetings and continually communicates a clear and consistent message regarding the departmental goals to produce desired results.
Conducting Human Resources Activities
Uses all available on the job training tools to train new room attendants and provide follow-up training as necessary.
Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees and verifies employees do the same with them.
Schedules employees to business demands and for tracks employee time and attendance.
Verifies employees understand expectations and parameters.
Verifies property policies are administered fairly and consistently, disciplinary procedures and documentation are completed according to Standard and Local Operating Procedures (SOPs and LSOPs) and support the Peer Review Process, where applicable.
Supervises staffing levels to verify that guest service, operational needs, and ficial objectives are met.
Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals.
Verifies employee recognition is taking place on all shifts.
Participates in an on-going employee recognition program.
Solicits employee feedback, utilizes an open door policy, and reviews employee satisfaction results to identify and address employee problems or concerns.
Participates in employee progressive discipline procedures.
Celebrates successes and publicly recognizes the contributions of team members.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
Sets a positive example for guest relations.
Understands the brands service culture.
Participates in the development and implementation of corrective action plans to improve guest satisfaction.
Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.
Emphasizes guest satisfaction during all departmental meetings and focuses on continuous improvement.
Responds to and handles guest problems and complaints.
Strives to improve service performance.
At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
Responsible for preparing all event documentation and coordinates with Sales, property departments and customer to ensure consistent, high level service throughout pre-event, event and post-event phases of property events.
This position primarily handles events of average complexity.
Ensures their property events have a seamless turnover from sales to service back to sales.
Recognizes opportunities to maximize revenue opportunities by up-selling and offering enhancements to create outstanding events.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; experienced (1 - 2 years of experience) in the event management or related professional area. OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; at least 1 year experience in the event management or related professional area required.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Managing Event Logistics and Operations
- Ensures that events progress seamlessly by following established procedures, collaborating with other employees, and ensuring accuracy.
- Greets customer during the event phase and hands-off to the Event Operations team for the execution of details.
- Adheres to all standards, policies, and procedures.
- Ensures billing accuracy and conducts bill reviews with the clients prior to processing the final bill.
- Manages group room blocks and meeting space for average to large-sized assigned groups.
- Identifies operational challenges associated with his/her group and determines how to best work with the property staff and customer to solve these challenges and/or develop alternative solutions.
- Uses his/her judgment to integrate current trends in event management and event design.
- Acts as liaison between field salesperson and customer throughout the event process (pre-event, event, post-event).
- Participates in customer site inspections and assists with the sales process as necessary.
- Performs other duties as assigned to meet business needs.
- Solicits feedback from the property departments to identify areas for improvement to enhance the Event Planner s experience.
Ensuring and Providing Exceptional Customer Service
- Delivers excellent customer service throughout the customer experience and encourages the same from other employees.
- Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.
- Sets a positive example for guest relations.
- Coordinates and communicates event details both verbally and in writing to the customer and property operations.
- Makes presence known to customer at all times during this process.
- Oversees his/her customer experiences from file turnover through the post event phase until turnover back to sales.
- Follows up with customer post-event.
- Responds to and handles guest problems and complaints.
- Uses personal judgment and expertise to enhance the customer experience.
- Stays available to solve problems and/or suggest alternatives to previous arrangements.
- Works to continually improve customer service by integrating obtained feedback and personal judgment into action plans.
- Emphasizes guest satisfaction during all departmental meetings and focuses on continuous improvement.
- Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
- Ensures hourly employees understand expectations and parameters for event activities.
Leading Event Management Teams
- Conducts formal pre- and post-event meetings as required to review/communicate group needs and feedback.
- Leads formal pre-event and post-event meetings for average to large-sized assigned groups.
- Facilitates various meetings as he/she perceives necessary (Banquet Event Order meeting, block review, etc).
Supporting and Coordinating with the Sales and Marketing Function
- Assists in the sales process and revenue forecasting for customer groups.
- Up-sells products and services throughout the event process.
- Forecasts group sleeping rooms and event revenue (catering and audio visual) for his/her groups.
Conducting Human Resources Activities
- Reviews comment cards and guest satisfaction results with employees.
- Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals and/or managers.
- Assists in the development and implementation of corrective action plans.
- Take initiative to use his/her experience to improve service performance according to his/her evaluation of the issue and resolution.
- Works with the property staff and customers to address operational challenges associated with his/her group.
- Performs other duties as assigned to meet business needs.
At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
ATM Field Service Engineering (Manipur)
Home
ATM Field Service Engineering (Manipur)
ATM Field Service Engineering (Manipur)
About the Role
An ATM Field Service Engineer is responsible for the entire lifecycle of ATMs, from pre-installation and setup to ongoing maintenance and repair. This includes training clients on ATM usage, performing preventive maintenance to avoid problems, troubleshooting malfunctions, and completing repairs to get ATMs back up and running quickly. They also interact directly with customers to address any concerns and provide excellent customer service. The role requires a proactive approach, responding immediately to all complaints and scheduling preventive maintenance to minimize downtime. For complex issues, collaboration with the customer support team and R&D department is necessary. A valid 2-wheeler license and motorbike are essential for travel to various ATM locations.
About the Company
Vortex Engineering is a Chennai, India-based Technology company focused on building innovative products for the ATM/self-service market. The company has a family of ATM HW & SW products with around 10K installations and a portfolio of software products for the management of multivendor ATMs and other value-added applications. Our customers include leading banks in India and a growing set of new customers in growth countries in Asia, ME & Africa.
Vortex Engineering is revolutionizing self-service product space with unique firsts in the industry

Lowest carbon footprint with ultra-low power design, making it viable for solar-powered deployments
Most sustainable, and the only commercially successful ATM to run on an open-source Linux platform
Only Indian company (and one of a few globally) to have developed and patented dispenser technology
Developing next-generation secured Hardware & Software products using IoT, AI, ML & 5G

The company has a partnership with IIT-Madras for R&D on the latest cutting-edge technologies and offers exciting career opportunities for dynamic individuals with a passion to innovate, lead, take larger responsibilities and grow with the company.
Job Summery
Location:
Manipur, India
Qualification:
Diploma or BE in EEE/ECE
Experience:
0 to 1 Year or willing to work as service technician.

The Asian International University is looking for Social Media Executive to join our dynamic team and embark on a rewarding career journey.A Social Media Executive is responsible for planning, executing, and managing social media campaigns to increase brand awareness, engagement, and sales. This role involves developing and maintaining a strong online presence for a company across multiple social media platforms, creating engaging content, and analyzing the success of social media efforts.

2. Excellent organizational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.
3. A creative and analytical mindset, with the ability to use data and metrics to continuously improve social media strategies.
4. A passion for social media and a deep understanding of how to use it to build brand awareness, engagement, and sales.
5. A strong understanding of brand messaging, tone, and voice, and the ability to consistently maintain a cohesive brand image across all social media channels.

Description:
The Asian International University is looking for Estate Manager to join our dynamic team and embark on a rewarding career journey.An Estate Manager, also known as a Property Manager or Estate Supervisor, is responsible for overseeing and managing various aspects of a property or estate, ensuring its efficient operation and maintenance. Estate Managers can work in residential, commercial, or institutional settings, and their duties may vary based on the size and nature of the estate they are managing.

Key Responsibilities:

Property Maintenance:

Supervise and coordinate maintenance and repair tasks.
Ensure the property is clean, well-maintained, and aesthetically pleasing.
Manage landscaping, gardening, and outdoor maintenance activities.
Regularly inspect the property to identify maintenance needs and address them promptly.
Financial Management:

Prepare and manage budgets for property operations and maintenance.
Monitor expenses, approve invoices, and reconcile financial records.
Negotiate contracts with vendors and service providers to ensure cost-effective services.
Security and Safety:

Implement and oversee security measures to safeguard the property and its occupants.
Coordinate with security personnel and install security systems as necessary.
Develop and enforce safety protocols and emergency procedures.
Tenant and Guest Relations:

Interact with tenants, guests, and residents in a professional and courteous manner.
Address tenant concerns, complaints, and requests promptly and effectively.
Conduct regular tenant meetings and ensure a high level of tenant satisfaction.
Staff Management:

Recruit, train, and supervise estate staff, such as maintenance workers, security personnel, and housekeeping staff.
Delegate tasks and responsibilities to staff members.
Conduct performance evaluations and provide feedback to employees.
Administrative Tasks:

Maintain accurate records of property-related activities, contracts, and expenses.
Prepare regular reports for property owners or management.
Handle administrative tasks such as scheduling, correspondence, and document management.
Compliance and Regulations:

Ensure the property complies with local, state, and federal regulations and codes.
Stay updated on relevant laws and regulations affecting property management.
Obtain necessary licenses and permits for the property's operation.
Project Management:

Oversee renovation, remodeling, and construction projects on the property.
Coordinate with contractors, architects, and designers to ensure projects are completed on time and within budget.
Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Business, Property Management, Hospitality, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
Previous experience in property management, estate management, or a related field is highly desirable.
Strong organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills.
Knowledge of property management software and basic financial principles.
Ability to multitask, prioritize tasks, and work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
Leadership skills and the ability to motivate and manage a team effectively.

Description:
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Youll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Servicessolving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
As a SAP EWM Senior Associate, you will specialize in providing consulting services for SAP supply chain and operations applications. You will analyze client needs, implement software solutions, and offer training and support for seamless integration and utilization of SAP supply chain and operations applications. Working in this area, you will enable clients to optimize their supply chain processes, improve operational efficiency, and achieve their strategic objectives. As a Senior Associate, you will focus on building meaningful client connections and learning how to manage and inspire others. You will navigate increasingly complex situations, growing your personal brand and deepening your technical skills. You are expected to anticipate the needs of your teams and clients, delivering quality solutions while embracing increased ambiguity.
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will leverage your skills to respond effectively to diverse perspectives and needs, using a broad range of tools and methodologies to generate new ideas and solve problems. You will develop a deeper understanding of the business context and how it is evolving, interpreting data to inform insights and recommendations. Upholding professional and technical standards, you will contribute to the firm's code of conduct and independence requirements, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and innovation within our Tax practice.
Responsibilities
- Analyzing client needs to implement SAP supply chain and operations solutions effectively
- Providing training and support for seamless integration and utilization of SAP applications
- Optimizing supply chain processes to enhance operational efficiency and achieve strategic objectives

Description:
We are currently hiring for Sales Specialist for our Apple Retail Stores in India.


Do you love how it feels to encourage others? As a Part-Time Specialist, you help create the energy and excitement around Apple products, providing the right solutions and getting products into customers hands. You understand that the Apple Store is dedicated to delivering a customer experience thats unlike any other. It starts with you discovering customers needs. And with the support of your store team members, you match those needs with the right products. Every day is an opportunity for you to turn another Apple Store visitor into a loyal Apple customer.


Role & responsibilities

Deliver excellent service to Apple customers by seeking to understand their needs, identifying ownership opportunities, presenting products and services, and educating customers on relevant ways to buy products.
Understand and proactively stay up to date on Apples products, services, purchase options and Product Zone sales processes.
Support your peers throughout the store as needed by sharing knowledge about Apples products, services and purchase options, and assist in offering ownership opportunities. Maintain accuracy and follow guidance.
Perform other tasks as needed, including but not limited to providing customer service and support in other areas of the store.
Contribute to an inclusive environment by respecting each others differences and having the curiosity to learn.
Demonstrate Apples values of inclusion and diversity in daily activities.



Preferred candidate profile

Demonstrate knowledge of Apple products and services.
Personalise solutions based on customer needs, and effectively communicate them.
Work in a fast-paced environment, often supporting multiple customers at the same time.
Work in a team environment, demonstrating shared responsibility and accountability with other team members.
Be curious and open to learning from others and helping each other grow.
Learn about and deepen your understanding of Apple products and services, and third-party products, to enhance the customer experience.
Be trusted with sensitive or confidential information, keeping with Apples core values.
You should have availability to work a schedule based on business needs that may include nights, weekends and public holidays in the retail store, and reliably attend work as scheduled, in line with local laws and subject to any approved accommodations.

This is a Part-Time opportunity, requiring you to work 4 Days in a week for 5 hours each day i.e 20 hours in a week.


Location

Bangalore , Delhi, Noida


Perks and benefits

PERFECT PLACER (www.perfectplacer.com), Promoted by a team of dedicated professionals with varied background, having comprehensive and extensive industry and consultancy exposure, is “One of the most preferred and referred consultants” today in Executive Search & Placement.

PERFECT PLACER in less than half a decade has grown to be a force to reckon with, having offices in Mumbai, Chennai, Bangalore, and New Delhi.

Perfect Placer along with its associate services has a long and prestigious list of leading Indian and Multinational Corporates in India and Outside across Managerial levels, functions, and Industries, covering both IT and Non-IT specialized in chief executive, board member and senior-level management search assignments.

Assistant Vice President (AVP) of Marketing – BPO or ITeS
Responsible for overseeing all marketing initiatives, including SEO, PPC, social media, email marketing, and content marketing. This role involves driving brand visibility, generating leads, and maximizing ROI through data-driven strategies.
Key Responsibilities:
F Serve as the primary people leader for marketing professionals across multiple disciplines, coaching and developing talent in close partnership with the functional leaders.
F Drive a comprehensive marketing talent strategy: workforce planning, strategic hiring, structured onboarding, career pathing, and retention — with depth in demand generation, Martech, digital, analytics, events, and creative.
F Champion of Event Technology & the Marketing Stack
F Act as a credible “internal customer”: represent the marketer’s perspective when evaluating Co’s own product portfolio and translate those insights into actionable feedback for Product, GTM, and Customer Success teams.
F Champion Event-Led Growth (ELG) thinking across the India organization, ensuring teams deeply understand how Co’s platform drives pipeline, revenue, and engagement for enterprise B2B marketers globally.
F Represent India marketing in global forums and industry events as a confident, opinionated voice on modern B2B marketing and Event Technology.
F AI search and automation
Build Co’s GEO and AEO strategy for Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Copilot and other AI platforms.
Improve brand mentions, citations, entity visibility and answer ownership across AI-generated experiences.
Develop frameworks for measuring AI visibility, referral traffic and assisted business impact.
Embed AI into keyword clustering, content research, technical analysis, reporting and anomaly detection.
Partner with technology teams to enhance Co’s platforms.
Establish human-review and AI-governance standards covering accuracy, privacy, copyright and brand safety.
F Operational Excellence & Execution
F Own the day-to-day operational rhythm of marketing teams, ensuring reliable delivery against SLAs and commitments to global discipline leaders and regional stakeholders.
F Design and continuously improve follow-the workflows across US-EMEA-APAC time zones for campaigns, events, marketing operations, and creative services — optimizing for speed, quality, and continuity of execution.
F Stakeholder Management & Matrix Leadership
F Partner with HR, Finance, Facilities, and corporate functions in India to champion site culture, employee engagement, and a world-class workplace experience for marketing professionals.
F Governance, Brand & Compliance
F Ensure India marketing teams adhere to global policies and standards related to brand, security, data privacy, and event execution.
F Proactively manage operational and people-related risks in partnership with global functional owners.

Preferred candidate profile
1. Candidate with 10+ years of progressive B2B marketing leadership within SaaS or enterprise technology organizations, with significant experience in people leadership and operations-focused roles.
2. Demonstrated success leading multi-disciplinary marketing professionals.
3. Deep, genuine familiarity with Event Technology and/or Martech landscape — as a practitioner, platform buyer, or industry advocate. Recognized credibility as a voice in this space.
4. Ability to serve as a sophisticated “internal customer”: evaluate marketing technology with a practitioner’s lens and translate insights into actionable product and GTM feedback.
5. A proven track record of driving AI adoption in marketing — through tooling, workflow transformation, or team capability-building — with an informed, hands-on orientation toward emerging AI platforms.
6. Prociency in analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics, Google Data Studio, Power BI) and CRM platforms.
7. Exceptional coaching, talent management, and recruiting capability: a track record of building high-performing teams, accelerating leaders, and constructing strong succession pipelines.
8. Outstanding stakeholder management skills — the ability to build trusted, influential partnerships with global CXO-level leaders.
9. Strong working knowledge of Martech, digital marketing, and data-driven demand generation.
10. Exposure to US, Europe, APAC and/or IMEA markets and regional marketing dynamics strongly preferred.
11. Executive presence and communication excellence; comfortable representing India marketing credibly in global forums and at industry events.
12. Strong leadership and team management skills, with the ability to inspire and mentor a team.
13. Excellent communication, strategic thinking, and problem-solving skills.
14. Ability to manage multiple projects, prioritize tasks, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
15. Strong nancial acumen and budget management skills.
16. Proven experience in client handling, pre-sales, and proposal creation.
17. Ability to create and present comprehensive digital marketing roadmaps.
18. Strong interpersonal skills to build and maintain client relationships.

Remuneration:
An outstanding remuneration package that rewards professionalism and diligence will be on offer for the successful applicant as well as a well-defined career path. An excellent package will be on offer for the right candidate, including an above-mentioned industry base salary for the right person as well as the most complete employee benefit scheme. Don't miss out on this opportunity to join the market leader.

Description:
Role: Enterprise & Functional Strategy (EFS) / Marketing Strategy Manager

Enterprise & Functional Strategy (EFS):
Drive transformation of enterprise cost structures aligned with corporate strategy.
Re-allocate spend from commodity to differentiating capabilities for growth acceleration.
Key capabilities: cost baselining, analytics, benchmarking, opportunity identification, value realization, process optimization, functional transformation (SG&A, Finance, HR), and operating model design.
Develop and execute adaptive, cross-functional strategies to address market shifts.
Lead go-to-market (GTM), market entry, and enterprise growth strategies.
Partner with clients to align people, processes, and strategy amid business disruption.
Marketing Strategy Offering:
Advise CMOs and marketing leaders on capabilities, operating models, digital strategy, and cost structures.
Help redesign customer engagement, personalize experiences, and drive growth using AI-native workflows and agentic marketing capabilities.
Deliver end-to-end marketing transformation services: customer segmentation, data strategy, operating model design, MarTech/AdTech assessment, predictive analytics, and design-led delivery.
Identify AI-enabled marketing use cases, build business cases, and deploy intelligent marketing solutions.

Key Responsibilities:
Marketing Strategy
Execute engagements: growth strategy, customer segmentation, market opportunity assessment, marketing effectiveness diagnostics.
Design enterprise-wide marketing strategies aligned with business goals.
Translate strategy into actionable transformation roadmaps with measurable outcomes.
Customer Marketing
Develop customer-centric marketing strategies (acquisition, engagement, retention, loyalty).
Analyze consumer behavior, market trends, and insights to identify growth opportunities.
Support design and activation of customer engagement programs.
Brand Strategy
Assist in brand positioning, portfolio strategy, value proposition, and messaging development.
Conduct market, competitor, and customer research for brand differentiation.
Provide recommendations to enhance brand equity and relevance.
Target Operating Model (TOM)
Support design of marketing operating models covering structure, governance, processes, capabilities, and technology.
Assess current marketing capabilities and identify improvement opportunities.
Aid marketing transformation aligned to strategic growth objectives.
Customer Data Strategy
Evaluate customer data assets, ecosystems, and activation capabilities.
Assess MarTech & AdTech platforms including automation, personalization, and measurement.
Develop roadmaps for data-driven marketing and AI-enabled transformation.
Core Domain Skills:
Marketing Strategy execution: market analysis, revenue diagnostics, commercial model assessments.
Target Operating Model design: current-state mapping and future-state design.
GTM Strategy: segmentation, positioning, channel activation analysis.
Brand Strategy & Portfolio Management.
Customer Data & MarTech Strategy.
Core Consulting Skills:
Critical Thinking & Problem Solving.
Collaborative teamwork and client relationship building.
Operational excellence and disciplined workstream management.
Effective communication: data storytelling and executive presentation.
Data analysis and visualization proficiency.
Tools & Technology:
Proficiency with GenAI & Agentic AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Cursor, Vercel).
Advanced Excel & PowerPoint skills.
Knowledge of Marketing Automation Platforms, Customer Data Platforms, Content Management Systems, Marketing Analytics tools.
Experience with visualization tools: Power BI, Tableau, etc.

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.
Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.
Position Summary
The Cybersecurity Software Lead will join our Software organization to design and implement the cybersecurity features our In Flight Entertainment and Connectivity (IFEC) product suite. The candidate must be a proficient technical leader and have extensive knowledge of cybersecurity of software systems that utilize Android and/or Linux platforms, multi-layered, client-server technologies. Experience in developing complex Java and C/C++ applications on the Android and Linux platform is required. Experience in following cybersecurity features is required: Firewall, Antivirus, Key management, Encryption, SELinux. Candidate must also possess excellent communication skills that will help in the job of leading, and facilitating discussions between stakeholders. The Cybersecurity Software Specialist also has software development responsibilities for prototyping new features. The Cybersecurity Software Specialist will work with SW Architects, SW development teams and system teams.
Essential Functions / Key Areas of Responsibility
The Cybersecurity Software Specialist will provide his technical expertise, guidance, oversight and drive the following:
Drive software architecture Cybersecurity aspects for the IFEC product lines Lead the design of the Cybersecurity features Responsible for Writing the Cybersecurity use cases (user stories), and allocate them to the functional components as necessary Lead the definition of interfaces/APIs between software components Provide the technical expertise and communicate on cybersecurity effectively to other engineers and management via presentations, architecture documents/diagrams, and software requirements Select COTS (Commercial Off the Shelf) and OSS (Open Source Software) for cybersecurity features Assess vulnerabilities of existing COTS and OSS and propose needed updates Analyze existing designs, define and implement security improvements to the existing IFEC designs Must be able to create proof-of-concepts as necessary to demonstrate new ideas/technologies and architectural concepts Participate in detailed design and code reviews for compliance with the defined secured software architecture Ensure the software implementation is in line with the proposed software architecture and recommended design patterns Partner Product and Program Management teams to define and estimate the work scope of new projects and cybersecurity features Responsible for providing technical leadership to junior software engineers in the areas of software design and implementation
Minimum Requirements: Skills, Experience, Education, Technical/Specialized Knowledge, Certifications, Language
Required Education and Experience:
Area of study: Computer Science
Master degree in field with minimum 6 years of experience
6+ years of cybersecurity software development experience
OR
Bachelor degree in field with minimum 8 to 10 years of experience in IFE
6+ years of cybersecurity software development experience
Skills:
Expertise in cybersecurity features like Firewall, certificates/key/authentication management, SELinux, Antivirus
Fluent in Java, C, C++, shell scripting, networking protocols, audio video distribution, and database management
Expertise in Android Framework/Internals
Experience with the Linux operating system and SELinux
Experience in software design and development of Android and/or Linux-based systems following an industrial process
Knowledge of the Scrum development process and Continuous Integration practices and tools (e.g. Jenkins, Sonar, GIT, BitBucket, JIRA)
Very good knowledge of all phases of software development lifecycle: requirements analysis, design, implementation, code review, testing, and release
Self-motivated, critical thinker with strong technical background
Excellent verbal and written communication skills
Experience with IFEC systems is a plus

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.
Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber Digital sectors. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.
Position Summary
As a UI Engineer, you will build our digital product and services that power our Airline customers and continuously improve our engineering practices. You will design, implement and deploy applications and backend business services that will empower passenger experience for our Airline customers and build data analytical solutions for better monitoring and reporting capabilities for our operational support teams. You will be an individual contributor in a high visibility role, positioning you to deliver high impact at Thales Inflyt Experience digital engineering team and challenging you with learning opportunities that will help you grow and accelerate your career.
Essential Functions / Key Areas of Responsibility
Essential Duties and Responsibilities: DevOps Engineer, to design, develop and deploy, and take ownership for the applications and services that are owned by your team.
Design, develop and deploy Inflyt Experience digital solutions with focus on high availability and scalability.
Collaboration within agile teams of Engineers and Product Owners and UI Designers to build new product features
Expertise in QT / QML / Android experience
Collaborate closely with squad engineers and become a valued member of an autonomous, cross- functional squad.
Collaboration with CCoE team to improve the tooling, develop a safe, secure framework for fast deployment of Inflyt Experience digital solutions.
Be hands on and deliver on frontend applications and backend platform services.
Build and operate infrastructure, toolset and CI/CD pipelines.
Develop individually to continue to grow and provide training to individuals and other functional groups as needed
Continuously improve Inflyt Experience digital solutions by innovating on the services offered.

Include minimum experience qualifications, required proficiencies with specialized knowledge, computer proficiencies, etc.
Bachelor s degree with 4 - 7 Years experience.
Experience in C/C++ with Linux Platform.
Experience in web/mobile application development, networking, or systems software development.
Experience with Azure, AWS, Docker, CI tools, and configuration management tools.
Experience working with virtualization and clustered orchestration (Kubernetes).
Ability to asynchronous communication and able to work independently while always sharing context with your team members.
Preferred Qualifications
Have interest in working on front and back-end services as a Full Stack Engineer.
Experienced working with cloud native development, modern infrastructure and tools.
Experienced running software in DevOps environments.
Excellent problem-solving skills, and communication skills.
Experienced in agile software development and a culture of continuous improvement.

Job Position:
Associate Strategy&, Deals, PwC Acceleration Centre (pan-India, headquartered in Kolkata)
Brief Company Description:
PricewaterhouseCoopers (PwC) is a leading global consulting firm. For more than 160 years, PwC has
worked to build trust in society and solve important problems for clients and the communities in which we
live and work. Today we have more than 276,000 people across 157 countries working towards this goal.
The UK Advisory Kolkata Acceleration Centre (KAC) is a natural extension of our United Kingdom based
consulting capabilities, providing support to a broad range of practice teams. Our UK-owned ACs are fully
integrated into our client-facing teams and are key to PwCs success in the marketplace.
Job Overview:
This position is for an Associate to be part of a fast-growing Strategy& practice within our Advisory
Acceleration Centre.
Strategy& (S&) is our global strategy consulting business. It is a specialist team within PwC that
combines strategy consulting capabilities with leading industry and sector insights and know-how. The
team helps clients identify and build the capabilities essential to their advantage, and develop strategies
based on these capabilities.
S& serves four main go-to-market channels: Deal Execution (M&A), Post-Deal Value Creation, Portfolio
Companies, Corporate and Public Sector Clients (non-deals) across industries (including Technology,
Media, Telco, Consumer Products, Retail, Industrials, Professional Services, Energy, Financial Services,
Healthcare, Pharma).
The Deals channel is the largest channel for our UK team. Our work shapes the M&A landscape by
supporting private equity (PE) and corporate clients in developing investment perspectives and value
creation strategies that make a difference in the highly competitive M&A market.
We serve PE clients with over 2.5 trillion in assets under management, and publicly traded companies
with a combined market capitalisation of over 4 trillion. From initial investment strategy development to
commercial due diligence, value creation post-close and exit, were here to help our clients drive growth.
The S& Acceleration Centre in India is a specialist team within our broader PwC Kolkata Acceleration
Centre that plays a critical role working with the UK team in project preparation and executing, including
all responsibilities typically required of a UK-based team member from Experienced Associate to
Manager. This includes analysis, research, output creation, presentation and discussion.
Responsibilities include:

Work in a team setting on delivery modules such as competition benchmarking, survey
analysis, website scraping, customer and financial analysis, slide creation, industry research,
knowledge management, and more




Ability to build solid and collaborative relationships with team members
Proactively assist the team in various aspects of the client engagement
Contribute to the development of your own and teams technical and functional acumen
Uphold the firm's code of ethics and business conduct

Strong academic credentials, analytical ability and leadership skills

Business development client relationships

Originate, shape and close large consulting pursuits build the pipeline, lead proposal development, defend commercials and convert opportunities into signed engagements; carry a sales/origination target.
Develop point-of-view assets and thought leadership on upstream priorities such as production optimization, subsurface digitalization, decarbonization of operations and capital project excellence.


Delivery leadership

Provide subject-matter assurance on technical content spanning reservoir engineering, production engineering, field development planning, and upstream economics and business planning.
Ensure quality, risk management, profitability and on-time delivery across the portfolio; safeguard client outcomes and Accentures reputation.


People practice building
Build and lead high-performing teams; coach managers and consultants, and act as a career counsellor and role model.
Strengthen the upstream capability recruit specialist talent, develop assets and accelerators, and grow the practices domain depth.

Description:
The Team: The Centre of Excellence Accounting team within Corporate Controllers is responsible for accounting across S&P Global related to revenue and centralized accounting support across the income statement. The team values collaboration and the ability to think critically while problem solving.
  The Impact:  The individual will perform the revenue accruals, accounts receivable (AR) and deferred revenue postings and reconciliations along with maintenance of revenue accrual models. The individual should understand Order to Cash (OTC) reporting and reconciliation processes to perform their duties. This position will assist the Director, Centre of Excellence Accounting, for the recording of the month end close entries. The individual will also be helping with the ad hoc reporting, audit requests and ensuring adherence to our SOX policies and procedures related to AR and Revenue accounting.
  The role with assist with the calculation of complex revenue accruals impacting multiple business units across S&P Global. Accounting is dependent on extracting and using data from multiple sub-systems across the company that are organized and linked to calculation models that drive revenue accruals and customer invoicing.
  The candidate will perform general ledger control reconciliations and work closely with the Finance Business Unit / Corporate Controllers teams to complete the reconciliations meeting the reconciliation policy requirements. The candidate should be proactive in getting the reconciliation items cleared on a timely manner.
  Understand subsystems such as Oracle Cloud, AR modules and our legacy systems that impact revenue recognition to ensure overall end to end processes work continuously and effectively. Adhere to accounting, audit, systems controls, and procedures ensuring compliance with corporate policies and SOX controls. 
  What’s in it for you:
Opportunity to be part of S&P Global, a growing global organization that powers the markets of the future.
Join a global accounting team and work alongside local and international staff, as well as third party teams such as OTC and all global business units to achieve team and company objectives. 
To work in the latest cutting-edge technologies and systems including our initiatives into automation and lean Six Sigma projects.
  Responsibilities:
Calculation of complex revenue accruals using data from multiple sub-systems across S&P Global.
Review and analyse contracts to determine appropriate revenue recognition treatment.
Conduct in-depth analysis of revenue trends, variances, comparisons to forecasts and reporting to internal FP&A teams.
Assist in the monthly accounting close process by preparing accrual journal entries based on US GAAP standards, financial reporting requirements and balance sheet account reconciliations.
Prepare dashboards to communicate revenue performance to stakeholders.
Work closely with OTC and FP&A team members within the S&P Global Corporate Controllers team.
Engage actively in the transition of new business and create standard operating procedures (SOPs) as required.
Assist in internal and external audits by providing necessary documentation and explanations related to revenue accounting.
Use broader knowledge of financial principles and theories to continually improve processes.
Provide training and support to team members on revenue recognition policies and procedures.
Interact and collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Sales, Operations, and Finance, to gather relevant data and insights.
Analyse and resolve issues timely and efficiently while ensuring SOX compliance is imperative.
  Qualifications:
4-6 years of revenue accounting experience preferred.
College level accounting degree preferred.
Strong understanding of U.S. GAAP and revenue recognition principles (ASC 606).
Experience with Oracle and the willingness to learn data management tools like Alteryx and Tableau.
Comfortable working with large data sets and able to interpret and analyse data accurately and efficiently.
Ability to understand and follow complex process and identify possible areas for improvement and automation.
Proficient in Microsoft Excel skills such as utilising pivot tables and formulas.
Experience in Alteryx or databases an advantage.
Willingness to learn new systems and legacy systems at a fast pace.
Excellent oral and written communication skills are required.
Ability to interact and collaborate with internal and external customers at all levels of management and staff globally. 
High degree of accuracy and ability to manage heavy workloads; understanding of contributions to the overall end to end process. 
Knowledge of all Microsoft Office products specifically Outlook, Excel and Word.
Must be assertive and proactive on resolving issues, ability to multi-task in a fast paced and dynamic environment.
Must be adaptable to working in the US time zone to meet transition requirements.
  This is an UK Hours role and will require you to work on-site.

Description:
The Team: The Centre of Excellence Accounting team within Corporate Controllers is responsible for accounting across SP Global related to revenue and centralized accounting support across the income statement. The team values collaboration and the ability to think critically while problem solving.
The Impact: The individual will perform the revenue accruals, accounts receivable (AR) and deferred revenue postings and reconciliations along with maintenance of revenue accrual models. The individual should understand Order to Cash (OTC) reporting and reconciliation processes to perform their duties. This position will assist the Director, Centre of Excellence Accounting, for the recording of the month end close entries. The individual will also be helping with the ad hoc reporting, audit requests and ensuring adherence to our SOX policies and procedures related to AR and Revenue accounting.
The role with assist with the calculation of complex revenue accruals impacting multiple business units across SP Global. Accounting is dependent on extracting and using data from multiple sub-systems across the company that are organized and linked to calculation models that drive revenue accruals and customer invoicing.
The candidate will perform general ledger control reconciliations and work closely with the Finance Business Unit / Corporate Controllers teams to complete the reconciliations meeting the reconciliation policy requirements. The candidate should be proactive in getting the reconciliation items cleared on a timely manner.
Understand subsystems such as Oracle Cloud, AR modules and our legacy systems that impact revenue recognition to ensure overall end to end processes work continuously and effectively. Adhere to accounting, audit, systems controls, and procedures ensuring compliance with corporate policies and SOX controls.
What s in it for you:
Opportunity to be part of SP Global, a growing global organization that powers the markets of the future.
Join a global accounting team and work alongside local and international staff, as well as third party teams such as OTC and all global business units to achieve team and company objectives.
To work in the latest cutting-edge technologies and systems including our initiatives into automation and lean Six Sigma projects.
Responsibilities:
Calculation of complex revenue accruals using data from multiple sub-systems across SP Global.
Review and analyse contracts to determine appropriate revenue recognition treatment.
Conduct in-depth analysis of revenue trends, variances, comparisons to forecasts and reporting to internal FPA teams.
Assist in the monthly accounting close process by preparing accrual journal entries based on US GAAP standards, financial reporting requirements and balance sheet account reconciliations.
Prepare dashboards to communicate revenue performance to stakeholders.
Work closely with OTC and FPA team members within the SP Global Corporate Controllers team.
Engage actively in the transition of new business and create standard operating procedures (SOPs) as required.
Assist in internal and external audits by providing necessary documentation and explanations related to revenue accounting.
Use broader knowledge of financial principles and theories to continually improve processes.
Provide training and support to team members on revenue recognition policies and procedures.
Interact and collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Sales, Operations, and Finance, to gather relevant data and insights.
Analyse and resolve issues timely and efficiently while ensuring SOX compliance is imperative.
Qualifications:
4-6 years of revenue accounting experience preferred.
College level accounting degree preferred.
Strong understanding of U.S. GAAP and revenue recognition principles (ASC 606).
Experience with Oracle and the willingness to learn data management tools like Alteryx and Tableau.
Comfortable working with large data sets and able to interpret and analyse data accurately and efficiently.
Ability to understand and follow complex process and identify possible areas for improvement and automation.
Proficient in Microsoft Excel skills such as utilising pivot tables and formulas.
Experience in Alteryx or databases an advantage.
Willingness to learn new systems and legacy systems at a fast pace.
Excellent oral and written communication skills are required.
Ability to interact and collaborate with internal and external customers at all levels of management and staff globally.
High degree of accuracy and ability to manage heavy workloads; understanding of contributions to the overall end to end process.
Knowledge of all Microsoft Office products specifically Outlook, Excel and Word.
Must be assertive and proactive on resolving issues, ability to multi-task in a fast paced and dynamic environment.
Must be adaptable to working in the US time zone to meet transition requirements.
This is an UK Hours role and will require you to work on-site.

Description:
About WTW
Willis Towers Watson (NASDAQ: WLTW) is a leading global advisory, broking and solutions company that helps clients around the world turn risk into a path for growth. With roots dating to 1828, Willis Towers Watson has 45,000 employees serving more than 140 countries and markets.
We design and deliver solutions that manage risk, optimize benefits, cultivate talent, and expand the power of capital to protect and strengthen institutions and individuals. Our unique perspective allows us to see the critical intersections between talent, assets and ideas the dynamic formula that drives business performance.
Together, we unlock potential.

About the team
Our Health & Benefits Sales team specializes in partnering with corporate clients to design, place, and implement comprehensive employee benefit solutions that support workforce wellbeing and business resilience.
We focus on acquiring and advising mid to large corporate clients across a broad spectrum of Health & Benefits products, including Medical, Accident & Disability, Term Life, Business Travel, and other employee wellbeing solutions. Our approach combines deep market knowledge, consultative selling, and strong insurer partnerships to deliver tailored, costeffective, and compliant benefit programs.

Role
The team works closely with clients to understand their workforce demographics, risk profile, and organizational goals, enabling us to recommend solutions that enhance employee value propositions while supporting longterm business sustainability. From initial prospecting and solution design to negotiations, placement, and onboarding, we provide endtoend support throughout the client acquisition journey.
With a strong emphasis on collaboration, datadriven insights, and client experience, our team plays a critical role in driving growth within the Health & Benefits portfolio while helping organizations build healthier, more engaged, and futureready workforces.

Requirement
MBA/ Bachelors degree or equivalent work experience in related field
4-15 years’ experience in health and benefits sales.
Demonstrated achievement in B2B sales.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including facilitation of group presentations.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Access and industry-specific analysis software.
Basic understanding of the insurance industry, with the ability to become a subject matter expert on the job.
Innovation and problem-solving skills that include the ability to develop and propose equipment-based solutions for clients.
Application Process
Step 1 - Online application and recruiter review
Step 2 - Live video/ in-person interview with hiring manager and team
Step 3 - Offer and onboarding
We’re committed to equal employment opportunity and provide application, interview and workplace adjustments and accommodations to all applicants. If you foresee any barriers, from the application process through to joining WTW, please email candidatehelpdesk@wtwco.com.

Description:
We are looking for an application DevOps engineer to join the technology team, responsible for developing and supporting regulatory risk solutions across fixed income, currencies, commodities and equities. The role will focus on managing and improving a large-scale risk calculation plant used for end-of-day and on-demand risk generation, with emphasis on production stability, application resiliency, capacity management, tooling and regulatory compliance.
The member will work closely with globally dispersed developers, DevOps, release management, Quartz DevOps, Technology Infrastructure and business-aligned risk teams to support scalable risk reporting and generation services. The environment is primarily Quartz, the next generation trading and risk platform, with development taking place largely in Python and some C++ for high-performance components.
Responsibilities include:
- Providing DevOps expertise and leadership for effective management of application infrastructure and large risk plants
- Supporting end-of-day and on-demand risk generation, with a focus on stability, resiliency and operational control
- Planning and executing failovers in line with application and infrastructure requirements
- Collaborating with various stakeholders , Quartz DevOps and Technology Infrastructure on weekday and weekend activities
- Improving tooling, monitoring and automation to support production stability and reduce manual operational effort
- Acting as a regional point of contact as the technology capability expands globally
Required:
- Experience in Python or equivalent programming languages, with ability to build and support automation, tooling and operational improvements
- Practical experience in software development, testing, deployment and production support using agile development methodologies
- Understanding of large-scale application plants, including capacity management, resiliency, failover and operational stability
- Ability to compartmentalise complex problems and propose practical, controlled solutions for production environments
- Strong problem-solving, analytical and troubleshooting skills across application, infrastructure and batch processing issues
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with ability to work effectively across technology, infrastructure and business stakeholders
- Experience working as part of a high-performance team on high-priority deliverables
- Self-motivated, proactive and comfortable taking ownership of production stability and operational outcomes
Preferred:
- Experience in the Financial Services industry, ideally with risk, trading, market risk or regulatory reporting platforms
- Knowledge of Quartz or similar large-scale trading and risk platforms
- Experience with continuous integration, deployment pipelines, monitoring, alerting and production automation
- Grasp of system design and architecture, especially for resilient, scalable and operationally controlled platforms
- Front office or production support background with motivation to grow further into DevOps, Python engineering and platform ownership

Description:
Role & responsibilities

Restaurant Partner Management: Manage a portfolio of restaurant partners and act as the primary point of contact.
Business Growth: Drive order growth, revenue, conversion, and overall business performance for assigned restaurants.
Partner Performance: Track key metrics such as orders, GMV, cancellations, ratings, customer complaints, and restaurant availability.
Restaurant Success: Identify performance gaps and recommend actions to improve visibility, orders, menu conversion, and customer experience.
Relationship Management: Build strong relationships with restaurant owners/management and understand their business challenges.
Promotions & Campaigns: Drive participation in relevant Swiggy campaigns, offers, discounts, and promotional programs.
Menu & Catalogue Management: Ensure menus, pricing, images, availability, and other restaurant information are accurate and optimized.
Issue Resolution: Coordinate with internal teams to resolve operational, payment, technology, or customer-related issues faced by restaurant partners.
Data Analysis: Use business data and dashboards to identify trends, opportunities, and underperforming restaurants.
Competition & Market Insights: Monitor competitor activity, pricing, offers, and market trends to provide actionable recommendations.
Retention: Reduce partner churn and improve engagement by proactively addressing partner concerns.
Cross-functional Coordination: Work with Operations, Sales, Marketing, Support, Finance, and Product/Tech teams to resolve issues and improve restaurant performance.
Target Achievement: Deliver assigned revenue, order, retention, and partner-engagement targets.



Preferred candidate profile

15 years of experience in account management, sales, business development, partner management, or customer success.
Experience managing B2B/B2C clients or merchant/restaurant partners.
Strong data analysis and Excel/Google Sheets skills.
Good understanding of revenue, sales, conversion, retention and growth metrics.
Strong communication and negotiation skills.
Ability to handle multiple restaurant partners and work in a target-driven environment.
Experience in food-tech, e-commerce, marketplace, SaaS, retail, or hospitality would be an advantage.
AboutCompany: Swiggy is an Indian online food ordering and delivery company. Founded in 2014, Swiggy is headquartered in Bangalore and operates in more than 580 Indian cities, as of July 2023.[4] Besides food delivery, the platform also provides quick commerce services under the name Swiggy Instamart, and same-day package deliveries with Swiggy Genie.
CompanyAddress: 6th Floor, Tower 1 Sumadhura Capitol Towers Sy. No. 14 & 158, Pattandur Agrahara Village Whitefield, Bengaluru Bengaluru Urban, Karnataka – 560066, BANGALORE, Karnataka, India
