Description:
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Youll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Servicessolving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
As a SAP MM- SA, you will specialize in providing consulting services for SAP supply chain and operations applications. You will analyze client needs, implement software solutions, and offer training and support for seamless integration and utilization of SAP supply chain and operations applications. Working in this area, you will enable clients to optimize their supply chain processes, improve operational efficiency, and achieve their strategic objectives. As a Senior Associate, you will focus on building meaningful client connections and learning how to manage and inspire others. You will navigate increasingly complex situations, growing your personal brand and deepening your technical skills. You are expected to anticipate the needs of your teams and clients, and to deliver quality. Embracing increased ambiguity, you will be comfortable when the path forward isn’t clear, using these moments as opportunities to grow.
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will leverage your skills within our Business Application Consulting practice to deliver impactful solutions. You will use a broad range of tools, methodologies, and techniques to generate new ideas and solve problems, while upholding professional and technical standards. This position offers a dynamic environment where you can develop a deeper understanding of the business context and how it is evolving.
Responsibilities
- Analyzing client needs to implement SAP supply chain and operations solutions effectively
- Providing training and support for seamless integration and utilization of SAP applications
- Optimizing supply chain processes to improve operational efficiency and achieve strategic objectives
- Navigating complex situations to build meaningful client connections and inspire team members
- Utilizing critical thinking to break down complex concepts and generate data-driven insights
- Developing a deeper understanding of business context and adapting to changes
- Managing project resources and budgets to validate timely delivery of solutions
- Implementing procurement strategies and systems to enhance cost management and efficiency
- Coordinating supply chain transformation initiatives to drive operational excellence
- Validating data integrity and compliance within supply chain management frameworks
What You Must Have
- At least a Bachelor's degree
- At least 5 years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required

Description:
Role: Manager
Experience: 10-18 years
Summary about Organization
A career in Managed Services at PwC offers unparalleled opportunities to excel in the field of global delivery capabilities. With PwC's leading expertise and resources, you can refine and strengthen your skills while making a significant impact in delivering exceptional services to clients worldwide. The team consists of highly skilled resources that can assist in the areas of helping clients transform their business by adopting technology using bespoke strategy, operating model, processes and planning. Youll be at the forefront of helping organizations around the globe adopt innovative technology solutions that optimize business processes or enable scalable technology. Our team helps organizations transform their IT infrastructure, modernize applications and data management to help shape the future of business.
An essential and strategic part of Advisory's multi-sourced, multi-geography Global Delivery Model, the Acceleration Centers are a dynamic, rapidly growing component of our business. The teams out of these Centers have achieved remarkable results in process quality and delivery capability, resulting in a loyal customer base and a reputation for excellence.
Job Description
Job responsibilities mainly include activities driven towards delivering results, SAM capability transformation, License Cost Benchmarking and Usage Tracking, SAM Tool implementation, work directly with project teams and facilitate meetings to enable decision making, organize and prepare recommendations to optimum use of technology.
Position Requirements:
Knowledge Preferred
As part of PwCs Managed Services practice, the Service Management and Operations capability helps our clients run their business through innovative technology solutions and effective Service Management Operations. Part of that journey includes helping our clients enable innovation, reinventing their customer experience, and exploring new markets.
We aim in providing excellence in following areas-
Architecture & Automation:
Enterprise Architecture – EA function, Component and Information Architecture
Automation – Process Optimization, BPM, Low Code, EC
Operations & Technology Resilience:
Operation Resilience and Disaster Recovery
Resilient Infrastructure
Cloud Ops and Resilience Control Framework
Systems Modernization & Technical Delivery:
Systems Modernization
Modern Delivery Solutions – Agile Consulting, Product Management; DevOps Consulting
Technical Delivery
Service Management & Operations:
FinOps & IT Asset Management
Intelligent Operations
Core ServiceNow Transformation & SM&O Technology Implementation
Skills & Competencies
Demonstrates intimate-level abilities and/or a proven record of success with:
Leading large scale Software Asset Management frameworks at Enterprise level
Designing and implementing software asset management processes, tools, and operating model to effectively manage the lifecycle of software asset license compliance.
Defining the requirements as a Product Owner for the implementation and managed service operation of Software Asset Management tools specifically Service SAMPro or Flexera or SNOW, including integrations with discovery sources.
Reviewing and interpreting software contracts including enterprise agreements, subscriptions and , support contracts for top publishers
Developing and maintaining entitlement license positions for software publishers
Conducting SAM data validation and supporting planning and preparation for publisher renewals
Managing hardware and software asset lifecycle processes and identify opportunities for optimization, savings, and risk mitigation.
Understanding of discovery and inventory tooling capabilities
Ability to provide experience and guidance to Application Rationalization
Act as a subject matter expert and provide training, coaching, and support to team members and stakeholders on SAM processes, tools, and compliance requirements.
Broad IT Asset Management and ITSM experience
Big 4 experience is preferred.
Demonstrates intimate-level abilities and/or a proven record of success in the following areas:
Identifying and developing opportunities to assist clients with organizational maturity.
Bringing together the right perspectives, identify roadblocks, and integrate feedback from clients and team members.
Managing delivery from project scoping to conclusion, while consistently keeping the client’s goals in mind.
Having a passion for developing and growing team members.
Communicating complex information simply.
Finding yourself in the role of advisor and peer to others.
Approaching new projects with an open mind.
Believing empathy for coworkers and customers is key to your success.
Valuing learning from mistakes and asking for help when needed.
Persevering through challenges.
Ability to multi-task and prioritize with great initiative and can-do attitude.
Ability to grasp innovative technologies quickly.
Believing in the value created by diverse teams and can adapt to a variety of working styles.
Developing thought leadership materials to further your knowledge and create new relationships.
Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in IT, Computer Science, or related field.
Minimum 10 years of experience.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
Ability to work independently, prioritize tasks, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
Work location:
Anywhere in USA
Certification Preferred:
ITIL 4 & CSAM Certification (IAITAM)
ServiceNow Certification(s)
Flexera Certification(s)
SNOW Certification(s)

Description:
Position Summary:
If you are a Project Pursuit professional Iooking for an opportunity to grow your career, Emerson has an exciting opportunity for you! Based in Delhi, Bengaluru, Mumbai, or Chennai, India, you will play a pivotal role in shaping early-stage project success by engaging with Global Engineering Centers (GECs) and Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) organizations. This role focuses on building strong, trusted relationships and positioning Emersons Measurement Solutions portfolio within engineering standards, specifications, and project requirements before procurement begins. You will contribute directly to business growth by influencing project design decisions, strengthening customer partnerships, and enabling innovative, value-driven solutions across industries.
In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:
Build and sustain strategic relationships with Global Engineering Centers and EPC stakeholders to position Emerson as a preferred partner.
Drive early engagement in project lifecycles to embed Measurement Solutions products into specifications, standards, and material requisitions.
Develop and execute structured account plans, including stakeholder mapping, project pipeline tracking, and qualification strategies.
Collaborate across global teams, including sales, marketing, product, and strategic account teams, to align pursuit strategies and deliver customer value.
Lead technical discussions, workshops, and training sessions to build customer capability and strengthen product adoption.
Maintain accurate and up-to-date project and account information in CRM tools to support data-driven decision-making and forecasting.
Provide insights on market trends, competitive positioning, and customer needs to inform strategy and innovation.
Monitor and improve key performance indicators, including specification success rate, pipeline growth, and customer engagement outcomes.
Develop and execute training plans for assigned Global Engineering Center, delivering awareness, application, and advanced technical training tailored to client seniority and discipline mix. Leverage Emerson’s training organization, Application Specialists, and Product Marketing. Position training as a strategic specification and preference tool. Track execution and measure outcomes including specification activity, stakeholder coverage, and client feedback.
Partner with Global Strategic Account teams to align pursuit strategies, commercial positioning, and stakeholder messaging for shared accounts. Regularly share account and project pipeline updates and support the execution of global approved vendor list qualification, Global Frame Agreement utilization, and licensor engagement activities at the local Global Engineering Center level.
AboutCompany:
Emerson is a global leader in automation technology and software. Through our deep domain expertise and legacy of flawless execution, Emerson helps customers in critical industries like life sciences, energy, power and renewables, chemical and advanced factory automation operate more sustainably while improving productivity, energy security and reliability.
With global operations and a comprehensive portfolio of software and technology, we are helping companies implement digital transformation to measurably improve their operations, conserve valuable resources and enhance their safety.
We offer equitable opportunities, celebrate diversity, and embrace challenges with confidence that, together, we can make an impact across a broad spectrum of countries and industries. Whether youre an established professional looking for a career change, an undergraduate student exploring possibilities, or a recent graduate with an advanced degree, youll find your chance to make a difference with Emerson. Join our team – let’s go!

Description:
Responsibilities
- Lead evaluation, benchmarking, and implementation of scalable, secure, and compliant Agentic AI frameworks aligned with enterprise business use cases and organizational strategies.
- Drive technical standardization and maturity in Generative and Agentic AI development by creating reusable orchestration blueprints, prompt engineering guides, best practices, and integration patterns to ensure consistent delivery in complex programs.
- Define scalable multi-agent system design patterns including tool usage, memory management, task routing, agent communication, human-in-the-loop processes, and orchestration frameworks.
- Establish evaluation frameworks to assess Agentic AI solution performance, focusing on reasoning, tool reliability, task completion, hallucination mitigation, and autonomous decision quality for production readiness and continuous improvement.
- Design enterprise Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures optimizing retrieval processes, embeddings, chunking, and reranking aligned with business goals and data governance, while mentoring AI engineering teams and collaborating with stakeholders to translate objectives into AI roadmaps.
- Manage client engagements including discovery, demos, proposal development, and delivery planning, leveraging strong DevOps, LLMOps, containerization, and CI/CD pipeline expertise to ensure successful, trusted partnerships and stay updated on Agentic AI and Generative AI advancements.
What You Must Have
- Bachelor's & Master's Degree in computer science, Data Science, or a related field
- 12+ years of experience in technical/technology roles
- Oral and written proficiency in English required
What Sets You Apart
- Proven experience with enterprise cloud AI platforms like Azure AI Foundry (with Microsoft Fabric and Purview), Amazon Bedrock (with Knowledge Bases and Guardrails), and Google Vertex AI (with BigQuery and Agentspace) for building, governing, and deploying scalable production-grade Gen AI and Agentic AI solutions.
- Hands-on expertise with leading agentic and AI orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, or equivalents for AI workflow automation and orchestration.
- In-depth knowledge of vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus, Azure AI Search) and their application in enterprise Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) and knowledge retrieval systems.
- Experience designing and scaling AI solutions that utilize multi-modal capabilities across text, vision, audio, and document understanding to enhance AI functionality.
- Familiarity with AI governance and observability platforms (e.g., LangSmith, Arize) to enable monitoring, tracing, debugging, and compliance of production AI systems, along with expertise in selecting appropriate LLMs (GPT, Claude, Gemini, etc.) based on enterprise cost, latency, and compliance requirements.
- Knowledge of AI-powered development tools (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Windsurf) to improve engineering productivity and facilitate large-scale AI-driven software development

Description:
Roles and Responsibilities :
Key Purpose of the Role
The Head of IT Infrastructure & Security will:
Lead the enterprise IT strategy and technology roadmap.
Manage infrastructure, cloud platforms, cybersecurity, workplace technology, and IT operations.
Drive digital transformation, cloud modernization, automation, and AI adoption.
Ensure business continuity, regulatory compliance, and operational resilience.
Partner with business leaders to align technology investments with organizational goals. 

Core Areas of Responsibility
1. Technology & Infrastructure Leadership
Develop and execute enterprise IT strategy.
Modernize infrastructure and establish technology standards.
Provide technology recommendations to senior management. 
2. Infrastructure & Operations
Own end-to-end IT infrastructure operations.
Ensure high availability, reliability, scalability, and performance.
Drive automation, monitoring, and operational excellence. 
3. Cloud Transformation
Lead cloud migrations across AWS, Azure, and hybrid environments.
Establish cloud governance, security, and FinOps practices.
Optimize cloud costs and performance.
4. Cybersecurity Leadership
Strengthen enterprise security posture.
Oversee SIEM/SOC, IAM, PAM, DLP, EDR/XDR, Microsoft Security, Cloud Security, and Zero Trust initiatives.
Manage incident response, vulnerability management, and security governance. 
5. AI & Innovation
Champion adoption of Generative AI solutions such as Microsoft Copilot and enterprise AI platforms.
Identify high-value AI use cases and drive implementation.
Promote AI governance, productivity enhancement, and automation. 
6. IT Service Management
Establish ITIL-based service delivery processes.
Improve user experience, service quality, and operational KPIs.
Implement self-service and AI-enabled support models. 
7. Governance, Risk & Resilience
Own IT governance, compliance, audits, business continuity, and disaster recovery.
Define risk frameworks and ensure adherence to security and data privacy standards.
8. Vendor & Budget Management
Manage technology vendors, contracts, licensing, and procurement.
Control infrastructure and security budgets while driving cost optimization. 
Ideal Candidate Profile
15+ years of experience across IT Infrastructure, Security, Cloud, and Operations leadership.
Strong expertise in AWS/Azure, cybersecurity frameworks, ITSM, identity management, and enterprise technology transformation.
Proven experience managing large-scale enterprise environments and strategic vendor relationships.
Exposure to Generative AI and enterprise AI adoption programs is highly preferred.
Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CCSP, ITIL, PMP, AWS, or Azure are advantageous.

Description:
Role & responsibilities

HCP Engagement- Contracting - Experienced Associate: Skillset :

1) 2+ year Experience in contract management, legal operations, or HCP/HCO engagement within healthcare, life sciences, or consulting
2) Strong understanding of compliance and regulatory frameworks related to HCP/HCO contracting (e.g., Sunshine Act, Anti-Kickback Statute)
3) Demonstrated ability to manage high volumes of contracts with precision and attention to detail. 
4) Experience with standard contract templates, redlining processes, and amendment management
5) Familiarity with contract lifecycle management systems or similar tools (e.g., Icertis, Conga, Veeva, SAP Ariba, Salesforce, DocuSign).


Preferred candidate profile

Job location: Bangalore, Hyderabad, Gurugram only

Flexible for work timings including US timings

Flexible for complete 5 days work from office mode

Exp range: 2 year to 4.6 year
AboutCompany: At PwC, our people in business application consulting specialise in consulting services for a variety of business applications, helping clients optimise operational efficiency. These individuals analyse client needs, implement software solutions, and provide training and support for seamless integration and utilisation of business applications, enabling clients to achieve their strategic objectives.

Description:
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Youll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Servicessolving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
As a SAP - SAC - Manager, you will specialize in providing consulting services for data and analytics solutions using SAP technologies. You will analyze client requirements, design and implement data management and analytics solutions, and provide training and support for effective utilization of SAP data and analytics tools. Within our Digital Core Modernisation practice, you will work closely with clients to understand their data needs, develop data models, perform data analysis, and create visualizations and reports to support data-driven decision-making, helping them optimize their data management processes, enhance data quality, and derive valuable insights from their data to achieve their strategic objectives.
As a Manager, you will lead teams and manage client accounts, focusing on strategic planning and mentoring junior staff. You are accountable for project success and maintaining standards. Enhancing your leadership style, you motivate, develop, and inspire others to deliver quality. You are responsible for coaching, leveraging team members' unique strengths, and managing performance to deliver on client expectations. With your growing knowledge of how business works, you play an important role in identifying opportunities that contribute to the success of our Firm. You are expected to lead with integrity and authenticity, articulating our purpose and values in a meaningful way.
Responsibilities
- Leading the design and implementation of SAP data management and analytics solutions to meet client needs
- Analyzing client requirements and developing data models to support data-driven decision-making
- Guiding teams in the integration and utilization of SAP Analytics Cloud and SAP BW/4HANA
- Overseeing the creation of data visualizations and reports to enhance client insights
- Managing project timelines and deliverables to align with client expectations
- Coaching team members to leverage their strengths and improve performance
- Collaborating with clients to optimize data management processes and enhance data quality
- Utilizing data analysis software to perform complex data analysis and derive valuable insights
- Promoting the adoption of innovative technologies and practices within data and analytics teams
- Confirming data security and compliance within analytics frameworks
What You Must Have
- At least a Bachelor's degree
- At least 9-13 years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required

We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
As a SAP Analytics - SAC - Senior Associate, you will specialize in providing consulting services for data and analytics solutions using SAP technologies. You will analyze client requirements, design and implement data management and analytics solutions, and provide training and support for effective utilization of SAP data and analytics tools. Within our Digital Core Modernisation practice, you will work closely with clients to understand their data needs, develop data models, perform data analysis, and create visualizations and reports to support data-driven decision-making, helping them optimize their data management processes, enhance data quality, and derive valuable insights from their data to achieve their strategic objectives.
As a Senior Associate, you will focus on building meaningful client connections and learning how to manage and inspire others. Navigating increasingly complex situations, you are growing your personal brand, deepening technical skills, and awareness of your strengths. You are expected to anticipate the needs of your teams and clients, and to deliver quality. Embracing increased ambiguity, you are comfortable when the path forward isn’t clear, you ask questions, and you use these moments as opportunities to grow. In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will leverage your skills to deliver impactful solutions and foster a culture of continuous improvement.
Responsibilities
- Analyzing client requirements to design and implement SAP data management and analytics solutions
- Developing data models and performing complex data analysis to support data-driven decision-making
- Creating visualizations and reports using SAP Analytics Cloud and SAP BusinessObjects BI
- Collaborating with clients to optimize data management processes and enhance data quality
- Providing training and support for effective utilization of SAP data and analytics tools
- Integrating SAP data solutions to streamline business operations and improve efficiency
- Conducting data migration and data integration tasks using SAP Data Intelligence Cloud
- Implementing data quality improvement plans to maintain data integrity and security
- Utilizing data analysis software to derive valuable insights and inform strategic objectives
- Navigating complex situations to build meaningful client relationships and deliver quality solutions
What You Must Have
- At least a Bachelor's degree
- At least 5 years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required

Job Title: Collections & Recovery Workout, Associate
Location: Bangalore, India
Role Description
Collectors & Recovery Workout is responsible for administering, designing, and ensuring compliance with collections processes. Typically for private customers (i. e. accounts, loans & mortgages) as well as small business customers (small corps i. e. limited liability Comp, private partnership, etc. ) with mostly automation/standardization processes (high coverage ratio).
What we ll offer you
As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you ll enjoy,
Best in class leave policy.
Gender neutral parental leaves
100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
Accident and Term life Insurance
Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above
Your key responsibilities
Work includes
Following up overdue accounts (e. g. , initiating demand letters, outbound phone calls to delinquent accounts, external debt collection, etc. )
Resolving operational setup/logistics issues with the support of divisional functions to ensure continuity
Supervising all operative processes related to the collection of incoming fund transfers and their correct accounting.

Our clients are leading MNC & Industrial Conglomerates (AUTOMOBILES, FMCG, CONSUMER DURABLES, MANAUFACTURING, RETAIL, EPC, INFRASTRUCTURE (POWER, ENERGY, OIL & GAS, PORTS), INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY, BPO, PHARMA & TELECOM with a Turnover of US $ 1 Bn to US $ 100 Bn with exponential growth potential. Our client’s reach span across several countries across the globe.

PERFECT PLACER (www.perfectplacer.com), Promoted by a team of dedicated professionals with varied background, having comprehensive and extensive industry and consultancy exposure, is “One of the most preferred and referred consultants” today in Executive Search & Placement.

PERFECT PLACER in less than half a decade has grown to be a force to reckon with, having offices in Mumbai, Chennai, Bangalore, and New Delhi.

Perfect Placer along with its associate services has a long and prestigious list of leading Indian and Multinational Corporates in India and Outside across Managerial levels, functions, and Industries, covering both IT and Non-IT specialized in chief executive, board member and senior-level management search assignments.

Head of Marketing (Accounting BPO)
You will be responsible for leading the marketing department to build brand awareness, brand positioning in the financial outsourcing space, global demand generation to attract enterprise clients and scale outsourcing contracts, client acquisition strategies tailored to financial outsourcing services and drive revenue growth.
Key Responsibilities
Strategy & Planning:
F Define the firm’s marketing vision, build annual plans, and align marketing goals with firm leadership. Design and execute global B2B marketing strategies to drive qualified leads for bookkeeping, tax processing, and financial reporting services.
F Position the firm as an industry leader in efficiency and innovation across international markets.
F Develop comprehensive annual marketing and brand strategies specific to BPO and Accounting/CPA support services.
F Position the company effectively against key competitors, highlighting value propositions like cost efficiency, data security, and scalability.
Demand Generation & Lead Funnel:
F Oversee SEO, content marketing and email automation.
F Own digital campaigns and lead generation targets (MQLs and SQLs) working in tight alignment with the global sales and business development teams.
F Own Implement ABM (Account-Based Marketing) campaigns targeting CFOs, Finance Directors, and CPA firm partners in international markets (US, UK, etc.).
F Design inbound and outbound campaigns to attract companies looking for accounting services, or back-office outsourcing.
Brand Positioning:
F Guide brand messaging and market differentiation specifically tailored to the accounting and professional services industry.
F Analyse competitor positioning, client demographics, and spending behaviours in the financial and accounting sector.
F Develop core brand positioning, taglines, and communication frameworks that resonate with ideal clients.
F Work with teams to ensure brand consistency across digital and print channels.
F Measure brand awareness, client perception metrics, and inbound conversion quality.
Digital & Content Leadership:
F Oversee digital marketing operations including SEO, SEM, paid media, and social channels (especially LinkedIn).
F Direct thought-leadership content creation (whitepapers, case studies, ROI calculators, and webinars) focused on bookkeeping, tax processing, data security, accuracy, cost-efficiency and financial compliance services
Budget & Analytics:
F Manage the marketing budget, agency relationships, and marketing tech stack (HubSpot, Google Analytics, CRM integrations and track ROI to demonstrate the value of marketing activities.
F Allocate funds across digital channels, industry events and PR.
Events & Industry Relations:
F Lead participation in virtual/in-person financial summits, accounting expos, and BPO forums.
F Manage analyst relations and public relations to build market credibility.
Team Leadership:
F Manage digital marketing, sales support, and content teams, conducting regular reviews of the client pipeline.
Partner with the sales team to create high-impact proposals, whitepapers, case studies, and pitch decks

Preferred candidate profile
1. MBA with 10+ years in BPO or ITES or professional accounting financial services.
2. with deep understanding of accounting workflows, financial outsourcing markets, and international compliance standards.
3. Deep familiarity with Finance and Accounting (F&A) outsourcing workflows, US/UK accounting standards, or working with CPA firms is a strong plus.
4. Expertise in SEO, CRM systems, content management platforms, data analytics, marketing automation platforms (HubSpot/Marketo), and enterprise lead generation
5. Understanding of accounting trends, regulatory shifts, and B2B client acquisition strategies.
6. Experience managing cold-calling teams and warm-lead conversion processes.
7. Strong commercial understanding with the ability to connect marketing activity to revenue.
8. Experience working across multiple businesses, products or customer segments.
9. Exposure to professional services, accounting, SaaS, technology, education or financial services would be advantageous.
10. Exceptional English verbal and written communication skills to present to global clients.

Remuneration:
An outstanding remuneration package that rewards professionalism and diligence will be on offer for the successful applicant as well as a well-defined career path. An excellent package will be on offer for the right candidate, including an above-mentioned industry base salary for the right person as well as the most complete employee benefit scheme. Don't miss out on this opportunity to join the market leader.

Job Title: Senior Associate Strategy& (Deals)
Location: Gurugram
Company: PwC Acceleration Centre

About PwC:

PricewaterhouseCoopers (PwC) is a leading global consulting firm with over 160 years of experience, working across 157 countries to build trust and solve complex problems for clients and communities worldwide. The UK Advisory Kolkata Acceleration Centre (KAC) is an integral part of our UK-based consulting operations, providing critical support to various practice teams and contributing to PwC’s global success.

Role Overview:

We are looking for a Senior Associate to join our fast-growing Strategy& practice within the PwC Advisory Acceleration Centre. Strategy& is PwC’s global strategy consulting business that combines deep industry insights with strategic expertise to help clients build competitive advantages and create effective growth strategies.
This role is focused on Deal Execution (M&A) and supporting private equity and corporate clients through commercial due diligence, investment strategy development, and value creation. The Senior Associate will work closely with UK-based teams, managing analysis, research, and client deliverables for high-impact projects across industries such as Technology, Media, Telecom, Consumer Products, Healthcare, Pharma, and more.

Key Responsibilities:

Conduct and review commercial due diligence modules including competition benchmarking, survey analysis, web scraping, and financial/customer analysis.
Lead day-to-day project deliverables, problem-solving, and work planning while ensuring accuracy and quality.
Collaborate effectively with UK Strategy& teams to support client engagements.
Assist with onboarding and training of new team members.
Develop your own and the team’s technical and functional skills.
Apply critical thinking to solve complex, unstructured commercial problems.
Support practice development through proposal responses, client interactions, and knowledge sharing.
Leverage new technologies including generative AI (genAI) and automation tools to enhance work efficiency.
Maintain up-to-date knowledge of global business, economic trends, and M&A market developments.

Required Experience & Skills:

4 to 7 years of relevant experience in consulting or related fields.
Experience in private equity, commercial due diligence, target screening, or M&A advisory is highly desirable.
Strong ability to independently analyze and solve commercial problems with structured research.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills for professional client and team interactions.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; familiarity with data visualization tools like Power BI is a plus.
Experience in primary (surveys, desktop research, web scraping) and secondary research.
Ability to create clear, client-ready reports, presentations, and data visualizations.
Strong project management skills to handle multiple priorities and deadlines.

Preferred Qualifications:

MBA from a reputed business school.
Previous consulting experience and exposure to multinational work environments is a bonus.
Strong work ethic, proactive attitude, strategic thinker, and effective problem solver.
Additional Details:
Full-time position.
Work hours may vary based on project requirements.
No travel requirements.
Join us at PwC Strategy& to shape the future of M&A, work on impactful projects with global clients, and grow your career in a dynamic, collaborative environment.

Exp: 4 to 10 Years
Location: Bang/Hyd/Chennai/Pune/Gurugram
Mode of work: Hybrid

Certification(s) Preferred:
Active Workday Finance certification (P2P/R2R)
Required Skills:
Requirements gathering: Understand clients Workday Financials and reporting requirements, including financial management processes, reporting needs, data definitions, security considerations, and how they align to Workday functionality
Workday Financials support: Configure, maintain, test, and support Workday Financial Management functionality across areas such as general ledger, accounts payable, accounts receivable, expenses, procurement, banking and settlement, and related finance processes

Data integrity and reconciliation: Help clients validate financial data, investigate discrepancies, support reconciliations, and maintain confidence in Workday financial reporting outputs
Facilitate knowledge transfer and educate customers on Workday Financials and reporting capabilities, providing functional and reporting expertise during client design workshops, support discussions, and training sessions
Invite and give in-the-moment feedback in a constructive manner
Share and collaborate effectively with others across finance, technology, managed services, and client teams
Identify and make suggestions for process, reporting, and system improvements when problems and/or opportunities arise
Handle, manipulate, and analyze data and information responsibly, with appropriate attention to confidentiality, access, and data governance
Follow risk management and compliance procedures
Keep up to date with developments in Workday Financials, reporting, analytics, and managed services practices
Communicate confidently in a clear, concise, and articulate manner—verbally and in the materials produced
Build and maintain an internal and external network
Seek opportunities to learn about how PwC works as a global network of firms
Uphold the firm’s code of ethics and business conduct

Description:
Are you excited about working with cutting-edge network
technologies
Would you enjoy taking ownership of our infrastructure
Join our Enterprise Hosting Services team!
The Enterprise Hosting Services (EHS) team designs and implements systems running diverse server operating systems on virtual or cloud infrastructures. This leading team focuses on enhancing productivity and security while reducing costs, downtime, and repetitive processes.
Partner with the best
As a Network Administrator II, you will maintain a reliable, secure and efficient data network infrastructure. You will deliver IT
Support Services effectively and ensure smooth network operations across the global network. You will deploy, configure, maintain and monitor all network equipments to ensure smooth network operations.
As a Network Administrator II, you will be responsible for:
Providing on-going administration and support of Corporate Network Infrastructure (Cisco / Fortinet / Juniper / Aruba / F5 / ClearPass).
Troubleshooting wired and wireless Ethernet networking technologies (including VLANs, Dot1x,Spanning Tree, Port Channeling, 802.11abgn, etc.).
Maintaining proactive and timely communication with customers via multiple mediums (tickets, calls, walk-ups, IM).
Ensuring effective, self initiated monitoring and configuration/change management is maintained for all systems and networks.
Using system resource utilization and monitoring tools to identify potential problem areas before they result in incidents.
Providing weekend support on rotating on-call schedule and leading support operations while being technical PoC for Bangalore
Do what you love
To be successful in this role you will:
Have 5 yrs of relevant experience with Bachelors or its or equivalent.
Configure and manage Cisco, Fortigate, and Juniper with practical, hands-on experience across various systems and environments.
Demonstrate good experience in experience configuring and managing Routers, Switches and
Firewalls
Have experience in maintaining complex and large networks and Data centers.
Have experience in wired and wireless Ethernet networking technologies (VLANs, Dot1x, Spanning
Tree etc.) and network security.
Demonstrate proficiency with routing protocols and related technologies - OSPF,BGP, SD-WAN.
Have understanding of network applications, protocols and client-based networking with systems
running Windows, Mac OSX, or Linux.
Possess understanding of end-to-end data flows and traffic patterns (wireshark).Be CCNP / JNCIP
certified
About us
At Akamai, we make life better for billions of people, trillions of times a day.
Whether youre streaming live events, scrolling social media, watching your favorite series, or managing your savings, were the engine behind the scenes. We provide the worlds most distributed platform from Cloud to Edge to help the giants of the digital world work faster and stay more secure, making the internet a better experience for everyone.

Our focus is simple:
Cloud and Edge: Running apps closer to users for instant performance.
Security : Neutralizing threats before they ever reach your data.
Content Delivery : Scaling the worlds biggest moments without a glitch.
AI : Enabling our customers to build, secure, and scale AI apps on the worlds most distributed cloud platform.

At Akamai, we dont just support the internet; we power and protect it, because behind every great digital experience is a massive hidden challenge. And were the ones who solve it. When millions of people hit play or pay, Akamai ensures it just works.
Benefits at Akamai: We support your health, well-being, finances, and life beyond work. See our benefits.
FlexBase adapts to your jobs needs
Akamais FlexBase program is yet another way we show our commitment to providing employees with an exceptional workplace experience. Its not about telling employees where to work; its about supporting employees to do their best work.

We trust our incredible employees to work in ways that suit them best: at home, in an office, or a combination of both.
Connect with us on social and see what life at Akamai is like!

As an ABAP - Senior Associate, you will specialize in utilizing and managing SAP software and solutions within an organization. You will be responsible for tasks such as installation, configuration, administration, development, and support of SAP products and technologies. As a Senior Associate, you will focus on building meaningful client connections and learning how to manage and inspire others. You will navigate increasingly complex situations, growing your personal brand and deepening your technical skills. This position offers the opportunity to develop a deeper understanding of the business context and how it is evolving, while using a broad range of tools and methodologies to generate new ideas and solve problems.

- Analyzing client needs to implement and support SAP software solutions effectively
- Managing SAP technology installations, configurations, and administration tasks
- Developing and maintaining SAP products and technologies to optimize operational efficiency
- Utilizing Advanced Business Application Programming (ABAP) for software development and customization
- Collaborating with teams to drive business transformation and process improvement initiatives
- Leveraging SAP Analytics Cloud and SAP Fiori for enhanced data visualization and insights generation
- Navigating complex situations to build meaningful client relationships and deliver quality outcomes
- Applying strategic technology planning to align SAP solutions with client objectives
- Embracing change and fostering innovation within SAP technology projects
- Mentoring junior team members to enhance their technical skills and professional growth

Description:
Jubilant Drug Discovery and Development Services (JDDDS) , is part of the Jubilant LifeSciences family of companies with R&D Centers in India, USA and business offices in Asia, Europe and North America. JDDDS has a global reach and provides comprehensive drug discovery and development solutions from target discovery to clinical development in partnership with leading pharma companies worldwide.

With clear scientific focus in Oncology, Metabolic Disorders, CNS and Pain and Inflammation, JDDDS has rapidly emerged as a leading collaborator for pharma industry. In each of these therapeutic areas, Jubilant has developed a depth of expertise in discovery informatics, medicinal chemistry, structural biology, biology, in vitro, in vivo models and translational sciences. Combined with strong clinical development and manufacturing capabilities, Jubilant has emerged as a fully integrated company with end-to-end solution for pharma industry.

JDDDS business constitutes three Jubilant subsidiaries, Jubilant Biosys (Drug discovery services), Jubilant Chemsys (Chemistry services) and Jubilant Clinsys (Clinical trial services). With over 1200 highly skilled and experienced scientific and medical personnel spread across Bangalore and Noida in India, Europe and the US, the JDDDS vertical leverages the capabilities in emerging markets for a global outcome, accelerating the global drug development efforts.

Description:
Jubilant Drug Discovery and Development Services (JDDDS) , is part of the Jubilant LifeSciences family of companies with R&D Centers in India, USA and business offices in Asia, Europe and North America. JDDDS has a global reach and provides comprehensive drug discovery and development solutions from target discovery to clinical development in partnership with leading pharma companies worldwide.

With clear scientific focus in Oncology, Metabolic Disorders, CNS and Pain and Inflammation, JDDDS has rapidly emerged as a leading collaborator for pharma industry. In each of these therapeutic areas, Jubilant has developed a depth of expertise in discovery informatics, medicinal chemistry, structural biology, biology, in vitro, in vivo models and translational sciences. Combined with strong clinical development and manufacturing capabilities, Jubilant has emerged as a fully integrated company with end-to-end solution for pharma industry.

JDDDS business constitutes three Jubilant subsidiaries, Jubilant Biosys (Drug discovery services), Jubilant Chemsys (Chemistry services) and Jubilant Clinsys (Clinical trial services). With over 1200 highly skilled and experienced scientific and medical personnel spread across Bangalore and Noida in India, Europe and the US, the JDDDS vertical leverages the capabilities in emerging markets for a global outcome, accelerating the global drug development efforts.

Description:
Join our Team
About this opportunity

Data Governance Manager are responsible for Responsible and drive formulation of policies, directives, guidelines for data Governance and control. Owner of Data-Governance strategy framework. Drive and responsible for operationalization of Data-governance framework across units in MSN(CU/SLOP/SDAP). Reporting and communicate regularly to management on Data Governance. Innovative in the offensive application & defensive controls in the use of data! Standardization and constant evolution of data governance framework data in a data domain and ensure that data is managed according to policies and standards. They have the appropriate capabilities and skills to access the data together with the tools required to manage and audit access. Enforces data governance policies and procedures, ensures reliable data quality as well as supports education for employees in data governance
The job is published across India, Hungary and Romania, final location will be decided after selection.

What you will do

- Sets the strategic direction for the data governance.
- Leads data standardization, drives domain data standardization and system alignment and improvements for the relevant data domain
- Acts as a data Leader to set the strategic direction.
- Support business processes (use cases) and resolves customer concern of data issues
- Develops data expertise within a data-domain to ensure data is accurately defined and used across organization
- Plans and design future data availability within data domain expertise
- Proposes and leads any change in existing data or acquire new data to meet business requirements.
- Provides information to internal stakeholders on data lifecycle within their domain expertise (from collection till decommission) and how this data can support business objectives, including the use-of technology to facilitate this.
- Trains business stakeholders on the content and definition of domain data fields and the impact on their operational processes
- Creates and maintains the documentation of the domain data definitions and domain data use
Tools & Resources
Data Catalog
Data Governance (Risk)
Data Lineage
Data Quality
Data ETL (Extract, Transform, Load)

Behavioral Competences:

Adapting & responding to change
Applying expertise & technologyAnalyzing (data, business and process)
Persuading & Influencing
Deciding & initiating action ||Leading & Supervising .
You will bring

Experience in Information Technology
Management experience
Experience in (data) domain subject matter
Data Steward Qualification Exam
Knowledge of data sources, transformation rules and users
Data analysis
Understand how a data operating model can be applied within an organisation
Knowledge of TOGAF (The open group architecture framework)
DAMA (Data Management Association)
All academic credentials must be from recognized and accredited institutions and are further subject to verification.
Why join EricssonAt Ericsson, you ll have an outstanding opportunity. The chance to use your skills and imagination to push the boundaries of what s possible. To build solutions never seen before to some of the world s toughest problems. You ll be challenged, but you won t be alone. You ll be joining a team of diverse innovators, all driven to go beyond the status quo to craft what comes next.

We truly believe that by collaborating with people with different experiences we drive innovation, which is essential for our future growth. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply and realize their full potential as part of our Ericsson team. Ericsson is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. learn more.

Description:
Job Description Summary The Lead Controls Field Engineer is responsible for the installation, commissioning, maintenance and troubleshooting for the full range of hardware and software products in the Controls Services Business portfolio. As well as external reporting: Lead controls Field Engineer may report to the client, the plant/utility owner, the construction firm, giving daily or weekly updates on job progress or as needed. Responsible for reviewing plant engineering documents and PID s, troubleshooting of plant systems and equipment, planning, organizing, integrating and direction of resources such as labor, tools and materials as required to complete the work scope according to contractual requirements. You may be assigned to other duties to help proactively drive our GE Gas Power Controls vision and align with our organization s core values.
Job Description
Essential Responsibilities
Actively manage controls and instrumentation activities on-site during Installation, Commissioning and Maintenance of upgrade project or new installation, including but not limited to oversight of installation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and diagnostics for controls system such as Mark V, Mark Vi, Mark Vie, Cimplicity and HMI s..
Provide customers with technical direction and support on Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) packaged products.
Understand PLC ladder logic, including basic understanding of how to navigate through ladder rungs while troubleshooting
Trace through the software documentation.
Implement control constant modifications.
Reading and Modifying software sequencing
Set up and modify the hardware /software associated with Gas and Steam Turbine systems.
Troubleshoot existing Control Solutions hardware and software installations on-site.
Prepare field services jobs and coordinate with the project /Service managers
Provide training to customer employees as needed
Supervise cable laying, meggering and connection
Maintain accurate timesheets and acquire customers signature on timesheets before leaving the job site
Understand TC (Terms and Conditions) commitments
Provide timely and accurate internal and external reports.
Ensure contractual obligations are met and attend technical meetings with Customers.
Ensure all in-field activities are carried out safely complying with company environmental, health, and safety (EHS) guidelines and procedures.
Provide expert consultation on complex projects.
Timely and accurately input hours, expenses, timesheets in internal systems
Pre-outage and installation planning; possibly recommending and administering policies and procedures.
Availability to frequently travel (. i.e. More than 75%), work offshore and in restricted countries
Ability and willingness to work holidays, weekends and overtime as required by field assignments.
Drive customer satisfaction through commitment to quality.
Support the business growth initiatives.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor s degree in engineering and 5 years of experience, or 10 years of experience without formal degree, in power plant maintenance, turbine generator maintenance, or power plant electrical equipment installation/ commissioning.
Experience working on GEV Controls systems such as Mark V, Mark Vi, Mark Vie/s etc.
Proven working experience in Oil Gas and Power Plant industry field activities.
Excellent written and oral communication skills, to convey technical concepts to business and technical personnel
Strong knowledge in rotating equipment control philosophy (Gas Turbine, Steam Turbine, Centrifugal Compressor, Reciprocate Compressor) and their auxiliaries
Strong knowledge in unit control panel (UCP), motor control centre (MCC), direct current panel (DCP), distributed control system (DCS) and firefighting system installation and commissioning
Strong knowledge in field devices, instruments and actuators (servo-valves, thermos elements, transmitters etc )
Ability to handle special tools like pressure pump, multi-meter, frequency generator, oscilloscope and field generator
Ability to understand and implement technical drawings (wiring diagram, PID, General Arrangement, etc ).
Ability to work under pressure
Willing to travel, in country and worldwide, and to work over-time
Fluent English and Arabic.
Valid drivers license and passport (or able to obtain a passport).
Strong computer skills using MS Office software
Desired Characteristics
Qualified level. Has the knowledge and skill to actively support an outage and be aware of where to seek answers to questions as they arise. Has experienced successful installations and outages.
Experience with Gas /Steam Turbine Driver Control Systems and Auxiliary Systems and their integration with Mark Controls Systems.
Familiar with Instruments and controls and PLCs for controls training
Familiarity with computer network systems switches
Wide degree of creativity and latitude is expected.
Strong analytic and problem-solving skills
Good interpersonal and organizational skills
Strong computer skills
Relies on extensive experience and judgment to plan and accomplish goals.
Ability to manage turnkey
Additional Information
Relocation Assistance Provided: No

Position
EY’s GDS Tax Technology team’s mission is to develop, implement and integrate technology solutions that better serve our clients and engagement teams. As a member of EY’s core Tax practice, you’ll develop a deep tax technical knowledge and outstanding ERP, database, data analytics and programming skills.
Ever-increasing regulations require tax departments to gather, organize and analyse more data than ever before. Often the data necessary to satisfy these ever-increasing and complex regulations must be collected from a variety of systems and departments throughout an organization. Effectively and efficiently handling the variety and volume of data is often extremely challenging and time consuming for a company.
EY's GDS Tax Technology team members work side-by-side with the firm's partners, clients and tax technical subject matter experts to develop and incorporate technology solutions that enhance value-add, improve efficiencies and enable our clients with disruptive and market leading tools supporting Tax.
GDS Tax Technology works closely with clients and professionals in the following areas: Federal Business Tax Services, Partnership Compliance, Corporate Compliance, Indirect Tax Services, Human Capital, and Internal Tax Services. GDS Tax Technology provides solution architecture, application development, testing and maintenance support to the global TAX service line both on a pro-active basis and in response to specific requests.
EY is currently seeking a Tax Senior to join our Tax Technology practice in Bangalore, India.

Handled and lead multiple clients/projects by own.

Be subject matter expert to program/project teams in the plan, design, and delivery of technical solutions.

Developed and Implemented strategies to improve operational efficiency, productivity and profitability

Tax Engine Experience such as (Vertex O Series, Accelerator, OneSource, GlobalNext)

Experience in VAT, Sales and Use Tax, India GST.

Knowledge of Scrum and working experience will be an advantage. o

Correction processing of statutory reporting.

Job Description
Overview
Our team within the Canada Business is dedicated to delivering cutting-edge engineering solutions for water infrastructure projects. We specialize in designing and managing complex systems that ensure sustainable water supply, treatment, and distribution. Our focus is on creating resilient, efficient, and environmentally responsible solutions that support communities and industries worldwide.
We leverage Building Information Modelling (BIM) to enhance collaboration, improve design accuracy, and optimize project delivery across the entire lifecycle-from concept and planning through construction and operation. BIM enables us to integrate civil, structural, and mechanical elements seamlessly, ensuring cost efficiency and reducing risks.
Atkins Global Technology Centre (GTC) is seeking a Civil 3D Designer to join our Water BIM team. This role will be based at our Bangalore & Gurugram office, contributing to world-class projects by creating detailed 3D models, coordinating multidisciplinary designs, and ensuring compliance with international standards.
Your Role
Roles & Responsibilities
Excellent in 3D Modelling of Pipe networks (Dry and Wet), Grading, Corridors, Cut and Fill using Civil 3D.
Excellent in Multidisciplinary 3D model coordination using Navisworks
Check model for Stage Completeness, Dimensional accuracy against modelling standards.
Ensure Level of Quality control for Completeness and adherence to company standards of all Drawings produced.
Stay informed the best practices & methodologies in BIM implementation.
Able to perform and coordinate on multi-disciplinary projects and effective implementation of BEP and BIM workflows.
Ability to determine appropriate record/As-built, test pit, drawings and point cloud data.
Identify and solve drawing/ modelling problems and troubleshooting Civil 3D issues.
Identify new logical ideas for automation to improve efficiency.
In depth knowledge of engineering drawings and specifications. Ability to work using engineers calculations and design in producing drawings / 3D modelling.
Ensures accuracy and adapts a detail-conscious approach; carefully checks details at each stage to avoid errors.
Ensure timely planning and delivery by proactively managing assumptions, dependencies, and risk.
Follow GTC BMS processes to projects
Use of Vehicle tracking
Software Skills
Autodesk Civil 3D
AutoCAD
Navisworks
MicroStation, ORD (add on)
ProjectWise / Forma
Microsoft Office (Excel, Word)
Required Skills & Competencies
Strong understanding of: Civil engineering drawings and construction methods
Ability to work with Survey data, point clouds
Good communication and coordination skills
Attention to detail and quality-focused approach
Ability to work independently with minimal supervision
About You
Qualifications & Skills
Graduate Engineers (bachelor s degree) with 3 to 5 years or Diploma in Engineering with up to 7-10 years of relevant experience in the BIM domain or duly qualified having exceptional work experience track record.
Desirable Experience
Canada / UK infrastructure or consultancy project experience
Experience working within ISO 19650 BIM environment
Awareness of Common Data Environment (CDE) workflows
Rewards & Benefits
Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive - at every stage of your life and your career.
This includes:
Comprehensive life insurance coverage.
Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.
Generous annual leave balance.
Flexible and hybrid work solutions.
Remote work opportunities outside of country.
Company gratuity scheme.
Discretionary bonus program.
Relocation assistance.
Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.
Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.

Were AtkinsR alis , a world-class engineering services and nuclear organization. We connect people, data and technology to transform the worlds infrastructure and energy systems. Together, with our industry partners and clients, and our global team of consultants, designers, engineers and project managers, we can change the world. Were committed to leading our clients across our various end markets to engineer a better future for our planet and its people.
Find out more.

Job Type Regular
At AtkinsR alis , we seek to hire individuals with diverse characteristics, backgrounds and perspectives. We strongly believe that world-class talent makes no distinctions based on gender, ethnic or national origin, sexual identity and orientation, age, religion or disability, but enriches itself through these differences.

Description:
Location: Bangalore - Indraprastha, India
Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.
Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber & Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber & Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.
Technical Lead - PCB Design Engineer
Position Summary:
Leading complex PCB layout and design, ensuring compliance with technical and manufacturing standards, and collaborating with cross-functional engineering teams. Develop, and release technical documentation of PCB/PCBA and components through design reviews and qualification testing. Support PCB/PCBA products through initial manufacturing builds and mass production. Work with third-party partner(s) as needed and internal multidisciplinary teams comprised of technical experts, program managers, field service, and Operations to execute product design details. PCB/PCBA designs shall enable efficient manufacturing, service and feature reliable performance and robust construction. Apply CAD, CAM, and CAE tools for PCB/PCBA design and drawings. Conduct engineering reviews in accordance with Thale s development process and lead peer reviews among technical teams to examine and record findings for corrective
actions on technical and documentation issues.
Internal customers:
Hardware Engineering, Product Management, Industrial OPS, Purchasing and Procurement
External coordination:
Development partners, contract manufacturers, suppliers, and vendors.
Essential Functions / Key Areas of Responsibility
Generate PCB CAD layout design data to meet product requirements.
Check complete layouts and drawings to clarify completeness, conformity to standards, procedures, specifications, manufacturability, and accuracy of calculations and dimensions.
Conduct comprehensive design reviews with engineering teams and manufacturing partners to confirm completion of engineering, cost, and manufacturability requirements.
Plan and execute PCB design project tasks according to project and/or program schedules.
Participate in PCB/PCBA product failure evaluations and analysis and provide recommendations to improve PCB testability, reliability, robustness and address components and material obsolescence.
Release and update Bills of Material, technical drawings, and PCB CAD design data into the Thales configuration document control system (Team Center) to meet Quality Assurance conformity standards and to maintain production configuration control.
Minimum Requirements: Skills, Experience, Education, Technical/Specialized Knowledge, Certifications, Language
Bachelor of Science (BS) degree in Electrical engineering or a related discipline.
8 to 12 years of experience in PCB layout and routing mixed signal, high-speed digital, analog, low power, and high current designs for high-volume manufacturing processes, and high-density interconnect (HDI), including Double-Sided PCBs, Multilayer PCBs, Flex PCBs, and Rigid-Flex PCBs.
Experience with CAD tools: Allegro, OrCAD, Valor (DFM), and AutoCAD (2D).
Able to generate parts for PCBs and update/maintain libraries, link schematic capture files to PCB layout
Candidate must be proficient in AutoCAD for generating fabrication and assembly drawings in accordance with IPC - ASME standards.
Experience in Product Data Management tools, such Team Center or similar.
Understanding of IPC 2221, 2222, 600, 610, 6012, 6013, 7351, and 7352 industry standards
Skills in Microsoft Office use: Excel, Outlook, Word, PowerPoint, Teams
Personal skills:
Evidence of excellent communication skills and working with a global cross-functional team
Capable of presenting information to project leaders and influencing key stakeholders
Ability to prioritize tasks while meeting deadlines in a high-pressure environment.
Ability to work collaboratively in a highly dynamic environment.
Ability to drive for results, hold self and others accountable, and continuously improve.
Self-starter with the ability to work through ambiguity and evolving requirements.
At Thales, we re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference - for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

Description:
EY- Assurance Consultant
As part of our EY-Assurance Team, the role requires the incumbent to proactively develop relationships with the global EY teams serving these engagements and supervise the delivery of GDS engagement management support activities. 

To qualify for the role, you must have
Candidates with CA Completed / CA Inter with Articleship completed
CPA qualified/ Semi qualified-2 papers should be completed
ACCA affiliates/part qualified-9 papers should be completed

The opportunity
Were looking for candidates with experience in carrying out routine substantive and controls-based assurance testing for the engagement teams during the financial year end for the Europe or US region.
Your key responsibilities
Clearly and accurately document the execution of specific review procedures as defined by the engagement teams
Demonstrate basic understanding of an industry or sector and be aware of technical issues
Stay informed of current business/economic developments relevant to the client's business
Recognize potential review issues or unusual relationships from basic analysis of the financial statements and communicate them to the immediate supervisor  
Collaborate with seniors and engagement teams to set goals and responsibilities  
Deliver work in line with designated methodology, project plan or process in line with EY standards  
Demonstrate professionalism, competence and clarity of communication when dealing with the team members 
Maintain a strong client focus, be responsive to team requests, and develop/maintain productive working relationships with team contacts  
Where appropriate, challenge procedures used in the past by team members and attempt to enhance review techniques
Compare efficiency of review procedures performed across different clients and suggest ideas for improvement.
Contribute ideas/opinions to the assurance teams and listen/respond to other team members' views
Use technology to continually learn, share knowledge with team members, and enhance service delivery  
Promote EYs ethical and professional standards, including data confidentiality, especially when dealing with outsiders                 
Skills and attributes for success
Confident and outgoing individual with strong communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to meet tight deadlines and ensure that work is of a consistently high standard
Ability to multi-task, pay attention to detail, prioritize projects and follow up on routine tasks diligently
Knowledge of basic accounting and book-keeping,  
Ability to communicate with leaders and peers with ease
Plan ahead and anticipate potential issues before they arise
Good written and oral communication skills
Ability to work effectively in a team

Ideally, youll also have
Interest in business and commerciality.
Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)

Job Title: Senior QA Automation Engineer (Playwright + Cursor AI)
Position: Senior QA Automation Engineer
Experience: 5 8 Years
Category: QA Automation Engineering
Shift: US Eastern Time (ET) 6:30 PM to 3:30 AM IST (subject to Daylight Saving Time adjustments)
Main location: India, Bangalore
Position ID:;
Employment Type: Full Time
Education Qualification:;Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related discipline.
Position Description: We are looking for an experienced Senior QA Automation Engineer with expertise in Playwright and Cursor AI to build and maintain modern automation solutions supporting enterprise digital transformation initiatives. The candidate will be responsible for developing scalable automation frameworks, implementing AI assisted test automation, and ensuring high quality software delivery through continuous testing practices.
This role requires hands on technical expertise in automation engineering, strong collaboration with Agile teams, and the ability to leverage AI tools to improve engineering productivity and software quality.
Key Responsibilities

. Design, develop, and maintain automation frameworks using Playwright with TypeScript/JavaScript.
. Develop automated Functional, Regression, Smoke, Sanity, and End to End test suites.
. Utilize Cursor AI to accelerate script development, code generation, debugging, and automation maintenance.
. Develop reusable automation components, utilities, and libraries.
. Automate REST API validation using Playwright API capabilities.
. Integrate automation suites with CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins).
. Analyze automation execution results and perform root cause analysis for failures.
. Participate in Sprint Planning, Backlog Grooming, and Agile ceremonies.
. Collaborate with Developers, Business Analysts, and Product Owners to ensure quality throughout the SDLC.
. Perform code reviews and promote automation best practices.
. Contribute to framework enhancements and continuous process improvements.

Mandatory Skills

. 58 years of experience in Software Testing and Automation.
. Minimum 3 years of hands on experience with Playwright.
. Strong programming skills in TypeScript and JavaScript.
. Experience using Cursor AI or AI assisted development tools (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Windsurf).
. Experience with REST API automation and validation.
. Experience integrating automation with CI/CD pipelines.
. Hands on experience with Git, Azure DevOps, or GitHub.
. Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies.
. Excellent analytical, debugging, and problem solving skills.
. Strong communication and stakeholder collaboration skills.

Preferred Experience
Experience with:

. Enterprise Web Applications
. Retail / E Commerce Platforms
. Microservices Architecture
. API Automation
. Cross browser Testing
. Cloud based Applications
. Continuous Testing

Exposure to:

. Docker
. Kubernetes
. SQL / Database Validation
. Performance Testing
. Accessibility Testing
. Azure Cloud

;
Key Competencies
The ideal candidate should demonstrate:

. Strong automation engineering expertise.
. AI assisted software development proficiency.
. High ownership and accountability.
. Excellent debugging and analytical skills.
. Ability to mentor junior automation engineers.
. Strong collaboration across cross functional teams.
. Continuous improvement mindset.
. Excellent communication and documentation skills.
