Description:
Risk Consulting Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) – Basel III Business Analyst – Manager/Senior
Description
EY's Financial Services Office (FSO) is a unique, industry-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional capability and product knowledge. FSO practice provides integrated consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, investment banks, broker-dealers, asset managers (traditional and alternative), insurance and energy trading companies, and the Corporate Treasury functions of leading Fortune 500 Companies. The service offerings provided by the FSO Consulting include: market, credit and operational risk management, regulatory consulting, quantitative consulting, structured finance transaction, actuarial consulting, technology enablement, risk and security, program consulting, and process & controls.
Within EY’s Business Consulting Practice, the Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) group provides solutions that can help FSO clients to identify, measure, manage and monitor the market (trading book), credit (banking book), operational, and regulatory risks associated with their trading, asset-liability management, capital management and other capital markets activities.
Within FSRM, the CSTC team assists across end-to-end aspects of Capital management, BASEL, credit risk and Stress testing related activities:
Key role involves producing critical deliverables to the senior management and regulators including EMEIA, US and APAC entities’ credit risk review, capital projections, Basel 4, Basel 3 endgame, capital aspects of Recovery & Resolution planning (RRP), stress testing and having oversight of various regulatory requirements.
Consulting and solutions delivery such as impact assessments, defining the target operating model, and integrated risk and finance reporting framework
Quality assurance such as assessment of controls of the Banking industry and similar business lines covering regulatory reporting involving Basel/CRR/RRP regulations
Early identification and accurate analysis of prudential developments and influence on changes to the capital framework.
Regulatory capital impact assessment in legal entity simplification initiatives, business re-organizations, new business initiatives and external commitments to regulators
Clients include large domestic and global financial institutions, broker-dealers, foreign banking organizations, asset management firms with significant capital markets activities. Project teams frequently work with the senior management of these firms, including CFOs and CROs.
Role Overview
The role is for a Basel III Business Analyst supporting the Basel III Proposal Roadmap implementation. The engagement focuses on restarting Basel III Proposal implementation program, adopting the Expanded Risk-Based Approach (ERBA), accelerating Single Counterparty Credit Limits (SCCL) gross exposure measurements, and onboarding incremental Basel III data requirements into the Unified Consumption Layer (UCL) Data Factory. The candidate will support exposure-pod based execution across credit risk, securitization, credit risk mitigation, derivatives / SA-CCR, operational risk, and related regulatory capital workstreams. The role requires strong business analysis, regulatory capital, data sourcing, data profiling, source-to-target mapping, calculation logic documentation, Axiom input mapping, controls design, testing, governance, and stakeholder management capabilities. The candidate will work closely with Risk, Finance, Technology, Data, Operations, and business stakeholders to produce implementation-ready requirements, support interim ERBA calculator development, and enable transparent program execution through high-quality documentation, testing, and governance routines.
Key Responsibilities
Support detailed implementation planning, governance, project management, status reporting, RAID / action trackers, decision logs, and senior stakeholder updates for the B3P Roadmap.
Refresh the Basel III Proposal / ERBA gap assessment and identify new, modified, or enhanced data elements required for rule interpretation, regulatory capital calculations, and downstream reporting.
Perform data profiling and fit-for-use analysis across existing UCL data elements and source-system data, including review of missing values, syntax consistency, data completeness, appropriateness for regulatory requirements, and data quality issues.
Document data sourcing, transformation, derivation, and calculation logic requirements for ERBA exposure types including residential mortgage / MSR, CRE, retail, off-balance sheet, corporates, banks, securitization, credit risk mitigation, collateral haircut approach, derivatives / SA-CCR, and operational risk.
Develop source-to-target mappings, business data dictionaries, data lineage, and transformation specifications to support onboarding of incremental Basel III data requirements into the UCL Data Factory.
Support UCL Data Factory activities, including data movement logic, UCL data model design, legacy consumption views, UCL ADRS unification, semantic layer configuration inputs, and source-to-target reconciliation / data validation activities.
Map data elements to Axiom-required calculation inputs and document the business rules, derivations, assumptions, controls, and evidence required to support regulatory capital processing.
Assist in the design, build, and testing of interim ERBA calculators using available UCL data and direct source-system data until strategic UCL feeds are available.
Support testing of calculator outputs, reconciliation of data and results, fit-for-use analysis, issue identification, remediation tracking, and user acceptance testing using project accelerators and agreed testing approaches.
Identify and document controls for new or modified data elements, including preventative and detective controls, data quality checks, lineage controls, reconciliation points, and governance documentation.
Recommend interim and strategic BAU data capture, data management, and process enhancements to support ERBA, SCCL gross exposure measurements, regulatory reporting, management reporting, and future-state capital insights.
Coordinate with exposure pods, technology teams, and business stakeholders to drive agile execution across discovery, assessment, design, build, testing, and refinement sprints.
Prepare clear, executive-ready documentation including requirements packs, mapping documents, control matrices, testing summaries, issue trackers, status decks, and steering committee materials.
Responsibly use AI and automation tools to improve analysis, documentation quality, workflow efficiency, and delivery transparency while following engagement and client requirements.
Qualifications, Certifications and Education
Must-have:
Master’s degree in business administration, finance, economics, engineering, statistics, information systems, or a related discipline, with at least 5 years of relevant experience in banking, consulting, risk management, regulatory capital, data management, or regulatory reporting.
Strong understanding of Basel III / Basel III Endgame / Basel III Proposal requirements, ERBA concepts, RWA calculations, regulatory capital, credit risk, counterparty credit risk, operational risk, and regulatory reporting processes.
Experience supporting Basel implementation, gap assessments, regulatory capital transformation, data sourcing, calculation logic documentation, data quality remediation, or regulatory reporting change programs.
Strong business and data analysis skills, including requirements documentation, data profiling, source-to-target mapping, data lineage, data dictionaries, metadata management, reconciliation, and control documentation.
Ability to understand exposure-level requirements across residential mortgage, CRE, retail, off-balance sheet exposures, corporates, banks, securitization, credit risk mitigation, SA-CCR, and operational risk.
Experience working with senior stakeholders across Risk, Finance, Credit, Technology, Data, Operations, Compliance, and business teams in a structured and professional manner.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with ability to translate regulatory requirements into practical data, logic, controls, testing, and implementation deliverables.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with proficiency in preparing executive-ready PowerPoint materials, Excel trackers, meeting notes, governance reports, requirements documents, and testing summaries.
Demonstrated focus on delivery excellence, attention to detail, process discipline, documentation quality, stakeholder management, and continuous improvement.
Good-to-have:
Experience with Axiom, regulatory capital calculators, RWA engines, regulatory reporting platforms, or capital data warehouses.
Technical skills such as SQL, SAS, Python, advanced Excel, data profiling tools, data visualization tools, or cloud data platforms such as Snowflake, Azure, GCP, or similar environments.
Familiarity with UCL / data factory delivery concepts, source-to-target reconciliation, consumption views, semantic layers, data model design, ADRS unification, and ETL design documentation.
Familiarity with SA-CCR, SCCL, credit risk mitigation, collateral haircut approach, securitization capital rules, corporate / wholesale banking products, and operational risk SMA / BIC concepts.
Certifications such as FRM, CFA, PRM, PMP, PRINCE2, Agile / Scrum, DAMA, or other relevant risk, data, or project delivery credentials.
Hands-on experience with project management, collaboration, and reporting tools such as MS Project, Jira, Confluence, SharePoint, Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms.
Prior consulting experience or experience working with US banks, regional banks, global financial institutions, or regulatory-driven change and remediation programs.

Description:
Forward Deployment Engineer

Location
Gurgaon Noida Pune Hyderabad Bangalore
Experience
8+ years We are hiring across all levels

Our mission: Axtria is building the pharmaceutical industry''s largest Forward Deployment Engineering workforce 1,000 certified FDEs embedded across the world''s leading pharma and life sciences organizations. We are hiring across multiple levels. If you have 8 or more years of engineering, data, and AI experience in pharma or life sciences and you have shipped production AI, not just built PoCs we want to talk to you.
POSITION SUMMARY:-
An Axtria Forward Deployment Engineer does not advise from the outside. They deploy forward directly into a pharma client''s environment, operating on the client''s data, within the client''s commercial or clinical operations and build production AI systems that real teams use. The role demands three capabilities simultaneously: the technical depth to architect and build production AI end-to-end, the pharma domain knowledge to understand why the system needs to work the way it does, and the consulting maturity to operate independently at the client without needing to be managed.
This is not a proof-of-concept role. FDEs scope, build, and ship. The seniority of your level determines the scale and complexity of the engagement you lead; the core mandate production AI in the client environment is the same across all levels.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:-
Embedded Client Delivery
Embed directly within pharma client organisations operating as a trusted technical peer, not a vendor and own the design, build, and deployment of production AI systems end-to-end on the client''s own infrastructure
Lead the technical workstream and direct teams of engineers Agent Pipeline Engineers and AI-Augmented Engineers under your architecture and delivery ownership
Hold the technical client relationship at Director, VP, and CDO level: scoping problems, presenting architecture trade-offs, defending design decisions under scrutiny, and translating technical outcomes into business language
AI Architecture and Engineering
Architect multi-agent AI systems for pharma environments spanning orchestration patterns, tool and function integration, retrieval-augmented generation, memory architectures, human-in-the-loop design, evaluation pipelines, and production MLOps
Build on the technology stacks clients already operate: Databricks (Delta Lake, Mosaic AI, Genie), Snowflake (Snowpark, Cortex AI, Cortex Analyst), AWS (Bedrock Agents, SageMaker), and the Claude and Anthropic API stack with Model Context Protocol
Design and implement AI evaluation frameworks appropriate for regulated pharma environments probabilistic quality thresholds, RAGAS, LLM-as-judge, adversarial red-teaming, and audit-trail-compliant output governance
Ensure systems are production-grade: observable, maintainable, secure, and compliant with pharma data governance requirements including HIPAA, GDPR, and applicable FDA AI/ML guidance
Stay current with the agentic AI ecosystem frameworks, model capabilities, evaluation techniques, and orchestration protocols and translate emerging capability into deployment-relevant technical decisions
Pharma Domain Translation
Translate pharma commercial and clinical business problems into AI-solvable architectures without requiring a domain primer from the client the depth of your domain expertise is part of what you bring to the engagement
Validate that AI outputs are accurate against pharma business logic and commercial or clinical norms not just technically correct but domain-defensible and explainable to the end users who act on them
Serve as the connective layer between the client''s business problem and the technical solution, eliminating the scoping ambiguity that causes most pharma AI deployments to stall before production
Programme Contribution and Methodology
Contribute to Axtria''s growing library of pharma AI deployment patterns, reference architectures, and reusable accelerators ensuring each client engagement adds to the institutional knowledge base rather than staying isolated in a single account
Identify opportunities to extend scope within existing client engagements by recognising where additional AI workstreams could unlock further commercial or clinical value
Mentor junior FDEs and AI-Augmented Engineers within your engagement team, and contribute to the technical standards and delivery methodology of the FDE programme
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:-
8 or more years of experience in engineering, data engineering, analytics engineering, or AI/ML roles, with direct pharma or life sciences client exposure across a substantial portion of that tenure
Pharma domain experience is mandatory. You understand how pharma organisations work without needing orientation: commercial depth in SFE, IC design, market access, omnichannel, KAM, or patient services; or clinical depth in trial operations, CDASH/SDTM, site analytics, RWE, HEOR, or regulatory data. You do not need a pharma primer to start this role.
Production AI engineering is required you have shipped, not just experimented. You have built AI systems that ran in production: LLM-based agents, RAG pipelines, multi-agent workflows, or clinical AI systems with real users in regulated environments. Notebooks, PoCs, and sandbox projects do not qualify for this requirement.
Strong engineering foundations: Python, SQL, cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, or GCP), data pipeline architecture, and API design you write production-grade code as a matter of course, not occasionally
Depth on at least one pharma AI platform Databricks, Snowflake, AWS Bedrock, or the Claude and Anthropic API stack and working fluency across the others sufficient to engage in architecture trade-off discussions
Demonstrated ability to operate in direct client-facing roles at senior stakeholder level: scoping ambiguous problems, managing technical expectations, presenting architecture decisions to non-technical executives, and working independently without a delivery management layer above you
Experience working in sprint-based, high-velocity delivery cycles where scope is defined, engineered, and shipped within weeks rather than quarters
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:-
Prior experience in a technology consulting, systems integrator, or AI services firm with pharma or life sciences clients specifically in delivery roles rather than advisory
Experience leading engineering teams of three or more people across concurrent AI workstreams, with accountability for technical quality and delivery timelines
Familiarity with AI governance frameworks, responsible AI design, and pharma-specific regulatory AI considerations including FDA AI/ML Software as a Medical Device guidance, ICH guidelines applicable to AI-generated evidence, and GxP data integrity requirements
Industry certification on one or more of the following is a big plus: AWS Certified AI Practitioner (AIF-C01), Databricks Certified Generative AI Engineer Associate, SnowPro Advanced Data Engineer (DEA-C01), or Claude Certified Architect Foundations (CCA-F)

BE/BTech/ME/MS/MTech or equivalent

Description:
We’re Nagarro.

We are a Digital Product Engineering company that is scaling in a big way! We build products, services, and experiences that inspire, excite, and delight. We work at scale across all devices and digital mediums, and our people exist everywhere in the world (18000 experts across 38 countries, to be exact). Our work culture is dynamic and non-hierarchical. We are looking for great new colleagues. That is where you come in!

REQUIREMENT: -

• Total Experience - 10+
• Strong IT industry experience with at least 5+ years of hands-on experience on the ServiceNow platform.
• Strong expertise in ServiceNow ITSM, ITOM, ITAM, HAM, and SAM modules, including platform configuration, customization, and governance.
• Extensive experience in designing and implementing enterprise-scale ServiceNow solutions across multiple business domains.
• Strong understanding of ServiceNow architecture, platform best practices, Now Create methodology, and governance frameworks.
• Hands-on experience with JavaScript, Glide APIs, Business Rules, Client Scripts, UI Policies, ACLs, Script Includes, Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, and Scripted REST APIs.
• Experience designing and implementing integrations using REST, SOAP, MID Server, IntegrationHub, and third-party systems.
• Deep understanding of CMDB architecture, CSDM, Discovery, Service Mapping, Event Management, and data integrity management.
• Experience designing and governing Hardware Asset Management (HAM) and Software Asset Management (SAM) processes, including software normalization, reconciliation, and license compliance.

Responsibilities: -

• Lead end-to-end solution architecture and design for ServiceNow implementations across ITSM, ITOM, ITAM, HAM, and SAM modules.
• Translate business requirements into scalable, maintainable, secure, and best-practice-aligned ServiceNow solutions.
• Define enterprise-level technical roadmaps, reference architectures, integration strategies, and platform standards.
• Govern platform health, upgrade strategies, technical debt reduction initiatives, and adherence to ServiceNow Technical Best Practices (TBPs).
• Architect and oversee integrations with ERP systems, CMDB data sources, discovery tools, and third-party applications.
• Drive CMDB strategy, CSDM adoption, Discovery, Service Mapping, and Event Management implementations.
• Design hardware and software asset lifecycle workflows, software normalization, reconciliation processes, and license compliance frameworks.
• Provide technical leadership and architectural guidance to developers, business analysts, administrators, and project teams.
• Conduct architecture reviews, design reviews, code quality audits, and technical governance activities.
• Partner with customers and stakeholders to communicate solution architecture decisions, trade-offs, and business value outcomes.

Interested candidates can apply/share their profiles -sweety01@nagarro.com

Description:
Purpose/Objective


Team Member - Airside Operations is responsible for aiding in coordinating and supporting airside activities to ensure safe and efficient operations.
This role involves handling routine tasks, monitoring airside operations, assisting in ground support equipment management, and helping with compliance to safety regulations.
Key Responsibilities of Role


Assist in Aircraft Movement Coordination: Aid in directing aircraft to and from gates, taxiways, and runways, ensuring compliance with air traffic control instructions.
Help monitor aircraft positions, communicate effectively with pilots and ground crew, and resolve any issues promptly.
Facilitate Ground Support Equipment Management: Ensure all ground support equipment (GSE) is in good working condition by assisting in coordinating regular maintenance schedules.
Help manage the availability of GSE, such as tugs, baggage carts, and refuelling trucks, to support aircraft operations.
Contribute to Compliance with Safety Regulations: Assist in conducting regular safety audits, implementing safety protocols, and providing training to staff on safety procedures.
Help monitor airside activities to identify potential hazards and take corrective actions promptly.
Aid in Emergency Response Coordination: Assist in developing and implementing emergency response plans, conducting drills, and ensuring effective communication with emergency services.
Help oversee evacuation procedures and provide support to affected individuals during emergencies.
Assist in Runway and Taxiway Maintenance: Aid in coordinating routine inspections, scheduling repairs, and managing the removal of debris or hazards from runways and taxiways.
Work closely with maintenance teams to ensure all surfaces are well-maintained and meet safety standards.
Key Stakeholders - Internal: Duty Manager - Airside Operations Air Traffic Control (ATC) Ground Handling Teams Terminal Operations Team Facilities Team Airport Security Maintenance and Engineering Department Customer Service Teams IT Department Safety and Compliance Department Marketing and Communications Department Key Stakeholders - External: Airlines Regulatory Authorities (e.
g.
, FAA, ICAO) Ground Handling Service Providers ATC Local Emergency Services Passengers Cargo Operators Fuel Suppliers Vendors and Contractors
Technical Competencies


Air Traffic Control (ATC)-AAHL,Aircraft Movements Management-AAHL,Airside Ground Handling-AAHL,Airside Safety Inspection-AAHL,Data Analysis and Interpretation-AAHL,Ground Support Equipment Management-AAHL,Incident Management-AAHL,Risk Management-AAHL,Runway and Taxiway Maintenance-AAHL
Qualifications and Experience


Educational Background: A Bachelor's degree in Aviation Management, Aeronautical Engineering, or a related field is required.
Work Experience: Supervisory Staff - Airside Operations should have at least 2-3 years of experience in airside or ground operations, including supervisory roles.

Description:
Job Summary
We are looking for a proactive, organized and people-oriented HR & Administration Executive to manage day-to-day HR operations and office administration. The role will support recruitment, employee lifecycle management, attendance and leave, payroll coordination, HR documentation, employee engagement, compliance support and smooth administrative operations across the office and business/project environment.

Recruitment & Talent Acquisition
Coordinate manpower requirements with management and department/project heads.
Manage job postings, candidate sourcing, screening, interview scheduling and follow-ups.
Coordinate offer letters, appointment letters, joining documentation and onboarding.
Maintain recruitment trackers and candidate databases.

Employee Lifecycle & HR Operations
Manage joining, induction, confirmation, transfers, promotions and exit formalities.
Maintain employee personal files, HR records and confidential documentation.
Issue HR letters, certificates and other employee-related documents.
Support implementation and communication of HR policies and procedures.

Attendance, Leave & Payroll Coordination
Monitor attendance, late coming, absenteeism, overtime and leave records.
Prepare accurate monthly attendance and leave data for payroll processing.
Coordinate with accounts/payroll teams for salary inputs and employee queries.
Maintain proper records of employee benefits and deductions as applicable.

Employee Relations & Engagement
Handle routine employee concerns and coordinate resolution with management.
Support employee engagement activities, celebrations, meetings and internal events.
Promote a positive, disciplined and professional workplace culture.
Assist in performance appraisal, feedback and employee development processes.

HR Compliance & Documentation
Support compliance with applicable labour laws, statutory requirements and company policies.
Coordinate with external consultants/agencies for statutory matters where required.
Maintain accurate and timely HR records, registers and documentation.
Ensure confidentiality and appropriate handling of employee information.

Administration & Office Management
Manage day-to-day office administration and facilities.
Coordinate with housekeeping, security, maintenance, transport and other vendors.
Maintain office supplies, assets, records and administrative inventories.
Coordinate travel, accommodation, meetings and other administrative requirements.
Support administrative coordination for project/site teams when required.
Monitor administrative expenses and maintain relevant records.

MIS & Reporting
Prepare HR and administrative reports for management.
Maintain headcount, recruitment, attendance, attrition, leave and other HR trackers.
Provide timely and accurate HR information for management decision-making.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE
Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Commerce or a related field.
05 years of relevant experience in HR and administration.
Experience in construction, infrastructure, manufacturing or project-based organizations will be an advantage.
Working knowledge of MS Excel, Word, PowerPoint and HRMS/HR software.
Good understanding of recruitment, employee records, attendance, payroll coordination and basic statutory compliance.
Strong communication, interpersonal, organizational and problem-solving skills.
Ability to maintain confidentiality and work effectively with employees at different levels.

KEY COMPETENCIES
Recruitment & Selection | HR Operations | Employee Relations | Attendance & Leave | Payroll Coordination | Compliance Support | Office Administration | Vendor Coordination | MS Excel & MIS | Communication

KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIS)
Recruitment turnaround time and quality of hires.
Accuracy of attendance, leave and employee records.
Timely completion of joining, onboarding and exit formalities.
Employee query/grievance resolution and engagement support.
Timely HR documentation and compliance support.
Efficiency of office administration, vendor coordination and facility management.

IDEAL CANDIDATE
The ideal candidate will be a responsible, disciplined and well-organized HR professional who can independently manage routine HR operations while taking ownership of administration. Experience in road safety, construction, infrastructure, manufacturing
AboutCompany:
CAPITAL RETRO INDUSTRIES is engaged in the business of Road Safety & Construction, with a specialized focus on road signs, road safety devices, LED signboards and road construction solutions. The company works towards supporting safer, better-organized and more efficient road infrastructure through quality products, reliable execution and professional project support.

Job Description Trainee US IT Recruiter
Job Title: Trainee US IT Recruiter
Company: AKAASA Technologies
Location: Noida, Sector 63
Job Type: Full-Time | Onsite
Experience: Freshers / Recent Graduates
About the Role:
AKAASA Technologies is looking for enthusiastic, ambitious, and career-oriented Fresh Graduates to join our team as Trainee US IT Recruiters.
This is an excellent opportunity for candidates who want to build a successful career in the US IT Staffing and Recruitment Industry. Selected candidates will receive professional training and hands-on exposure to the complete US recruitment process.
Training & Internship Period
Selected candidates will initially undergo a 2-month Training and Internship Program.
Stipend: 12,000 to 15,000 per month
During this period, candidates will receive practical training and exposure to:
US IT Recruitment Process
Understanding various IT Technologies and Skills
Candidate Sourcing through Job Portals and LinkedIn
Resume Screening and Shortlisting
Candidate Screening and Initial Interviews
US Staffing Terminologies and Processes
Working with T1 and Prime Vendors
Candidate Submission and Coordination
Interview Scheduling and Follow-ups
Full-Time Opportunity
Upon successful completion of the 2-month Training and Internship Program, candidates will be evaluated for a full-time position as a US IT Recruiter.
Full-Time Salary: 22,000 to 25,000 per month
The full-time opportunity and compensation will be offered based on the candidate's performance and successful completion of the training period.
Education & Qualifications
We are looking for candidates with a technical educational background, including:
Required Skills
Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
Good understanding of basic IT technologies.
Strong interpersonal and communication skills.
Ability to learn quickly and work in a fast-paced environment.
Strong interest in Recruitment and the US Staffing industry.
Positive attitude and willingness to build a long-term career in US IT Recruitment.
Ability to work effectively as part of a team.
Work Location
Noida, Sector 63
Work Mode: Onsite
Why Join AKAASA Technologies?
This role offers an excellent opportunity to start your career in the growing US IT Staffing Industry, gain practical experience, develop professional recruitment skills, and grow within the organization.
If you are a fresh graduate with a technical background and are ready to start an exciting career in US IT Recruitment, we would love to hear from you!
AboutCompany:
We are your one-stop solution, handling all of the moving parts of staff augmentation saving you time and money. We can quickly find the right IT talent at the right rate. Our Team of experienced Industry professionals have been providing highly accomplished software and IT professionals for short and long- term contract assignments as well as permanent position globally. At AKAASA, we connect businesses with exceptional tech talent to drive innovation and success. We build lasting relationships with clients and candidates, ensuring we understand their needs and aspirations. Our commitment to excellence and transparency, along with a focus on diversity and inclusion, sets us apart in the Tech talent solutions landscape.

Role & responsibilities

Legal Officer (Non-Litigation) - Key Responsibilities
Conduct Title Search (TSR) and property legal due diligence.
Verify ownership, title chain, and property-related documents.
Draft and vet legal documents, agreements, NOCs, affidavits, and declarations.
Provide legal opinions for Home Loan and LAP cases.
Identify title defects, encumbrances, and legal risks.
Coordinate with Credit, Sales, and Operations teams.
Handle non-litigation legal matters related to lending and property finance.
Preferred Profile: LLB with experience in NBFC/HFC/Banking, property law, title search, and legal documentation

Interested candidate can share their resumes at
himani.negi@iiflhomeloans.com
AboutCompany:

We are seeking a dynamic and motivated individual to join our team as a Premium Retail Sales Executive in Bangalore

Work a flexible schedule, including evenings, weekends, and holidays

Stand in an enclosed area for 100% of the shift while assisting customers

0

Open to experienced professionals

Salary will be between 20-25k per month based on last salary
PF + ESIC
Lucrative Incentives

Description:
Join our Team
About this opportunity:
The position is based out of Gurgaon, Noida & Bangalore. Candidate would be responsible for providing second-level support on incidents, problem resolutions and technical operations. The incumbent should be authoritative on hardcore networking technologies such as Routers, Switches, Firewalls, proxies, load balancers, VPNs and must have a passion for it. We invite you to apply.
What you will do:
Investigate and resolve incidents.
Investigate and diagnose problems. Where applicable, identify short-term work-around solutions.
Act as network specialist and identify improvements in existing deployed solutions, provide input to RFCs etc.
Support and maintain routers, switches, firewalls, proxies, load balancers, DNS, Email Security solutions
Build user documentation.
Provide technical support.
Redesign and reconfigure alarms for network.
Maintain a stable environment and optimizes the network as vital.
The skills you bring:
6+ Years of experience in LAN/WAN Networks and Security Operations/Development
All academic credentials must be from recognized and accredited institutions and are further subject to verification.
Education: A primary degree in Engineering, IT or Telecommunications
The applicant will require a background in Linux systems, Networking and Firewall technologies.
JNCIA , CCSA qualifications are preferred
Candidate should have relevant
Knowledge of Networking and WAN technologies
Technical experience on Juniper, Cisco, Palo Alto, Cloud, F5
Strong Technical Skills on IP/MPLS, Routing, WAN/LAN, Security, DHCP/DNS/IPAM, Aruba Switches & WLAN
Must have strong working experience with a wide range of Cisco & Juniper routers and switches, LAN, WAN and wireless LAN technologies, network security, DHCP/DNS and routing protocols such BGP, OSPF, RIPv2 and EIGRP.
Candidates has experience in Airwave, Mobility master & controller, Access points, Aruba ClearPass policy manager, Scalance-X Industrial Ethernet Switches
Should have excellent hands on troubleshooting experience, Good to understand tools like Wireshark.
Understanding and experience while working with Cloud technologies, Devops, Terraform, cloudformation.
Candidate should have working experience with Network and security over Azure/AWS/GCP/IBM clouds.
The candidate will need to be prepared to be flexible in approach to work content and responsibilities, along with out of hours and on call support
Candidate Should be ready for 24x7 role.
Communication with Business - Stakeholder Management and Customer Interaction
Individual Contribution and hands on technical role
Ways of working - Lean & Agile, DevOps, Automation, AI, Scripting, ISMS Frame work
Communication with Business - Stakeholder Management and Customer Interaction
What happens once you apply Click Here to find all you need to know about what our typical hiring process looks like.We encourage you to consider applying to jobs where you might not meet all the criteria. We recognize that we all have transferrable skills, and we can support you with the skills that you need to develop.Encouraging a diverse and inclusive organization is core to our values at Ericsson, thats why we champion it in everything we do. We truly believe that by collaborating with people with different experiences we drive innovation, which is essential for our future growth. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply and realize their full potential as part of our Ericsson team. Ericsson is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. learn more.
Primary country and city: India (IN) || Gurgaon; Noida and Bangalore

About Fractal
Fractal is one of the most prominent providers of Artificial Intelligence to Fortune 500 companies.Fractals vision is to power every human decision in the enterprise, and bring AI, engineering, and design to help the worlds most admired companies.Fractal currently has 4000+ employees across 16 global locations, including the United States, UK, Ukraine, India, Singapore, and Australia.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Azure Lead Architect to join our consulting practice. In this leadership role, you will work with enterprise clients to design, build, and modernize cloud-native solutions on Microsoft Azure. You will be responsible for leading architecture engagements, defining cloud strategies, and guiding cross-functional teams to deliver scalable and secure cloud environments.
Key Responsibilities
Lead the design and implementation of Azure-based solutions for complex enterprise applications.
Define cloud architecture and roadmap in collaboration with business and technology stakeholders.
Assess client s current environment and make architecture recommendations for cloud adoption, migration, and optimization.
Own end-to-end solution architecture and act as a trusted advisor to client leadership.
Collaborate with DevOps, Security, Data, and Application teams to align cloud solutions with enterprise strategy.
Mentor and guide development teams on best practices in cloud architecture.
Conduct architecture reviews, risk assessments, and cost-benefit analysis.
Support pre-sales and proposal development including effort estimation, technical solutions, and client presentations.
Stay updated with the latest Azure offerings and industry trends.
Required Skills Qualifications
12+ years of experience in IT, with 6+ years of hands-on experience in Azure architecture and implementation.
Strong expertise in Azure services such as Azure App Services, AKS, Azure Functions, Azure SQL, Cosmos DB, Azure DevOps, ARM/Bicep/Terraform templates.
Deep understanding of cloud networking, identity, governance, and security principles.
Experience with hybrid and multi-cloud environments.
Strong background in enterprise application design and microservices architecture.
Familiarity with cloud cost optimization and FinOps practices.
Microsoft Azure certifications (e.g., Azure Solutions Architect Expert) preferred.
Bachelors or Master s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
Prior experience in a client-facing consulting role.
Knowledge of other cloud platforms like AWS or GCP is a plus.
Why Join Us
Opportunity to work with top-tier clients across industries.
Exposure to cutting-edge cloud projects and digital transformation programs.
Collaborative and inclusive work environment.
Learning and development opportunities with access to cloud certifications and trainings.
If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, youll enjoy your career with us!

Description:
As an NLP Lead Data Scientist, you will be building solutions that require analyzing and transforming natural language data into useful outcomes using NLP techniques. To succeed in this role, you should possess outstanding skills in statistical analysis, machine learning methods and text representation techniques and language models, consulting experience in FS, banking domain, good communication and client handling skill.
Responsibilities :
Build Solutions that identify intent and entities, other features from user comments, chat transcript and other unstructured text data.
Design and implement advanced solutions utilizing NLP traditional Models and Large Language Models (LLMs).
Demonstrate self-driven initiative by taking ownership and creating end-to-end solutions.
Conduct research and stay informed about the latest developments in generative AI and LLMs.
Train and fine-tune pre-trained NLP models and run evaluation experiments.
Perform statistical analysis of results and refine models.
Basic logical pseudo code writing.
Develop and maintain code libraries, tools, and frameworks to support generative AI development.
Participate in code reviews and contribute to maintaining high code quality standards.
Engage in the entire software development lifecycle, from design and testing to deployment and maintenance.
Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to align messaging, contribute to roadmaps, and integrate software into different repositories for core system compatibility.
Possess strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Demonstrate excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a team environment.
Primary skills:
Natural Language Processing (NLP): Hands-on experience in use case classification, topic modeling, QA and chatbots, search, Document AI, summarization, and content generation.
AND/OR
Computer Vision and Audio: Hands-on experience in image classification, object detection, segmentation, image generation, audio, and video analysis.
Generative AI:
Proficiency with SaaS LLMs, including Lang chain, llama index, vector databases, Prompt engineering (COT, TOT, ReAct, agents). Experience with Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, AWS Bedrock for text/audio/image/video modalities.
Familiarity with Open-source LLMs, including tools like TensorFlow/Pytorch and huggingface. Techniques such as quantization, LLM finetuning using PEFT, RLHF, data annotation workflow, and GPU utilization.
Cloud: Hands-on experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, and GCP. Cloud certification is preferred.
Application Development: Proficiency in Python, Docker, FastAPI/Django/Flask, and Git
Domain Skill: Consulting experience with FS,Banking domain for at least 3 years.
Required qualifications:
16-20 years into Deep Learning framewokrs like Keras, Pytorch, TensorFlow
Experience of design, building and deployment of ML/NLP Solutions
Proficient in Python SQL
Experience in NLP tools like Genism, spacy, Stanford NLP, HuggingFace
Must have excellent project/program management skills and have experience managing multiple work streams and projects at one time
Have business acumen to manage revenues profitably and meet financial goals consistently. Able to quantify business value for clients and create win-win commercial propositions.
Preferred qualifications:
Experience automating data within Tableau/Qlik/ggplot/Shiny to tell a story through interactive visualizations
Client relationship management: Build deep client relationship, network be a thought partner. Anticipate business problems deliver par excellence.
Sales Support account growth: Actively focus on opportunities to grow the client along with the senior engagement manager. Support the sales team as required for RFPs and regular sales pitches
Firm building: Contribute to firm growth by participating and conducting training sessions.
Coaching grooming: Coach groom the team on gaining knowledge skills on first principles of analytics techniques, problem-solving, project management, client relationship management
EDUCATION:
B.E/B.Tech/M.Tech in Computer Science or related technical degree OR Equivalent

Description:
Role & responsibilities :

We are seeking a highly experienced MongoDB Lead/Architect to lead a large-scale legacy data modernization initiative, involving migration of old mainframe-based data systems into a modern MongoDB ecosystem.
This role requires deep expertise in data discovery, reverse engineering, canonical data modeling, and NoSQL schema design, along with the ability to handle highly complex, undocumented legacy systems.
Lead end-to-end data architecture and migration strategy from legacy mainframe systems to MongoDB
Perform data discovery and reverse engineering of undocumented / poorly documented systems
Analyze mainframe data structures (VSAM, flat files, hierarchical data, etc.)
Define and design canonical data models for enterprise-wide usage
Design optimized MongoDB document models (collections, embedding, referencing)
Establish data transformation, cleansing, and mapping strategies
Build data migration frameworks and pipelines
Ensure data consistency, integrity, and reconciliation during migration
Implement MongoDB best practices (indexing, sharding, replication, performance tuning)
Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand implicit data relationships and rules
Define data governance, metadata, and lineage frameworks
Support validation, testing, and post-migration stabilization
Mentor teams on NoSQL design principles and migration approaches


Preferred candidate profile :

MongoDB & NoSQL Expertise
Deep hands-on experience with MongoDB architecture
Migrating from RDBMS/SQL to MongoDB/NoSQL
Knowdlege of MongoDB (Replica Sets, Sharding, Aggregation Framework)
Familiarity with GCP cloud platforms
Strong expertise in:
Document data modeling
Schema design (embedding vs referencing)
Indexing, aggregation framework
Sharding and replication
Data Modeling & Architecture
Expertise in canonical data modeling
Strong experience in:
Data normalization vs denormalization
Designing enterprise-wide data models
Mapping legacy data to modern schemas
Data Migration & Engineering
Experience in large-scale data migration programs (Migrating from RDBMS/SQL to MongoDB/NoSQL)
Knowledge of:
ETL/ELT processes
Data transformation and cleansing
Data reconciliation techniques
Experience with tools like Spark / Python / data pipelines
Legacy System Understanding (Good to have)
Strong experience with mainframe data systems
Knowledge of:
VSAM files
COBOL copybooks
Flat files / hierarchical data structures
Ability to work with missing or undocumented codebases
Problem Solving & Analysis
Strong analytical skills to interpret legacy data without documentation
Ability to infer business rules from data patterns
Performance & Scalability
Experience in performance tuning MongoDB workloads
Ability to design for high-volume, high-velocity data systems
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in banking / insurance / government legacy systems
Exposure to data governance frameworks
Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure)
Experience with data cataloging and metadata tools
MongoDB certifications (Developer/DBA)

About Us
NoBroker.com, founded in 2014 by Amit, Akhil, and Saurabh, is Indias first Proptech unicorn. Its a brokerage-free platform that directly connects property owners with tenants and buyers, eliminating the need for middlemen. With over 1 crore customers and 5 lakh new users each month, its reshaping the real estate market. The platform handles 55,000 transactions monthly, saving INR 1200 crore in brokerage fees each year. Job Title: Field Relationship Manager Packers & Movers
Experience: 03 years
Type: Full-time
Location: Pune , Mumbai, Delhi NCR

MANDATORY: Own bike with valid driving licence is compulsory. Candidates without a two-wheeler will not be considered.
About the Role:
NoBroker is India's first and largest prop-tech unicorn. Our Packers & Movers vertical helps thousands of families relocate stress-free every month. As a Field Relationship Manager, you will be the face of NoBroker on the ground visiting customer locations, coordinating with vendor partners, and ensuring every move is executed smoothly from pre-survey to post-service feedback.
Key Responsibilities:
- Visit customer locations for pre-move surveys and accurately assess household volume, special items, and logistical requirements.
- Build and maintain strong relationships with empanelled PNM vendors and moving partners in your assigned territory.
- Coordinate end-to-end move execution packing, loading, transit, unloading, and unpacking ensuring adherence to committed timelines.
- Act as a single point of contact for the customer throughout the relocation journey.
- Handle on-ground escalations, damage complaints, and service issues with prompt resolution.
- Collect customer feedback and service completion confirmations post-move.
- Identify upsell opportunities for value-added services such as home cleaning, storage, and painting.
- Update job status, visit logs, and customer details in the CRM on a daily basis.
- Meet weekly and monthly field visit and conversion targets assigned by the team lead.
Desired Candidate Profile:
- Own bike + valid driving licence non-negotiable. The role requires daily field visits across the city.
- 03 years of experience in field sales, logistics coordination, or customer relationship management.
- Strong interpersonal and communication skills comfortable dealing with customers and vendors on the ground.
- Self-driven, punctual, and target-oriented with a problem-solving mindset.
- Comfortable using smartphone apps and basic CRM/Google Sheets for daily reporting.
- Graduates preferred; HSC with relevant field experience will also be considered.
- Local candidates with good knowledge of city geography will have an advantage.
What's in It for You:
- Fixed salary + attractive performance-based incentives on every completed move.
- Fuel reimbursement for field visits.
- Health insurance up to 1 lakh.
- Fast-track growth into senior FRM, Team Lead, or Operations roles.
- Structured onboarding and training from day one.
- Work with a high-energy team at India's leading prop-tech company.

Through NoBrokerHood, our smart society and community management platform, we empower over 21,000+ societies across 15 major cities—offering seamless visitor management, billing, and engagement experiences.

Description:
Overview:
The Data Architect for Marketing Solutions on Adobe Experience Platform will lead the design and implementation of robust, scalable, and secure data architectures within AEP, particularly focused on supporting marketing use cases. This role ensures that marketing data is effectively ingested, modeled, governed, and activated to deliver personalized customer journeys and optimize campaign performance.
Key Responsibilities:
Data Architecture & Design: Lead the technical architecture for the client's marketing stack in AEP, including XDM schema design, dataset configuration, and identity graph strategy. Define customer, account, and behavioral data models leveraging XDM standards.
Data Ingestion & Integration: Design and govern the data integration architecture between upstream enterprise sources (e.g., CRM, order management, customer service) and AEP, as well as integrating AEP with other Adobe tools (e.g., Adobe Analytics, Target, Journey Optimizer) and external systems.
Real-Time Customer Profile & Segmentation: Architect and oversee Real-Time CDP configuration, including profile merge rules, identity namespaces, consent management, and destination activation. Design profile schemas, datasets, and identity stitching strategies to support a single customer view.
Data Governance, Privacy & Quality: Establish and enforce governance, privacy, consent management, and data usage frameworks within AEP, ensuring compliance with regulations like GDPR and CCPA. Monitor data quality and security standards for data ingested and activated through AEP.
Collaboration & Leadership: Partner with technical build teams, business stakeholders, marketing teams, and IT to translate complex marketing objectives into scalable data solutions. Provide guidance and act as a trusted advisor to stakeholders on AEP capabilities and best practices.
Optimization & Innovation: Continuously identify new use cases and opportunities to leverage AEP components (such as Adobe Journey Optimizer, Real-Time CDP, Customer Journey Analytics) to support marketing and customer experience objectives. Evaluate new technologies and tools to optimize existing integrated marketing solutions.
Required Qualifications:
Experience with Adobe Experience Platform: 5+ years of hands-on experience with Adobe Experience Platform (AEP) and Adobe Real-Time CDP (RTCDP).
Data Modeling Expertise: Strong knowledge of XDM schema design, data modeling, identity resolution, and cross-platform activation practices within AEP.
Integration Skills: Proven experience in designing data integrations between various marketing technologies and enterprise systems.
Data Governance: Experience establishing and implementing data governance policies, privacy, and consent management within a CDP environment.
Technical Acumen: Familiarity with data ingestion pipelines, APIs, and data warehousing concepts.
Communication: Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills to collaborat with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Marketing, or a related field.
Preferred Qualifications:
Adobe Certifications: Adobe Certified Master - Architect or Expert-level certification in Adobe Experience Platform or related Adobe Experience Cloud products.
Broader Adobe Experience Cloud Knowledge: Experience with other Adobe Experience Cloud solutions such as Adobe Analytics, Adobe Target, Adobe Journey Optimizer, and Marketo Engage.
SQL Expertise: Experience with data querying (e.g., SQL) and understanding of data analysis ecosystems.

Description:
Senior Consultant - Model Validator - Generative AI

The Opportunity
This role offers the opportunity to work within EYs Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) group, supporting leading global financial institutions in identifying, measuring, and managing risk including tradingbook market risk & counterparty credit risk, bankingbook credit risk, operational risk, and regulatory requirements. As part of the Quantitative Trading Book (QTB) team within FSRM, you will contribute to strategic and functional transformation across risk, treasury, and fronttoback-office functions. You will apply quantitative skills to enhance risk and valuation processes, support regulatory compliance, and develop analytics that drive better decisionmaking for clients with capitalmarkets activities. This is an opportunity for quant professionals looking to work on models, regulatory initiatives, and highimpact capitalmarkets engagements across global banks, brokerdealers, asset managers, and insurance institutions.
EY is seeking a highly skilled Generative AI Specialist with expertise in developing / validating AI models. The successful candidate will be instrumental in driving innovation and enhancing our AI capabilities across various domains.
Your key responsibilities
Demonstrate deep technical capabilities and industry knowledge of financial products
Lead components of large-scale client engagements and/or smaller client engagements while consistently delivering quality client services
Understand market trends and demands in the financial services sector and issues faced by clients by staying abreast of current business and industry trends relevant to the client's business
Manage risk, and effectively communicate with key stakeholders regarding status, issues and key priorities to achieve expected outcomes.
Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.
Skills and attributes for success
MRM (SR 11-7 experience) / Model Audit / Model governance along with Gen AI / Traditional AI
Deep understanding of various neural network architectures, including convolutional neural networks (CNNs), recurrent neural networks (RNNs), transformers, and generative adversarial networks (GANs), along with their applications in supervised, unsupervised, and reinforcement learning.
Proficiency in the development / validation of state-of-the-art generative AI models, including RAG structures, as well as experience with natural language processing (NLP) and large language models (LLMs), with skills in data preprocessing, model training, hyperparameter tuning, and evaluation metrics specific to generative tasks for creative content generation and data synthesis.
Utilize leading AI platforms like OpenAI, Azure GPT, Google Gemini, LLaMA, or Mistral, with proficiency in at least one platform.
Conduct comprehensive testing and evaluation of AI models on tasks such as text summarization, content generation, and other NLP applications.
Experience in performance testing of AI models, including evaluation for hallucinations, toxicity, bias, robustness, adversarial attacks, and cybersecurity vulnerabilities.
Knowledge of responsible AI practices, ensuring fairness, transparency, and accountability in AI model development and deployment.
Demonstrate ability to learn and apply new concepts, specifically in the area of financial risk management.
Excellent communication and problem-solving skills, with the ability to explain complex AI concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

EY | Building a better working world
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Description:
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Youll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Servicessolving real client challenges through connected collaboration. Well help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
As an Oracle EPM - EPBCS/EDMCS - Senior Associate - Consult, you will specialize in providing consulting services for enterprise performance management solutions using Oracle technologies. You will collaborate with clients to assess their performance management needs, design and implement Oracle-based solutions for budgeting, forecasting, financial consolidation, and reporting. Within our Digital Core Modernisation practice, you will leverage your skills to help clients improve their financial planning and analysis processes and achieve their performance objectives.
As a Senior Associate, you will play a pivotal role in building meaningful client connections and navigating complex situations. You will be responsible for analyzing intricate problems, mentoring others, and maintaining professional standards. Your role will involve anticipating the needs of your teams and clients, and delivering quality solutions. Embracing increased ambiguity, you will be comfortable when the path forward isn’t clear, using these moments as opportunities to grow.
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will enhance your leadership style by motivating, developing, and inspiring others to deliver quality. You will coach team members, leverage their unique strengths, and manage performance to meet client expectations. Your growing knowledge of business operations will be crucial in identifying opportunities that contribute to the success of our firm.
Responsibilities
- Analyzing client needs to design and implement Oracle-based enterprise performance management solutions
- Collaborating with clients to assess performance management requirements and develop tailored solutions for budgeting, forecasting, and financial consolidation
- Providing training and support to facilitate seamless integration and utilization of Oracle enterprise performance management tools
- Leading project planning, budgeting, execution, and completion to meet client expectations
- Utilizing analytical thinking to identify linkages and interactions within complex systems
- Developing and mentoring team members to enhance their skills and performance
- Addressing conflicts and engaging in challenging conversations with clients and stakeholders
- Upholding professional and technical standards, including adherence to the firm's code of conduct and independence requirements
- Encouraging innovation and embracing technology to improve service delivery and client outcomes
- Conducting strategic data analysis to inform financial planning and performance improvement initiatives

Role & responsibilities

To be responsible for all aspects of specification jobs which includes writing specification packages/ ensuring that the specifications written are given impetus and thrust especially with technical community including opinion makers for all products (excluding cement Grinding aids) and help the sales team in running projects for getting specified new products with consultants/clients & and also to break the competitor specifications.

ESSENTIAL

Participate in technical events like ACCE, REDECON, ICI, IE meetings

BE or Dip in Civil

Fosroc, a Saint-Gobain business, is a leading global provider of high-performance construction chemical solutions, serving the building and infrastructure industry for decades.

Description:
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Youll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Servicessolving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
As an EPM FCCS - Senior Associate - Consult, you will engage with clients to deliver Oracle Enterprise Performance Management solutions, focusing on business application consulting. Within our Technology Consulting practice, you will leverage your skills to support clients in optimizing their performance management processes. This role involves working closely with clients to understand their needs and provide tailored solutions that enhance their business operations.
As a Senior Associate, you will build meaningful client connections and develop a deeper understanding of the business context. You will navigate complex situations, using critical thinking to analyze and solve problems. Your role will involve mentoring junior team members and maintaining professional standards. You will be expected to anticipate the needs of your teams and clients, delivering quality solutions even when the path forward is not clear.
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will have the opportunity to grow your personal brand and deepen your technical skills. You will be part of a dynamic team that values collaboration and innovation, working on projects that have a significant impact on our clients' success.
Responsibilities
- Analyzing complex business processes to develop and implement Oracle Enterprise Performance Management solutions
- Collaborating with clients to understand their financial planning and forecasting needs and translating them into actionable strategies
- Utilizing Oracle Business Intelligence Enterprise Edition (OBIEE) to enhance data-driven decision-making processes
- Conducting business process analysis to identify opportunities for optimization and improved organizational effectiveness
- Developing and maintaining financial planning, budgeting, and forecasting models to support strategic decision-making
- Implementing performance management software to track key performance indicators (KPIs) and operational performance
- Performing root cause analysis to address financial discrepancies and improve profitability management
- Creating and managing budgets to align with client financial goals and regulatory guidelines
- Supporting enterprise integration efforts to streamline financial operations and enhance resource allocation
- Providing guidance and mentorship to junior team members to foster professional growth and development

Location : Chennai, Hyderabad, Bangalore, Noida, Pune and Gururgram

Description:
Position: Sales Officer - General Trade (Dhubri, Tura)
Location: Dhubri, Assam
Industry: Packaged Drinking Water / Beverages / FMCG

Position Overview (Dhubri):
We are looking for performance-driven Sales Officers (General Trade) to manage and expand our packaged drinking water business in Coimbatore. The role involves achieving sales targets, strengthening distributor and retailer networks, enhancing product visibility, and ensuring strong market penetration across the assigned territory.

Key Responsibilities:
Sales & Market Growth:
Achieve monthly and quarterly sales targets in the Dhubri, Tura market.
Drive both primary and secondary sales through distributors, wholesalers, and retail outlets.
Expand retail coverage across general stores, supermarkets, and convenience outlets.

Market Development & Visibility:
Ensure effective product placement, brand visibility, and availability at all relevant outlets.
Execute trade promotions, schemes, and consumer sampling activities in the region.
Explore new business opportunities in urban and semi-urban pockets of Dhubri & Tura.

Distributor & Channel Management:
Manage and support distributors in the assigned territory.
Oversee order booking, delivery coordination, and inventory control.
Implement trade schemes and resolve distributor/retailer concerns promptly.

Customer Relationship Management:
Build and maintain strong relationships with key retailers and trade partners.
Address service issues, complaints, and feedback in a timely manner.
Develop loyalty and retention initiatives to strengthen long-term trade partnerships.

Market Intelligence & Reporting:
Monitor competitor products, pricing strategies, and promotions in the local market.
Collect consumer and retailer insights to shape effective market development strategies.
Submit daily/weekly/monthly reports on sales performance, coverage, and collections.

Collections & Compliance:
Ensure timely collection of payments from distributors/retailers.
Maintain accurate sales, stock, and payment records.
Adhere to company policies, processes, and reporting standards.

Preferred Candidate Profile:
Graduate preferred.
3 - 6 years of experience in FMCG / Beverages / Packaged Drinking Water sales.
Prior exposure to Dhubri/Tura general trade market is preferred.

Candidates interested, kindly send your CV's / Resume to arnab.mukherjee@bisleri.co.in

Description:
Job Location - Meghalaya
NOTE: Candidate will be stationed for 3-5 months in Guwahati Branch at Ulubari for training purpose.

Freshers are welcomed from BSc Agriculture/Botany/Zoology/Chemistry

2 wheeler and Driving license is Mandatory as the role if field operations role

Job Responsibilities:
Core Operations
Ensure availability of qualified (trained & certified) Technicians at all time as per Technical Training Guidelines.
Coach and train assigned technicians in order to improve the service quality and customer retention of the assigned service area, as per Technical Training Guidelines & service SOPs.
Ensure availability of recommended preparation, materials, and service tools in working condition to Technicians as per service SOPs.
Conduct daily 10 min stand up meeting, and explain safety and special instruction to assigned technicians to execute the job as per instructions received from Sales Team/Service Docket.
Ensure SCP devices are effectively used by technicians, troubleshooting of SCP issues and providing refresher training to technicians on the updates as & when required.
Ensure all On-Site service documentation in 'Partner Kit' are up to date as per contractual requirements and as per myRentokil (for myR customer)
Ensure implementation and Compliance of service SOP, SHE golden rules, ATEX and PINK NOTE by self and the assigned technicians.
Minimum 15 customer visits per week that includes- Surprise visits, Rout ride, TPA, Customer complaints, Pest Audits, etc.- Resi & SA (including QSRs)
Ensure APL (Approved Preparations List) listed preparations, products and materials are used in line with service SOPs
Ensure material stores are maintained appropriately as per good storage practice and disposal of empty containers, used TG/Control board, pesticides wrappers and damaged materials are disposed in line with SOP
Ensure proper schedule of maintenance & repairs of equipment is established & is followed periodically
In case any of the Operations colleagues are on leave or position is vacant, should ensure entries are made in iCABS to achieve operations KPI of Branch.
Ensure technicians carry out treatment within a given Standard Treatment Time (STT) in a competent manner and effectively follow the route plan and timings defined by Service Planner.
Approval of conveyance amount for assigned technicians
Promote highest grooming standards (uniform, Safety shoes, PPEs)
Advance Operations
Conduct PMI 'Pest Audit' as per icabs- QSRs & Small branch accounts
Plan & execute 01 TPAs (Technicians Performance Assessment) per assigned technician with 1 development programs per year.
Identify & resolve Service delivery issues in coordination with the Branch Manager
Ensure customer complaints are resolved as per complaint management SOP and update the Root Cause in iCABS to ensure proper ticket closure in time.
Analyse customer complaints- CO- service wise and improve skills of identified Technicians to reduce CO & ensure closure by monitoring open tickets on weekly basis
Compliance and closure of audits non-conformities w.r.t. service operations (Internal / External)
Track and optimize material consumption as per SRF, Cost sheet and SOW and report deviations to line manager
Ensure adequate stocks of materials as pending & new jobs in line with APL and SOPs are available in branch, and near expiry materials are used first.
Track and monitor materials consumption to ensure branch material consumption within the target.
Maintaining Optimum Stock Level and Ensuring Indents are raised after checking requirement and stock.
Monitor and drive service productivity and efficiency.
Carry out Pest Management Inspection- Pest Audits of assigned customers as per iCAB using rAuditor
Ensure Service leads are submitted by all technicians as per the target
Monitor & report to Line Manager on input costs at all major sites as per gross margin agreed & discuss action plans to bring it within limits.
Actively drive Service & Product Leads for assigned technician group within service area by on the job coaching to create density of customers.
Encourage technicians to plan their leaves in advance to curb absenteeism
Help Resolve any Grievances & IR issues of Technicians & bring to the notice of the Line Manager on day to day basis
Report any deviation that could impact service quality or productivity of technicians like- overcommitments, recommendation regarding night service, additional visits, covered area mismatch, etc.
Self Development- Be updated with latest innovations, Service SOPs, SHE and PN updates.

Educational Qualification / Other Requirement:
Minimum B. Sc. (Chemistry / Zoology / Agriculture). Any prior experience in operations of pest management or service industry is desirable.
Proficient in use of computer applications & systems with Excel, Word, PowerPoint (or its equivalent)
Should get well versed with various internal company systems such as iCABS, STP, iAuditor, SRA, SQA, SQS, TPA, myRentokilPCI, Service Leads App, U+ etc

Rentokil PCI is the leading pest control service provider in India. A Rentokil Initial brand, Rentokil PCI was formed in 2017 through a joint venture (JV) between Pest Control India, the number one pest control company in India, and Rentokil, the world’s leading pest control brand. Rentokil PCI aims to set new standards for customer service having operations across 300 locations in India.

Mizoram Greetings from ICICI Lombard General Insurance Co. Ltd.!!

ICICI Lombard is the leading private general insurance company in the country. Description:
Areas of responsibility include Restaurants/Bars and Room Service, if applicable.
Assists in the daily supervision restaurant operations and assists with menu planning, maintains sanitation standards and assists servers and hosts on the floor during peak meal periods.
Strives to continually improve guest and employee satisfaction.
Determines training needed to accomplish goals, then implements plan.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 4 years experience in the food and beverage, culinary, or related professional area. OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Food Service Management, Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; 2 years experience in the food and beverage, culinary, or related professional area. CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Assisting in Management of Restaurant Team
- Handles employee questions and concerns.
- Monitors employees to ensure performance expectations are met.
- Provides feedback to employees based on observation of service behaviors.
- Assists in supervising daily shift operations.
- Supervises restaurant and all related areas in the absence of the Director of Restaurants or Restaurant Manager.
- Participates in department meetings by communicating a clear and consistent message regarding the departmental goals to produce desired results.
Conducting Day-to-Day Restaurant Operations
- Ensures all employees have proper supplies, equipment and uniforms.
- Communicates to Chef and Restaurant Manager any issues regarding food quality and service levels.
- Ensures compliance with all restaurant policies, standards and procedures.
- Monitors alcohol beverage service in compliance with local laws.
- Manages to achieve or exceed budgeted goals.
- Performs all duties of restaurant employees and related departments as necessary.
- Opens and closes restaurant shifts.
Providing Exceptional Customer Service
- Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
- Supervises staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and ficial objectives are met.
- Encourages employees to provide excellent customer service within guidelines.
- Handles guest problems and complaints, seeking assistance from supervisor as necessary.
- Strives to improve service performance.
- Sets a positive example for guest relations.
- Assists in the review of comment cards and guest satisfaction results with employees.
- Meets and greets guests.
Conducting Human Resource Activities
- Supervises on-going training initiatives.
- Uses all available on the job training tools for employees.
- Communicates performance expectations in accordance with job descriptions for each position.
- Coaches and counsels employees regarding performance on an on-going basis.
Additional Responsibilities
- Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
- Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
- Assists servers and hosts on the floor during meal periods and high demand times.
- Recognizes good quality products and presentations.
- Supervises daily shift operations in absence of Restaurant Manager.

Complete closing duties, including storing all reusable goods, breaking down goods, cleaning all equipment and areas, returning equipment to proper locations, locking refrigerators, restocking items, turning off lights, locking doors, and completing daily cleaning checklist.
Set up, stock, and maintain work areas.
Inspect the cleanliness and presentation of all china, glass, and silver prior to use.
Maintain cleanliness of work areas throughout the day, practicing clean-as-you-go procedures.
Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures; report accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; and complete safety training and certifications.
Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional, maintain confidentiality of proprietary information, and protect company assets.
Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards.
Speak with others using clear and professional language, and answer telephones using appropriate etiquette.
Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others, support team to reach common goals, and listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees.
Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards.
Read and visually verify information in a variety of formats (eg, small print).
Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time or for an entire work shift.
Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance.
Grasp, turn, and manipulate objects of varying size and weight, requiring fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination.
Move over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces as well as up and down stairs and/or service ramps.
Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping.
Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.

Description:
Our jobs aren t just about giving guests a clean room and a freshly made bed.
Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique.
Our Guest Environment Experts are skilled in a wide range of housekeeping functions with responsibility for maintaining the appearance and cleanliness of the whole hotel.
They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done.
Whether delivering guest requests, stocking carts, cleaning rooms and public spaces, or other similar responsibilities, the Guest Environment Expert makes sure the spaces in the hotel help create a great guest experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success ensuring a safe work place, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Environment Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Environment Experts to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Determines training needed to accomplish goals, then implements plan.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
High school diploma or GED; 4 years experience in the food and beverage, culinary, or related professional area. OR
2-year degree from an accredited university in Food Service Management, Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; 2 years experience in the food and beverage, culinary, or related professional area. CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Assisting in Management of Restaurant Team
Handles employee questions and concerns.
Monitors employees to ensure performance expectations are met.
Provides feedback to employees based on observation of service behaviors.

Manages to achieve or exceed budgeted goals.
Performs all duties of restaurant employees and related departments as necessary.
