Handles guest problems and complaints, seeking assistance from supervisor as necessary.
Strives to improve service performance.
Sets a positive example for guest relations.
Assists in the review of comment cards and guest satisfaction results with employees.
Meets and greets guests.

Uses all available on the job training tools for employees.
Communicates performance expectations in accordance with job descriptions for each position.
Coaches and counsels employees regarding performance on an on-going basis.

Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
Assists servers and hosts on the floor during meal periods and high demand times.
Recognizes good quality products and presentations.
Supervises daily shift operations in absence of Restaurant Manager.

Description:
Assists the Front Office Manager in administering front office functions and supervising staff on a daily basis.
Front office areas include Bell/Door Staff, Switchboard and Guest Services/Front Desk.
Position directs and works with managers and employees to carry out procedures ensuring an efficient check in and check out process.
Ensures guest and employee satisfaction and maximizes the ficial performance of the department.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
High school diploma or GED; 2 years experience in the guest services, front desk, or related professional area. OR
2-year degree from an accredited university in Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; no work experience required.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Maintaining Guest Services and Front Desk Goals
Manages day-to-day operations, ensuring the quality, standards and meeting the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.
Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish your work.
Handles complaints, settling disputes, and resolving grievances and conflicts, or otherwise negotiating with others.
Supervises staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and ficial objectives are met.
Ensures that regular on-going communication is happening with employees to create awareness of business objectives and communicate expectations, recognizes performance, and produces desired results.
Understands the impact of department s operations on the overall property ficial goals and objectives and manages to achieve or exceed goals.
Supporting Management of Front Desk Team
Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound ficial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
Encourages and building mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.
Serving as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.
Supervises and manages employees.
Manages all day-to-day operations.
Understands employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees absence.
Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees and ensures employees do the same within the team.
Supervises all areas of the Front Office in the absence of the Front Office or Assistant Front Office Manager.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.
Responds to and handles guest problems and complaints.
Sets a positive example for guest relations.
Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.
Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals.
Interacts with customers to obtain feedback on quality of product, service levels and overall satisfaction.
Ensures employees understand customer service expectations and parameters.
Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
Emphasizes guest satisfaction during all departmental meetings and focuses on continuous improvement.
Managing Projects and Policies
Implements the customer recognition/service program, communicating and ensuring the process.
Trains staff and monitors adherence to all credit policies and procedures to reduce bad debts and rebates.
Supervises same day selling procedures to maximize room revenue and control property occupancy.
Supervises daily Front Desk shift operations and ensures compliance with all policies, standards and procedures.
Ensures property policies are administered fairly and consistently, disciplinary procedures and documentation are completed according to Standard and Local Operating Procedures (SOPs and LSOPs) and support the Peer Review Process.
Supporting Human Resource Activities
Supports the developmental needs of others and coaching, mentoring, or otherwise helping others to improve their knowledge or skills.
Solicits employee feedback, utilizes an open door policy and reviews employee satisfaction results to identify and address employee problems or concerns.
Brings issues concerning employee satisfaction to the attention of the department manager and Human Resources.
Assists as needed in the interviewing and hiring of employee team members with the appropriate skills.
Supports a departmental orientation program for employees to receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.
Participates in employee progressive discipline procedures.
Additional Responsibilities
Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
Informs and/or updates the executives, the peers and the subordinates on relevant information in a timely manner.
Performs all duties at the Front Desk as necessary.
Runs Front Desk shifts whenever necessary.
Participates in departmental meetings and continually communicates a clear and consistent message regarding the Front Desk goals to produce desired results.

Description:
We are looking for a skilled Attendant Operator to join our team at Tagros Chemicals India Ltd., responsible for ensuring the smooth operation of our chemical plant. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in chemical plant operations and be able to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.

Roles and Responsibility


Operate and maintain chemical plant equipment, including reactors, distillation columns, and centrifuges.

Monitor and control chemical processes to ensure product quality and safety.

Collaborate with other operators and maintenance personnel to troubleshoot issues and optimize performance.

Implement safety procedures and protocols to prevent accidents and injuries.

Conduct regular inspections of equipment and facilities to identify potential hazards or defects.

Develop and implement process improvements to increase efficiency and reduce costs.


Job Requirements


Diploma or degree in Chemical Engineering or related field.

Minimum 2 years of experience as an operator in a chemical plant setting.

Strong knowledge of chemical plant operations, including safety procedures and protocols.

Ability to work effectively in a team environment and communicate clearly with colleagues.

Familiarity with chemical plant software and instrumentation is desirable.

Must pass a pre-employment physical and drug-alcohol screening.

Qualification: Diploma, ITI, or equivalent technical qualification in textiles, fiber technology, handicrafts, rural technologies, or related fields.

Experience Required:

Prior experience supporting natural fiber-based enterprises, weaving units, or community production centers.

Experience working with rural livelihoods, artisan collectives, or producer groups will be preferred




Skills and Attributes


Practical knowledge of pineapple fiber extraction, processing, and weaving/textile production.

Ability to operate and troubleshoot fiber extraction/processing machinery and tools.

Understanding of quality standards and production workflows for natural fiber products.

Experience working with artisans, producer groups, SHGs, or community enterprises.

Strong problem-solving, communication, and hands-on training skills.


About the Project

PCI India is implementing multi-state livelihood programmes across Assam, Tripura, Meghalaya, and Sikkim, supporting women and youth from rural and tribal communities to build micro-enterprises in bamboo craft, banana and pineapple fiber textiles, and community-led eco-tourism. The programme provides capacity building, tools and services, exposure, and market linkages to strengthen socio-economic resilience and promote inclusive, climate-resilient growth.

Within the programme, a dedicated pineapple fiber enterprise intervention is being implemented in Meghalaya to establish SHG-led fiber extraction and weaving units. The intervention converts agricultural waste (pineapple leaf biomass) into eco-fabric for fashion, packaging, and other value-added markets, combining technical training with market linkage support to build sustainable, climate-resilient livelihoods for women and youth.

The programme integrates appropriate technology, quality production processes, artisan skill development, and sustainable resource utilization.

The Role

The Technical worker will provide hands-on operational and technical support to ensure efficient functioning of pineapple fiber extraction, processing, and weaving activities at the unit level.

Key Responsibilities


Ensure smooth operation and maintenance of pineapple fiber extraction and processing equipment.

Support standardised production processes and quality assurance for eco-fabric and textile products.

Strengthen technical capacities of artisans, SHG members, and production workers for efficient and sustainable enterprise operations.

Support the establishment and smooth operation of SHG-led pineapple fiber extraction and weaving units.

Description:
About the Position
Job Title: Consultant Livelihood Expert
Number of positions: 1
Location: Meghalaya (Local-based at Banana Pineapple Fibre Extraction and Fabric Making Unit)
Duration: Till March 2027
Type: Project Based
Qualification: Graduate/Postgraduate degree in Rural Development, Textile technology, Agriculture/Agribusiness, Development studies or a related field.
Experience Required:
Minimum 2-3 years of experience in livelihood projects, rural enterprise development, or textile processing.
Demonstrated experience in community mobilization, strengthening producer organizations and value chain developments for rural enterprises.
Experience working with government programs, NGOs, or private sector initiatives is desirable.
Skills and Attribute
Strong understanding of rural livelihoods, enterprise development, and value chain approaches.
Experience in SHG/community institution building, governance, and capacity strengthening.
Knowledge of market linkage strategies, including for natural fibre/textile or handicraft-based products. Ability to design training curricula and capacity-building plans for community-based enterprises.
Strong analytical, planning, Communication and report writing skills.
Excellent stakeholder engagement and coordination skills with government departments, SHGs, and private sector partners.
Sensitivity to the socio-cultural and tribal community context of Meghalaya/Northeast India.
About the Project
PCI India is implementing multi-state livelihood programmes across Assam, Tripura, Meghalaya, and Sikkim, supporting women and youth from rural and tribal communities to build micro-enterprises in bamboo craft, banana and pineapple fibre textiles, and community-led eco-tourism. The programme provides capacity building, tools and services, exposure, and market linkages to strengthen socio-economic resilience and promote inclusive, climate-resilient growth.
Within the programme, a dedicated pineapple fibre enterprise intervention is being implemented in Meghalaya to establish SHG-led fibre extraction and weaving units. The intervention converts agricultural waste (pineapple leaf biomass) into eco-fabric for fashion, packaging, and other value-added markets, combining technical training with market linkage support to build sustainable, climate-resilient livelihoods for women and youth.
The program integrates appropriate technology, quality production processes, artisan skill development, and sustainable resource utilisation.
The Role
The Livelihood Expert will provide overall technical and strategic guidance to strengthen SHG-led enterprise development, ensure the intervention is designed and implemented in a financially and socially sustainable manner, and support convergence with market and livelihood ecosystems in the state.
Key Responsibilities
Provide technical leadership for the design, planning, and implementation of the pineapple fiber livelihood intervention
Strengthen SHG institutional capacity for enterprise management, governance, and financial sustainability.
Facilitate market linkages and value chain development for pineapple fiber-based products.
Support monitoring of livelihood outcomes and implementation strategies as needed.
What You Can Expect at PCI
A warm, inclusive, and happy work environment
Performance driven reward mechanism

Description:
BACKGROUND
The Hans Foundation (THF), established in 2009, is a Public Charitable Trust that works towards creating an equitable society to enhance quality of life for all through the empowerment of marginalized and underprivileged communities in India. The Hans Foundation works for the Health and Wellbeing of remote and under-served groups, with an additional focus on children, persons with disabilities and women. THF also works for holistic Education and Livelihood development of our communities. Our Two-Fold Strategy involves identifying and working within Aspirational Districts and high poverty index in the North, North-East and East regions within specific states, as well as catering to lower-income and migratory populations in cities, through urban programs.
Over its 15 years of existence, THF has reached more than 35 million beneficiaries through its programs. THF works with communities through direct implementation of projects on the ground in addition to providing local management and monitoring support to not-for-profit organizations in India funded through THF USA and RIST.

PROJECT OVERVIEW: Hans Learning Bridge - Meghalaya
The Learning Bridge Meghalaya Project is a primary education intervention aimed at strengthening foundational learning outcomes among children through structured support in 8 government primary schools and 5 Community-Based Learning Centres (CBLCs). The project focuses on improving basic literacy, numeracy, attendance, and overall classroom engagement by introducing targeted learning support, trained facilitators, and community-based learning activities. It works closely with schools, teachers, and local communities to bridge learning gaps, enhance teaching quality, and ensure continuous academic support for children, especially those who are at risk of falling behind. Through regular monitoring, capacity building, and community participation, the project seeks to create a strong and inclusive learning environment that improves educational outcomes at the primary level in Meghalaya.

GENERAL
Location of Job: Mylliem Block, East Khasi Hills, Meghalaya
No. of Positions: 01
Reporting to: Project Coordinator
Job type: Consultant mode for 1-year, renewable basis project requirements.


1. JOB PURPOSE
The FLN Tutor will support children in achieving foundational literacy and numeracy skills through school and community-based learning interventions. The tutor will conduct remedial classes, support out-of-school children, and engage with parents and communities to improve learning outcomes and school retention.

2. KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES
Conduct FLN and remedial learning sessions for children.
Assess learning levels and track student progress.
Support Community-Based Learning Centres (CBLCs) and learning camps.
Identify and support out-of-school and irregular children through bridge learning activities.
Maintain attendance, assessment, and activity records.
Conduct parent meetings and home visits to encourage regular learning and school attendance.
Coordinate with schools, community stakeholders, and project staff.

3. Reporting to: Project Coordinator
4. Other Indicative Requirements
Educational Qualifications:
Graduate in Education, Social Sciences, or related field.
B.Ed./ DL.Ed preferred
Functional / Technical Skills and Relevant Experience & Other requirements (Behavioural, Language, Certifications etc.)
Minimum 2 year of teaching, tutoring, or community education experience.
Knowledge of FLN, child-centred pedagogy, and community engagement preferred.
Skills Required
Good communication and facilitation skills.
Ability to work with children and communities.
Basic reporting and record-keeping skills.
Knowledge of local language(s) and English preferred.

THF is an equal opportunity employer that encourages women, people with disabilities and those from economically and socially excluded communities with the requisite skills and qualifications to apply for positions. We do not discriminate in employment on the basis of caste, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, or any other such matter.

Description:
Job Title
Assistant Security Safety Manager
Job Summary
This position exists for leading the Security Safety team at a property, ensuring full compliance with safety regulations, fire and life safety standards, and implementing security protocols effectively. The role involves managing incidents, conducting risk assessments, overseeing staff training, and ensuring a safe and secure environment for both guests and employees.
Responsibilities
Assists in leading the security and safety function for a large property or manages a mid-size property independently.
Supervises staff, ensures compliance with security protocols, and leads emergency preparedness programs.
Conducts risk assessments and leads incident investigations.
Collaborates with property leadership on safety and security strategies, managing projects such as security system upgrades and safety audits.
Areas of Responsibility
1. Leadership and Supervision of Security Safety Operations. Operational Leadership. Lead day-to-day operations of the security and safety team, Staff Scheduling and Performance Management. Manage staff rosters, ensuring adequate coverage for all shifts, including night patrols. Leadership in Incident Response. Act as the point of escalation during security and safety incidents.
2. Property Patrols, Safety Inspections, and Incident Management. Regular Patrol Supervision. Direct and oversee routine property patrols, focusing on critical areas such as entry/exit points, guest room corridors, parking areas, and high-risk zones. Inspection and Compliance. Conduct daily and weekly safety inspections of the property, Incident Management. Ensure prompt response to any security or safety incidents, such as fire alarms, medical emergencies, or unauthorized access.
3. Access Control Surveillance Management. Access Point Management. Oversee all access control points, ensuring the team diligently monitors and restricts unauthorized access to sensitive areas. Surveillance Systems Oversight. Card Access Systems. Supervise the proper management of electronic access systems, ensuring accurate logging and review of access logs for sensitive or restricted areas.
4. Fire Life Safety Management. Fire Safety Protocols. Oversee the maintenance and readiness of fire detection systems, firefighting equipment, and evacuation routes. Life Safety Preparedness. Manage life safety programs, including first aid, medical response, and emergency evacuation plans. Fire Drills and Emergency Simulations.
5. Risk Assessments, Audits, and Compliance. Comprehensive Risk Management. Conduct comprehensive security and safety risk assessments on the property, identifying vulnerabilities in physical security, access control, and fire/life safety systems. Internal Audits and Compliance. Conduct internal audits of security and safety operations, ensuring compliance with IHCL's safety standards, local regulatory requirements, and global best practices. Incident Reporting and Documentation. Ensure that all security incidents, safety breaches, and fire hazards are documented accurately.
6. Safety Security Awareness and Training. Staff Training Programs. Lead the development and delivery of safety and security training programs for the property staff. Security Awareness Campaigns. Develop security awareness programs to promote a proactive safety and security culture within the property. Contractor and Vendor Safety Training. Ensure that all third-party contractors, vendors, and external service providers are fully briefed on property security and safety procedures.
7. Budget Resource Management for Security Safety Operations. Budget Oversight. Assist the SS Manager in preparing and managing the budget for security and safety operations, ensuring all expenditures are aligned with property and company standards. Resource Allocation. Manage the deployment of security resources, based on property needs, special events, and high-risk periods. Procurement of Equipment. Oversee the procurement of security and fire safety equipment, ensuring that all systems and tools are up-to-date, operational, and meet the regulatory requirements.
8. Crisis Management Business Continuity. Emergency Response Leadership. Take an active leadership role during crises, such as fire outbreaks, evacuations, or large-scale incidents. Business Continuity Planning.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Security Management, Occupational Health Safety, or equivalent
Certification in Fire Safety, First Aid, or Occupational Safety
Work Experience
13-15 years of experience in security and safety roles, with leadership experience in large properties
Languages Needed in Position
Fluency in English, Hindi, and local dialects
Key Interfaces - External
Local law enforcement and emergency services
Regulatory bodies
Contractors and service providers (Fire safety, security systems)
Third-party security agencies (where applicable)

SS Manager
Director of SS
General Manager
HR Department
Engineering and Housekeeping
Other departmental heads
Behavioral Competencies
Change Championship
Collaborative Engagement
Growth Mindset
Guest Centricity
Personal Effectiveness
Process Excellence

About the Role
We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented DGM Unit HR & Administration for our client, a reputed organization in the Cement Industry. The position will be responsible for independently leading the complete HR & Administration function of the manufacturing unit, reporting to the Unit Head and functionally reporting to the Corporate HR Head.

Key Responsibilities
Lead and manage the complete Unit HR & Administration function.
Develop and implement HR strategies aligned with the operational and business requirements of the plant.
Manage manpower planning, recruitment, onboarding, employee engagement and retention.
Handle employee relations, industrial relations and grievance management.
Manage contract labour and ensure effective workforce deployment.
Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws, statutory requirements and company policies.
Oversee HR operations including attendance, leave, payroll coordination and employee records.
Lead administrative functions including security, transportation, canteen, facilities and employee welfare.
Drive employee engagement, discipline, capability development and a positive work culture at the unit.
Work closely with plant leadership and corporate HR on manpower, employee relations and organizational initiatives.
Ensure smooth and effective implementation of HR policies and processes at the unit.

Candidate Profile
12–15 years of overall experience in HR & Administration.
Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in Unit HR & Administration.
Mandatory experience in the Cement Industry.
Strong experience in a manufacturing/plant environment.
Good understanding of Industrial Relations, Labour Laws and statutory compliance.
Experience in handling large-scale manpower and contract labour.
Strong leadership, stakeholder management and communication skills.
Should have the ability to independently manage HR & Administration operations at a unit level

Compensation & Facilities
Food facility provided by the company.
Family accommodation provided.
Senior leadership opportunity within a reputed Cement Industry organization.

Interested candidates may share their updated resume at:
Mail ID: contact@talentcraft.co.in
Contact No./Whatsapp No.: +91-9664301865

Description:
About The/Nudge
The/Nudge is an action institute building resilient livelihoods to alleviate poverty. We work with women, farmers, tribals, and youth across rural development, agriculture, skilling, and economic inclusion, in partnership with 15+ central and state governments.
Our economic inclusion journey towards serving 25 million Indians spans 10 states and currently reaches over 1.5 million people. Through our incubator, accelerator, and grand challenges, we have supported 200+ social entrepreneurs, including Forbes 30 Under 30 honorees, Earthshot Prize winners, and nationally recognized changemakers.
Founded with the support of 130+ eminent philanthropists, 40+ corporates, and 15+ foundations, The/Nudge is working towards a poverty-free India, within our lifetime."
What are we solving for
We are solving for households in poverty who are also nancially and socially vulnerable through a targeted, multi-faceted, and sequenced model called the graduation approach, which has demonstrated that we can durably pull households out of poverty.
At The/Nudge Institute, we are in the process of catalyzing the propagation of the same. Our purpose is to contribute to making the most excluded individuals a contributing member to the economy:
Enable govt to adopt by providing research, design, and implementation support
Continue to implement on its own to iterate the design for impact at scale
Enable more NGOs to adopt technical and capacity-building support
Continue to generate data on poverty and evidence on graduation approach to nudge governments to adopt at-scale
Build technology solutions for NGOs and governments to adopt and implement at scale & with quality.
Position Overview:
The/Nudge is working with the Meghalaya Government Innovation Lab and Meghalaya State Rural Livelihoods Society (MSRLS), Government of Meghalaya, to help increase adoption of the graduation approach/ economic inclusion program by targeting 4000 ultra-poor/ poorest of the poor, mainly single distress mothers through community institutions.
Block Lead : To be placed in Rongram block- West Garo HIlls District

What will you do
Pure eldwork in close coordination with the District and Block Project Managers of MSRLS, district and block staff of various line departments of the State Government, local community leaders, and community institutions of MSRLS like CLF, VO, SHG, Community Cadre and Gram Panchayat.
Regular eld visits.
To understand and practice the Spirits of The/Nudge Institute and MSRLS
Selection of vulnerable women in identi ed geographies in Meghalaya
Mobilization of such vulnerable women into small groups and SHG
Selection, placement and capacity building of community cadre from local villages/ gram panchayats to provide tight handholding and facilitation support to the targeted vulnerable women/ families
Facilitate such vulnerable family s access to eligible Government entitlements and social security schemes through various convergence platforms like community cadre, community institution, social capital, block level line departments, internal convergence within the MSRLS etc.
Effective livelihood planning for these families and facilitate them to access and avail formal credit/ loans from the community institutions to start the livelihood activities
Capacity building of the community institutions and community cadre for the welfare of these vulnerable women in long-run (enhance community s ownership through communitization process)
Ensure all project activities are implemented on time with utmost quality as per approved Project Implementation Plan (PIP)/ Standard Operating Procedure (SoP)/ Package of Practice (PoP)/ Community Operational Manual (COM)
Timely collection/ entry, processing and reporting of data
Develop case studies and to add content/contextualisation to the overall knowledge management component of the program
Good stakeholder management at the grassroots level

Who are we looking for in this role
Preference shall be given to women candidates, candidates from ST, SC social categories and belonging to the state.
Must have a working knowledge of English and local language (read, speak and write). The position is transferable at any point in time to any District/Blocks within Meghalaya with at least 15 days of notice.
Candidates from development sector/ rural development / poverty eradication / livelihood promotion / tribal development educational / work experience backgrounds or any administrative experience.
Candidates with internship / work experience working in block / district-level positions in National Rural Livelihood Mission/ State Rural Livelihood Missions in Institution Building, Capacity Building, Social Inclusion, Social Development, and Livelihood promotion
The candidate must have her/his own bike with a valid driving license as it is a eld-based job.
Preference will be given to local residents, especially women candidates, and candidates belonging to ST, SC social categories and any other marginalized communities.
What s in it for you
Own your growth: An impact-led learning environment encourages Nudgesters to invest in their learning and capacity building needs through initiatives and policies, including L&D wallet, individual development plan and internal role change opportunities.
Find your tribe: Our hiring philosophy emphasises intent, attitude, smarts and skills, in that order, to build a cohesive environment for Nudgesters. The organisation is committed to curating people-centric policies, enhancing how employees experience life at The/Nudge.
Take big bets: Organisational initiatives are intended to facilitate Nudgesters with a view to the big picture, illustrated by our impact across 50000+ households, 15+ governments, 200+ social enterprises and Charcha: India s largest social sector convening forum.
Make it happen: A product-based approach in an action-biased environment empowers Nudgesters to implement audacious plans. Driven to fail fast, we endeavour to optimise resources in favour of programs that align with our scale ambition.
We aspire to be an inclusive and diverse organization and encourage qualified individuals irrespective of their religion, caste, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, ethnicity, age, or any other dimension of identity, to apply.

Description:
Summary
The Area Sales Manager is a key strategic leader within the solar energy industry, responsible for driving revenue growth and expanding market presence across a defined geographic region. This role focuses on building and managing a high-performing B2B sales team, cultivating relationships with commercial and industrial clients, and executing targeted sales strategies to achieve aggressive quarterly and annual targets. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in B2B sales within the renewable energy sector, with a proven ability to navigate complex procurement processes, negotiate long-term contracts, and deliver scalable solar solutions. As a critical link between the organization and its enterprise clients, the Area Sales Manager plays a pivotal role in advancing sustainable energy adoption, contributing to corporate sustainability goals, and strengthening the company position as a leader in the solar industry.

Responsibilities
Develop and execute regional sales strategies aligned with company growth objectives and market opportunities in the solar energy sector.
Lead, mentor, and manage a team of B2B sales representatives, ensuring performance excellence through coaching, goal setting, and regular feedback.
Identify, qualify, and pursue new commercial and industrial B2B prospects, focusing on solar PV system installations for businesses, manufacturing facilities, and institutional clients.
Build and maintain strategic relationships with key decision-makers at enterprise accounts, including facility managers, sustainability officers, and procurement teams.
Collaborate with technical and project development teams to deliver customized solar solutions that meet client energy needs and financial objectives.
Analyze market trends, competitor activity, and customer behavior to refine sales approaches and improve win rates.
Prepare and present detailed proposals, financial models, and ROI analyses to support client decision-making.
Track and report on sales pipeline, forecast accuracy, and KPIs using CRM platforms to ensure transparency and data-driven planning.
Ensure compliance with industry regulations, safety standards, and company policies throughout the sales and project handoff process.

Requirements
Requirements:
Bachelor degree in Business, Engineering, Renewable Energy, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
Proven experience (5+ years) in B2B sales, with a strong track record of exceeding sales targets in the renewable energy, clean tech, or construction industry.
In-depth knowledge of solar energy systems, including photovoltaic (PV) technology, financing models (PPA, lease, cash purchase), and incentive programs (e.g., ITC, state rebates).
Demonstrated ability to manage complex sales cycles involving multi-stakeholder decision-making and long-term contracts.
Proficiency in CRM software (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot) and Microsoft Office Suite for reporting, forecasting, and client presentations.
Strong negotiation, presentation, and interpersonal skills with the ability to influence at the executive level.
Valid driver license and willingness to travel extensively within the assigned region.
Experience in team leadership and performance management, including hiring, training, and performance evaluation.
Familiarity with sustainability metrics and ESG reporting is a plus.
Compensation Benefits
Competitive base salary: ${salary}
Performance-based commission and bonus structure
Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
401(k) plan with company match
Paid time off, holidays, and professional development opportunities
Company-sponsored training in solar technology and sales strategy

Description:
About Bharti Airtel Foundation:
Quality education is the hallmark of a great nation; if we wishto see phenomenal changes in the world, we must strive to create an order thatsupports education and develops it. With a profound intent and commitment tomake a difference, Bharti Airtel Foundation, the philanthropic arm of BhartiEnterprises, started its operations in the year 2000, to bring about atransformation in the education arena and thus the living condition of childrenand youth in rural India.
Since its inception, the Foundation has been proactively engagedin formulating and executing education programs at primary, secondary andtertiary levels. All its actions are driven by a necessity and resolve, notonly to offer free education to the underprivileged children, but also tocreate opportunities that enable their holistic development.
Bharti Airtel Foundation consistently works to realize itsvision, mission and goals in collaboration and partnership with itsstakeholders, including government, corporate sector and rural community.
AboutQuality Support Program:
Bharti Airtel Foundation is committed to ensuring studentsholistic development by making schools into vibrant institutions that offerquality education by strengthening co-scholastic interventions. The belief isof a holistic approach to education to inspire students to become engaged inthe learning and schooling process. QSP State Partnerships aims to transformgovernment schools into vibrant and integrated learning institutions bystrengthening and introducing new techniques and interventions at the state anddistrict levels. The core philosophy of the program is that if schools becomeengaging and happy spaces, it would result in the development of students asthey acquire various life skills that are critical to academics.
Qualification and Experience Required:
MSW / MBA / Post Graduate in Rural Development.
Candidate has degree/ diploma/ certificate in courses related to education- B. Ed/ M. Ed or qualified UGC-NET in education.
Working experience in school management, content/ curriculum development or developing tools of assessment/ testing.
Experience in implementation of education program & Learning Outcomes.
Freshers are also welcome to apply.
Ideal age bracket (preferable) is upto 35 Years.
About the Job:
The purpose of this role is to ensure project implementation inallocated schools and maintain quality and effectiveness as per logicalframework and in line with overall program philosophy.
Key Responsibility Area:
Conduct baseline assessments in school.
Support school team and teachers to develop academic interventions plan and activity calendar.
Support teachers to use TheTeacherApp effectively towards continuous professional development.
Orient Principal and Teacher about the QSP Program at regular intervals.
Implement all program activities as per Logical Framework and in line with the overall program philosophy.
Engage with and encourage community participation in school development activities.
Motivate students to lead all in school club activities.
Keep the school informed about various external competitions/participative events and bring in a culture of winning awards in partner schools.
Plan and budget for all in school activities, event, campaigns etc. on a monthly /quarterly basis as may be mutually agreed with the Reporting Manager.
Carry out activities as may also be planned by the HO and effectively implement.
Ensure effective and accurate reporting of all program indicators on a monthly/need basis in the online MIS portal/other reporting templates from time to time.
Engage with Block/District level department officials and provide necessary information as may be asked for.
Follow all operating guidelines with respect to student safety both within and outside the school in case of any external activities, competitions, excursion tours etc.
Prepare all program reports, plan the exit process, and provide support to the school on a need basis in case of program tenure completion.
Skills:
Liasoning and networking
Interpersonal relationship
Facilitation skill
Communication and presentation
Execution skill

Description:
We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced Attendant Operator to join our team at Sumitomo Chemical India Private Limited. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in chemical plant operations and be able to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.

Roles and Responsibility


Operate and maintain chemical plant equipment for optimal performance.

Monitor and control chemical processes to meet production targets.

Collaborate with other operators and maintenance staff to troubleshoot issues.

Implement safety procedures and protocols to prevent accidents.

Conduct regular inspections of equipment and facilities to identify areas for improvement.

Develop and implement process improvements to increase efficiency and reduce costs.


Job Requirements


Bachelor's degree in Chemistry or related field.

Proven experience as an operator in a chemical plant setting.

Strong knowledge of chemical processes and equipment operation.

Excellent problem-solving and communication skills.

Ability to work effectively in a team environment.

Familiarity with safety protocols and regulations.

Description:
About The/Nudge
The/Nudge is an action institute building resilient livelihoods to alleviate poverty. We work with women, farmers, tribals and youth on rural development, agriculture, skilling and economic inclusion, along with 15+ central and state government partners.

Our economic inclusion journey for 25 million Indians, has reached 10 states with $250M of government funding to cover 1.25M people. Our incubator, accelerator and grand challenges have supported 200+ social entrepreneurs including 17 Forbes 30U30, 3 EarthShot Prize winners, 1 Time Magazine cover and more.

Set up with support from 90+ eminent philanthropists , 40+ corporates and 15+ foundations including Gates, Mackenzie Scott, Vinod Khosla, Nandan Nilekani, Tata Trusts, Skoll, Meta, LinkedIn, HDFC, Mphasis, KPMG and LOreal, we are contributing towards a "poverty-free India, within our lifetime".

What are we solving for
We are solving for households in poverty who are also financially and socially vulnerable through a targeted, multi-faceted, and sequenced model called the graduation approach, which has demonstrated that we can durably pull households out of poverty.
At The/Nudge Institute, we are in the process of catalyzing the propagation of the same. Our purpose is to contribute to making the most excluded individuals a contributing member to the economy:

Enable govt to adopt by providing research, design, and implementation support
Continue to implement on its own to iterate the design for impact at scale
Enable more NGOs to adopt technical and capacity-building support
Continue to generate data on poverty and evidence on graduation approach to nudge governments to adopt at-scale
Build technology solutions for NGOs and governments to adopt and implement at scale & with quality.

What will you do
The/Nudge is working with various state SRLMs to help increase adoption of the graduation approach/ economic inclusion program by targeting vulnerable rural women through community institutions.
To understand and practice the Spirits of The/Nudge Institute and the respective SRLMs
Ensure all project activities are implemented on time with utmost quality as per approved Project Implementation Plan (PIP)/ Standard Operating Procedure (SoP)/ Package of Practice (PoP)/ Community Operational Manual (COM) in the respective districts.
Support the district in projects under PVTG Domain.
Coordinate with DMMU and BMMU to ensure smooth implementation of the project .
Coordinate and facilitate in organizing capacity building training of project team and community.
Coordinate and lead in organizing any project related event at regional and district.
Coordinate and support in any field visits of dignitaries and officials.
Ensure timely planning and implementation of project activities.
Ensure proper documentation and reporting related to the project to respective offices.
Facilitate the timely collection/ entry, processing and reporting of data.
Support and practice monitoring & evaluation of projects.
Good stakeholder management at the grassroots level.

Who are we looking for in this role
Candidate must be graduate; post-graduate will be preferred, in relevant streams like rural development, rural management, agriculture, forestry, social work, anthropology etc.
Candidate must have 4-6 years of relevant experience in the development sector/ rural development projects/ poverty eradication projects/ livelihood promotion projects/ tribal development projects.
Candidate with work experience working in district-level positions in National Rural Livelihood Mission/ State Rural Livelihood Missions in Institution Building, Capacity Building, Social Inclusion, Social Development, and Livelihood promotion will be preferred.
The candidate must have her/his own two-wheeler with a valid driving license as it is a field job.
This position is based in The Location for this role is Mawkyrwat , South West Khasi Hills

What s in it for you

Own your growth: An impact-led learning environment encourages Nudgesters to invest in their learning and capacity building needs through initiatives and policies, including L&D wallet, individual development plan and internal role change opportunities.
Find your tribe: Our hiring philosophy emphasises intent, attitude, smarts and skills, in that order, to build a cohesive environment for Nudgesters. The organisation is committed to curating people-centric policies, enhancing how employees experience life at The/Nudge.
Take big bets: Organisational initiatives are intended to facilitate Nudgesters with a view to the big picture, illustrated by our impact across 50000+ households, 15+ governments, 200+ social enterprises and Charcha: India s largest social sector convening forum.
Make it happen: A product-based approach in an action-biased environment empowers Nudgesters to implement audacious plans. Driven to fail fast, we endeavour to optimise resources in favour of programs that align with our scale ambition.

You can learn more about what we do and how we do it through this deck .

We aspire to be an inclusive and diverse organization and encourage qualified individuals irrespective of their religion, caste, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, ethnicity, age, or any other dimension of identity, to apply.

Description:
Company : Bharti Axa Life Insurance

Designation :DM - Agency Channel

Job Summary:
The Relationship Manager Agency Channel is responsible for driving life insurance sales through the recruitment, development, and management of insurance advisors. The role involves identifying potential advisors, providing product and sales training, motivating them to achieve business targets, and ensuring high levels of customer service. The incumbent will work closely with advisors to generate quality business, expand market reach, and contribute to the overall growth of the Agency Channel.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Generate business through advisor-led sales while ensuring achievement of monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets.
Conduct regular field visits with advisors to support customer acquisition, lead generation, and policy closures.
Identify new business opportunities through personal networking, referrals, local market activities, and customer interactions.
Build and maintain strong relationships with advisors to improve productivity, retention, and business performance.
Support advisors during customer meetings, presentations, and financial planning discussions to improve conversion rates.
Monitor advisor performance using MIS reports and provide continuous feedback to improve productivity.
Prepare and execute business development plans to increase market penetration and achieve branch objectives.
Ensure quality business by maintaining high policy persistency, minimizing cancellations, and reducing claim-related issues.
Coordinate with Branch Managers and internal support teams for smooth business processing and policy issuance.
Ensure timely documentation, KYC compliance, proposal submissions, premium collections, and policy servicing.
Drive customer awareness regarding life insurance solutions and financial protection through local campaigns and promotional activities.
Participate in branch sales meetings, review discussions, and performance planning sessions.

CTC Up to 5 LPA

Location : GUWAHATI , TINSUKIA , SHILLONG

Key Skill:

Excellent communication, interpersonal and selling skill • Strong problem solving skills and decision making ability

MINIMUM/SPECIFIC EXPERIENCE:

Graduate/ Post Graduate in any discipline

Organisation: I Create India
I Create India, a not-for-profit organization, is focused on Entrepreneurship Development at Grassroots level. Over the last 25 years it has helped create more than 7,000 entrepreneurs in the country. Indian Army Veterans form a significant portion of these numbers.
Entrepreneurship Development of Indian Army Veterans is a flagship program of I Create India. These BICs provide entrepreneurial skills and help veterans convert their entrepreneurial dreams into business reality in their second innings.

The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in B2B sales within the renewable energy sector, with a proven ability to navigate complex procurement processes, negotiate long-term contracts, and deliver scalable solar solutions. As a critical link between the organization and its enterprise clients, the Area Sales Manager plays a pivotal role in advancing sustainable energy adoption, contributing to corporate sustainability goals, and strengthening the companys position as a leader in the solar industry.

Responsibilities
Develop and execute regional sales strategies aligned with company growth objectives and market opportunities in the solar energy sector.
Lead, mentor, and manage a team of B2B sales representatives, ensuring performance excellence through coaching, goal setting, and regular feedback.
Identify, qualify, and pursue new commercial and industrial B2B prospects, focusing on solar PV system installations for businesses, manufacturing facilities, and institutional clients.
Build and maintain strategic relationships with key decision-makers at enterprise accounts, including facility managers, sustainability officers, and procurement teams.
Collaborate with technical and project development teams to deliver customized solar solutions that meet client energy needs and financial objectives.
Analyze market trends, competitor activity, and customer behavior to refine sales approaches and improve win rates.
Prepare and present detailed proposals, financial models, and ROI analyses to support client decision-making.
Track and report on sales pipeline, forecast accuracy, and KPIs using CRM platforms to ensure transparency and data-driven planning.
Ensure compliance with industry regulations, safety standards, and company policies throughout the sales and project handoff process.

Requirements
Requirements:
Bachelors degree in Business, Engineering, Renewable Energy, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
Proven experience (5+ years) in B2B sales, with a strong track record of exceeding sales targets in the renewable energy, clean tech, or construction industry.
In-depth knowledge of solar energy systems, including photovoltaic (PV) technology, financing models (PPA, lease, cash purchase), and incentive programs (e.g., ITC, state rebates).
Demonstrated ability to manage complex sales cycles involving multi-stakeholder decision-making and long-term contracts.
Proficiency in CRM software (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot) and Microsoft Office Suite for reporting, forecasting, and client presentations.
Strong negotiation, presentation, and interpersonal skills with the ability to influence at the executive level.
Valid drivers license and willingness to travel extensively within the assigned region.
Experience in team leadership and performance management, including hiring, training, and performance evaluation.
Familiarity with sustainability metrics and ESG reporting is a plus.

Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance

Description:
BACKGROUND
The Hans Foundation (THF), established in 2009, is a Public Charitable Trust that works towards creating an equitable society to enhance quality of life for all through the empowerment of marginalized and underprivileged communities in India. The Hans Foundation works for the Health and Wellbeing of remote and under-served groups, with an additional focus on children, persons with disabilities and women. THF also works for holistic Education and Livelihood development of our communities. Our Two-Fold Strategy involves identifying and working within Aspirational Districts and high poverty index in the North, North-East and East regions within specific states, as well as catering to lower-income and migratory populations in cities, through urban programs.
Over its 15 years of existence, THF has reached more than 35 million beneficiaries through its programs. THF works with communities through direct implementation of projects on the ground in addition to providing local management and monitoring support to not-for-profit organisations in India funded through THF USA and RIST.

PROJECT OVERVIEW: HANS HEALTH & WELLNESS CENTRE

The Hans Health & Wellness Centre, Meghalaya, is a transformative initiative aimed at addressing the fundamental healthcare needs of rural and hard-to-reach populations. Recognizing the limitations of government resources, The Hans Foundation (THF) has committed to bridging the gap by taking over 50 sub-centres in the first phase. This project is designed to make a substantial impact on health parameters, particularly in reducing maternal mortality rates. Through a meticulous gap assessment, THF will provide the necessary equipment and facilities, deploy skilled human resources, and ensure comprehensive training to meet the project s demands. The initiative is not just a short-term intervention but a long-term commitment, with regular operations and monitoring to ensure sustained improvement. THF envisions this project as a model for community healthcare at the grassroots level, aspiring to set a benchmark that other states might seek to replicate, ultimately expanding its reach across the region in a phased manner.


GENERAL
Location of Job: Ribhoi, Meghalaya
Type of Employment: Contractual for 1 year, renewable basis performance
No. of Position: 1
Reporting to: Project Manager
JOB PURPOSE
The Project Coordinator will be responsible for successful implementation of field level activities and will report to Project Manager.
1. Duties and Responsibilities:
The key responsibilities of this position are as given below:
Responsible for implementation of the project activities at the field level and coordination with other external stakeholders at the project area level.
Support the MMU team in mobilizing the community for taking up the MMU services.
Facilitate in compliance with government norms with respect to MMU operations.
Coordinate baseline survey and project monitoring.
Identify Health workers from the community and support their recruitment
process
Support Senior Project Coordinator /Project Manager in preparing MMU movement schedule and ensure effective implementation of all the project activities.
Responsible for tracking of MMUs through GPS tracking and other mechanism.
Prepare all reports and documentation related to the project, such as MIS reports, financial reports, narrative reports, field observation and visit reports, collection and compilation of case studies and photographs.
Coordinate with various departments/institutions like Health Sub Centres (HSCs), Primary Health Centres (PHCs), Community Health Centres (CHCs), PRI members, Women Self Help Groups, Village Health Sanitation and Nutrition Committees etc.
Liaison with Health and other line departments in district and blocks, ensuring their support and involvement in the project activities.
Conduct regular field visits to monitor and the project progress and provide supportive supervision to the teams and village health workers as and when required.
Other tasks which may be assigned by the Project Manager from time to time.
2. Other Indicative Requirements
Educational Qualifications
Graduation in Social Sciences/ any relevant field, preferable to have a diploma or certificate in computer application

Functional / Technical Skills and Relevant Experience & Other requirements (Behavioural, Language, Certifications etc.)
Experiences of more than 3 years, ideally with a public health program or non-profit or organization
Ability to work independently and as part of a team, with strong project management skills.
Demonstrated passion for social impact and development sector.
Good communication and documentation skills in English and Hindi.
Data analysis, reporting and presentation skills.
Leadership and team management skills.
Willingness to travel extensively in remote areas.
THF is an equal opportunity employer that encourages women, people with disabilities and those from economically and socially excluded communities with the requisite skills and qualifications to apply for positions. We do not discriminate in employment on the basis of caste, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, or any other such matter.

Description:
In Meghalaya, the program is expanding its content localization, training, and user feedback integration. As an ECCE Language Expert, you will support the development and contextualization of early learning content in your assigned local language. You will help ensure that video-based and activity-based content is culturally relevant, pedagogically sound and easy to understand for Anganwadi workers and caregivers in your community.
Job Overview
Location: Shillong, Meghalaya. Regular travel across districts.
Number of Positions
3 (one each for Khasi, Garo and Jaintia)
Key Responsibilities
Translate and adapt educational scripts and materials into Khasi / Garo / Jaintia, ensuring cultural and linguistic relevance
Collaborate with content experts and media producers to support scripting, dubbing and reviewing video content
Participate in user testing of content with Anganwadi workers; integrate feedback into content improvement
Support in the training of field staff (District Coordinators etc.) to ensure accurate delivery and usage of the localized content
Ensure all content aligns with MECDM ECCE priorities and national ECCE frameworks
Provide ongoing feedback to the content team for continuous improvement of content delivery and training practices
Required Qualifications
Degree or certification in ECE, Education, Child Development, or related fields
Fluency in Khasi / Garo / Jaintia (depending on position) and working proficiency in English
1-3 years of experience in ECCE curriculum development, teacher training, teaching or related education roles
Familiarity with local culture and early learning practices in Meghalaya
Comfort working with digital tools and collaborating with cross-functional teams
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, especially in training settings
Willingness to travel to districts for user testing and training sessions

With a mission to bridge learning gaps, Rocket Learning positions itself as a catalyst for scalable, inclusive, and quality education for children.

AboutCompany:
Woodland Hospital is a Multi-Specialty Hospital situated at the heart of the city at Dhankheti, Shillong which was established in 21st March 1991 as a Proprietary concern. Considering the paucity of standard medical facilities available in the state, Dr. W. Kharshiing and his wife Mrs. Margret Wahlang decided to start a Nursing Home offering better alternatives to the patients of the medically deficient state. It was such a dream that few may have been imagined to see in its present form.
The hospital was started with 28 Indoor beds, two Operation Theatres viz; One Major & One Minor, along with the very basic Diagnostic facilities likes: Pathology, X-Ray, Ultra-Sonography etc. The Departments were limited to General Surgery, Obstetrics & Gynecology, Pediatrics and ENT. During the year 1994, the hospital was expanded to 56 bed capacity. The New Operation Theatre Complex, a CT Scan Machine and four bedded Intensive Care Unit were also added to meet the increasing demands of the people. The CT scan was the first one the State had ever seen in1995.
The hospital went on to Expand to 120 beds during the year 2001 with the addition of an annexed building. Woodland Hospital has always strived to introduce the latest advancements of medical technology and it introduced the Medical Resonance Imaging (MRI) the first one in the state in 2002. At present the hospital expanded to 160 beds with the addition of another annexed building in 2013. The Hospital is the only Hospital in the state which is well equipped with the ultra modern facilities.
In 2006 the Department of Pathology has been accredited by the National Accreditation Board for Testing & Calibration Laboratories (NABL) for Medical Testing and has been given the Certificate Number M-0213 in accordance with the ISO 15189:2007. The Department of Pathology of the Hospital is the first one in the entire state and the only fourth institution in the entire North East India to be accredited in the field of Medical Blood Testing by NABL at that point of time. This stature is not only the recognition of our expertise in the field for the past works done but is also the boost for the Department of Pathology to continue doing the same for ever. Woodland Hospital, Shillong is also NABH pre accredited.
On 15th September 2020, Woodland WK Hospital was inaugurated at Jowai in West Jaintia Hills District of Meghalaya. It is a 100 bedded Multispecialty Hospital having General beds, Semi-private beds and Single rooms. It is equipped with 14 I.C.U beds and 6 Neonatal I.C.U beds. It also has 3 Operation Theatres, 12 Dialysis beds, Endoscopy, X-Ray, CT- Scan, U.S.G, Department of Pathology and Department of Microbiology. Other services include O.P.D and I.P.D and round the clock Emergency Services. All Doctors quarters are within the Hospital premises.
Our other diagnostics centres are Woodland Medical Centre, Ladthalaboh, Jowai, Bell View Diagnostic Clinic, Mawkhar, Shillong, Woodland Diagnostic Centre, Nongkseh, Upper Shillong and Woodland Institute of Nursing, Latikor, Shillong

Description:
Job Purpose
Job Purpose Description
Job Context & Major Challenges
Job Context: Responsible for day to day operational, financial, commercial & administrative activities of the branch. Ensuring 100% compliance to regulatory and organizational guidelines.
Job Challenges: Consistent delivery of 100% accuracy across wide range of activities amid rapidly changing processes, diverse organizational guidelines , adaptation to regular extended working hours, seasonal & un predictable spike in volumes with limited or no system validations.
Maintaining confidentiality of information and documentation despite lack of infrastructure and support
Operating multiple systems (in excess of 15) despite server band width and connectivity issues
Handling Sales behaviour effectively in order to ensure compliance to internal and external guidelines
Key Result Areas KRA (Accountabilities) (Max 1325 Characters) Supporting Actions (Max 1325 Characters) KRA1 Execute financial processes timely with 100% accuracy 1. Execute the receipting, banking and reconciliation processes accurately for policy cash/Cheque/DD within timelines as per the set process. 2. Detection of Fake note to avoid operational loss 3. Cheque Dishonour Management. 4. Safe custody of both sets of Safe and cash box Keys and one set of office keys. 5. Timely reconciliation of assets of the branch. 6. Ensure genuineness of petty cash spends, timely raising and recording. KRA10 Execute Advisor Licensing process & extend Sales Support 13. Contact updation in BSLI online of Advisors and FLS 14. Contactability enhancement at NB stage,post welcome call followed by CRT. 15. Preparation of Various MIS related to BSLI Way and updation of Various Dash Boards. 16. Coordination with various institutes, approved by Training Head, for the training of new Insurance Applicant. 17. Re exam scheduling of failed candidates in coordination with BH/AMs 18. Coordination with RHR for offer letter generation for FLS 19. Arrangement of Various training programmes in Branches coordinating with Training manager and BM/BH. 20. Downloading various process to Sales team during morning huddle (BSLI Way). 21. Ensure timely opening and closing of office premises KRA2 Provide commercial support 1. Identify local vendors and facilitate their registration as per procurement guidelines. 2. Procurement of vendor bills, establishing genuineness and timely payment as per agreement. 3. Encourage NEFT registrations of vendors. 4. Support lease agreement registration and renewal process. 5. New branch set up- coordination with various functions like IT/Infra/banking/ZOPS/DSF for smooth functions of branch. KRA3 Extend Legal , Compliance and Taxation support 1. Timely remittance of professional and work contract tax. 2. Represent company on behalf of compliance/HO for hearing matters in labour/consumer court. 3. Timely updates to HO on receipt of any notice from Tax authorities/labour offices/employment exchange/Local municipal offices. 4. Ensure statutory displays at branches. 5. Ensure 100% compliance of AML guidelines, identification and reporting of suspicious & fraudulent operational and financial transactions. 6. Adherence to BCP guidelines. KRA4 A- Handle Advisor commission process B- Provide HR/IT/Admin support A- 1. Timely Updation & handover of Commission chq to Advisors. 2. Encourage NEFT with advisors and FLS. 3. Resolve commission related queries of advisor. 4. Ensure timely receipts and hand-over of TDS certificate to advisors. B- 1. Manage joining and exit formalities for concerned employees at the branch, including full and final settlement process. 2. Log calls in case of downtime/pursue with Corporate IT. 3. Monitor and ensure housekeeping, security and dispatch services are rendered in an uninterrupted and cost effective manner. 4. Handle physical resource booking like meeting rooms, projectors, etc. KRA5 Execute Underwriting and New Business processes 1. Scrutinise New Business applications as per the SOPs to ensure 100% input accuracy to enhance straight through processing and issuance to submission ratio. 2. Arrange speedy pick up of medical reports from medical labs and timely transmission of applications, medical reports, requirements via scanning and indexing with 100% accuracy. 3. Collaborate with head office process owners/vendors to facilitate faster issuance. 4. Ensure timely and accurate updation and delivery of policy documents/refund cheques in adherence to set standards. KRA6 Provide prompt, accurate and courteous Customer Service 1. Ensure 1st contact resolution at the branch for all internal & external customers & track requests through prescribed systems ensuring 100% accuracy and timely closure. 2. Scrutinise claims documentation as per set guidelines and coordination with sales force and claimant for speedy fulfilment of claim requirements. 3. Ensure 100% accurate and timely scrutiny & processing of reinstatement, fund switch, financial payout requests & other customer requests on the same day to avoid Gain/Loss. Customer identity & signature to be verified to establish genuineness of the transaction. 4. Proactively participate in data cleansing exercise for both internal & external customers in respect of Bank details, PAN card Information, contact details & undelivered communications. KRA7 Contribute to Revenue Generation & conservation at every single opportunity & instance. 1. Encourage NEFT enrolment for internal & external customers 2. Participating in Persistency drive by sharing data with sales force & contacting customers for the allocated data base. 3. Encourage use of self help tools like Go Green, ECS activation, alternate payment options by customers. 4. Enhance contactability of the customers by collecting contact details. 5. Participate in cost savings initiatives. 6. Actively endeavour towards containing Freelook/ Surrender / withdrawal at branches by convincing customers. 7. Actively engage with visiting customers to enhance revenue generation for the business by way of promoting Riders & top up adding to incremental premium on the existing policies for the Co. KRA8 Contribute to Revenue Generation & conservation at every single opportunity & instance. 8. Intimate & pursue cheque dishonour cases with the respective sales team members / customer both at new business & renewal stage & strive for repayment to conserve the revenue. 9. Identify & report fraudulent claims by providing proof / information to Claims team and get involved with the investigation as much required and sought. 10. Prevent Fraudulent / Fake Policies from issuance by Branches by controlling the document verification and reporting to Compliance & UW 11. Save cost (on controllable expenses) at Branches on Electricity, Stationery, Photocopying, Staff Welfare, Other Miscellaneous Expenses etc KRA9 Execute Advisor Licensing process & extend Sales Support 1. First time right application processing for New advisor and license renewal 2. Support BM on Recruitment plan is executed properly and the candidates are nominated for Pre Licensed training 3. Description:
ABOUT THE HANS FOUNDATION
The Hans Foundation (THF), established in 2009, is a Public Charitable Trust that works towards creating an equitable society to enhance quality of life for all through the empowerment of marginalized and underprivileged communities in India. The Hans Foundation works for the Health and Wellbeing of remote and under-served groups, with an additional focus on children, persons with disabilities and women. THF also works for holistic Education and Livelihood development of our communities. Our Two-Fold Strategy involves identifying and working within Aspirational Districts and high poverty index in the North, North-East and East regions within specific states, as well as catering to lower-income and migratory populations in cities, through urban programs.
Over its 15 years of existence, THF has reached more than 35 million beneficiaries through its programs. THF works with communities through direct implementation of projects on the ground in addition to providing local management and monitoring support to not-for-profit organisations in India funded through THF USA and RIST.
PROJECT OVERVIEW: HANS HEALTH WELLNESS CENTRE
The Hans Health Wellness Centre, Meghalaya, is a transformative initiative aimed at addressing the fundamental healthcare needs of rural and hard-to-reach populations. Recognizing the limitations of government resources, The Hans Foundation (THF) has committed to bridging the gap by taking over 50 sub-centres in the first phase. This project is designed to make a substantial impact on health parameters, particularly in reducing maternal mortality rates. Through a meticulous gap assessment, THF will provide the necessary equipment and facilities, deploy skilled human resources, and ensure comprehensive training to meet the project s demands. The initiative is not just a short-term intervention but a long-term commitment, with regular operations and monitoring to ensure sustained improvement. THF envisions this project as a model for community healthcare at the grassroots level, aspiring to set a benchmark that other states might seek to replicate, ultimately expanding its reach across the region in a phased manner.
GENERAL
Location of Job: Rongchongre SC - South Garo Hills (Meghalaya)
Type of Employment: Contractual for a period of one year, renewable basis of performance and project requirements
No. of Position: 1
Reporting to: Project Coordinator
1. JOB PURPOSE
Nurse (ANM/GNM) will be responsible for providing preventive, promotive and curative health care services through VHSND in the assigned villages. S/he will accompany the team and will be responsible for providing counselling services to the community and other field level communication, counseling and health education support to the program. S/he will ensure participation of the community. S/he will maintain records of patient registrations and provide health education using IEC materials.
2. KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES
Visit along with the team in VHSND Programs.
Ensure support and work in coordination with local community workers such as Anganwadi workers, ASHA workers for effective service delivery.
Provide preventive, promotive and curative health care services.
Conduct individual and group sessions on reproductive health, mother and child health and nutrition, communicable and non-communicable diseases, and adolescent health.
Support in the management of Sub Center especially, record keeping, management of the patient flow and medicine distribution.
Coordinate to refer the patients to nearest health facility for secondary level treatment and follow up.
Responsible for supervision of village health workers and their capacity building.
Maintain relevant reports and documents.
3. Other Indicative Requirements
Educational Qualifications : Bachelor s degree in nursing /ANM/GNM training or a related field with good knowledge in public health or hospitals
Functional / Technical Skills and Relevant Experience Other requirements (Behavioural, Language, Certifications etc.)
Experience of working in field/clinic for 1-3 years.
The candidate should be well versed with Hindi and local dialect.
Community mobilization and communication skills
THF is an equal opportunity employer that encourages women, people with disabilities and those from economically and socially excluded communities with the requisite skills and qualifications to apply for positions. We do not discriminate in employment on the basis of caste, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, or any other such matter.

Description:
Job Description
Title: State Academic Expert: Partnership and Trainings;- Level 1
Location: Shillong, Meghalaya
Language: Garo and Khasi
Key Responsibilities
1. Develop and implement processes for high-quality curriculum development aligned with national standards for parents and educators in the public education system, targeting ages 0-3 and 3-6.
2. Lead the content and training material creation process for different ECCE domains in Hindi and English language (ideation, shooting video footage, coordinating with media editors, coordinating with Teacher Professional Development Team)
3. Support in Scripting / Translation / dubbing / production and Quality Management of all content produced in Hindi/English Language along with other representatives from Education Team
4. Plan and anchor pilot-testing/user-testing across various content formats videos, games, worksheets, images and polls to assess effectiveness of RLs curriculum and to integrate user feedback into content development.
5. Review curriculum monthly and annual plans for Parent and Teacher product in assigned geographies with Junior/Associate State ECCE Experts
6. Support in optimizing the Learning Management System (LMS) to ensure full functionality, including automated scheduling, content uploads, and user engagement for Hindi curriculum packets.
7. Offer support to align the curriculum with state requirements and national standards to ensure efficient content distribution and meeting of educational goals,for assigned geos along with SMEs.
8. Build relationships/support in maintaining relationships with external stakeholders, as per requirements.
9. Participate in monthly and quarterly check-ins with Operations Teams of assigned geos to continuously improve and customize educational content as per state and national standards along with SME.
10. Observe/support/conduct internal and external team training facilitation (both in-person and online) to enhance technical proficiency in assigned geos along with other Education team experts.
11. Conduct frequent field visits to observe and maintain quality checks on trainings and provide mentor support.
12. Join selected geo-specific WhatsApp groups to perform quality checks on the TP/PP journey and provide semi-annual reports of insights for assigned geos.
13. Plan and conduct field visits for assigned-geos for observations/ training/ research.
14. Support in development of interactive educational games and technologies
15. Support cross-team functions and collaboration for all assigned geo-initiatives/pilot programs, address ad hoc requests, troubleshoot issues, and innovate educational approaches and technologies.
16. Enhance team skills and cohesiveness through participation in and initiation of regular professional development and team building activities.
Critical Factors for Success
Degree or certification in Early Childhood Care and Education/Education/Child Psychology and Development/Teacher Training/Social Work.
8-10 years of work experience in education either as a curriculum developer, teacher or on teacher training programs.
Have a strong understanding of how children learn and develop in their early years.
Interest in developing expertise in the development of digital and offline instructional tools.
Be comfortable presenting in front of the camera.
Willingness to travel a few days each month for field visits, training and educational shoots.
Willingness to participate and provide need-based support with additional requirements for growth of team and organization
Be able to adapt to the demands of a young, fast-growing organization.
Be comfortable working with technology in a remote-work environment
Be fluent in Garo, Khasi, English and have a working knowledge of Hindi.
Knowledge of other regional languages is a bonus.
