Description:
Finance Controller
About the job Finance Controller
The position is the most senior person within Finance responsible for all the financial matter,
Reporting to the local CFO. S/he is responsible for but not limited to :
1. Ensuring compliance to meet corporate headquarter needs, adhering to all external
compliance requirements of the Government, auditors. Banks in India and ensuring
compliance to India GAAP etc
2. Ensure completion of yearly group and company audit
3. Leading internal controls improvement work by ensuring documentation and
adequate processes are in place
4. Being the owner of the ERP system Zoho/ Tally so that data is inputted in the system
right from the beginning in accordance with operational requirements and india
GAAP.
5. Lead and prepare regular analytical financial reports, financial statements to Group
for consolidation and reports to local management.
Hands-on Operational & Financial Responsibilities

1. Statutory Compliance related to financial statements, GST, taxable income and ensure,
timely hands on reconciliation and payments of taxes and filling of annual returns, and
hands-on TDS (Tax deducted at source) reconciliation and checking
2. Financial Reporting and Audits
Bookkeeping and Accounting: Maintaining accurate books of accounts in our ERP system in
line with the operations and ensuring they also comply with India Accounting Standards and
group financial standards for timely monthly reporting and statutory audit.
3. Coordinate regulatory and statutory filings and documentation with our partners & legal
personnel (include but not limited to ROC, MGT, AOC-4 etc), AGM
4. Detailed cashflow reporting on expenditure on project level
5. Ownership of ERP system, including setting up the system in the right way for effective costs follow up
6. Lead the fixed asset register reconciliation with General Ledger
7. Timely execution of payments for invoices, payroll within organisation and ensure bank reconciliations is performed monthly
8. Hand-on reconciliation for Group related party transactions calculation, invoicing and bookkeeping in line with transfer pricing and group instructions.
9. Improve internal control processes across the operations ensuring proper approvals,
procedures are adhered to and documentations are available for audit
10.Responsible for timely monthly, quarterly & year-end closing incl reconciliations
11. Lead standardization, improvements & automation of financial processes for efficiency

Qualification and technical skills required to execute the role.
- Successful candidate should be a chartered Accountant with solid 12 to 20 years of
technical accounting knowledge of India GAAP, have eyes for details and have strong
hands on book keeping experience.
- Strong knowledge of local tax, and local statutory compliance requirements.
- Understand project cost accounting
- Should have eye for details and able to roll-up sleeves and execute the operational
responsibilities him/herself
- Strong knowledge of foreign currency regulation and requirements of India banking
requirements
- Should have a strong track record of improving internal controls & compliance for audit
- Should have solid knowledge and hands on experience of working in ERP system like
Zoho and Tally
- Good communication in English and can have strong people management skills as
strength.
- Possess good, reporting presentation skills and organizational skills with international
group reporting experience
- Innovative and creative in coming up with forward looking solutions so that challenges can be overcome in a compliant way
- Willing to grow with the company and be part of our journey in a challenging phase of the scale up of the company.

Description:
Role & responsibilities


We are looking for a Junior Chemist to support chemical testing and quality control activities in the cement manufacturing process. The candidate will be responsible for sampling, testing, analysis, documentation, and ensuring that raw materials, intermediate products, and finished cement meet the required quality standards.
Key Responsibilities
Conduct chemical analysis of raw materials, clinker, cement, and process samples.
Perform routine testing using laboratory instruments and standard chemical methods.
Monitor and maintain chemical parameters such as SiO, AlO, FeO, CaO, MgO, SO, LOI, and other relevant parameters.
Collect and prepare samples from different sections of the cement plant as per established procedures.
Maintain accurate records of test results, laboratory reports, and quality parameters.
Assist in monitoring raw mix, kiln feed, clinker, and cement quality.
Coordinate with Production and Process departments regarding quality deviations and corrective actions.
Ensure proper calibration, operation, and basic maintenance of laboratory equipment.
Maintain laboratory chemicals, glassware, instruments, and testing materials.
Follow established SOPs, safety procedures, and quality standards.
Assist in investigation of quality variations and support root-cause analysis.
Ensure proper housekeeping and safe working practices within the laboratory.
Support internal quality audits and maintain required documentation.
AboutCompany: We are driven by not just our core business of producing superior quality cement, but also the desire to create a positive impact in peoples lives, as well as the environment. Hence, along with world-class labs for quality control, we have a built-in, self-regulating mechanism to encourage a positive impact on the environment, employees, local communities and stakeholders. Sustainability initiatives form a major part of our corporate social responsibility policy and strive to improve living conditions in surrounding areas.

Strong knowledge of cement manufacturing process.
Excellent understanding of raw mix design and pyro process chemistry.
Hands-on experience in XRF, XRD, wet chemical analysis, and laboratory instruments.
Knowledge of clinker quality parameters and process optimization.
Understanding of kiln operation, raw mill, and process quality control.
Knowledge of BIS/IS standards applicable to cement manufacturing.
Laboratory equipment calibration and maintenance.
Proficiency in MS Excel and laboratory reporting.

Description:
We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced Associate Manager to lead our Livelihood Program, with a strong background in EIP. The ideal candidate will have a passion for driving social change and improving the lives of marginalized communities.

Roles and Responsibility


Develop and implement comprehensive livelihood programs to enhance economic opportunities for the target population.

Conduct research and analysis to identify areas of improvement and develop strategies to address them.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design and deliver training programs that meet the needs of the community.

Monitor and evaluate program performance, making data-driven decisions to optimize outcomes.

Build relationships with key stakeholders, including government agencies, NGOs, and community leaders.

Design and manage projects to promote income generation and asset building among program participants.


Job Requirements


Minimum 5 years of experience in a related field, preferably in EIP or livelihood programming.

Strong understanding of social development principles and practices.

Excellent project management skills, with the ability to design and implement effective programs.

Effective communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work with diverse stakeholders.

Ability to analyze complex data sets and make informed decisions.

Experience working with technology-based solutions to drive social change is an added advantage.


About Company

The Nudge Institute is a leading organization committed to creating innovative solutions for social change, with a focus on leveraging technology to drive impact. We are passionate about empowering marginalized communities and promoting inclusive growth.
